titulo: POUDRE FERMENTÉE DE NATTO DE SOJA ENTIER À FAIBLE ODEUR ET À HAUTE STABILITÉ, SON PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION ET SON APPLICATION
abstract: The present invention discloses a low-odor, high-stability whole-soybean natto fermented powder, a preparation method therefor, and an application thereof. Soybeans are soaked to a moisture content of 58%-64%, cooked and sterilized at 115-121°C, cooled, and inoculated with Bacillus subtilis subsp. natto. The inoculated soybeans are spread to a thickness of 2-4 cm and subjected to solid-state fermentation at 37-41°C for 18-28 hours, followed by low-temperature post-ripening at 8-16°C for 12-36 hours. The post-ripened product is subjected to vacuum low- temperature drying or freeze drying, and then pulverized and sieved at a material temperature not higher than 25°C. The resulting whole-soybean natto fermented powder has reduced off-odor, low water activity, good storage stability, and retained nattokinase, y-polyglutamic acid, and vitamin K2 MK-7, and is suitable for preparing various food products.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ D'EXTRACTION ET DE PRÉPARATION À FAIBLE TENEUR EN OXYGÈNE POUR UNE MATIÈRE PREMIÈRE DE COENZYME Q10 RÉDUITE DE TYPE MITO FAVORISANT L'ABSORPTION MITOCHONDRIALE, ET SON UTILISATION
abstract: The present invention discloses a low-oxygen extraction and preparation method for a MITO-type mitochondrial uptake-promoting reduced coenzyme Q10 raw material, and use thereof. Coenzyme Q10-containing fermentation biomass is subjected to nitrogen-protected slurry preparation, composite-enzyme-assisted cell disruption, and low-temperature extraction with an ethanol-ethyl acetate mixed solvent. The resulting extract is concentrated, purified with neutral alumina and activated carbon, and subjected to biphasic mild reduction using L-sodium ascorbate to obtain a reduced coenzyme Q10 concentrate. Medium-chain triglycerides, plant-derived phospholipids, phosphatidylserine, ascorbyl palmitate, and mixed tocopherols are added to form a reduced coenzyme Q10 lipid phase. The lipid phase is emulsified with γ-cyclodextrin, gum arabic, and resistant dextrin, followed by low-oxygen spray drying or freeze drying. The method improves extraction yield, reduced-state retention, water dispersibility, storage stability, and mitochondrial-fraction enrichment in an in vitro cell uptake model.

titulo: APPAREIL POUR MODIFIER CERTAINES CARACTÉRISTIQUES DU VIN ET DES SPIRITUEUX
abstract: This disclosure relates to methods and systems for treating wines and spirits using electromagnetic induction. A method includes energizing a conduction ring to generate electromagnetic signals between about 50 kHz and 300 kHz and applying the signals such that the wine, spirit, or its vessel forms at least part of a secondary coil. The treatment improves organoleptic properties and/or inhibits microbial proliferation and may enhance heat treatment and aging acceleration. The electromagnetic signals may induce electric fields of about 1-5,000 V/cm and power levels of about 1-2,000 W, applied for about 1 second to 24 hours at various production stages from pre-fermentation to bottling. A corresponding system includes a conduction ring, an electrical signal source configured to energize the ring, and a secondary coil at least partially defined by the wine, spirit, or its vessel, and may include conductors, flexible magnetic transducers, and wireless drive circuitry.

titulo: CULTURE, RÉCOLTE ET FERMENTATION ASEPTIQUE DE CELLULES DE CACAO CULTIVÉES DANS UNE CULTURE EN SUSPENSION
abstract: Methods for processing cell cultured plant cells, e.g., cell culture cacao cells, from cellular agriculture are provided. The cell cultured plant cells are dewatered one or more times in a dewatering apparatus to remove some or most of the growth media and/or an aseptic fermentation solution. The cell mass in the aseptic fermentation solution is incubated in an incubation apparatus to aseptically ferment the cell mass and generate an aseptically fermented cell mass. Cell-based cacao products with the aseptically fermented cell mass are provided. Systems for conducting the aseptically fermented cell mass are also included.

titulo: MÉTHODES DE FERMENTATION DE GLUCIDES
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for fermenting carbohydrate comprising a compound having formula (I), a use of said compound compound for improving growth, uptake, metabolization and/or fermentation of carbohydrate by a yeast, and for increasing ethanol production of a yeast.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ EN CONTINU DE PRODUCTION D'ÉTHANOL PAR L'UTILISATION D'UNE EXTRUDEUSE À DOUBLE VIS ET DE LA SACCHARIFICATION ET DE LA FERMENTATION SIMULTANÉES
abstract: The present invention relates to a continuous process for producing ethanol from corn, wherein a twin-screw extruder replaces a conventional jet cooker. In the process, ground corn is fed into the twin-screw extruder, and water together with at least one starch-hydrolyzing enzyme is introduced into the extruder. Under the combined effects of pressure, temperature, and mechanical shear forces generated within the extruder, the starch is gelatinized and liquefied. Heat generated within the extruder supplies at least a portion of the thermal energy required for the process, thereby reducing reliance on external heat sources. The extruder outlet is subsequently subjected to further hydrolysis, cooling, fermentation, and distillation to produce ethanol. The process enables control of dry matter content, enzyme addition, reaction conditions, degree of hydrolysis, and Dextrose Equivalent (DE).

In particular, the yeast strains produce higher ethanol and lower glycerol and residual sugars, and have a higher temperature tolerance and higher fermentation rate than strains and products currently used in ethanol production processes.

titulo: MASQUE POUR LE SOIN DES MATIÈRES KÉRATINIQUES
abstract: Provided is a mask, preferably for caring for keratin materials, comprising: A) a gel comprising at least one non-ionic polysaccharide selected from homopolymers of mannose, copolymers of mannose and glucose, copolymers of mannose and galactose, and a combination thereof, and B) a composition soaked in the gel, comprising: a) at least one acidic fermentation extract; and b) at least one polyglyceryl fatty acid ester. It also relates to a non-therapeutic process for caring for keratin materials with said mask.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ DE PRODUCTION D'ALDONATE D'AMMONIUM ET PROCÉDÉ DE CULTURE DE MICRO-ORGANISME
abstract: The present invention provides a technique that enables efficient production of a target substance, wherein the target substance is produced by fermentation using a microorganism, and a biomass-derived aldose liquid is used. More specifically, the present invention provides a method for producing an ammonium aldonate, the method comprising: (1) producing an aldonic acid from an aldose in a first aqueous solution containing a biomass-derived aldose liquid by using an aldose oxidase-producing microorganism or an aldose oxidase; (2) producing a calcium aldonate precipitate in a second aqueous solution by precipitating the aldonic acid as a calcium aldonate using a calcium salt; (3) isolating the calcium aldonate precipitate from the second aqueous solution; and (4) producing an ammonium aldonate from the calcium aldonate precipitate in a third aqueous solution by using ammonia or an ammonium salt.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ DE PRODUCTION DE LA VITAMINE K2 (MÉNAQUINONE-7, MK-7) BIOMK7™ À PARTIR DE POIS CHICHES FERMENTÉS, AINSI QUE DE PRODUITS ET DE FORMULATIONS DE HAUTE PURETÉ DÉRIVÉS DE CELLE-CI
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method for producing vitamin K2 (menaquinone-7, MK-7) BIOMK7™ from fermented chickpeas (Cicer arietinum). The method comprises solid-state fermentation using a non-genetically modified strain of Bacillus subtilis ASNT3, extraction with bioethanol as a green solvent, concentration by rotary evaporation, and solvent recovery through a closed-loop system, followed by purification using chromatographic techniques. The process yields MK-7 with a purity of about 90% to 99% in an all-trans configuration, a residual solvent content of less than about 0.5%, and a moisture content of less than about 2%. The concentrated extract or purified MK-7 may be formulated into self-nano emulsifying drug delivery systems (SNEDDS), cold-water displaceable microencapsulation systems, or veterinary nutritional supplements. Such formulations may optionally incorporate additional vitamins, minerals, essential fatty acids, carotenoids, or phytosterols. The disclosed BIOMK7™ products are suitable for use in dietary supplements, nutraceuticals, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, functional foods, and veterinary applications.

titulo: EARTHWORM-PIG MANURE FERMENTED BACTERIAL FERTILIZER AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREOF
abstract: The present invention discloses an earthworm-pig manure fermented bacterial fertilizer and its preparation method, belonging to the technical field of agricultural organic fertilizers. The preparation method includes: (1) mixing pig manure with a conditioner to adjust moisture content and C/N ratio; (2) inoculating a composite microbial agent for primary high-temperature aerobic fermentation to obtain decomposed material A; (3) inoculating earthworms into decomposed material A for secondary biotransformation to obtain earthworm cast decomposed material B; (4) drying, crushing and sieving earthworm cast decomposed material B to obtain the finished product. Through the synergy of two-stage processes of microbial fermentation and earthworm transformation, the present invention realizes rapid, efficient harmless treatment and resource utilization of pig manure. The obtained bacterial fertilizer has comprehensive nutrients, high activity, and is rich in humic acid and beneficial microorganisms.

titulo: Fermenting pharmaceuticals to reduce adduct risks coupled with functional enzyme metrics
abstract: [0000]    Disclosed are kits, methods, systems, and devices for reducing mutagen-related biomolecular adduct risk during pharmacotherapy. A therapeutic agent comprising an active pharmaceutical ingredient or a therapeutic supplement is combined with one or more adjunct components selected from probiotics, antioxidants, buffering agents, chelators, plant-derived materials, algae-derived materials, enzymes, vitamins, and combinations thereof to form a mixture that is fermented prior to oral or topical administration. Biomarker data comprising one or more adductomic endpoints is obtained from a subject and compared with functional protein metrics and comparator data, thus subsequent preparation cycles are adjusted by modifying one or more fermentation parameters including duration, temperature, pH, light exposure, concentration, and/or order of adjunct addition. Clinical, pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic, and/or functional protein metrics are used to guide adjustment. System embodiments include one or more kits, compositions, vessels, and instructions configured to output updated preparation instructions while maintaining intended therapeutic efficacy.

titulo: FERMENTED PIG FEED AND APPLICATION THEREOF
abstract: The present invention discloses a fermented pig feed and its application, belonging to the technical field of animal feed. The pig feed is prepared by fermenting basic feed raw materials in a specific ratio with a composite microbial agent, where the basic feed raw materials include corn flour, soybean meal, traditional Chinese medicine residue, wheat bran and premix; the composite microbial agent is compounded by Lactobacillus plantarum, Bacillus subtilis and Saccharomyces cerevisiae at a viable count ratio of (2- 3):(1-2):1, and the addition amount is 0.5-2% of the total weight of the raw materials. Its preparation method includes steps such as batching, microbial agent activation, inoculation, and anaerobic fermentation. The present invention also provides an application of the feed in promoting pig growth, improving feed conversion rate, reducing diarrhea and regulating intestinal health.

titulo: Improved method for the production of mussel adhesive protein by engineered yeast fermentation
abstract: The invention discloses a method for producing mussel adhesive protein using genetically engineered yeast such as Pichia pastoris; wherein the genetically engineered yeast may comprise mussel adhesive protein genes fp-1 or fp-2, which may be codon-optimised and integrated into yeast using CRISPR-Cas9 technology. The genetically engineered yeast may also comprise genes related to DOPA modification such as tyrosinase. The method for producing the mussel adhesive protein may comprise fermenting the genetically engineered yeast in a culture medium comprising a carbon source, nitrogen source, and inorganic salts; wherein expression of the mussel adhesive protein may be regulated by using an inducer such as galactose or methanol. The mussel adhesive protein may be extracted via centrifugation and purified using affinity chromatography, ion-exchange chromatography, and gel filtration. The mussel adhesive protein may undergo further chemical modification with N-hydroxysuccinimide (NHS) and 1-ethyl-3-(3dimethylaminopropyl) carbodiimide (EDC). The final purified product product may be freeze-dried and demonstrate a high purity (>95%) and high adhesion strength (70 N/cm2). The mussel adhesive protein is suitable for use in medical adhesives, tissue engineering, drug delivery systems, marine antifouling coatings, and industrial applications. [No figure].

titulo: AN AUTOMATIC CLASSIFIED GARBAGE RECYCLING DEVICE
abstract: The present invention discloses an automatic classified garbage recycling device. The present invention is specially provided with a rolling crushing and retaining assembly. The rolling crushing and retaining assembly is capable of rolling and crushing perishable organic garbage, and during the rolling crushing of the perishable organic garbage, the rolling crushing and retaining assembly is capable of ensuring that at least part of the recyclable garbage is not crushed, so that a perishable garbage and recyclable garbage separation tank can separate the rolled and crushed perishable organic garbage from the recyclable garbage that is not crushed. The organic perishable garbage can be used for fermentation and the like, and the fermented biogas slurry and residue can also be used as organic fertilizer for agriculture, thereby improving environmental protection performance.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ DE PRODUCTION SIMULTANÉE DE XYLOOLIGOSACCHARIDES ET DE PROTÉINE DE LEVURE À PARTIR DE RAFLE DE MAÏS

More specifically, after pretreatment of corn cob, simultaneous saccharification and fermentation of the corn cob can be carried out using a recombinant yeast strain, having Thermoanaerobacterium saccharolyticum-derived endo-xylanase immobilized on the surface thereof, to simultaneously produce xylooligosaccharides (XOS) and yeast protein, and the xylooligosaccharides (XOS) and yeast protein thus produced can be used as a feed additive composition.

A method for a simple downstream processing strategy to recover 3-hydroxypropionic acid as sodium salt is further provided.

titulo: ARTIFICIAL FERMENTATION METHOD CAPABLE OF IMPROVING CIGAR AROMA FOR CIGAR TOBACCOS
abstract: The present invention belongs to the technical field of processing of cigars, and particularly relates to an artificial fermentation method capable of improving a cigar aroma for cigar tobaccos. According to the artificial fermentation method capable of improving a cigar aroma for cigar tobaccos provided by the present invention, a microbial agent and an aroma enhancing agent are combined for use, such that the ratio of sugar to nitrogen in the cigar tobaccos is balanced through addition of microbial fermentation supernatant and a rum component, and the defects of pungency, bitterness, etc. caused by acid-base imbalance during smoking are overcome. The method provided by the present invention obviously enriches the aroma characteristics of cigars, improves the smoke texture, reduces the greenish off-odor and improves the smoking comfort. The present invention has readily-available raw materials, a simple process and strong operability, thereby having a relatively good application prospect.

applicante: SHANDONG LUTUO ANIMAL PRODUCTS CO LTD
titulo: Microbial fermentation system for beef product processing
abstract: The invention provides a microbial fermentation system for beef product processing, and relates to the technical field of food microbial fermentation, and the microbial fermentation system comprises the following steps: collecting the pH value of the surface of beef and the average thickness and the maximum thickness in batches; calculating an initial microbial vaccination concentration based on the average thickness; calculating the duration of the first high-humidity fermentation stage based on the average thickness, judging fermentation abnormity according to the change rate of the pH value, and switching to the second low-humidity fermentation stage when the change rate is increased to a set threshold value from a negative peak value; and calculating the thickness compensation fermentation duration according to the surface pH standard reaching duration and the maximum thickness. According to the method, the inoculation concentration and the high-humidity duration are dynamically adjusted through the average thickness, so that beef with different thicknesses obtains similar flora density and breeding time, stages are intelligently switched in combination with the pH change rate, early warning is conducted on abnormity, then the fermentation duration is compensated with the maximum thickness, and the fermentation consistency and the finished product quality of the beef with different thicknesses in batches are remarkably improved.

applicante: ZHAOQING CORUSCATE BIOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD
titulo: Microbial fermentation tail gas treatment device
abstract: The utility model provides a microbial fermentation tail gas treatment device. The microbial fermentation tail gas treatment device comprises a condensation tank, a first absorption tank and a second absorption tank which are sequentially connected through a pipeline in the fermentation tail gas conveying direction, and a liquid collection assembly connected to the condensation tank through a pipeline. By arranging the condensation tank and placing a refrigerant in the condensation tank, water vapor in the fermentation tail gas can be efficiently condensed, and compared with a traditional condensation device, the heat exchange efficiency is greatly improved. The liquid collecting assembly can collect condensate water generated by condensation in time, and the situation that the heat exchange efficiency is reduced due to accumulation of the condensate water is avoided. The fermentation tail gas sequentially passes through the first absorption liquid in the first absorption tank and the second absorption liquid in the second absorption tank, so that water vapor and pollutants are more thoroughly separated, and the content of VOCs in the fermentation tail gas is remarkably reduced. The device has the advantages of simple structure, high heat exchange efficiency, low implementation cost, high tail gas treatment quality and convenience in popularization and implementation.

titulo: Detection device for microbial fermentation for baking
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of detection, in particular to a detection device for microbial fermentation for baking, which comprises a fermentation box and a detection component, and the detection component comprises a limiting component, a supporting component, a first servo motor, a first driving screw rod, a moving block, a mounting slide rail, a second servo motor, a second driving screw rod, a connecting seat and a detection component, a first servo motor drives a first driving screw to rotate so as to drive a moving block to move, the moving block drives a mounting sliding rail to move so as to adjust the longitudinal position, the output end of a second servo motor drives a second driving screw to rotate, and rotation of the second driving screw drives a connecting base to move. A detection component is mounted at the bottom of the connecting seat, and is driven by a second servo motor to reach different detection positions, so that the problem of inaccurate data caused by the fact that a temperature probe in an existing detection device for microbial fermentation of pastries can only detect a single longitudinal position of a dough is solved.

applicante: YUNNAN XINGRUN AGRICULTURAL TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
titulo: Microbial fermentation device with residual liquid recovery function
abstract: The utility model discloses a microbial fermentation device with a residual liquid recovery function, and relates to the field of microbial fermentation. Through the effect of the adjusting mechanism, the L-shaped pipeline can be rapidly installed at the bottom of the switch, the opening facing direction of the L-shaped pipeline can be changed, fermented materials can be conveniently collected, the sealing gasket is arranged on the opposite sides of the lower clamping plate and the upper clamping plate, after the lower clamping plate is completely attached to the upper clamping plate, at the moment, the clamping block is clamped into the L-shaped sliding groove of the limiting block, and the L-shaped pipeline can be rapidly installed at the bottom of the switch. After the multiple clamping blocks are clamped into the corresponding limiting blocks respectively, the lower clamping plate is rotated, the clamping blocks are rotated to the tops of the limiting beads, the limiting beads are clamped into the clamping blocks under the action of the first springs, the clamping blocks are fixed in the limiting blocks through the corresponding limiting beads, and the opening facing direction of the L-shaped pipeline is changed in the mode; the device has the effect of quickly installing the L-shaped pipeline, and meanwhile, the opening direction of the L-shaped pipeline is adjusted according to the position requirement of collected microorganisms.

applicante: KARAMAY XINAODA PETROLEUM TECH SERVICE CO LTD
titulo: Microbial fermentation tank for microbial oil recovery
abstract: The utility model discloses a microbial fermentation tank for microbial oil recovery, which belongs to the technical field of microbial oil recovery and comprises a tank body component, a cleaning component is mounted at the central position of the tank body component, and a discharge pipe is fixedly mounted on one side of the bottom of the tank body component. Supporting blocks are fixedly installed at the positions, located on the two sides of the cleaning assembly, of the lower portion of the tank assembly, a plurality of supporting legs are arranged below the two supporting blocks, the two supporting blocks and the multiple supporting legs are connected through a storage conveying device, and an auxiliary disinfecting and killing device is fixedly installed on one side of the top of the tank assembly; according to the utility model, the storage and conveying device is arranged, so that a worker can temporarily store and convey fermented microorganisms through the cooperation of the moving box, the pump body and other structures as required, thereby better meeting the working requirements under different conditions, and further improving the working capacity of the fermentation tank.

titulo: Microbial fermentation adaptive control method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract: The invention provides a microbial fermentation self-adaptive control method based on multi-source data fusion, which comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-source process data of a plurality of historical batches, performing time alignment, anomaly elimination, deletion completion and normalization processing on the multi-source process data, and fusing and extracting batch fingerprints, meanwhile, calculating a stability evaluation result to construct a historical batch fingerprint database; collecting multi-source process data in a preset short time window of the current batch, and generating a short window fingerprint of the current batch according to a data processing aperture consistent with a historical batch; training an imitation learning strategy model based on a historical batch fingerprint database, and selecting controller initialization parameters in a feasible region corresponding to the security boundary constraint in combination with a wolf pack algorithm; and in a preset control period, according to the fusion result and a target value called by the target table, calculating a control quantity, applying a safety boundary constraint, and then outputting an execution instruction to drive an execution mechanism to form closed-loop control.

titulo: Bacillus velezensis R125 as well as fermentation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides bacillus velezensis R125 as well as a fermentation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation engineering and biological medicines. According to the method, the bacillus velezensis R125 is separated from the traditional fermented food acid porridge in the Suifen County of Chongzuo Chongzuo Chongzuo Autonomous District of Guangxi Zhuang, China, and factors such as carbon source concentration, culture temperature, pH and time are optimized, so that the yield of the alcohol precipitation product of the bacillus velezensis R125 is greatly increased from about 0.596 g/L of the conventional process to about 1.131 g/L, the increasing rate is close to 90%, and the method is suitable for industrial production. The production efficiency is greatly improved, and a solid foundation is laid for industrial production.

titulo: Method for improving soil by fermenting straws based on compound microbial agent
abstract: The invention discloses a method for improving soil by fermenting straws on the basis of a compound microbial agent, which comprises the following specific steps: fermenting pretreated straws by using the compound microbial agent consisting of various microorganisms, and directly returning decomposed products to the field, so that the content of organic matters in soil can be effectively increased, and the microbial community structure of the soil can be improved; the synergistic effect of straw recycling and soil ecological restoration is achieved, and the composite microbial agent is composed of bacillus subtilis, aspergillus niger, brevibacillus laterosporus and lactobacillus plantarum. The problems that an existing straw returning technology is low in decomposition efficiency and prone to spreading diseases and insect pests, and an existing microbial fermentation technology is single in strain function, poor in synergism, difficult to synchronously achieve efficient degradation and soil improvement and the like can be effectively solved.

titulo: Trichoderma reesei engineering bacterium with high cellulase yield as well as construction method and application of trichoderma reesei engineering bacterium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of genetic engineering and microbial fermentation, and particularly discloses a trichoderma reesei engineering bacterium capable of producing cellulase at high yield as well as a construction method and application of the trichoderma reesei engineering bacterium. The method comprises the following steps: replacing an orotate 5 '-phosphate carboxylase coding gene pyr4 in a genome with a hygromycin resistance coding gene to obtain a pyr4:: hph intermediate strain; and then replacing an L-rhamnonate dehydratase-like enzyme gene in the genome of the pyr4:: hph intermediate strain with an orotate acid-5 '-phosphate carboxylase encoding gene pyrG to obtain a Mesm1:: pyrG engineering strain, namely the trichoderma reesei engineering strain for high yield of cellulase. Compared with a wild type starting strain, the trichoderma reesei engineering strain provided by the invention has the advantages that the enzyme production activity, the extracellular protein content and the saccharified glucose yield are remarkably improved.

titulo: Acetic acid tolerance type caproic acid producing strain and application thereof in yellow water enhanced fermentation
abstract: The invention discloses an acetic acid tolerance type caproic acid producing strain and application thereof in yellow water enhanced fermentation, and belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation. The clostridium kluyvei GDMCC NO: 68031 disclosed by the invention can grow at pH of 4.0-9.0, can perform growth metabolism by utilizing carbon sources such as arabinose, fructose, lactose, ethanol, L-fucose and glucose, and has wide substrate utilization capability. The strain has typical acetic acid preference metabolic characteristics, and the hexanoic acid yield is the highest and can reach 6.46 g/L when acetic acid is used as a unique carbon source. In a compound fermentation system composed of simulated yellow water bottom substances, the strain is not significant in hexanoic acid yield difference in a wide lactic acid/acetic acid proportion range, shows high adaptability to substrate proportion fluctuation, and can synchronously promote generation of various volatile flavor substances such as alcohols, pyrazines and esters.

titulo: Lactic acid monomer production strain for regulating and controlling nutritional form of strain by utilizing temperature and application of lactic acid monomer production strain
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of microbial fermentation engineering, in particular to a lactic acid monomer production strain for regulating and controlling the nutritional form of the strain through temperature and application. According to the method, the target lactic acid monomer high-yield strain is subjected to accurate deletion of L-alanine synthesis related genes, and a temperature-sensitive plasmid system is utilized to realize dynamic reconstruction of a metabolic pathway, so that metabolic stage separation of cell proliferation and target product synthesis is effectively realized; the unit volume and unit time yield (production intensity) and the purity of the synthesized lactic acid monomer are obviously improved, the industrial requirements of modern fermentation intelligent manufacturing and efficient preparation of a large amount of bio-based raw materials are met, and the method can be widely applied to production of the high-purity lactic acid monomer in the polylactic acid (PLA) industry.
termos_detectados: fermentation, microbial fermentation, plasmid, metabolic pathway

titulo: Lactobacillus rhamnosus LT-1 and application thereof in solid-state fermentation of spirulina
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of microbial fermentation technology and biological resource utilization, and particularly relates to a lactobacillus rhamnosus LT-1 strain and application thereof in solid-state fermentation of spirulina. The lactobacillus rhamnosus (LT-1) is screened and separated from a target spirulina oat powder solid-state fermentation system, the growth and metabolism characteristics of the lactobacillus rhamnosus (LT-1) are highly matched with those of a fermentation substrate, and the technical problems that an existing conventional fermentation strain is poor in adaptability to a spirulina substrate and low in fermentation efficiency are solved; according to the method, a synergistic fermentation mode of'bacillus subtilis wall breaking + LT-1 strain fermentation 'is innovatively adopted, and fermentation process parameters in a specific range are combined, so that the precise control of the solid-state fermentation process of the spirulina can be realized, and the stable quality of a fermentation product is ensured; the strain is derived from natural fresh camel milk, is high in safety and has good industrial large-scale application potential.
termos_detectados: fermentation, microbial fermentation, solid-state fermentation, fermentation process, large-scale

titulo: Novel bacillus strain and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation, and particularly relates to a novel bacillus strain and application thereof. In order to achieve the purpose of increasing hexane and reducing milk, a novel bacillus strain (Bacillus sp.) LZLJ49 is separated, screened and identified from pit mud, and the preservation number of the novel bacillus strain is CCTCC NO: M 2025394. The strain has excellent lactic acid utilization capacity, can achieve the purpose of increasing hexanoic acid and reducing milk by consuming lactic acid, generating acetic acid, propionic acid, butyric acid, hexanoic acid and other organic acids, reducing the content of ethyl lactate and increasing the content of ethyl hexanoate, has wide culture conditions, can adapt to the harsh environment of yellow water, and has wide application prospects. The method is used for enhancing utilization and conversion of lactic acid in the wine-making byproduct yellow water. Various flavor components such as esters, alcohols, phenols, aldehydes, terpenes and pyrrole can be produced through metabolism, so that the quality of white spirit or food leavening is improved.

titulo: Aroma-producing yeast strain XQU8 and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an aroma-producing yeast strain XQU8 and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation and food aroma enhancement. The bacterial strain is classified and named as Wickerhamomyces anomalus, and the preservation number of the bacterial strain is CCTCC (China Center for Type Culture Collection) M 2026993. The strain can be fermented to prepare a characteristic aroma-producing fermentation liquor, HS-SPME-GC-MS detects and compares a blank culture medium with a control strain BY4147 fermentation liquor, and the fermentation liquor is rich in volatile substances such as esters, alcohols, acids, aldehydes and terpenes; through VIP and multiple change analysis, six flavor substances such as ethyl acetate, D-limonene, octanoic acid, 9-hexadecenoic acid methyl ester and 9-hexadecenoic acid ethyl ester are remarkably enriched, and the fermentation liquor is endowed with strong fruit fragrance, ester fragrance, flower fragrance and fermentation sweet fragrance. The fermentation liquor can be used for preparing a fermentation flavor enhancer, and is widely applied to flavor improvement of foods, beverages, seasonings, Fuzhuan tea, feeds and pet foods.

applicante: LIAONING JINHONG AGRICULTURAL BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD
titulo: Compound microbial agent for fermenting and detoxifying peanut meal and improving digestion conversion rate and application of compound microbial agent
abstract: The invention discloses a compound microbial agent for fermenting and detoxifying peanut meal and improving digestion conversion rate and application of the compound microbial agent. Belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation. According to the compound microbial agent disclosed by the invention, through a system design of a four-order functional chain of enzyme production, degradation, conversion and absorption promotion, synchronous and efficient degradation of various types of harmful substances such as free gossypol, a trypsin inhibitor, aflatoxin B1, vomitoxin and zearalenone in the peanut meal is realized; meanwhile, the true protein content is remarkably increased, small molecule active peptides are enriched, and the amino acid composition is optimized. The total amino acid content in the fermented product is increased by 30% or above, the small peptide content is increased by 50% or above, the anti-nutritional factor removal rate reaches 85% or above, and the dry matter digestibility is increased by 40% or above. Unexpected technical effects are achieved in the aspects of detoxification broad spectrum, protein quality improvement, digestion and absorption promotion and the like.

titulo: Efficient production method and application of anthocyanin-rich yeast ingredient and fermented beverage with high anthocyanin retention rate
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of microbial fermentation, and particularly discloses an anthocyanin-rich yeast ingredient and an efficient production method and application of a fermented beverage with a high anthocyanin retention rate. The production method of the fermentation material comprises the following steps: adjusting the sugar addition amount and the pH value of the anthocyanin-rich fermentation liquor to preset values; inoculating a DYG5 strain into the fermentation liquid, and fermenting for a preset time to obtain a fermentation material; wherein a solid-phase substance in the fermented material is a yeast ingredient, and a liquid-phase substance in the fermented material is a fermented beverage. According to the production method provided by the invention, the retention rate of anthocyanin can be remarkably increased, efficient adsorption and embedding of anthocyanin can be realized through yeast cell walls and exopolysaccharides, and yeast ingredients and fermented beverages with high additional values are synchronously obtained. Wherein the yeast ingredient can reduce the in-vivo degradation rate of the anthocyanin, so that slow release is realized, the stability and bioavailability of the anthocyanin are remarkably improved, and the technical bottlenecks of poor stability and low bioavailability of the anthocyanin in the prior art are effectively solved.

applicante: JINAN INST OF FRUIT PRODUCTS CHINA COOP
titulo: Fermented plant beverage with high anthocyanin and active polysaccharide content and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of microbial fermentation, in particular to a fermented plant beverage and a preparation method of the fermented plant beverage, and the fermented plant beverage is prepared by sequentially fermenting lactobacillus plantarum CTCF-LP-1 and morchella esculenta CTCF-Y-7. 905. The invention also relates to a preparation method of the fermented plant beverage. The preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively carrying out enzymolysis extraction on purple corn and morchella esculenta, mixing the obtained extracting solutions in proportion, carrying out primary fermentation at the temperature of 30-37 DEG C by adopting lactobacillus plantarum CTCF-LP-1 (the preservation number is CGMCC NO.28329), and then carrying out secondary fermentation at the temperature of 15-20 DEG C by adopting morchella esculenta CTCF-Y-7.905 (the preservation number is CGMCC NO.42580). Through the synergistic effect of specific strains, heat-sensitive anthocyanin in purple corn is effectively protected by utilizing an acid environment generated by lactobacillus fermentation, meanwhile, macromolecular polysaccharide is converted into micromolecular active polysaccharide which is easy to absorb through morchella fermentation, the flavor is improved, and the final product is high in anthocyanin and polysaccharide content, sour and sweet in flavor and good in taste. The nutrition and the functionality are realized.

titulo: Fermentation tank for preparing agricultural microbial fertilizer
abstract: The utility model discloses a fermentation tank for preparing agricultural microbial fertilizer, and particularly relates to the technical field of fermentation tanks, the fermentation tank comprises a fermentation tank body, a fermentation cavity and a water cavity which are distributed up and down are formed in the fermentation tank body, a tank cover is mounted at the top of the fermentation tank body, and a motor is fixedly mounted at the top of the tank cover; a stirring assembly is fixedly installed in the fermentation cavity, a spiral temperature adjusting channel surrounding the outer portion of the fermentation cavity is formed in the fermentation tank body, a linkage rod is rotatably installed on the top wall of the water cavity, and the top end of the linkage rod penetrates and extends to the bottom wall of the fermentation cavity. According to the fermentation tank for preparing the agricultural microbial fertilizer, cold water or hot water is conveyed into the water inlet pipe through mutual cooperation of the linkage assembly, the linkage rod, the continuous water conveying assembly, the heating assembly and the check valve assembly, and then the temperature in the fermentation cavity is adjusted through the cold water and the hot water, so that the microbial fermentation temperature is controlled; the fermentation efficiency is improved, and later use is facilitated.

titulo: Bacteroides fragilis TZF-004 and application thereof in preparation of rare ginsenoside through fermentation conversion
abstract: The invention discloses a strain of Bacteroides fragilis TZF-004 and an application of the strain of Bacteroides fragilis TZF-004 in preparation of rare ginsenoside through fermentation conversion, and belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation. The bacteroides fragilis TZF-004 is preserved in the China Center for Type Culture Collection on April 22, 2026, and the preservation number of the bacteroides fragilis TZF-004 is CCTCC (China Center for Type Culture Collection) NO: M2026760. According to the invention, ginseng total saponins are used as a raw material, firstly, the strain is used for carrying out mild, controllable and efficient fermentation conversion on the ginseng total saponins, and then high-temperature steam treatment is combined, so that fermentation products rich in rare ginsenosides Rg6, F2, F4, 20 (S)-Rh2, 20 (R)-Rh2, 20 (S)-Rh4 and 20 (R)-Rh4 are finally prepared. According to the method, microbial biotransformation is combined with a physical treatment mode, the conversion efficiency of the rare ginsenoside is further improved, the method has the advantages of being short in fermentation period, high in conversion efficiency, rich in product variety and the like, and the product obtained through the method is different from an existing single process in the variety and content of the rare ginsenoside; the content of rare saponin in the extracting solution can be obviously improved.

titulo: PROCESS AND SYSTEM FOR CARBON CAPTURE BY MICROBIAL FERMENTATION
abstract: The disclosure is directed to a process and apparatus for capturing carbon by microbial fermentation. The disclosure relates to capturing off or waste gas stream(s) comprising CO and CO2 produced from a cupola furnace located in a foundry. The cupola furnaces are cost-effective melting solution, but they can generate significant air emissions. The off or waste gas stream(s) from the cupola furnace is passed to gas fermentation process and converted into one or more products by microbial fermentation.

titulo: Flexible telescopic microbial fermentation supporting device
abstract: The utility model discloses a flexible telescopic microbial fermentation supporting device, which is arranged below a microbial fermentation tank and comprises a metal corrugated pipe, threaded holes, an upper mounting piece and a lower mounting piece, and the threaded holes are formed in the top of the metal corrugated pipe and the bottom of the microbial fermentation tank. According to the utility model, the mounting holes for inserting the upper mounting piece and the lower mounting piece are formed between the microbial fermentation tank and the metal corrugated pipe, so that the upper mounting piece and the lower mounting piece can be respectively mounted in the mounting holes in the microbial fermentation tank and the metal corrugated pipe during use; at the moment, the positions of threaded holes in the microbial fermentation tank and the metal corrugated pipe are automatically aligned, so that the mounting difficulty between the microbial fermentation tank and the metal corrugated pipe is reduced; wherein the upper mounting piece and the lower mounting piece can be in elastic sliding connection, so that the applicability of connection between the metal corrugated pipe and the microbial fermentation tanks with different sizes is improved.

applicante: SANYA HUADA LIFE SCIENCE RESEARCH INST
titulo: Method for detecting carbohydrate compounds in microbial fermentation sample
abstract: The invention discloses a method for detecting carbohydrate compounds in a microbial fermentation sample, which comprises the following steps: detecting the microbial fermentation sample to be detected by using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry to obtain a liquid chromatogram and a mass spectrum; and determining the content of the saccharide compound in the microbial fermentation sample based on the liquid chromatogram and the mass spectrum wherein the saccharide compound comprises one or more of the following: glucose (Glu), lactose (Lac), 2 '-fucosyllactose (2'-FL), 3-fucosyllactose (3-FL), lactose-N-neotetraose (LNnT), 3 '-sialic acid lactose (3'-SL), and 6 '-sialic acid lactose (6'-SL). According to the method, only 7.5 min is needed for analyzing a running program of a single sample, single-sample multi-index synchronous detection is achieved, and the method has the advantages of being high in flux, sensitivity, specificity and accuracy.

titulo: Biorefinery method for fluidized continuous biotransformation
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of process engineering of non-grain biomass resource utilization, and particularly relates to a bio-refinery method for fluidized continuous biotransformation. The method comprises the following steps: (1) pretreating a lignocellulose raw material; (2) fully mixing with water and a neutralizer, cooling and neutralizing to form slurry; (3) performing continuous enzymolysis saccharification on the liquid pulp fluid to obtain low-viscosity lignocellulose hydrolysate pulp; (4) carrying out a continuous inhibitor complete biodegradation process to obtain hydrolysate slurry which is low in viscosity and free of inhibitor residues; and (5) carrying out continuous fermentation production of the bio-based product on the hydrolysate slurry from which the inhibitor is removed. According to the method, the fluidization and continuous operation of the solid lignocellulose raw material in the bio-refinery process is realized, so that each bio-refinery process unit can be quickly and continuously conveyed through a closed pipeline on the premise that no wastewater, solid waste, waste gas and solvent are discharged.

applicante: INNER MONGOLIA MINING AREA ECOLOGICAL CONSTRUCTION CO LTD
titulo: Fermentation device for ecological organic fertilizer production and use method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a fermentation device for ecological organic fertilizer production and a use method thereof.The fermentation device comprises a fermentation bin, a fermentation assembly is fixedly installed on the inner wall of the fermentation bin and comprises a stirring shaft, stirring blades and an auger are fixedly installed on the outer wall of the stirring shaft, and an air distribution pipe is fixedly installed on the inner wall of the fermentation bin; the invention belongs to the technical field of organic fertilizer production equipment, and aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, a proper amount of oxygen is inconvenient to convey into an organic fertilizer for cooperative fermentation, the fermentation efficiency and the stability of continuous fermentation are inconvenient to improve, and the production cost is low. The ecological organic fertilizer fermentation device has the technical effects that environmental air is conveyed into the fermentation bin according to the amount required by fermentation for a proper time, and airflow is dispersed and conveyed into the fermentation bin through the air distribution pipe, so that the use practicability of the device is improved.

applicante: HUANGSHAN SHUIGONG TEA IND CO LTD
titulo: Continuous partitioned solid-state fermentation equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of tea and Chinese herbal medicine food solid state fermentation, in particular to continuous partition solid state fermentation equipment which comprises a finished product discharging mechanism, a sterile constant-temperature and constant-humidity fermentation box, an ultraviolet sterilization mechanism and a steam sterilization mechanism. The fermentation constant-temperature and constant-humidity box comprises a bottom shell and a top cover, a placement frame capable of horizontally rotating is arranged in the bottom shell, and a clamping frame for fixing a storage tank is arranged on the placement frame; a second one-way discharging sealing door, a second one-way feeding sealing door and an unqualified product discharging mechanism are arranged on the bottom shell, and a first stepping motor for driving the placing frame to rotate is arranged on the bottom shell; the top cover is provided with a visual detection unit used for identifying fermentation pollution or unqualified golden flower products; the unqualified product discharging mechanism is communicated with the bottom shell, an unqualified product conveying-out machine and an unqualified product one-way discharging sealing door are arranged on the unqualified product discharging mechanism, and the unqualified product conveying-out machine discharges fermented unqualified products through the unqualified product one-way discharging sealing door. The device has the advantages of continuous fermentation production, automatic quality inspection and elimination and graded sterilization.
termos_detectados: fermentation, continuous fermentation, solid-state fermentation, solid state fermentation

applicante: HUNAN WANFU UNITED AGRICULTURE AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECH CO LTD
titulo: Continuous fermentation biogas digester with heat exchange interlayer and vacuum heat preservation
abstract: The continuous fermentation biogas digester comprises a biogas digester body, the top of the biogas digester body is in threaded connection with a biogas discharge pipe and an excrement inlet pipe, a stirring motor is installed on the front face of the biogas digester body, and a heating water tank is fixed to one side of the biogas digester body through bolts. The top of the heating water tank is in threaded connection with a backflow pipe, a heating plate is installed in the heating water tank, a biogas digester inner shell is welded in the biogas digester body, a vacuum cavity is formed between the biogas digester body and the biogas digester inner shell, a temperature sensor and a heat exchange pipe are installed on the outer wall of the biogas digester inner shell, and a heat preservation pad is installed on the inner wall of the biogas digester body. Through the vacuum cavity, the heat exchange pipe and the heating water tank, the heat exchange capacity and the heat preservation performance of the biogas digester are improved, the fermentation biogas digester can effectively maintain the proper temperature, heat balance is guaranteed, energy waste and influence on the fermentation efficiency are avoided, and finally the practicability and the overall performance of the biogas digester are improved.

applicante: GUANGZHOU WEIDE AGRICULTURAL TECH CO LTD
titulo: Cow dung treatment equipment
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of environmental protection equipment, and particularly relates to cow dung treatment equipment which comprises a fermentation tank, the top of the fermentation tank is bolted with a top cover; a first rotating rod is rotationally mounted in the middle of the fermentation tank; a first motor is fixedly connected to the top end of the top cover. A rotating shaft of the first motor is fixedly connected with the top end of a first rotating rod; the outer ring of the first rotating rod is fixedly connected with radial partition plates. A feeding structure and a discharging structure are arranged on one side of the top of the top cover; the raw materials in each fermentation cavity sequentially form biogas, biogas slurry and biogas residues; after the biogas in the fermentation tank is discharged, a first motor is started to drive a partition plate to rotate, the fermentation cavity where the raw materials are completely fermented is rotated to a discharging structure, and biogas residues are conveyed out of the fermentation tank to be used for manufacturing fertilizer; then, the fermentation cavity after discharging is completed rotates to the feeding structure to add fermentation raw materials; therefore, continuous fermentation work of the cow dung is achieved, the storage amount and storage time of the cow dung are reduced, and farmers can use the cow dung conveniently.

titulo: Recombinant yeast foal engineering bacterium as well as construction method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of microbial genetic engineering and fermentation engineering, in particular to a recombinant yeast foal engineering bacterium as well as a construction method and application thereof. According to the invention, cns1, cns2 and cns3-NK are integrated into a Kp-Con genome, and a multi-copy strain capable of efficiently synthesizing cordycepin is constructed. The als3 gene or the gcw16 deltacbd gene is further integrated into a multi-copy strain genome for producing cordycepin, so that the biological film-forming ability of the recombinant strain is enhanced, and the cordycepin yield of the recombinant strain under the free fermentation condition can reach 6.41 g/L at most in combination with a fermentation culture medium and condition optimization. Compared with a control strain, the total average cordycepin yield of the recombinant strain KpCor-A441-als3 and the total average cordycepin yield of the recombinant strain KpCor-A441-gcw16 deltacbd are respectively increased by 25.4% and 19.3% by combining an immobilized continuous fermentation strategy.
termos_detectados: fermentation, continuous fermentation, culture medium, recombinant

applicante: XUZHOU HEGU LIFE TECH CO LTD
titulo: Method for producing ornamental blue through continuous fermentation
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation, and relates to a method for producing ornamental blue through continuous fermentation, which comprises the following steps: inoculating a seed solution into a fermentation tank containing a fermentation culture medium to carry out X-batch continuous fermentation, when the production intensity of the ornamental blue in the fermentation tank is 1.8-2.0 g/L/h or the concentration of acetic acid is 0.8-1 g/L, carrying out emptying and supplementing operations, and then continuously culturing, respectively carrying out emptying and supplementing operations for Y times, and then ending fermentation; x is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 5, and Y is more than or equal to 3 and less than or equal to 4; and when X is greater than or equal to 2 and OD600 in the fermentation tank reaches 110-120, transferring out part of the fermentation liquid in the fermentation tank, inoculating the fermentation liquid into a next-stage fermentation tank, and supplementing a fermentation culture medium and a carbon source into the fermentation tank from which the fermentation liquid is transferred out. According to the method, the fermentation period is shortened, the cost is reduced, inhibition of accumulated metabolites is relieved, higher ornamental blue concentration, saccharification rate and production intensity are obtained, and the yield of single-tank fermentation liquor is increased.
termos_detectados: fermentation, microbial fermentation, continuous fermentation, culture medium

titulo: Novel microbubble bioreactor and application thereof in fermentation production of gamma-polyglutamic acid
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation equipment and fermentation, and particularly relates to a novel microbubble bioreactor and application thereof in fermentation production of gamma-polyglutamic acid. According to the microbubble bioreactor, through the innovative collaborative design of the microbubble generation system, the gas-liquid mixing system and the flow field regulation and control system, microbubbles with the diameter being 10-100 microns can be generated, the oxygen transfer efficiency and the dissolved oxygen level of a fermentation system are greatly improved, meanwhile, the liquid shear force is reduced, and foam generation is reduced; the reactor is applied to gamma-PGA aerobic fermentation of bacillus atrophaeus NWS-01, the problems that a traditional fermentation reactor is low in oxygen utilization rate, high in energy consumption, prone to damage to thalli and poor in fermentation stability are solved, synergistic improvement of high-density growth of the thalli and efficient synthesis of gamma-PGA is achieved, and the reactor is suitable for industrial continuous fermentation production of gamma-PGA.
termos_detectados: fermentation, microbial fermentation, continuous fermentation, aerobic fermentation, bioreactor, oxygen transfer, dissolved oxygen, gas-liquid

applicante: JILIN YANMING LAKE SOYBEAN BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD
titulo: Temperature control stirring device for natto fermentation
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of food fermentation equipment, in particular to a temperature control stirring device for natto fermentation. A temperature control stirring device for natto fermentation comprises a shell, supports, a sealing cover, a feeding port, a stirring barrel, a motor and the like, the supports are fixedly connected to the four corners of the bottom of the shell, the sealing cover is fixedly connected to the top of the shell, the feeding port is connected and communicated with the top of the sealing cover, the stirring barrel is arranged in the shell, and through holes are evenly distributed in the periphery of the upper portion of the stirring barrel. An annular cavity is formed between the shell and the stirring barrel; a motor is mounted on the right side of the top of the sealing cover. According to the utility model, the annular cavity is arranged between the shell and the stirring barrel and is used for accommodating a water medium, the electrothermal film is combined to realize water bath heating, and the temperature sensor and the controller are matched to form a closed-loop temperature control system, so that the effects of constant-temperature fermentation, small temperature fluctuation and uniform heat conduction are achieved, and a stable environment is provided for the continuous fermentation activity of bacillus natto.

titulo: Continuous fermentation device and production line
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of microbial fermentation, in particular to a continuous fermentation device and a production line, the fermentation device comprises a plurality of horizontal fermentation tanks which are stacked in the longitudinal direction, and a control pipeline is arranged between the upper and lower adjacent fermentation tanks and is used for conveying fermentation liquor; the horizontal fermentation tank is internally provided with a stirring device for stirring fermentation liquid, and is also provided with an air supplementing pipe and a liquid supplementing pipe, the air supplementing pipe and the liquid supplementing pipe extend in the horizontal fermentation tank, and a plurality of openings are formed in pipe bodies at intervals and are used for supplementing gas and nutrient liquid into the horizontal fermentation tank. By improving the structure of the fermentation tank, fermentation liquid can directionally flow along the fermentation tank, fermentation is performed in the flowing process, and the survival rate of flora can be guaranteed by uniformly supplementing air and liquid; the plurality of fermentation tanks which are longitudinally arranged can save the occupied space, and the fermentation liquor is controlled to flow in the plurality of fermentation tanks by utilizing gravity, so that the energy consumption is saved, and the damage to equipment is also avoided.

titulo: Organic fertilizer continuous fermentation device based on distiller's yeast waste residues
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of distiller's yeast waste residue treatment, in particular to an organic fertilizer continuous fermentation device based on distiller's yeast waste residues, which comprises a fermentation device main body, a box cover is hermetically mounted at the top end of the fermentation device main body through bolts, and a turning mechanism is mounted at the top end of the box cover and penetrates through the box cover to the inside of the fermentation device main body. Spraying mechanisms are installed on the two sides of the outer wall of the fermentation device body and the two sides of the outer wall of the box cover and penetrate into the fermentation device body and the box cover, and the bottom end of the fermentation device body is in sealed connection with a sealing ring through threads. According to the distiller's yeast waste residue fermentation device disclosed by the utility model, through mutual cooperation of internal parts of the turning mechanism, distiller's yeast waste residues in the fermentation device main body can be uniformly turned by turning blades and cutting blades respectively in the fermentation process, so that the temperature of the distiller's yeast waste residues during fermentation is stable; the temperature and humidity during distiller's yeast waste residue fermentation can be conveniently controlled, and the distiller's yeast waste residue fermentation period is shortened.

titulo: Airlift fermentation tank for continuous fermentation
abstract: A first connector is arranged at the bottom end of a fermentation tank body, a second connector is arranged at the top end of the fermentation tank body, the second connector is connected with a gas-liquid separation tank, and the first connector is respectively connected with a first water pump and a second water pump through pipelines. The first water pump and the second water pump are respectively connected with the fermentation tank main body through a return pipeline, a venturi mixer is mounted on the return pipeline, and the gas-liquid separation tank is connected with the venturi mixer through a pipeline. The continuous operation of the fermentation system can be maintained for a long time without stopping the tank for maintenance; the consumption of compressed air can be reduced, and the cost is saved; the gas-liquid separation tank at the top is additionally arranged, and the gas suction function of the Venturi mixer and other auxiliary bubble breaking equipment are matched, so that bubbles generated in the fermentation process can be quickly broken.
termos_detectados: fermentation, continuous fermentation, fermentation process, airlift, gas-liquid

applicante: NANJING SHIQI BIOCHEMICAL TECH CO LTD
titulo: Clostridium Yangdall for immobilizing one-carbon gas and application of clostridium Yangdall in production of alcohol and mycoprotein
abstract: The invention relates to a one-carbon-gas-immobilized clostridium perdali and application thereof in production of alcohol and mycoprotein, and belongs to the technical field of industrial microbial synthesis. The clostridium is named as clostridium yangduli GG8, is classified and named as Clostridium ljungdahli, is preserved in the China General Microbiological Culture Collection Center (CGMCC), and is obtained by evolving and sorting a wild type strain clostridium yangduli DSM13528 through an adaptive laboratory. Compared with a wild type strain, the clostridium yangdaei GG8 has the advantages that the capability of producing ethanol and mycoprotein by taking one-carbon gas as a carbon source is improved; in the batch fermentation process, the clostridium yangduli GG8 can accumulate thallus biomass OD600 not less than 20, ethanol concentration not less than 50 g/L, and acetic acid concentration not less than 5 g/L; in the single-tank continuous fermentation process, the GG8 can be stably fermented for more than 5 months, the ethanol production intensity exceeds 2g/L/h, and the economical efficiency of gas fermentation is favorably improved.
termos_detectados: fermentation, batch fermentation, continuous fermentation, fermentation process

titulo: Method for fermenting low-temperature chicken manure
abstract: The invention discloses a method for fermenting low-temperature chicken manure. Aiming at the problem that high-humidity fresh chicken manure cannot be efficiently and continuously fermented in a severe cold season (the environment temperature is less than or equal to 0 DEG C) in the prior art, the invention provides a dynamic fermentation method based on biological thermal self-circulation, and the dynamic fermentation method comprises the following steps: when the environment temperature is more than or equal to 5 DEG C, pre-establishing at least two fermentation stacks (a starting stage) in a high-temperature fermentation state; when the environment temperature is smaller than or equal to 0 DEG C, a high-temperature stack is selected circularly, high-temperature fermentation materials (the center temperature is larger than or equal to 60 DEG C) in the high-temperature stack are mixed with low-temperature fresh chicken manure to be treated, auxiliary material straw powder, fermentation fungicide and the like according to the specific weight ratio, and the initial temperature of the mixture is increased to 20 DEG C or above through sensible heat of the high-temperature materials; and then part of the mixed material is separated out and moved out for decomposition, and the remaining material is left in situ for continuous fermentation to serve as a subsequent heat source, so that dynamic balance of continuous feeding and discharging is realized. External energy is not needed, and open-air continuous efficient fermentation and recycling of the chicken manure in the severe cold environment are achieved.

applicante: NANJING SHIQI BIOCHEMICAL TECH CO LTD
titulo: Method for preparing single-cell protein by using compound bacteria
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing single-cell protein by using compound bacteria, and belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation. The method comprises the following steps: respectively carrying out continuous fermentation culture on clostridium aerovorans and pichia pastoris, simultaneously supplementing a fresh culture medium and discharging part of fermentation liquor at the same flow speed so as to replace decayed thalli and maintain the volume of the fermentation liquor in a fermentation tank to be constant; the method comprises the following steps: compounding the fermentation liquor of clostridium aerovorans and the fermentation liquor of pichia pastoris, separating by a disc centrifuge, and sequentially carrying out enzymolysis and spray drying to obtain the single-cell protein. The clostridium with high acid-soluble protein content is compounded with the yeast with high biomass, so that the contradiction that the traditional single-cell protein is high in nutrition and low in yield or high in yield and low in absorption is solved, the thallus recovery rate, the equipment operation rate and the acid-soluble protein proportion are increased, and large-scale production is facilitated.

applicante: YUNNAN MINGQU BIOTECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD
titulo: Method for preparing mulberry oral liquid through synergistic fermentation of wine-brewing yellow water and sorghum
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine fermentation preparations, and discloses a method for preparing mulberry oral liquid through synergistic fermentation of wine-brewing yellow water and sorghum. The method specifically comprises the following steps: fully soaking and crushing dried mulberries, uniformly stirring and cooking the crushed mulberries and sorghum, and adding compound Xiaoqu for brewing to perform saccharification treatment; then putting the saccharified mixture into a fermentation tank for fermentation, and then adding yellow water for continuous fermentation; and finally, collecting liquid generated in the fermentation process, filtering, clarifying, sterilizing and packaging to obtain the mulberry oral liquid. Through synergistic fermentation of mulberries and sorghum, nutritional ingredients of the sorghum and inherent sugar of dried mulberries are used for jointly promoting microbial metabolism, and the alcoholic strength of the finished oral liquid is controlled to be about 8 degrees by means of the saccharification effect of wine making Xiaoqu and the synergistic effect of yellow water microflora and flavor substances; the alcoholic strength can promote full dissolution and conversion of active ingredients such as anthocyanin and polysaccharide of the dried mulberries, also can significantly improve the bioavailability of the product, and endows the product with a unique fermentation flavor at the same time.

titulo: Efficient dynamic double-reflux continuous fermentation method for brewing rose-flavor honey wine
abstract: The invention provides an efficient dynamic double-reflux continuous fermentation method for brewing rose-flavor mead, and relates to the field of alcoholic drinks, and the method comprises the following steps: preparing a yeast activation solution in an initial fermentation tank, and inoculating saccharomyces cerevisiae to prepare a brewing seed solution; preparing a honey fermentation liquid, sterilizing, inoculating a brewing seed liquid, and performing anaerobic fermentation in a first main fermentation tank to obtain a first main fermentation liquid; after the first main fermentation liquid is fermented for a preset time length, continuously transferring into a second main fermentation tank for anaerobic fermentation; when the volume of the fermentation liquid in the previous fermentation tank reaches a corresponding volume preset proportion, continuously transferring to the next fermentation tank for anaerobic fermentation, and sequentially arranging a secondary fermentation tank, a post-fermentation tank and a receiving fermentation tank behind the second main fermentation tank; when the second main fermentation liquor reaches the corresponding volume preset proportion, the second main fermentation liquor flows back to the first main fermentation tank; and when the secondary fermentation liquor reaches the corresponding volume preset proportion, the secondary fermentation liquor flows back to the initial fermentation tank according to the preset percentage. The defects of long fermentation period and low equipment utilization rate in the prior art are overcome.

applicante: TIANJIN HENGSHENG XINGWANG BIO TECH CO LTD
titulo: Straw continuous fermentation device for preparing biofuel
abstract: The utility model discloses a straw continuous fermentation device for preparing biofuel, which comprises a box body, the top end of the box body is connected with a box cover, a fermentation cylinder is detachably connected in the box body, the box cover is connected with a feeding pipe and a quantitative feeder, the box cover is connected with an exhaust pipe, the fermentation cylinder is provided with a dynamic regulation and control mechanism, and the dynamic regulation and control mechanism is connected with the box cover. The dynamic regulation and control mechanism comprises a temperature regulation and control module and a PH regulation module, a discharging plate connected with the fermentation cylinder through a driving shaft is arranged at the bottom end of the fermentation cylinder, a vibration screening mechanism is arranged below the fermentation cylinder, a discharging pipe is connected to the bottom end of the box body, the vibration screening mechanism comprises a first filter screen, and a compression mechanism is arranged on one side of the filter screen. According to the utility model, by arranging the vibrating screening mechanism, the discharge pipe, the exhaust pipe and the compression mechanism, not only can fermentation products be directly discharged, but also the fermentation products can be subjected to solid-liquid-gas separation discharge, so that time and labor are saved, and the working efficiency is greatly improved.

applicante: DONGGUAN YUEJING LIQUOR IND CO LTD
titulo: Preparation method of purple sweet potato wine
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of purple sweet potato wine, and belongs to the technical field of wine brewing. The preparation method comprises the following steps: breeding, peeling, steaming and grinding in sequence, respectively adding saccharifying enzyme, pectinase and glucosidase in saccharification, hydrolysis and aroma enhancement stages for enzymolysis, then inoculating specific sweet distiller's yeast for constant-temperature fermentation, and carrying out combined treatment of two-stage high-pressure homogenization, ultrahigh-temperature instantaneous sterilization, hot filling and pasteurization on the fermentation liquor. According to the method, free aroma substances are increased through the synergistic effect of an enzyme system, the homogenizing and grading heat sterilization process is combined, anthocyanin is protected while microorganisms are killed, continuous fermentation of the product is inhibited, and the prepared purple sweet potato wine does not need to be additionally provided with a stabilizer and essence and has the advantages of being rich in aroma, stable in wine body color and long in shelf life.

titulo: Intelligent groove type aeration system for efficient fermentation of agricultural organic wastes
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of organic matter fermentation, in particular to an intelligent groove type aeration system for efficient fermentation of agricultural organic waste, which comprises a moisture analysis module used for obtaining the actual moisture content in the fermentation process of the organic waste, and determining whether the actual moisture content is larger than the maximum value of a preset moisture content range or not. Based on the fact that the actual moisture content belongs to the dangerous moisture content range, the air supply duration is adjusted and controlled according to the first preset duration adjusting amount and the moisture deviation value; and the acid-base analysis module is used for obtaining the actual pH value of the fermentation product, determining the temporary water supply amount according to the water residual difference value on the basis that the actual pH value is greater than the maximum value of the risk pH value range, and regulating and controlling the turning and throwing times. According to the method, a plurality of single parameters in the fermentation process are detected and fused, the fermentation condition is mastered by combining judgment in a plurality of single directions with comprehensive judgment, ventilation and oxygen supply are intelligently regulated and controlled to reduce abnormal fermentation, and the stable and continuous fermentation process is ensured.
