applicante: HEBEI NIHEWAN AGRICULTURAL DEV CO LTD
titulo: Continuous vegetable protein fermentation system for ultraviolet-ozone synergistic sterilization
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of vegetable protein fermentation, and discloses an ultraviolet-ozone synergistic sterilization continuous vegetable protein fermentation system which comprises a raw material pretreatment unit, a synergistic sterilization unit, a continuous fermentation unit and a product separation unit which are communicated in sequence, the control system is electrically connected with each unit, and the sterile air supply unit is used for providing an air source for the collaborative sterilization unit and the continuous fermentation unit. According to the invention, synergistic sterilization and continuous fermentation are organically combined and matched with an automatic regulation and control system, so that multiple defects of a traditional vegetable protein fermentation system are effectively overcome, efficient, residue-free and continuous vegetable protein fermentation production is realized, the production efficiency and the product quality are remarkably improved, and the industrial application value is extremely high. The method is suitable for the fields of food, feed, medical intermediates and the like, and is used for deep processing scenes of various plant proteins such as active peptide production through mung bean protein fermentation, allergenicity improvement through mung bean protein fermentation, flavor improvement through mung bean protein fermentation and the like.

applicante: DEQING ZHEJIANG UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY MOGANSHAN RESEARCH INST
titulo: Method for safely preparing fertilizer through continuous fermentation of urine
abstract: The invention discloses a safe fertilizer preparation method by continuous fermentation of urine, which comprises the following steps: during primary fermentation, adding an environment-friendly enzyme into a container, then collecting fresh urine, adding molasses, and carrying out sealed fermentation; after fermentation is finished, part of fermentation liquor is reserved as a substrate; fresh urine and molasses are directly added into the container with the substrate in the subsequent batch for fermentation, and continuous circulation is achieved. According to the method, the environment-friendly enzyme (or the last fermentation liquor) and the molasses are added into the fresh urine in time for fermentation, and the hydrolysis process of urea in the urine can be inhibited in the early stage, so that the volatilization amount of ammonia nitrogen is greatly reduced, and pathogenic bacteria in the urine can be inhibited to an extremely low level in a short time. Except that the environment-friendly enzyme needs to be added in the first fermentation, the environment-friendly enzyme does not need to be added in the next batch of fermentation, and only a small amount of molasses needs to be added. A large number of beneficial bacteria such as lactic acid bacteria and saccharomycetes and metabolites such as lactic acid and acetic acid are generated in the fermentation process, so that the urine is converted into the microbial fertilizer.

titulo: Continuous fermentation liquor separation centrifugal machine
abstract: The utility model discloses a continuous centrifugal machine for separating fermentation liquor, and relates to the technical field of biological fermentation. Through the arrangement of the guide plate, the motion direction of a sprayed solid phase is guided to be vertically downward, and the solid phase sprayed at a high speed is prevented from directly colliding with the inner wall of the shell; through the arrangement of the buffer plate, solid phases can be stacked into a roughly triangular buffer pile at the buffer plate due to existence of dead angles, the buffer pile can buffer and decelerate subsequent solid phases, collision between the solid phases moving at a high speed and a rigid structure is avoided, the discharging process is carried out stably, and the activity of the solid phases is guaranteed.

titulo: Phosphorus and potassium solubilizing functional bacterium reinforced chicken manure aerobic fermentation method
abstract: The invention discloses a phosphorus-dissolving and potassium-dissolving functional bacterium reinforced chicken manure aerobic fermentation method, and relates to the technical field of harmless treatment of livestock breeding wastes. According to the method, fresh broiler chicken manure is used as a unique raw material, no biomass auxiliary material needs to be added, a fed-batch continuous fermentation mode is adopted, directional reinforcement and scientific supplement of a high-activity high-temperature-resistant phosphorus-dissolving and potassium-dissolving composite functional bacterial agent are adopted, high-temperature fermentation compost with the water content of 45-55% is adopted for fermentation starting, the loading amount is controlled to be 70-80% of the effective volume of a tank body, and the fermentation time is 2-3 hours; rapid innocent treatment of broiler chicken manure and efficient activation of phosphorus and potassium nutrients are achieved, the fermentation efficiency and the product quality are greatly improved, energy consumption is reduced, and the requirement for continuous manure treatment of a large-scale farm is met.

applicante: SHANDONG FOCUS FREDA BIOLOGICAL CO LTD
titulo: Multi-section feeding, mixing and strengthening device for semi-continuous fermentation of hyaluronic acid
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of hyaluronic acid fermentation, and particularly relates to a multi-section feeding, mixing and strengthening device for semi-continuous fermentation of hyaluronic acid. The multi-section feeding, mixing and strengthening device for semi-continuous fermentation of hyaluronic acid comprises a fermentation tank, feed inlets are formed in the top, the middle and the bottom of the fermentation tank, the feed inlet in the top of the fermentation tank is connected with a storage device, and the storage device is provided with a branch connected with the feed inlet in the bottom of the fermentation tank. A feed port in the middle of the fermentation tank body is connected with an alkali liquor tank; the bottom of the fermentation tank is connected with a buffer tank through a delivery pump. According to the multi-section feeding, mixing and strengthening device for semi-continuous fermentation of hyaluronic acid disclosed by the utility model, reasonable supply of nutrient substances in the fermentation process of hyaluronic acid and uniform gas distribution in the fermentation process are realized through structural designs such as multi-section accurate feeding, strengthening and mixing, optimization of gas distribution and the like, the dissolved oxygen rate in fermentation liquor is increased, and the quality of the fermentation liquor is improved. The stability of the fermentation process is ensured.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ D'AMÉLIORATION DE LA QUALITÉ NUTRITIONNELLE DE PUPES DE VER À SOIE, DE FARINE DE PUPES DE VER À SOIE ET DE DÉCHETS DE VER À SOIE (SPM) PAR FERMENTATION À L'ÉTAT SOLIDE À L'AIDE D'UN PROCÉDÉ DE CO-CULTURE SÉQUENTIELLE
abstract: The present invention relates to compositions and methods for improving the nutritional quality of a silkworm-based substrate, such as silkworm pupae, silkworm pupae meal or silkworm waste (SPM). The method utilizes a sequential solid-state fermentation process that synergistically increases both the crude protein content and the digestibility of the substrate. The process also improves the amino acid profile by increasing the concentration of lysine and methionine, enhances the fatty acid profile by reducing saturated fats, and decreases undesirable components like carbohydrates and non-protein nitrogen. The resulting fermented product is a highly digestible, protein-rich animal feed component particularly suitable for use in aquaculture feeds, but may also be useful for humans.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ POUR LA PRODUCTION D'ARÔMES NATURELS, UTILISATION D'UN BASIDIOMYCÈTE DU GENRE TRAMETES ET INGREDIENT ALIMENTAIRE
abstract: The present invention relates to a biological process for the production of natural aromas, in particular passion fruit and meat aromas, to use of a basidiomycete and to a food ingredient. The proposed solution is based on the solid-state fermentation of edible fungi and uses plant waste as a substrate. The present invention can be used as an aromatising agent in a range of products across a wide variety of industries. These aromas are particularly suitable for use in food products and beverages, but they also have potential applications in cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and hygiene products.

applicante: SICHUAN WUDOUMI FOOD DEV CO LTD
titulo: Edible mushroom polypeptide composition as well as directional enrichment method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an edible mushroom polypeptide composition as well as a directional enrichment method and application thereof, and relates to the field of food biology. The directional enrichment method comprises the following steps: pretreating an edible mushroom substrate; performing pulsed electric field pretreatment and inoculation; performing constant-temperature and constant-humidity solid-state fermentation; performing ultrasonic-microwave synergistic immersion extraction and inactivation; and carrying out multi-stage targeted separation and enrichment. The edible mushroom polypeptide composition comprises a umami peptide ATARTA. The invention discloses application of the edible mushroom polypeptide composition in food seasoning. According to the invention, it is found for the first time that the edible fungus extract fermented by the eurotium cristatum contains the umami peptide ATARTA, the pulsed electric field pretreatment and the eurotium cristatum fermentation are combined, and two-stage ultrafiltration graded enrichment is matched, so that directional enrichment of the specific hexapeptide ATARTA in the edible fungus fermentation product is realized, and the edible fungus extract can be applied to food seasoning.

applicante: HENAN YOUKE PET PRODUCTS CO LTD
titulo: Preparation method of enzymolysis and fermentation complete food for regulating intestinal microecology of cats
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of pet food preparation, and discloses a preparation method of enzymolysis fermentation complete food for regulating cat intestinal microecology, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: raw material pretreatment, composite enzymolysis treatment, fermentation substrate preparation, complex microbial inoculant fermentation, after-ripening and drying, functional grease mixture preparation and probiotic microcapsule embedding. The animal protein source and the plant protein source are subjected to step-by-step composite enzymolysis treatment, macromolecular protein is degraded into small molecular peptide and amino acid, the bioavailability of nutrient substances is improved, and potential sensitizers are passivated; then, a composite probiotic leavening agent with a specific ratio is used for carrying out temperature-controlled and humidity-controlled solid-state fermentation on a substrate containing an enzymolysis product, and predigestion and flavor improvement are carried out on a base material, so that a final product can mildly act on the intestinal tracts of cats, and a nutrient and material basis is provided for establishment of beneficial microbial communities in the intestinal tracts and adjustment of micro-ecological balance; therefore, the efficacy of regulating the intestinal micro-ecology of the complete food is enhanced.

titulo: Preparation method of ecological bamboo-flavor liquor
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of ecological bamboo-flavor Baijiu, and belongs to the technical field of Baijiu brewing. On the basis of a traditional fen-flavor liquor process, three core technologies are innovatively adopted: 1, bamboo particles are prepared from bamboo materials such as phyllostachys pubescens and the like, and traditional rice husk auxiliary materials are completely replaced and subjected to exclusive pretreatment; 2, the movable intelligent constant-temperature ventilation saccharifying box is made of phyllostachys pubescens, so that season limitation is broken through, and four-season production is realized; 3, the inner wall of the pit is built with phyllostachys pubescens for ecological anaerobic fermentation; the technology comprises the whole processes of raw material pretreatment, solid state fermentation, distillation, constant-temperature cave storage and natural blending, pesticide residues and foreign flavors of rice hulls are thoroughly eliminated, bamboo fragrance is naturally generated, the fragrance body is coordinated, the liquor body is pure and healthy, the flavor is unique, a standardized ecological bamboo fragrance type liquor production system is constructed, and the technology has novelty, creativity and practicability and is suitable for large-scale production.

applicante: HUNAN GREAT SANXIANG CAMELLIA OIL RESOURCES CO LTD
titulo: Method for preparing camellia oleosa seed oil through fermentation
abstract: The invention discloses a method for preparing camellia oleosa seed oil through fermentation, and belongs to the field of agricultural product processing. The method comprises the following steps: S1, preparing a composite crude enzyme solution with low lipase activity by taking oil-tea meal as a substrate and combining aspergillus niger solid-state fermentation with later ventilation and precipitation treatment; s2, mixing the composite crude enzyme liquid with crushed camellia seeds to prepare pulp, inoculating lactic acid bacteria, and carrying out biological acidification fermentation, so that the pH value of the pulp is reduced to 4.0 or below; s3, performing enzymolysis on the acidified slurry, performing centrifugal separation after enzyme deactivation, and respectively collecting upper crude oil, middle camellia oleifera fermentation filtrate and bottom solid. According to the method disclosed by the invention, the special compound enzyme with high wall-breaking activity and low lipolytic activity is obtained by fermenting the homologous oil-tea meal, and an acidic microenvironment is constructed by combining with the biological acidification of lactic acid bacteria, so that the hydrolysis rancidity of oil is effectively inhibited, the green extraction of the oil-tea seed oil with high oil yield and low acid value is realized, and meanwhile, the oil-tea fermentation filtrate is co-produced.

titulo: Microbial fertilizer solid-state fermentation tank convenient to feed
abstract: The invention discloses a microbial fertilizer solid-state fermentation tank convenient to feed, and relates to the technical field of microbial fertilizer manufacturing, the microbial fertilizer solid-state fermentation tank comprises a fermentation tank body, a support, a feed pipe and a discharge pipe, the support is fixed at the side position of the bottom of the fermentation tank body, the feed pipe is communicated and fixed at the middle position of the top of the fermentation tank body, and the discharge pipe is communicated and fixed at the bottom of the fermentation tank body; the fermentation tank further comprises an auxiliary feeding mechanism connected with the inner wall of the fermentation tank body, and the auxiliary feeding mechanism comprises a material distributing assembly located at the bottom of the feeding pipe and a knocking assembly connected to the top of the inner wall of the fermentation tank body. The problems that a microbial fertilizer solid-state fermentation tank is uneven in material distribution and frequent in material blockage are solved, materials can be evenly distributed in multiple positions of the inner cavity of the fermentation tank body, and therefore the problems of single-point feeding, local accumulation and uneven material distribution are thoroughly solved.

applicante: FUAN PHARMACEUTICAL GROUP YANTAI JUSTAWORE PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
titulo: Strain solid state fermentation bioreactor
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of biological fermentation, in particular to a strain solid-state fermentation bioreactor which comprises a fermentation tank, an upper cover is mounted on the upper side of the fermentation tank, a feed hopper is mounted on the upper cover, two groups of stirring shafts with the same specification are arranged in the fermentation tank, and stirring augers are fixedly arranged on the two groups of stirring shafts. Two groups of stirring motors are mounted at the right end of the fermentation tank, one ends of the two groups of stirring shafts are respectively connected to the output ends of the two groups of stirring motors, an air inlet pipe and a water inlet pipe are arranged on the upper cover, an air pipe valve is assembled on the air inlet pipe, and a plurality of groups of water outlet nozzles are uniformly distributed at the bottom of the upper cover and are connected with the water inlet pipe through hoses; a discharge hole is formed in the front side of the bottom surface of the fermentation tank, and an openable and closable sealing cover plate is hinged to the discharge hole. According to the utility model, a convection stirring mode is formed through the two groups of stirring augers which rotate in opposite directions, so that matrix accumulation caused by single-direction stirring is avoided, materials form circular flow in the tank, local dead angles are reduced, and the stirring effect is enhanced.
termos_detectados: fermentation, solid-state fermentation, solid state fermentation, bioreactor

titulo: Highland barley and gastrodia elata beverage and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a highland barley and gastrodia elata beverage, and belongs to the technical field of food processing. Existing gastrodia elata beverage preparation methods have the problems of low extraction efficiency of active ingredients, difficulty in synergistic utilization of highland barley functional ingredients, dependency on exogenous addition of flavor, easiness in precipitation of products and the like. The preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing and curing highland barley and gastrodia elata according to a specific ratio, inoculating a composite leavening agent containing saccharomyces cerevisiae, lactobacillus plantarum and streptococcus thermophilus for solid-state fermentation, and performing enzymolysis and subsequent treatment through a composite enzyme preparation containing alpha-amylase, beta-glucanase and pectinase to obtain the beverage. The method synergistically improves enrichment of gastrodin and highland barley beta-glucan, creates coordinated flavor, and improves product stability. The obtained beverage is mainly used for providing a flavored beverage with nutritional and health-care functions of the gastrodia elata and the highland barley.

applicante: GUIZHOU YICHONG KANGSHAN BIOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD
titulo: Blueberry pomace pet health-care feed rich in active ingredients and preparation method of blueberry pomace pet health-care feed
abstract: The invention discloses a blueberry pomace pet health-care feed rich in active ingredients and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: mixing blueberry pomace which is dried and crushed at a low temperature with an acidizing color-protecting solution, performing color-protecting treatment under a low-oxygen condition, and performing composite enzymolysis and lactic acid bacteria and saccharomycetes segmented solid-state fermentation to obtain a blueberry pomace active fermentation base material; mixing the blueberry pomace active fermentation base material with a protein-polysaccharide protection solution, and performing vacuum drying and size stabilization to obtain a blueberry pomace active protection compound; basic feed raw materials are mixed, granulated and cooled, then the cooled basic feed raw materials and the blueberry pomace activity protection compound are subjected to low-temperature post-coating, and the pet health-care feed is obtained. According to the present invention, the retention rate of anthocyanin, polyphenol and dietary fiber in the blueberry pomace can be increased, the anti-oxidation nutrition supply, the gastrointestinal release performance, the palatability and the storage stability can be improved, and the blueberry pomace nutrition supplement powder is suitable for daily nutrition supplement of pets.

titulo: Method for judging flora interaction relationship of solid-state fermentation of composite microbial system and application of method for judging flora interaction relationship of solid-state fermentation of composite microbial system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of microbial solid-state fermentation, and relates to a method for judging a flora interaction relation of solid-state fermentation of a compound bacterium system and application of the method, and the method comprises the following steps: respectively carrying out solid-state fermentation on each single bacterium in the compound bacterium system, and extracting the maximum thermal power and the total heat yield of each single bacterium; carrying out solid-state fermentation on the compound microbial system, and extracting actually measured maximum thermal power and actually measured total heat production of the compound microbial system; calculating the theoretical maximum thermal power and the theoretical total heat production based on the inoculation proportion of each single bacterium in the compound bacterium system and the thermal spectrum data of the single bacterium; and judging the flora interaction relationship according to the difference between the maximum thermal power and the total heat production of the compound microbial system and the theoretical maximum thermal power and the theoretical total heat production. A distinguishing system capable of distinguishing different cooperation modes is established through the combination of the total heat production and the maximum thermal power parameter, thermal spectrum data are monitored in real time in the whole process, whole-process dynamic tracking of flora interaction is achieved, and engineering guidance is provided for accurate regulation and control of the fermentation process and directional optimization of flora functions.

titulo: Novel strain of clopentium ivongi and application of novel strain of clopentium ivongi
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of microbial fermentation, and particularly relates to an ivory-color kuntingia and an application of the ivory-color kuntingia. In order to provide more wine brewing microbial resources capable of resisting high temperature and producing pyrazines, the invention separates a new strain MZ35 of the kuntingia in ivory color from Maotai-flavor yeast, and the preservation number is CCTCC NO: M 20252598. The strain can adapt to high-temperature solid-state fermentation and Maotai-flavor liquor fermented grain stacking fermentation environment, and formation of tetramethylpyrazine is promoted. After the MZ35 is inoculated to a sorghum solid-state fermentation or fermented grain reinforced fermentation system, the content of tetramethylpyrazine can be remarkably increased. In addition, the strain can promote accumulation of sauce-flavor related substances or precursor substances such as acetoin and trimethylpyrazine. Therefore, the strain has an important application value for the stacking fermentation of white spirit, the regulation and control of the flavor of fermented grains and the preparation of solid-state fermentation products enriched with tetramethylpyrazine.

applicante: TIANJIN ZEYOU FEED SALES CO LTD
titulo: Preparation method of recombinant bacillus for expressing antibacterial peptide and traditional Chinese medicine residue fermented feed
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of recombinant bacillus for expressing antibacterial peptide and a traditional Chinese medicine residue fermented feed, and belongs to the crossing field of genetic engineering and feed processing. Recombinant bacillus subtilis for expressing chimeric antibacterial peptide CecA-Plc is constructed, and double promoters P43 and PxylA are adopted for driving, so that the recombinant bacillus subtilis with the chimeric antibacterial peptide CecA-Plc is obtained; chinese medicine residues are pretreated by alkaline hydrogen peroxide to release xylose to self-induce efficient expression of antibacterial peptides, and the fermented feed with antibacterial activity and probiotic functions is prepared through two-stage solid-state fermentation.

applicante: ZHEJIANG TIANPENG AGRICULTURAL DEV CO LTD
titulo: Vinasse and tea leaf residue probiotic fermented feed for fattening pigs and application of vinasse and tea leaf residue probiotic fermented feed
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of biological feed, in particular to vinasse and tea leaf residue probiotic fermented feed for fattening pigs and application thereof.The vinasse and tea leaf residue probiotic fermented feed is prepared by compounding vinasse, tea leaf residues, corn flour and composite probiotic fermented liquid and conducting solid-state fermentation. Meanwhile, the pork quality of the fattening pigs is remarkably optimized, and the large-scale live pig breeding requirement is met. High-value utilization of agricultural by-products is achieved, the growing performance and the organism immunity of the fattening pigs can be improved, the breeding cost is reduced, the pork quality is optimized, the technology is simple and easy to popularize, and economic and environmental benefits are achieved.

applicante: SHIJIAZHUANG XINHAI ANIMAL HUSBANDRY CO LTD
titulo: Attracting fermented feed based on pomace resource environmental protection, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural solid waste recycling and functional feed, and particularly relates to food calling fermented feed based on pomace resource environmental protection and a preparation method and application thereof. The phagostimulant fermented feed is prepared from a fermentation carrier, a composite fruit flavor base, an organic acid phagostimulant and a composite fermentation inoculant as raw materials through solid state fermentation under an anaerobic condition. According to the invention, a stable composite fruity system is formed through biological fusion of fruity flavor base components and fermentation esters, so that the problems that a traditional phagostimulant is volatile, the effect is not lasting and the conventional fermentation flavor is uncontrollable are solved, and the feed intake of weaned piglets can be remarkably increased.

titulo: Preparation method of plant chenopodium quinoa high-activity feed based on bacterium-enzyme synergistic fermentation, fermented plant chenopodium quinoa feed and application of fermented plant chenopodium quinoa feed
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of a plant quinoa high-activity feed based on bacterium-enzyme synergistic fermentation, a fermented plant quinoa feed and application, and relates to the technical field of biological fermentation feed preparation. According to the method, plant quinoa, corn flour and ground cinnamon are mixed to obtain a fermentation substrate, compound probiotics and pectinase are added into the fermentation substrate, the water content is adjusted, and the compound probiotics comprise bacillus subtilis, lactobacillus plantarum and saccharomyces cerevisiae; and carrying out solid-state fermentation on the to-be-fermented material, carrying out enzymolysis on pectinase to destroy the cell wall structure of the plant quinoa, carrying out fermentation conversion on the plant quinoa by using the compound probiotics, and drying and crushing to obtain the fermented plant quinoa feed. The release degree of soluble active ingredients in the plant quinoa can be improved.

applicante: INST ANIMAL SCIENCE & VETERINARY MEDICINE SHANDONG AAS
titulo: Feed processing method of expired instant noodles
abstract: The invention provides a feed processing method of expired instant noodles, and belongs to the technical field of feed. The preparation method comprises the following steps: crushing overdue fried instant noodle cakes, and performing enzymolysis by adopting lipase; then carrying out compound enzyme enzymolysis, adding a seasoning bag, carrying out aerobic solid-state fermentation by adopting a compound probiotic preparation, carrying out ultraviolet irradiation, and carrying out micro-voltage instantaneous pulse illumination liquid anaerobic fermentation by adopting the compound probiotic preparation; filtering the fermented material to obtain a supernatant which is the compound organic acid feed additive rich in organic acid and probiotics; and uniformly mixing the filter residues with sodium chloride and rice hull powder, extruding and granulating to prepare the biological feed rich in mycoprotein and nucleotide. Substances such as carbohydrates, grease and table salt in instant noodles are fully utilized and converted into a composite organic acid feed additive rich in organic acid and probiotics and a biological feed rich in mycoprotein and nucleotide, and the health and efficient utilization of livestock and poultry are promoted.

titulo: Vinegar residue-based single-cell protein feed as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a vinegar residue-based single-cell protein feed as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of feed preparation. According to the method, the vinegar residue is used as a raw material, aspergillus, candida utilis and saccharomyces cerevisiae are compounded and combined with compound enzyme for solid-state fermentation, the synergistic effect of strains and the enzymolysis effect of exogenous enzyme are utilized, fibrous substances in the vinegar residue are efficiently degraded and converted into microbial protein, and the microbial protein is used for degrading the vinegar residue. The crude protein content in the prepared vinegar residue-based single-cell protein feed is increased from 5-8% of the raw materials to 20-25%, and the total fibrous matter degradation rate is greater than or equal to 60%. The vinegar residue-based single-cell protein feed produced by the invention has good feeding value, can effectively replace part of protein raw materials such as soybean meal, improves the production performance of beef cattle, reduces the breeding cost, realizes high-value utilization of vinegar residue resources, and has good popularization and application prospects.

titulo: Straw-based single-cell protein feed as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of animal feed preparation, and particularly relates to a straw-based single-cell protein feed as well as a preparation method and application thereof. According to the method, straw lignin barriers are broken through steam explosion and alkali-oxygen pretreatment, and the polysaccharide degradation efficiency is improved; trichoderma reesei mutant bacteria are obtained by mutagenesis of normal-pressure and room-temperature plasma (ARTP), and are matched with bacteria-enzyme synergistic solid-state fermentation, fermentable sugar is efficiently converted, and the crude protein content of the product is greatly increased. The process abandons traditional high-pollution chemical treatment, is water-saving and environment-friendly, adopts cheap and easily available raw materials, and is easy for large-scale production. According to the method, the straw crude protein can be improved from 4%-6% to 10%-15%, and the quality improvement effect is remarkable. titulo: Feeding control method and system based on multi-modal data
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent breeding, in particular to a feeding control method and system based on multi-modal data. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-modal data in a breeding process through a multi-modal sensor array, and constructing a time sequence fusion data set; on the basis of the time sequence fusion data set, a self-adaptive feature extraction algorithm is adopted to extract ingestion behavior feature vectors; inputting the ingestion behavior feature vector into a feeding decision model based on deep reinforcement learning, and generating a blanking amount parameter, a blanking opportunity parameter and a water-feed ratio parameter; and driving an execution mechanism to complete feeding operation according to the control parameters, and feeding back and collecting new data in real time to form closed-loop control. The problems that in the prior art, the data collection dimension is single, feature extraction lacks adaptivity, the feeding strategy optimization capacity is insufficient, and an effective closed-loop feedback mechanism is lacked are solved, and the feed utilization rate and the breeding benefits are remarkably improved.

According to the embodiment of the invention, the pig group is dynamically grouped according to the body weight difference, the feeding strategy is adjusted, the optimal slaughter plan is generated by integrating economic factors, abnormity is identified through multi-dimensional verification, the health state is output, a formula switching decision is made, and a complete data processing flow of bred pigs from data acquisition to feedback execution is formed.

titulo: Numerical control energy efficiency adaptive planning method based on physical information neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a numerical control energy efficiency self-adaptive planning method based on a physical information neural network, relates to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing and numerical control machining, and aims to overcome the defects of high standby energy consumption of a machine tool and poor generalization of a pure data driving model caused by an existing conservative feeding strategy. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing an instantaneous mechanical model containing to-be-identified physical parameters; secondly, a physical information neural network is trained in a mixed mode through small sample cutting data, network weights and physical parameters are jointly updated, and pre-adaptive identification of material attributes and high-fidelity prediction of cutting force are achieved; track discretization and geometric Boolean operation are carried out on the numerical control program, and instantaneous cutting features are extracted; and finally, reversely solving a global optimal variable feed speed sequence by combining network forward reasoning and machine tool physical constraints and relying on an automatic differential mechanism and a hot start gradient descent algorithm. According to the method, on the premise that additional sensor hardware is not added, remarkable energy conservation and efficiency improvement of complex curved surface machining are achieved.

titulo: Dynamic regulation and control method for fish culture strategy
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of aquaculture management, in particular to a dynamic regulation and control method for a fish culture strategy, which comprises the following steps: acquiring water quality parameters of a culture water body and fish school behavior video data in real time, and extracting behavior feature vectors; according to the water quality parameters and the behavior feature vectors, multi-dimensional risk components are calculated and fused into a comprehensive risk index; dividing risk grades according to the comprehensive risk index, and determining a corresponding feeding mode; calculating a reference feeding amount, and calculating a suggested feeding amount in combination with the feeding mode, the reference feeding amount and a risk adjustment coefficient determined by the comprehensive risk index; and finally, generating and adjusting a feeding strategy according to the feeding mode and the suggested feeding amount. According to the method, the disease risk can be quantified, active prevention is achieved, a disease transmission chain is blocked from the source through risk-driven dynamic feeding strategy management, and the scientificity and the automation level of breeding decision making are improved.

titulo: Prawn body color staged regulation and control method based on carotenoid metabolism time sequence
abstract: The invention discloses a prawn body color staged regulation and control method based on a carotenoid metabolism time sequence, and belongs to the technical field of aquaculture. The method comprises the following steps: determining a feeding time sequence according to the metabolic aging difference of at least two different carotenoids in hepatopancreas of prawns; according to the feeding time sequence, respectively feeding corresponding carotenoids in different stages of prawn culture. The metabolic aging difference comprises at least one of onset time, peak time, conversion time or half-life period. Based on time sequence metabolism characteristics of carotenoids such as astaxanthin (on the day of effect taking), canthaxanthin (reaching a peak on the second day), zeaxanthin (being converted on the fourth day), beta-carotene (being converted on the sixth day) and the like, a staged accurate feeding strategy is provided, and adjustment can be carried out in combination with a prawn shelling period. The method is simple to operate, can remarkably improve the body surface redness of the prawns, improve the pigment utilization efficiency and reduce the culture cost, and is suitable for body color regulation and control of economic prawns such as litopenaeus vannamei.

titulo: Automatic calf feeder
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of feeders, and particularly relates to an automatic feeder for calves, which comprises a feeding unit for storing milk replacer; the water supply unit is used for providing a constant-temperature water source required for dissolving the milk replacer; the stirring unit is used for mixing and stirring the milk replacer and water to form normal milk; the feeder is used for storing mixed normal milk; the first recognition unit is used for recognizing individual information of the calves and precisely controlling the feeding amount of the corresponding calves according to the recognition result in combination with a preset feeding strategy; the gateway control unit is used for controlling the number of the calves entering the feeding station and preventing confusion caused by simultaneous entering of multiple calves; the second identification unit is used for identifying individual information of the calves before the calves enter the feeding station; the first driving unit is used for driving the calves which do not meet the conditions of entering the feeding station; and the control system is used for controlling the first driving unit to operate according to the identification result of the second identification unit so as to drive the calves which do not meet the conditions of entering the feeding station, so that the calves leave the gateway control unit area.

titulo: Preparation method and application of yak bone marrow protein peptide for increasing bone mineral density
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicine, and discloses a preparation method of yak bone marrow protein peptide with bone targeting. The preparation method comprises the following steps: pre-freezing, crushing and homogenizing yak bone marrow, adding pancreatic lipase at 40-45 DEG C to act for 0.5-1 hour, reducing the pH value of a system to 6.0-6.5 by using generated free fatty acid, then adding neutral protease to continue enzymolysis for 3-4 hours, and performing enzyme deactivation, centrifugation, 5kDa ultrafiltration classification, calcium salt loading and drying to obtain protein peptide powder. The molecular weight of the protein peptide is less than 5kDa, the calcium binding rate is not less than 75%, and the protein peptide can be used for preparing medicines for preventing or treating osteoporosis. According to the invention, microenvironment self-regulation is realized in the same reaction system through a timing sequence differential feeding strategy of pancreatic lipase, the degreasing and pH regulation steps are simplified, and the peptide yield and bone deposition activity are improved.

titulo: Bird behavior and water quality coupling driven machine learning self-adaptive feeding device and use method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a bird behavior and water quality coupling driven machine learning self-adaptive feeding device and a use method thereof. The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment engineering technology, and discloses a bird behavior and water quality coupling driven machine learning self-adaptive feeding device. The device comprises a self-adaptive feeding system decision module and a feeding device module; the self-adaptive feeding system decision-making module is composed of an AI camera, a polycrystalline silicon solar panel, a wireless communication module, a storage battery, a data processor and a water quality sensor, and the AI camera, the polycrystalline silicon solar panel, the wireless communication module, the storage battery, the data processor and the water quality sensor are all installed on a stainless steel support. The AI camera is located at the top of the stainless steel support. Through a double-layer machine learning architecture, the bird population density, behavior characteristics and environmental water quality are automatically monitored, a feeding strategy is dynamically optimized, self-adaptive regulation and control of the feeding amount are achieved, water quality pollution and food waste caused by excessive feeding are avoided, and endogenous release pollution caused by bird fight for food is reduced.

titulo: Fish school accurate feeding method and device based on multi-modal perception and uncertainty weighted multi-task learning
abstract: The invention relates to an accurate fish school feeding method based on multi-modal perception and uncertainty weighted multi-task learning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring pre-selected multi-source heterogeneous data as model input data; processing the model input data through a preset feature project to obtain a unified multi-modal joint feature vector; the unified multi-modal joint feature vector is processed by an uncertainty weighted multi-task model integrating a double attention mechanism and a self-adaptive loss balance mechanism, and an optimized feeding decision is obtained; the optimized feeding strategy is analyzed, a feeding control instruction is generated, and accurate feeding of the fish school is achieved based on the feeding control instruction. According to the method, an uncertainty weighted multi-task model is adopted, the problems of data singleness and multi-task balance difficulty are solved, the decision-making precision and the bait utilization rate are improved through double-attention mechanism optimization, and high-benefit culture is achieved. According to the invention, the sustainability of the breeding environment is optimized, and the water quality and fish school health are promoted.

titulo: Low-temperature continuous microchannel synthesis process of narrow-distribution VP/VI copolymer

According to the invention, the micro-channel reactor, the low-temperature redox initiation system and the segmented feeding strategy based on the monomer reactivity rate are cooperated. The method specifically comprises the following steps: preparing a monomer solution and segmenting; preparing an initiator solution; reacting the first part of monomer with all the initiator in a first-stage microchannel module at 35-55 DEG C; then supplementing a second part of monomers at a specific position of the second-stage module, and continuing the reaction; and finally purifying. According to the method, rapid and uniform polymerization is realized under mild conditions, composition drift is effectively inhibited, the copolymer with uniform chain segment sequence and narrow molecular weight distribution is obtained, energy consumption is remarkably reduced, and the method is suitable for continuous production of high-quality VP/VI copolymers.

titulo: Newborn state monitoring system and method integrated with intelligent feeding
abstract: The invention discloses a newborn state monitoring system and method integrated with intelligent feeding, and relates to the technical field of newborn nursing equipment, and the system comprises a sensing module, an edge calculation module, an execution module, a man-machine interaction module and a compliance guarantee module. Intelligent integrated closed-loop regulation and control are achieved, multi-modal physiological monitoring, three milk feeding modes and nipple training are deeply fused, a core algorithm dynamically optimizes a feeding strategy according to real-time data, the problem that monitoring and feeding are disjointed is solved, precise self-adaptive feeding of newborns is achieved, the clinical efficiency and nursing quality are remarkably improved, and the system is worthy of popularization and application. The device can be widely applied to newborn intensive care units and nursing centers.

titulo: Chicken aging assessment method based on PDCD10 gene transcript and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a chicken aging evaluation method based on PDCD10 gene transcript and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of biological detection. The invention provides an application of a PDCD10 gene transcript as a chicken senescence marker. A nucleotide sequence of cDNA (complementary deoxyribonucleic acid) corresponding to the PDCD10 gene transcript is shown as SEQ ID No. 1. The PDCD10 gene transcript shows the expression characteristic of persistent and linear decline along with the increase of chicken ages in a plurality of chicken tissues, and the whole physiological senescence state of the chicken can be reflected more accurately according to the cross-tissue consistent molecular change rule in the senescence process, so that the stability and reliability of chicken senescence evaluation are improved. The method can be used for grading evaluation and dynamic monitoring of the aging state of the chicken flocks, and a molecular reference basis is provided for grouping management, elimination time selection and feeding strategy adjustment of the chicken flocks in the breeding process.

titulo: Method for accurately emptying blast furnace shutdown bin based on data fitting
abstract: The invention discloses a data fitting-based blast furnace shutdown bin accurate emptying method, which specifically comprises the following steps: carrying out an empty bin test before shutdown, and recording bin position data and used material batch number for each bin at intervals until the bin is empty; calculating the total weight of each stock bin and the corresponding residual weight of different bin positions by combining the collected data with the average return rate, and establishing a bin position-residual weight corresponding data table; the data table is imported into data analysis software to be processed, and a mathematical relational expression associated with the bin position and the residual weight is obtained; according to the preset material using plan of the stoppage furnace material, the furnace feeding time interval of each batch of material is calculated in combination with the blast furnace operation parameters; integrating the data of the steps and the relational expression, obtaining a time-consumption-bin position corresponding relation table through calculation, and inquiring the theoretical bin position and the residual weight of the stock bin at any time point; the actual bin position and the theoretical bin position are compared in real time, and the feeding strategy is adjusted; the method effectively solves the problems that in the prior art, hollow bin precision is insufficient, operation is complex, and risks and hidden dangers are many.

applicante: SUZHOU YUNQING ENVIRONMENTAL ENERGY TECH CO LTD
titulo: Automatic feeding method and device for gasification furnace, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to an automatic charging method and device for a gasification furnace, electronic equipment and a storage medium, the method adopts a charging monitoring system, the system comprises a thermal imaging device, first to fourth positioning modules, a material lock lower valve and the gasification furnace, each positioning module comprises a plurality of positioning sub-blocks, and the method comprises the following steps: identifying the first to fourth positioning modules, determining a current positioning module corresponding to a material layer in the gasification furnace; identifying the number of the positioning sub-blocks in the current positioning module to obtain the number of the current positioning sub-blocks; and determining an automatic feeding strategy of the gasification furnace according to the number of the current positioning sub-blocks and the current temperature of the material layer, and automatically feeding the gasification furnace based on the automatic feeding strategy. Therefore, the problems of inaccurate material level monitoring and potential safety risks of the existing gasification furnace charging technology are solved, the real-time and accurate monitoring of the material level and the temperature in the gasification furnace can be realized in a high-temperature and high-pressure environment, and the stable operation of the gasification furnace is ensured.

applicante: HUBEI BOHAI BIOLOGICAL HOLDING GROUP CO LTD
titulo: Constant temperature control and early warning system for glycoside-containing fertilizer production adding link
abstract: The invention provides a constant temperature control and early warning system for a glycoside-containing fertilizer production and addition link, which comprises the following steps: carrying out multi-mode production monitoring and timestamp labeling on the glycoside-containing fertilizer production and addition link to obtain a production parameter sequence, and carrying out material viscosity analysis and foam thickness analysis on the production parameter sequence to obtain a standard parameter sequence; constructing a reduced-order thermal network model, and dynamically correcting the reduced-order thermal network model to obtain a standard temperature distribution model; performing active thermal damage analysis on the glycoside-containing fertilizer based on the standard temperature distribution model to obtain an activity attenuation index sequence, and performing adhesion risk analysis on the three-dimensional model of the feeding bin based on the standard parameter sequence to obtain an adhesion risk index sequence; and constructing a feeding risk prediction model, carrying out future risk prediction and strategy updating based on the feeding risk prediction model to obtain a constant-temperature feeding strategy, and carrying out production feeding according to the constant-temperature feeding strategy.
scores_por_categoria: Fed-Batch & Feeding Strategy:6 | Process Monitoring & Control:6

applicante: HUANENG ZHEJIANG ENERGY DEV CO LTD CLEAN ENERGY BRANCH
titulo: Intelligent precise feeding management method and device for offshore wind-fish integration
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent marine fishery, in particular to an intelligent precise feeding management method and device for offshore wind-fish fusion, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining environment dimension data and fish behavior dimension data; inputting the environment dimension data and the fish behavior dimension data into a pre-trained feeding decision model; when the dissolved oxygen data is higher than a preset first threshold value, the fish school gathering density is higher than a preset second threshold value, and the fish school activeness is higher than a preset third threshold value, outputting a feeding trigger instruction; after the feeding triggering instruction is received, bait feeding and trapping are conducted, the fish school food grabbing behavior continues to be monitored in the feeding process, monitoring data are fed back to the feeding decision model, and the feeding strategy is optimized. The environmental suitability and the appetite performance of the fish are subjected to multi-dimensional and deep fusion as a combined intelligent criterion for feeding decision making, so that the scientificity and rationality of the feeding decision making are ensured.
scores_por_categoria: Fed-Batch & Feeding Strategy:6 | Bioreactor & Mass Transfer:4

titulo: Periodic feeding method of ampelopsis grossedentata superfine powder in aquaculture and application of periodic feeding method
abstract: The invention discloses a periodic feeding method of ampelopsis grossedentata superfine powder in aquaculture and application of the periodic feeding method. The method comprises the following steps that ampelopsis grossedentata superfine powder is mixed into aquatic animal feed according to the adding amount of 1%-8% of the total weight of the feed, and feeding is conducted in a periodic feeding mode; according to the periodic feeding mode, continuous feeding is conducted for 7 days, then medicine stopping is conducted for 7-21 days, and the mode is cyclically conducted as a cycle. According to the method, the ampelopsis grossedentata is smashed to the optimal particle size of 300 meshes, meanwhile, the optimal addition amount of 4% is optimized, and the periodic feeding strategy that the ampelopsis grossedentata is continuously used for 7 days and stopped for 14 days is adopted, so that the anti-oxidation and immunological enhancement effects of the ampelopsis grossedentata are brought into full play, and the liver and kidney burden and immunosuppression risk possibly caused by long-term continuous use are effectively avoided. A big pond application test shows that the protection rate of the method in various aquatic animals such as crucian carp, micropterus salmoides, penaeus vannamei, carp and tilapia reaches 52.91%-65.14%, and the method has remarkable economic benefits and industrial application prospects.

titulo: Self-adaptive control method for nutrition supply and metabolic response in fermentation process
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive control method for nutrition supply and metabolic response in a fermentation process, relates to the technical field of fermentation control, and is used for solving the problems of metabolic imbalance, aggravated process fluctuation and reduced product consistency in a local area in a large-volume and high-feed-rate fermentation process. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out gridding treatment on the internal space of a bioreactor, constructing a uniform space coordinate system, collecting dissolved oxygen concentration and pH fluctuation data at different space positions in real time in combination with a multi-point online sensor array, and reconstructing space metabolism response characteristics in a fermentation process; calculating a comprehensive evaluation index based on response delay and difference to identify a metabolic risk, triggering a feeding strategy switching mechanism when local imbalance is detected, performing segmented and pulse-type adjustment on feeding flow and duration, and combining tail gas carbon dioxide concentration feedback to judge a metabolic state recovery condition. The fermentation stability, the resource utilization rate and the product consistency are improved.

applicante: NANJING VOCATIONAL INST OF TRANSPORT TECHNOLOGY
titulo: Water treatment medicine dosage control method and device
abstract: The invention provides a water treatment drug dosage control method and device, and is applied to the technical field of data processing. According to the method, multi-dimensional field data such as inflow water quality and inflow water quantity are collected to generate basic dosing data, the dosing amount of poly-aluminum and poly-propanamide is calculated by means of a deep neural network in combination with feed-forward, feed-back and compound control, and initial values are generated. Basic data is compared with historical data, an initial value is converted into the pump frequency, the opening degree of the valve is adjusted, and the adding amount is finely adjusted and corrected in combination with water quality feedback parameters. Water quality and equipment parameters are continuously recorded, a feeding strategy is dynamically optimized and feeding parameters are regulated and controlled according to water quality and water quantity changes, finally, seamless switching of double control modes is achieved based on multi-dimensional data, instructions are dynamically adjusted through automatic closed-loop remote control, accurate feeding results are output, and whole-process intelligent control is completed.

applicante: JIANGSU NONGKEN FISHERY SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD
titulo: Fishing-light complementary unmanned aerial vehicle feeding strategy dynamic optimization method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle operation control, in particular to a fishing-light complementation unmanned aerial vehicle feeding strategy dynamic optimization method and system, and aims at the composite attribute of a fishing-light complementation scene, the scheme is coupled with photovoltaic energy complementation power margin, disturbance power consumption and total operation load, and a unified quantitative index of field domain energy calculation ratio is constructed. Cooperative judgment of multi-dimensional core parameters is achieved, hierarchical regulation and control instructions can be generated based on interval distribution of the calculation energy ratio, flight and feeding operation behaviors of the unmanned aerial vehicle are dynamically adjusted, energy redundancy is fully utilized to improve operation efficiency, operation risks can be avoided when energy is insufficient, complex and changeable operation conditions of fishing and light complementation scenes can be adapted, and the operation efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved. The feeding operation efficiency and the operation stability are comprehensively improved.

applicante: EAST CHINA SEA FISHERIES RESEARCH INST CHINESE ACADEMY OF FISHERY SCIENCES
titulo: Intelligent layered precise feeding method based on weever physiological metabolic energy demand model
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent layered precise feeding method based on a weever physiological metabolic energy demand model. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, online estimation of instantaneous total metabolic energy demand of a weever group; step 2, identifying dynamic partitions of the pond based on feeding competition intensity; step 3, generating and executing a layered dynamic feeding strategy; 4, optimizing model parameters based on individual growth uniformity feedback; through direct and real-time online estimation of the instantaneous total metabolic energy demand of the fish school, real-time perception and layered satisfaction of the real physiological demand of the fish school are realized. The accurate perception can effectively reduce the feed coefficient, alleviate the uneven growth caused by feeding competition, and significantly improve the breeding benefits.

applicante: NINGBO PURUISEN NUTRITION TECH CO LTD
titulo: Intelligent precise feeding method and system based on pig farm unit, corollary equipment and monitoring and business use terminal
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent precise feeding method and system based on a pig farm unit, corollary equipment and a monitoring and business use terminal, and belongs to the field of intelligent precise animal feeding. According to key factors such as weight, environment and health of pigs in each pig house unit every day, different nutritional requirements of each pig house unit are precisely calculated, and the feeding efficiency is improved. A feed formula and a feeding execution strategy matched with the nutrition requirement amount are dynamically generated according to the actual conditions such as the feed type, the pig house distribution distance, the feeding time and the number of times in the production of the user, and finally the system monitors the feeding strategy executed by the mixing equipment and indexes such as excess feed of each unit in real time; therefore, closed-loop response is made to the whole-process closed-loop management of pig feeding from nutrient requirement amount calculation, feeding strategy making and execution result monitoring, and precise and fine feeding with daily dynamic response and difference adaptation is achieved. Finally, the adaptation degree of the feeding amount and the required amount of the individual growth nutrition of the pigs can be greatly improved, and the feeding cost is saved.

titulo: Method for improving fermentation efficiency of O-acetyl-L-homoserine
abstract: The invention discloses a method for improving the fermentation efficiency of O-acetyl-L-homoserine, which develops a system factor optimization-double-stage precise regulation and control synergetic fermentation method, improves the yield of OAH, the conversion rate of sugar acid and the process stability by optimizing the culture medium ratio and a pH feedback feeding strategy, realizes efficient matching of thallus growth and product synthesis, and improves the fermentation efficiency of O-acetyl-L-homoserine. Therefore, the end point concentration, yield and production intensity of OAH are improved, and the industrialization process of OAH is promoted.

titulo: Rapid converter slagging method based on high-alkalinity casting residues
abstract: The invention discloses a rapid converter slagging method based on high-alkalinity casting residues, which specifically comprises the following steps: (1) before the beginning of converter smelting, calculating the required high-alkalinity casting residue adding amount based on heat charging information so as to control the content of AlO in early-stage slag as a target mass fraction; (2) after converter loading is completed, high-alkalinity casting residues accounting for 40-60% of the required high-alkalinity casting residues and lime are synchronously added into the converter before blowing; and (3) when the smelting duration reaches 3-5 min, the remaining high-alkalinity casting residues with the needed high-alkalinity casting residue adding amount are put into the furnace. The feeding amount of the high-alkalinity casting residues is calculated based on converter loading information, a batch feeding strategy is adopted, the residues rapidly enter a liquid phase at the initial stage of blowing, a high-alkalinity and high-fluidity slag system is formed, and therefore the slagging and dephosphorizing efficiency is remarkably improved.

applicante: DALIAN TENGFEI PRECISION TECH CO LTD
titulo: Substrate feeding machine
abstract: The utility model provides a substrate feeding machine which comprises a feeding module, a material transferring module, a conveying module, a detecting module and a material pushing module which are fixedly installed on a base, the feeding module is arranged on one side of the base, the feeding module and the conveying module are arranged in parallel, one end of the feeding module and one end of the conveying module are distributed corresponding to the material transferring module, and the other end of the feeding module and one end of the detecting module are distributed corresponding to the material pushing module. And a detection module is arranged at the other ends of the feeding module and the conveying module. Uniform conveying of material boxes is achieved through the feeding module, multi-directional movement of the material boxes is conducted through the material transferring module, the material boxes can be grabbed and moved to the position of the conveying module, electronic substrates are conveyed through the conveying module, the electronic substrates can be placed in the material boxes in a layered mode, and the detection module is arranged at the position of the conveying module; according to the substrate feeding machine, real-time detection in the feeding process of the electronic substrates can be achieved, the conveying module is movably arranged, the electronic substrates can be effectively detected, feeding of the electronic substrates in other material boxes can be conducted, and the machining efficiency of the substrate feeding machine is improved.

titulo: Circuit board substrate feeding structure and etching equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of circuit board etching, in particular to a circuit board substrate feeding structure and etching equipment. The plurality of driving rollers are arranged in parallel, are rotatably mounted on the rack and are used for conveying a substrate; the synchronizing mechanism is connected with the end parts of all the active driving rollers and is used for forcing all the active driving rollers to synchronously rotate; the pressing unit is arranged above the active driving roller and is used for providing multi-point independent adjustable vertical pressure for the passing substrate; the supporting mechanisms are arranged between the adjacent driving rollers and are used for supporting and guiding the edge of the base plate from the bottom; and the uniform grinding mechanism is connected with the bearing seats of at least part of the active driving rollers and is used for driving the active driving rollers to do reciprocating micro motion in the axial direction of the active driving rollers. The substrate conveying device has the effects that the stability of the substrate is guaranteed, the substrate is not prone to damage, and high-precision conveying is achieved.

applicante: DONGGUAN SHUNXINYI AUTOMATION EQUIPMENT CO LTD
titulo: Automatic assembly double-sided film pasting line
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic assembly double-sided film pasting line which comprises a front-section conveying line and a rear-section conveying line, gravity film covering components are arranged on the front-section conveying line and the rear-section conveying line, a turn-over mechanism is arranged between the front-section conveying line and the rear-section conveying line, and an assembly part is turned over by 180 degrees through the turn-over mechanism and then placed on the rear-section conveying line; a base plate feeding mechanism, a check ring assembling mechanism, a first face film pasting unit and a second face film pasting unit are sequentially arranged in the direction of the front section conveying line and the rear section conveying line. By means of series-parallel integration of the substrate feeding mechanism, the check ring assembling mechanism, the double-face film pasting unit and the turn-over mechanism, whole-process automation and double-material parallel production of substrate feeding, check ring assembling, front face film pasting, turn-over and back face film pasting are achieved, and the production efficiency is effectively improved.

applicante: FOSHAN JINYAOHUA GLASS NEW MAT CO LTD
titulo: Double-station glass substrate automatic feeding equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses automatic double-station glass substrate feeding equipment, which relates to the technical field of glass substrate production, and comprises a rack, a support column is fixedly mounted at the upper end of the rack, a conveying shaft is rotatably mounted at the upper end of the support column, a conveying wheel is arranged on the surface of the conveying shaft, and the conveying wheel is mounted on the upper end of the support column. Supporting bases are fixedly installed on the two sides of the upper end of the machine frame, overturning arms are rotatably installed at the upper ends of the supporting bases, the positions of every two adjacent overturning arms are opposite, an air cylinder is movably installed at the upper end of the machine frame, the output end of the air cylinder is movably connected with the overturning arms, and when the overturning arms rotate to the original position under the action of the air cylinder, the overturning arms are driven by the air cylinder to rotate. The overturning arm is attached to the rubber cushion block, the rubber cushion block drives the supporting rod to move, the supporting rod drives the moving block to move, the buffering spring is stretched, under the action of the buffering spring and the rubber cushion block, the overturning of the overturning arm has a certain buffering effect, and meanwhile the overturning arm can be conveniently supported.

applicante: XINTISU HANGZHOU TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
titulo: Substrate feeding device
abstract: The utility model discloses a substrate feeding device, and belongs to the technical field of automation equipment. The substrate feeding device comprises a feeding mechanism, an incoming material detection mechanism and an NG discharging mechanism. The feeding mechanism is used for automatic feeding of products, the incoming material detection mechanism is used for detecting whether the products have defects or not, and the NG discharging mechanism is used for discharging and recycling the products detected by the incoming material detection mechanism to have the defects and empty trays obtained after feeding. Wherein the incoming material detection mechanism comprises a Tray plate transferring assembly, an incoming material detection station, a height measurement sensor and a first camera, the products are conveyed to the incoming material detection station through the Tray plate transferring assembly, and whether the products have defects or not is judged in the mode of measurement of the height measurement sensor and photographing recognition of the first camera. According to the incoming material detection mechanism, the non-contact height measurement sensor and the high-resolution first camera are integrated, so that the automation level and the accuracy of incoming material detection are remarkably improved.

applicante: GUANGDONG RUNDONGXIA HEALTH IND CO LTD
titulo: Hepialus armoricanus larva feeding container
abstract: The utility model provides a hepialus larva feeding container, which relates to the technical field of insect feeding and comprises a container body, the top of the container body is provided with an opening, a partition plate groove is arranged in the container body, a partition plate is clamped on the partition plate groove, and the interior of the container body is divided into a substrate feeding area and a feed feeding area by the partition plate. A separation net is erected in the matrix feeding area, and sponge is filled between the separation net and the bottom of the container body. The survival rate of the hepialus armoricanus larvae can be improved.

titulo: Semiconductor packaging substrate feeding and discharging equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductor production, and provides semiconductor packaging substrate feeding and discharging equipment which comprises semiconductor automatic processing equipment, and an intermittent lifting mechanism is arranged on one side of the semiconductor automatic processing equipment. According to the turnover frame structure, a servo motor is controlled by a controller to start, a movable plate can move upwards along the outer surface of a lead screw, at the moment, the turnover frame structure stops moving upwards, a pulling force is synchronously applied to a second connecting strip, then a pushing force is synchronously applied to the second connecting strip, and a movable rod slides back and forth; the packaging substrate in the turnover frame structure is pushed into the semiconductor automatic processing equipment through the first L-shaped strip, the first L-shaped strip returns from the turnover frame structure, and the operation is repeated, so that the turnover frame structure does not need to be lifted by using a push rod and the packaging substrate in the turnover frame structure is not required to be pushed into the semiconductor automatic processing equipment; and only one servo motor is needed for driving, stability and reliability are achieved, and therefore the input cost of feeding and discharging equipment is reduced.

applicante: CHANGZHOU XIEHE OPTICAL DEVICE CO LTD
titulo: Substrate feeding manipulator for LED lamp circuit board production
abstract: The utility model discloses a substrate feeding manipulator for LED lamp circuit board production, and relates to the technical field of LED lamp production. The feeding device comprises a feeding mechanism, the feeding mechanism is used for grabbing or placing a substrate needed for processing the LED lamp, and the feeding mechanism comprises a mechanical arm, a rectangular top cover and a bidirectional lead screw. According to the utility model, the dismounting assembly is arranged, specifically, the air pump is started to inject air into the air bag through the air chamber and the air pipe, so that the air bag expands and pushes the insertion block outwards to move outwards to be inserted into the rectangular convex block, and then the threaded pin shaft is inserted to anchor the insertion block; in this way, after the air bag exhausts air, the inserting block is driven by the spring to retract into the hollow protruding block, an operator can conveniently control locking of the rectangular top cover and the U-shaped bottom plate through expansion of the air bag, the dismounting steps are simple, special tools do not need to be used for dismounting, and the work progress of equipment maintenance is guaranteed.

titulo: Copper wire automatic embedding FPC manufacturing process
abstract: The invention discloses a copper wire automatic embedding FPC (Flexible Printed Circuit) manufacturing process, which comprises the following steps of S1, substrate feeding: putting an FPC substrate into a copper wire automatic embedding machine and fixing the FPC substrate; s2, circuit pattern design: generating an automatic line embedding path of the FPC circuit; s3, automatically embedding and sealing the copper wire, namely embedding the copper wire into a set depth of the FPC substrate section by section according to the automatic wire embedding path in a continuous paying-off manner by adopting an automatic copper wire embedding and sealing machine to form a conductive circuit; wherein a copper wire is straightened on line in the paying-off process so as to ensure the straightness, a wire embedding path is corrected through CCD visual positioning and coordinate compensation before wire embedding, and redundant copper wires are automatically cut off and recycled after wire embedding; s4, covering film pasting: pasting a windowed covering film on the substrate after wire embedding, and curing the covering film and the substrate through vacuum hot pressing; and S5, punching: punching through laser or a die to obtain the final FPC finished product appearance. The method has the advantages of no copper-containing waste liquid and environmental protection. And redundant copper wires are recycled after being automatically cut off, so that the material cost is remarkably reduced.

titulo: Flexible perovskite solar cell preparation device and method
abstract: The invention discloses a flexible perovskite solar cell preparation device and method, and belongs to the technical field of cell preparation, the flexible perovskite solar cell preparation device comprises a bottom plate, the bottom plate is provided with a covering assembly, a transfer assembly, a transportation assembly and an auxiliary assembly, the covering assembly comprises a plurality of purification work areas and a plurality of preparation work areas, and each preparation work area is internally provided with a slit coating die head; the transfer assembly comprises a plurality of supporting square plates, a pressing sliding frame is movably arranged on the supporting square plates, pressing strip plates are symmetrically installed on the pressing sliding frame in a sliding mode, a first limiting unit is arranged between the supporting square plates and the pressing sliding frame, and a second limiting unit is arranged between every two pressing strip plates. The full-process automatic circulation from flexible substrate feeding, accurate positioning, automatic cutting, atmosphere regulation and control, layer-by-layer coating to finished product discharging is achieved, the production efficiency and the process consistency are remarkably improved, and the device is suitable for large-scale mass production.
