applicante: FORTY EIGHTH RESEARCH INST OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY GROUP CORPORATION
titulo: Wafer slide holder for electron beam exposure machine
abstract: The invention discloses a wafer carrying table for an electron beam exposure machine, which is characterized in that feeding guide rails are symmetrically arranged on two opposite sides of a bottom plate and are used for conveying and guiding a wafer substrate disc; an X-axis reflecting mirror and a Y-axis reflecting mirror which are perpendicular to each other are arranged on two adjacent sides of the bottom plate and are used for feeding back real-time position data in an exposure process; a plurality of groups of sapphire pads are arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate and are used for positioning the height of the wafer substrate disc; the bottom plate is arranged on the motion platform, a plurality of positioning columns are arranged at the bottom of the bottom plate, a plurality of height-adjustable positioning balls are arranged on the surface of the motion platform, and connection and positioning of the bottom plate and the motion platform are realized by compressing and tangency of the positioning balls and inclined groove surfaces at the bottoms of the positioning columns; a pressing seat is arranged in the center of the bottom plate, penetrates through the bottom plate and is tightly attached to the surface of the moving platform, and the pressing seat and the moving platform are locked through an elastic fastening assembly, so that the position of the slide holder is fixed. The device has the advantages of being compact in structure, convenient to operate, high in reliability and the like, and stable substrate feeding and accurate positioning of the substrate disc are achieved.

applicante: JIANGSU LEADMICRO NANOMETER TECH CO LTD
titulo: Substrate feeding and discharging mechanism, substrate feeding and discharging method, substrate feeding and discharging device and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaics, in particular to a substrate feeding and discharging mechanism, a substrate feeding and discharging method, a substrate feeding and discharging device and a medium, and the substrate feeding and discharging mechanism comprises a substrate carrying boat which comprises a plurality of substrate inserting grooves, each substrate inserting groove is provided with M tooth grooves, and each tooth groove is provided with a first substrate carrying position and a second substrate carrying position which are respectively used for loading a substrate; the flower basket is provided with N third substrate carrying positions and used for carrying one substrate, and M is larger than or equal to 0.5 N and smaller than N; the number of the full-loaded slide glass is N, the suction cup assembly is used for being correspondingly matched with the first slide glass position and/or the second slide glass position to complete one-time substrate taking and placing, and the single-batch substrate transferring number of the suction cup assembly between the flower basket and the slide glass boat is N. According to the invention, the number of the tooth grooves in the slide glass boats and the number of the third slide glass positions in the basket are optimized, and the sucker assembly can suck the substrates from the plurality of slide glass boats at the same time, so that the full-load state of the sucker assembly and the basket is achieved, the number of the substrates transferred by the sucker assembly at a time is increased, and the transfer efficiency of the substrates between the slide glass boats and the basket is improved.

applicante: CHANGGUANG PREC MACHINERY GUANGZHOU CO LTD
titulo: Pre-pasting machine glass substrate feeding device based on red light detection
abstract: The utility model discloses a pre-pasting machine glass substrate feeding device based on red light detection, and relates to the technical field of glass substrate processing and transportation, the pre-pasting machine glass substrate feeding device comprises a support, the upper side of the support is fixedly connected with a detection bin, and the inner walls of the two sides of the upper end of the detection bin are connected with lead screws through bearings; the moving motor is fixedly connected to one side of the upper end of the detection bin, and the driving end of the moving motor is connected to the end, outside the detection bin, of the lead screw through a coupler. According to the pre-pasting machine glass substrate feeding device based on red light detection, the deviation condition of a glass substrate in the horizontal direction is detected by adopting a non-contact body of the infrared emitter and the infrared receiver, so that damage to the surface of a glass body caused by traditional rigid contact detection is avoided; meanwhile, under the action of a pressure sensor, a rotating gear shaft and a fixed gear ring in the deviation correcting assembly, deviation of the glass substrate in the vertical direction and the horizontal direction can be rapidly corrected at the same time, and the product quality is guaranteed through flexible clamping of a suction cup.

titulo: Method for controlling biotransformation canrenone by monitoring hydroxylase gene expression quantity
abstract: The invention discloses a method for controlling biotransformation of canrenone by monitoring hydroxylase gene expression quantity, which comprises the following steps: by taking aspergillus ochraceus as a strain and canrenone as a substrate, monitoring the hydroxylase gene expression quantity through a real-time quantitative PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction) technology in a thallus culture and transformation process so as to determine the logarithmic growth middle stage of thallus culture; carrying out biotransformation on canrenone by taking aspergillus ochraceus as a strain and canrenone as a substrate, and putting a foreign aid inducer in the medium logarithmic growth stage of thallus culture to improve the transformation rate. According to the method disclosed by the invention, a molecular biological index, namely the hydroxylase gene expression quantity, is taken as a key process parameter to guide decision of a substrate feeding time point and optimization of transformation conditions, so that precise regulation and control of process optimization driven on the basis of gene expression data can be realized, the transformation rate is greatly improved, and the transformation period is greatly shortened; the application prospect is good.
scores_por_categoria: Fed-Batch & Feeding Strategy:6 | Strain & Metabolic Engineering:8

applicante: NIDEC PREC TESTING EQUIPMENT ZHEJIANG CO LTD
titulo: Automatic adjusting mechanism for substrate feeding
abstract: The utility model discloses an automatic substrate feeding adjusting mechanism which comprises a base, and a liftable stacking table is arranged on the base. The base is provided with a vertically-arranged material pushing rod, the material pushing rod can move in the X-axis direction, and the material stacking table is provided with a first long notch allowing the material pushing rod to penetrate through. A first material pushing block moving in the X-axis direction and a second material pushing block moving in the Y-axis direction are arranged above the base. According to the base plate feeding device, an automatic structure is adopted for feeding the base plates, the base plates are lifted through the liftable stacking table, the stacked base plates sequentially enter the upper clamping positions, the positions of the base plates can be rapidly adjusted through cooperative movement of the pushing blocks and the pushing rods, the feeding speed and the feeding precision are greatly improved, the requirement for large-scale production is met, and the production efficiency is improved. The production cycle is effectively shortened, and the overall production efficiency is improved.

applicante: JIANGXI HENGYI NEW ELECTRONIC MAT CO LTD
titulo: Feeding equipment for aluminum substrate machining
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of aluminum substrate feeding, and discloses feeding equipment for aluminum substrate processing, which comprises a transportation assembly, a cleaning device is arranged on the transportation assembly, and the cleaning device comprises a power part. According to the feeding equipment for aluminum substrate machining, an air pump, a dust collection box, a dust suction pipe, a screw cover, a collection shell, a filter screen, a partition plate, a spring, a sliding rod, a sealing ring and a cover plate are arranged, after the air pump is started, dust on the outer surface of an aluminum substrate is sucked into the collection shell, after cleaning is completed, the screw cover and the collection shell are rotated, the collection shell is taken out downwards, and meanwhile the spring is shortened; the bottom face of the sealing ring extrudes the top face of the partition plate, impurities are prevented from falling below the partition plate, when the device cleans the impurities in the collecting shell, an air pump and a conveying assembly do not need to be closed, and the influence on aluminum substrate conveying is reduced; and by arranging a cleaning brush and a movable shell, the cleaning brush is used for cleaning the outer surface of the aluminum substrate, and impurities are conveniently sucked into a dust collection box.

applicante: HUADIAN JINSHANG CHANGDU NEW ENERGY CO LTD
titulo: No-tillage reseeding integrated device suitable for alpine meadow alopecia areata area
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological restoration engineering, in particular to a no-tillage reseeding integrated device suitable for alpine meadow alopecia areata areas, which comprises a rack assembly, a surface layer membrane rupture assembly, a seed feeding assembly, a substrate feeding assembly and a light-pressing planting assembly, the surface layer membrane breaking assembly conducts shallow layer membrane breaking on the meadow earth surface through a plurality of membrane breaking modules, and underlying soil is not disturbed. The seed feeding assembly is arranged behind the film breaking assembly, and meadow grass seeds are quantitatively sown in a film breaking area; the substrate feeding assembly synchronously covers a grass seed sowing area with a substrate material following the substrate feeding assembly; the light-pressing field planting assembly is located at the tail end and used for conducting light compaction on the reseeding area. On the basis that the original soil structure is not damaged, continuous operation of shallow layer film breaking, quantitative sowing, matrix covering and light pressing planting is achieved, the bald areata area can be efficiently restored, construction disturbance is reduced, the reseeding efficiency and the grass seed survival rate are improved, and the method is suitable for ecological restoration of alpine meadows and project limited areas.

applicante: SHENZHEN HANS CNC SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD
titulo: Base plate feeding and discharging machine tool system and control method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a substrate feeding and discharging machine tool system and a control method thereof. The substrate feeding and discharging machine tool system comprises a base, a machining assembly, a jacking mechanism, a clamping mechanism and a robot operation assembly. According to the base plate feeding and discharging machine tool system, the pins are positioned and clamped through the clamping mechanism, so that after the pins are clamped, the boards on the lowermost layer of the base plates can be supported by the upper surfaces of the clamping mechanism and the jacking mechanism, and therefore the PCBs on the lowermost layer of the base plates can be prevented from falling, base plate material deformation or stacking failure is prevented, and the service life of the base plates is prolonged. Therefore, the substrate with the pin structure can be positioned and processed.

titulo: 5alpha-reductase mutant and application thereof in synthesis of steroid C4, 5 hydrogenation drug intermediate
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of enzyme gene engineering and enzyme engineering, and discloses a 5alpha-reductase mutant and application thereof in synthesis of steroid C4, 5 hydrogenation drug intermediates. Compared with an amino acid sequence of wild type 5 alpha-reductase, the mutant has mutation of at least two sites corresponding to the following sites of the amino acid sequence as shown in SEQ ID NO.1: the 56th site, the 109th site and/or the 144th site. The mutant has efficient catalytic activity on 3-keto steroids, a high-yield target product is obtained under high substrate feeding concentration, no by-product is generated, and the conversion rate is not lower than 99%. The invention also discloses a coding gene, a recombinant vector, an engineering bacterium and application of the mutant, the reaction conditions are mild, the process is simple and environment-friendly, the defects of the traditional method are effectively overcome, technical support is provided for green industrial production of steroid drug intermediates, and the application prospect is wide.
scores_por_categoria: Fed-Batch & Feeding Strategy:6 | Strain & Metabolic Engineering:2 | Scale-up & Industrialization:5

applicante: SHENZHEN PTC VISION SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD
titulo: Ceramic substrate feeding device
abstract: The utility model provides a ceramic substrate feeding device which comprises a base, a feeding bin mechanism and a substrate taking and placing mechanism, wherein the feeding bin mechanism and the substrate taking and placing mechanism are arranged on the base. The upper stock bin mechanism comprises a sliding bottom plate, a stock bin arranged on the sliding bottom plate and provided with an upper opening, an air blowing assembly arranged beside the stock bin, a brush assembly arranged above the air blowing assembly and a jacking assembly, and the substrate taking and placing mechanism upwards sucks substrates one by one from the opening of the stock bin; an air blowing opening of the air blowing assembly blows air to the uppermost layer of base plate and the second layer of base plate of the stock bin from the side face, and when the base plate taking and placing mechanism sucks the base plates and moves upwards to the brush assembly, the brush assembly brushes the edges of the base plates; the jacking assembly is arranged below the stock bin and used for jacking the substrates stacked in the stock bin. By means of the air blowing-brush double anti-lamination design and sequential linkage of the jacking assembly and the taking and placing mechanism, the feeding smoothness is greatly improved, and the feeding period is shortened.

applicante: HEFEI SINEVA INTELLIGENT MACHINE CO LTD
titulo: Large-size substrate vacuum evaporation chamber and vacuum evaporation device
abstract: The invention discloses a large-size substrate vacuum evaporation chamber which comprises an evaporation chamber body and a line source device arranged in the evaporation chamber body, at least one substrate frame used for containing a substrate is arranged in the evaporation chamber body, the substrate frame is located above the line source device, and the line source device is located above the substrate frame. One side of the evaporation chamber is provided with a substrate feeding port for a substrate to enter and exit from the evaporation chamber; the lower portion of the linear source device is horizontally and slidably connected with the bottom of the evaporation chamber through a linear source driving part, and the linear source driving part is fixedly connected with the evaporation chamber through a fixed supporting seat. The linear evaporation source mechanism is used, the precise movement mechanism is installed on the evaporation source mechanism and can reciprocate in the direction of the substrate, the coating thickness and uniformity are controlled by accurately controlling the movement speed of the evaporation source mechanism, and uniform coating of the large-size substrate is achieved.

applicante: KUNSHAN HUITAO MACHINERY TECH CO LTD
titulo: Aluminum substrate feeding mechanism
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of raw material transportation, in particular to an aluminum substrate feeding mechanism which comprises a base, rolling wheels are installed at the four corners of the bottom of the base, and according to the aluminum substrate feeding mechanism, an inclined plate is driven to circularly ascend and descend through circular rotation of an eccentric wheel so as to generate vibration; when moving outside a first threaded rod, a movable block synchronously drives two external cylindrical blocks to slide inside two corresponding limiting grooves, and when the two cylindrical blocks move, the two cylindrical blocks synchronously drive a movable frame to move. The movable frame is rotationally connected with the bottoms of the two cylindrical blocks and the bottom of the adjusting plate, so that angle adjustment of the adjusting plate is achieved, feeding operation can be conveniently carried out by adjusting different angles of the conveyor, and after the device is moved to a designated position through rollers, the device is positioned and fixed through two groups of positioning plates; displacement during use is avoided, and operation is convenient.

applicante: ZHEJIANG CHANGKE CERAMIC NEW MAT CO LTD
titulo: Aluminum nitride ceramic substrate processing and continuous sintering integrated device
abstract: The invention discloses an aluminum nitride ceramic substrate processing and continuous sintering integrated device, and belongs to the field of ceramic substrate processing and conveying. An aluminum nitride ceramic substrate machining and continuous sintering integrated device comprises a base, a conveying belt, an aluminum nitride ceramic substrate sintering furnace and a ceramic substrate placing seat and further comprises a ceramic substrate feeding area, a ceramic substrate conveying area and a ceramic substrate discharging area which are connected. A pushing plate is slidably connected into the long groove. An auxiliary wheel and a driving wheel are rotationally connected into the supporting base. The limiting plate is arranged on the ceramic substrate conveying area in a sliding manner; according to the invention, the pushing plate can be stably positioned at the initial position, the next group of ceramic substrate placing seats can be prevented from sliding into the pushing position in advance, the collision between the ceramic substrate placing seats of the ceramic substrates and the pushing plate is avoided, the deviation of the positions of the ceramic substrate placing seats entering the sintering station is avoided, and the yield is improved.

titulo: Perovskite glass substrate feeding carrier and use method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductor devices, and particularly relates to fragile material conveying equipment, in particular to a perovskite glass substrate feeding carrier and a using method thereof. The perovskite glass substrate feeding carrier is configured to transport a carrier plate carrying a glass substrate and comprises a tongue assembly and a carrier body, the tongue assembly is configured to be at least partially capable of stretching into the inner space of the carrier body and completely move out of the inner space of the carrier body, and the carrier body is configured to move in the vertical direction; the carrier comprises a frame, a supporting block and a carrier vertical displacement piece. According to the invention, no interaction behavior with the upper surface of the glass substrate is generated in the whole feeding process, stable and impact-free transfer of the glass substrate is realized, and the risk of scratching and cracking of the glass substrate is obviously reduced. And a plurality of pairs of supporting blocks are arranged in the carrier, so that a plurality of carrier plates loaded with the glass substrates can be accommodated at one time, and batch transportation is realized.

titulo: Preparation method of efficient biological fertilizer based on quantum tunneling effect regulation and control
abstract: The invention discloses an efficient biological fertilizer preparation method based on quantum tunneling effect regulation and control, relates to the technical field of agricultural biology, in particular to an efficient biological fertilizer preparation method based on quantum tunneling effect regulation and control, and the method comprises the following steps: screening activated syntrophic bacteria and methanogens, and constructing a fermentation system in a customized anaerobic reactor. A nanometer microenvironment monitoring probe, a pressure regulation and control module and a temperature control device which are arranged in the reactor are used for monitoring and regulating and controlling the fermentation environment in real time, and the quantum tunneling efficiency of microbial electron transfer is accurately maintained in the optimal interval of 0.7-0.9. Feeding and output of materials are completed through a strain inoculation opening, a substrate feeding opening and a product discharging opening. The bio-fertilizer prepared by the method can significantly increase the crop yield, effectively reduce the bio-availability of soil heavy metals and degrade pesticide residues, and has the functions of efficient nutrient supply and soil environment remediation.
scores_por_categoria: Fermentation Process:1 | Fed-Batch & Feeding Strategy:6 | Process Monitoring & Control:3

titulo: Corcyra cephalonica breeding method
abstract: The invention discloses a corcyra cephalonica breeding method which comprises the following steps: from the day of inoculation of corcyra cephalonica eggs, the corcyra cephalonica eggs are fed with feed for five times, the feeding time points are respectively the 10th-14th day, the 17th-21st day, the 24th-28th day, the 31st-35th day and the 38th-42nd day after inoculation, the feeding amount of the third feeding is the maximum value of all the five feeding amounts, and the feeding amount of the fourth feeding is the maximum value of all the five feeding amounts. The ratio of the third feeding amount to the second feeding amount is 1.4-1.6, and the ratio of the third feeding amount to the fourth feeding amount is 1.2-1.3. According to the method provided by the invention, the rice moths grow relatively early, the moth yield and the egg laying amount are high, meanwhile, the problems of unbalanced nutrient feeding of larvae, diapause, low yield and the like in the feeding process are avoided, and large-scale production of the rice moths is facilitated.

applicante: SHANDONG YILIN MUNICIPAL GARDEN CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD
titulo: Automatic maintenance system for dwarf municipal landscape flowers
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic maintenance system for dwarf municipal landscape flowers, relates to the technical field of landscape flower maintenance, and solves the problems of low efficiency, poor nutrient feeding accuracy and high maintenance cost in the prior art. Comprising a planting pot, a mechanical execution assembly is connected in the planting pot, one side of the planting pot is connected with a control module, and the control module is electrically connected with the mechanical execution assembly; the mechanical execution assembly comprises an irrigation assembly and a fertilization assembly; the control module comprises a monitoring module, an environment sensor assembly, a plant state monitoring assembly, a data interaction module and a power supply module. The method has the advantages that maintenance efficiency can be improved, complexity of pot-by-pot operation is avoided, and response time is shortened.

applicante: NONGFAZIRAN YANTAI AGRICULTURAL TECH CO LTD
titulo: Pear seedling cultivation device for pear tree planting
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of pear seedling cultivation, in particular to a pear seedling cultivation device for pear tree planting, which mainly comprises a support frame, a displacement base, a cultivation host, a detection support and a nutrient-root zone cooperative system. The supporting frame bears the overall structure. A movable guide rail is laid on the displacement base, and the cultivation main machine can be slidably positioned; the cultivation main machine comprises a cultivation container and a light supplementing device. The detection bracket is connected with the translation module through the hoisting top frame to realize two-dimensional movement; the detection unit comprises a split type sliding detection plate and an integrated high-resolution imaging module. The nutrient feeding mechanism is located at the bottom of the container, and directional fertilizer supply for the root system is achieved through micropore liquid injection and the pushing soil loosening mechanism; the root zone maintenance mechanism is provided with a kneading device and a heat shock module, and the root zone environment is dynamically regulated and controlled.

applicante: BANENGZAO CHANGZHOU BIOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD
titulo: Integrated algae nutrient feeding device
abstract: The utility model provides an integrated algae nutrient feeding device. The integrated algae nutritional agent feeding device comprises a bottom plate; the two supporting frames are fixedly connected to the positions, close to the two sides, of the top of the bottom plate correspondingly, a mixing barrel is installed at the top of one supporting frame, a driving assembly is installed at the top of the mixing barrel through a first cover, and a stirring rod is installed at the output end of the driving assembly; a feeding barrel is mounted at the top of the other supporting frame, a second cover is mounted at the top of the feeding barrel, a conical filter cone is mounted in the feeding barrel, and a blow-off pipe is mounted at the bottom of the conical filter cone. According to the integrated algae nutritional agent feeding device provided by the utility model, the feeding amount of algae nutritional agent liquid can be accurately monitored through the design, the effect of the algae nutritional agent is prevented from being influenced by more or less feeding, impurities filtered in the feeding barrel are convenient to clean, and the cleaning difficulty is reduced.

applicante: INNER MONGOLIA YOURAN ANIMAL HUSBANDRY CO LTD
titulo: Preparation method of fermented feed microbial inoculum additive
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of fermented feed microbial inoculum additives for livestock breeding, in particular to a preparation method of a fermented feed microbial inoculum additive, which comprises the following steps: carrying out steam sterilization on a fermentation tank with a culture medium; judging the temperature transfer degree and reducing the introduction speed of cooling water according to the section length proportion with the same temperature change trend in the first time section and the second time section of the temperature change, and adjusting the forward rotation duration of stirring according to the area proportion of the bacterial liquid plane region of the surface image of the to-be-fermented bacterial liquid conforming to the rotational flow characteristic; determining a nutrient feeding angle and a nutrient feeding speed according to a relative relationship between the inoculation port and the plane area; and sequentially carrying out continuous fermentation, microbial inoculum stabilizing treatment, forming processing and finished product quality detection on the to-be-fermented bacterial liquid to form a finished product of the fermented feed microbial inoculum additive. According to the invention, the number of viable bacteria and metabolites thereof in the fermented feed microbial inoculum additive is increased.
termos_detectados: fermentation, continuous fermentation, culture medium, inoculum, nutrient feeding

applicante: GUANGDONG LANFENG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD
titulo: Modularized nutrient feeding and conveying equipment for aquaculture and conveying method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of aquaculture, in particular to modularized nutrient feeding and conveying equipment for aquaculture and a conveying method thereof.The equipment comprises a base, a measuring mechanism and a material containing mechanism, the material containing mechanism is provided with a material container, a first auxiliary part and a second auxiliary part, and a discharging part of the material container is provided with a material scattering mechanism and a conveying mechanism. Shrimp materials are put into the material container, are divided, dispersed and distributed and then are conveyed to the material distributing pieces of all the shrimp ponds through the conveying pieces, and the material distributing pieces adjust the material scattering radius and the material scattering flow. Through the synergistic effect of segmentation, vibration scattering and guiding, the material blocking problem of traditional equipment is solved; the design of the flow guide plate reduces shrimp material crushing, and waste and water pollution are avoided; the adjustable air pressure of the Roots blower and the flow adjusting function of the material distributing piece are adaptive to the requirements of different shrimp ponds; and the weight sensor is linked with the large-scale stock bin to realize automatic feeding, so that the labor cost and the labor intensity are reduced. The feeding efficiency and stability are integrally improved, and the shrimp yield and the water quality safety are guaranteed.

applicante: CHENGDU HEXIE ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD
titulo: Microbial nutrient feeding device
abstract: The utility model discloses a microbial nutrient feeding device which comprises a base, a blowing structure and a discharging structure, and the blowing structure and the discharging structure are both arranged on the base. The blowing structure comprises an air blower and a discharging barrel. The discharging structure comprises a storage hopper, a supporting plate, a sealing plate, a control motor, an eccentric wheel and a rocker. The air blower is arranged on the base, the discharging barrel is arranged at an air outlet of the air blower, a material receiving barrel is arranged at the top of the discharging barrel, the storage hopper is fixedly connected with the base through a supporting plate, the bottom of the storage hopper faces the material receiving barrel, a supporting frame is arranged on the base, the sealing plate is movably connected with the supporting frame, and one side of the sealing plate is located at the bottom of the storage hopper. The control motor is fixedly connected with the supporting frame, the eccentric wheel is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the control motor, and the two ends of the rocker are hinged to the sealing plate and the eccentric wheel respectively. And through the cooperative design of the blowing structure and the discharging structure, the nutritional agent can be conveniently and uniformly fed.

titulo: Poultry feeding device and calibration method and feeding method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a poultry feeding device and a calibration method and feeding method thereof.The poultry feeding device comprises a framework, the framework is in a step shape, breeding cages are installed on all layers of the framework, and the poultry feeding device further comprises a support arranged at the top of the uppermost layer of the framework, a rail laid at the top of the support and a feeding assembly capable of moving along the top of the rail. Feed, nutrients and a feed conveying motor are calibrated, when the feeding trolley walks on a track, feeding can be conducted according to the preset feeding amount, when a Hall proximity switch detects a detection magnet on a segmented plate, a PLC can recognize and judge the serial number of the detection magnet, and the detection magnet can be detected by the PLC according to the number of the detection magnet. The feed feeding amount and the nutrient feeding amount input in advance on the feeding section are read, so that the feed feeding amount and the nutrient feeding amount required by the poultry in the feeding section are reasonably given, the feeding amount is quantified, and the feeding precision is high.

titulo: METHODS FOR INCREASING ALGAE PRODUCTIVITY
abstract: [0000]    The present disclosure describes cultivation methods for increasing productivity of algae strains. The methods include diluting the algae cultures at specific times, as well as nutrient feeding the cultures at specific times.

applicante: ETUOKEQI XINJIAN ALGAE IND CO LTD
titulo: Nutrient feeding device for spirulina
abstract: The utility model discloses a nourishment feeding device for spirulina, which relates to the technical field of spirulina and comprises a culture pond, a movable stirring mechanism is arranged in the culture pond, a second connecting block is fixedly connected to one side of the culture pond, two connecting plates are fixedly connected to two sides of the second connecting block, and the connecting plates are fixedly connected to the other side of the culture pond. A conveying mechanism is arranged in the connecting plates, and fourth connecting blocks are arranged in the conveying mechanism and located on the sides, close to one another, of the four connecting plates. Through mutual cooperation of a lead screw, a rack, stirring blades, a third sliding block, a first rotating shaft and a fourth gear, stirring can be carried out while moving in a culture pond in use, the situation that nutrients cannot be fully mixed with culture liquid due to in-situ stirring of a transmission stirring mechanism is avoided, the financial resource investment can be reduced through the movable stirring mechanism, and the cost is reduced. And the stirring range is effectively expanded.

applicante: ZHANGJIAGANG SHENGANG MEDICAL PRODUCTS CO LTD
titulo: Nutrient feeding bag forming mold
abstract: The utility model discloses a nutrition feeding bag forming die which comprises a bottom plate, the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a workbench through a support, the middle end of the top of the workbench is fixedly connected with a lower die, a forming groove is formed in the top of the lower die, and a cooling groove is formed in an inner cavity of the lower die. A spray head is fixedly connected to the right side of an inner cavity of the cooling groove, a temperature sensor is fixedly connected to the left side of the inner cavity of the cooling groove, a top plate is fixedly connected to the top of the workbench through a support, electric telescopic rods are fixedly connected to the left end and the right end of the bottom of the top plate, and an upper mold plate is fixedly connected to the bottoms of the electric telescopic rods. Through mutual cooperation of the dustproof net, the refrigeration groove, the refrigerator, the draught fan, the cooling groove, the spray head, the temperature sensor and the through opening, the problems that an existing nutrition feeding bag forming mold is formed only through natural cooling, the forming speed is low, and the working efficiency is affected are solved.

applicante: XINFENGMING GROUP HUZHOU ZHONGSHI TECH CO LTD
titulo: Granular nutrient feeding device in water treatment
abstract: The device comprises a material cylinder, a material taking device, a scattered material storage tank, a material scattering device, a material carrying vehicle and a pulley guide rail, the material cylinder comprises a cylinder body, the top surface of the cylinder body is provided with an opening, a plurality of first angle iron supporting legs are vertically installed outside the cylinder body, the material taking device comprises a columnar rotator and a secondary material placing disc, and the columnar rotator is provided with a plurality of first angle iron supporting legs; and the top end of the columnar rotator is communicated and assembled with the bottom end of the cylinder body. The invention overcomes the defects that the water treatment granular nutrients are not uniformly put in unit area due to the limited putting distance of the water treatment granular nutrients in the existing mode of putting the water treatment granular nutrients into the sewage pool by manually pulling and pushing a push plate and pushing the water treatment granular nutrients into the sewage, so that the water treatment granular nutrients are not uniformly put in the sewage pool, and the water treatment granular nutrients are not uniformly put in the sewage pool. And on the other hand, when a large batch of water treatment particle nutrients are put, the time consumed by manual putting is long, and the labor intensity is high.

applicante: ZHONGYUE ROSE AGRICULTURAL TECH SUQIAN CO LTD
titulo: Regional organic efficient planting and breeding system for essential oil roses
abstract: The invention discloses an essential oil rose regionalization organic efficient planting and breeding system, and relates to the field of rose planting.The essential oil rose regionalization organic efficient planting and breeding system comprises a breeding area used for conducting batch rose planting and a nutrient area used for providing nutrients for the breeding area, the breeding area is provided with multiple sets of soil blocks used for breeding roses, and spacing grooves are formed among the multiple sets of soil blocks; guardrails are arranged outside the soil blocks, the nutrient area is provided with a material tank used for storing nutrients, the bottom end of the material tank is provided with a main pipeline and multiple sets of auxiliary pipelines which are located in the interval grooves and used for transporting the nutrients, communicating pipes are arranged among the multiple sets of auxiliary pipelines, and a cut-off mechanism used for controlling automatic on-off of nutrient conveying is assembled in the middle of each communicating pipe. The technical problems that in an existing rose cultivation system, rose pieces are usually stacked together to be planted and cultivated, due to uneven manual nutrient feeding of the roses in the area, the roses are likely to be uneven in the growth process, and the quality of each rose plant cannot be guaranteed are solved.

titulo: Microecological preparation for preventing pelteobagrus fulvidraco calicivirus
abstract: The invention discloses a microecological preparation for preventing pelteobagrus fulvidraco calicivirus, and belongs to the field of pelteobagrus fulvidraco disease prevention, the microecological preparation for preventing pelteobagrus fulvidraco calicivirus comprises a prevention preparation and an improvement preparation; the prevention preparation comprises a povidone-iodine solution, a five-yellow anti-toxic solution, gallnut powder, Sanhuang powder, honeysuckle, radix isatidis, sanguisorba officinalis, dark plum, rheum officinale, andrographis paniculata, astragalus membranaceus and purified water. According to the technical scheme, two use forms of the prevention preparation and the improvement preparation are adopted, the fish pond water quality and fish physique can be subjected to prevention, treatment and purification treatment synchronously, and the problem that the death time of pelteobagrus fulvidraco is delayed due to traditional disinfectant or nutrient feeding is effectively solved, the quality of the pelteobagrus fulvidraco is improved, and the service life of the pelteobagrus fulvidraco is prolonged. The phenomenon of treating the symptoms but not the root causes is avoided, and the death probability of the pelteobagrus fulvidraco is reduced to 60% or below.

titulo: RAFFINEMENT DE MILIEUX ET APPROCHES D'ALIMENTATION EN NUTRIMENTS POUR AUGMENTER LA PRODUCTION D'ACIDES GRAS POLYINSATURÉS
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method for increasing production of a polyunsaturated fatty acid, especially eicos¬ apentaenoic acid (EPA), in a microorganism, comprising adjusting the macro- and/or micronutrients during fermentation. The invention includes any culture, biomass, and oil produced by the method.

titulo: Negative-pressure constant-temperature grain powder nutrient conveying and screening device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of food production, in particular to a grain powder nutrient negative-pressure constant-temperature conveying and screening device which comprises a vacuum feeding part, a mixing part, a vacuum conveying groove, a vacuum discharging part and a nutrient feeding part. The vacuum feeding part comprises a first vacuum material pumping machine, a first vacuum material pumping machine feeding pipeline, a first vacuum material pumping machine discharging pipeline and a first vacuum material pumping machine exhaust pipeline, the mixing part comprises a first mixing and stirring device, a first nutrient feeding pipe and a first stirring part, and the vacuum conveying groove comprises a conveying groove body, a screw motor and a screw. The grain powder nutrient negative-pressure constant-temperature conveying and screening device has the advantages that materials are conveyed in a vacuum environment, stirring and mixing are conducted in the stirring device added with nitrogen, the vacuum environment is kept in the discharging process after mixing is completed, and therefore the grain powder nutrient negative-pressure constant-temperature conveying and screening device is simple in structure, convenient to use and high in practicability. The oxidation of the nutrients can be effectively reduced, and the investment cost of the nutrients is saved for enterprises.

applicante: CHONGQING CHENGKOU SONGKUN JUNCAO TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
titulo: Edible mushroom cultivation device capable of achieving soil conveying and nutrient feeding
abstract: The invention discloses an edible mushroom cultivation device capable of realizing soil conveying and nutrient feeding, which comprises a shell, a control panel is arranged on one side of the top of the front surface of the shell, a storage bin assembly is arranged on the top of the shell, a nutrient feeding mechanism is arranged on one side of the bottom of the storage bin assembly, and a soil conveying mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the nutrient feeding mechanism. A conveying belt lifting mechanism is arranged on one side of the soil conveying mechanism, an edible fungus sowing mechanism is arranged on the top of the conveying belt lifting mechanism, and an edible fungus cultivation mechanism is arranged on one side of the conveying belt lifting mechanism. Under the cooperative action of the storage bin assembly, the nutrient feeding mechanism, the soil conveying mechanism, the conveying belt lifting mechanism, the edible mushroom sowing mechanism and the edible mushroom cultivation mechanism, the space utilization rate of the greenhouse is increased, the cultivation unit area yield is increased, the time and manpower for placing and recycling nutrition bags are reduced, morchella is sown more uniformly, and the planting efficiency is improved. Meanwhile, water flowing out of the soil is prevented from being recycled, and pollution to the environment is avoided.

titulo: Kits for feeding plant nutrients
abstract: The present invention relates to a plant nutrient feeding kit, comprising: a body combined with a container storing a chemical solution, and having an accommodation portion in which the chemical solution is accommodated; a fixing fastener installed at a lower part of the body; and a plurality of chemical solution supply pipes supplying the chemical solution accommodated in the accommodation portion of the body to a flowerpot. Accordingly, there is no need to pile up or dig up soil in the pot to a certain height to erect the body, there is no need to remove plant nutrients even when watering the soil in the pot or repotting a plant, and the plurality of chemical solution supply pipes can be inserted into the soil along a circumferential direction of the plant to supply the chemical solution evenly to an entire root of the plant.

titulo: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR INDOOR CULTIVATION AND PROCESSING OF DUCKWEED
abstract: A photobioreactor system includes a growing tower tray assembly configured to utilize laminar flow to harvest a plant; a nursery subsystem configured to feed inoculum to the growing tower tray assembly; and a nutrient feeding subsystem configured to feed nutrient media to the growing tower tray assembly.

titulo: Nutrient control device for compound microbial fertilizer
abstract: The utility model discloses a nutrient control device for a compound microbial fertilizer, relates to the technical field of compound microbial fertilizers, and aims to solve the problem that the action effect of the fertilizer is influenced due to low material proportioning precision caused by low nutrient supply precision of the conventional nutrient supply device for the compound microbial fertilizer. The device comprises a mixing pipe, a microorganism feeding pipe and a fertilizer nutrient feeding pipe, the microorganism feeding pipe and the fertilizer nutrient feeding pipe are arranged at the upper end of the mixing pipe, smashing bins are arranged in the microorganism feeding pipe and the fertilizer nutrient feeding pipe, smashing machines are arranged in the smashing bins, and the smashing machines are connected with the mixing pipe. According to the utility model, the microorganism feeding pipe and the fertilizer nutrient feeding pipe are utilized to crush materials, and then the crushed materials are precisely and quantitatively fed into the mixing pipe for mixing and feeding, so that the nutrient supply control precision of the compound microbial fertilizer is greatly improved.

applicante: MAOMING HONGYU ENERGY TECH CO LTD
titulo: Strain culture device for industrial wastewater biochemical treatment unit
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of wastewater treatment of strain culture, in particular to a strain culture device for an industrial wastewater biochemical treatment unit, which comprises a strain culture tank and a nutrient storage tank which are connected with each other, the nutrient storage tank is communicated with the strain culture tank through a nutrient feeding pipe, a material port is arranged at the upper part of the strain culture tank, and a material outlet is arranged at the lower part of the nutrient storage tank. The lower part of the strain culture tank is respectively communicated with a strain discharge pipe and an air blower; a perforated aeration pipe is connected between the air blower and the strain culture tank; the strain culture tank further comprises a first stirring device, the first stirring device comprises a first stirring paddle, and the first stirring paddle extends into the strain culture tank. The device disclosed by the utility model is simple to manufacture and install, convenient to operate and maintain, complete in function and capable of quickly culturing various anaerobic bacteria and aerobic bacteria, and the cultured bacteria can be used for supplementing the loss of the anaerobic bacteria and aerobic bacteria of a wastewater treatment biochemical unit and maintaining the removal effect of the biochemical treatment unit on organic pollutants in wastewater.
scores_por_categoria: Fed-Batch & Feeding Strategy:5 | Bioreactor & Mass Transfer:3

applicante: HANDAN IRON & STEEL GROUP CO LTD
titulo: High-efficiency and low-cost steel cold rolling wastewater treatment device
abstract: A high-efficiency and low-cost steel cold rolling wastewater treatment device belongs to the technical field of steel rolling wastewater treatment equipment and is used for treating cold rolling wastewater. According to the technical scheme, a first adjusting tank, a second adjusting tank, a first-stage neutralization tank, a second-stage neutralization tank, a radial-flow clarification tank, a pH adjusting tank, a cooling tower, a biological contact oxidation tank, an inclined plate sedimentation tank, an intermediate water tank, a biological aerated filter and a reuse water tank are sequentially connected, the first adjusting tank is provided with an alkaline oily wastewater inlet, and the second adjusting tank is provided with an acid-containing wastewater inlet; the first-stage neutralization tank is provided with a lime milk inlet and a high-density sludge inlet, the second-stage neutralization tank is provided with a lime milk inlet, the radial-flow clarification tank is provided with a flocculant inlet, the pH regulating tank is provided with an acid liquor inlet, and the biological contact oxidation tank is provided with a nutrient feeding port. The device disclosed by the utility model is reasonable in combination, low in operation cost and stable in effluent quality, improves the treatment efficiency of the cold rolling wastewater, meets the production recycling requirements, meets the environmental protection requirements, and has good social benefits.

applicante: WUHAN ZAONONG ECOLOGICAL AGRICULTURE TECH CO LTD
titulo: Nostoc sphaeroids kutz culture device with quantitative nutrient feeding function
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of nostoc sphaeroids kutz culture, in particular to a nostoc sphaeroids kutz culture device with a quantitative nutrient feeding function. According to the technical scheme, the device comprises a bottom plate, a culture box and a back plate, the top of the bottom plate is fixedly provided with the culture box through a mounting frame, the top of the mounting frame is fixedly connected with the back plate, the bottom of the mounting frame is welded with a water tank, the rear end of the back plate is slidably connected with a motor, and the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating rod; a supporting frame corresponding to the rotating rod is welded to the top of the bottom plate at the front end of the mounting frame. The distribution box, the bearing plate, the rotating rod and the back plate are matched with one another, so that the bearing plate can move back and forth conveniently through rotation of the rotating rod and meshing between a gear and a rack, nutrients can be uniformly and quantitatively added to the interior of the incubator conveniently through the discharging port, operation is convenient and rapid, and the practicability is high. And the practicability is improved.

titulo: High-density fermentation technique of powdered pichia pastoris
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural microbiology, and particularly relates to a high-density fermentation technique of powdered pichia pastoris. The technique comprises the steps of seed preparation and fermentor culture. The conditions of the fermentor culture are as follows: the loaded liquid volume is 40-60% (V/V), the inoculation amount is 1-5% (V/V), the control temperature is 28-40 DEG C, the ventilatory capacity is 1-3.5 VVM, the startup rotating speed is 300 r/min, the rotating speed is increased by 100 r/min in every 4h, after being increased to 700r/min, the rotating speed is kept unchanged, and the fermentation cycle is 20-30h. In the process of fermentation, by dropwise adding a NaOH solution, the pH value of fermentation liquor is adjusted to about 6.0. After 13h of fermentation, a certain amount of glucose is added at certain interval, the fermentation is completed after 20-30h, and the effective viable count is 30.0-3.5 hundred million/mL. By adopting the fermentation technique disclosed by the invention, the biomass is significantly increased, the process is simple, the efficiency is superior to that in the prior art, and the production cost is lower.

titulo: CLOSED-LOOP WATER SYSTEM WITH INTEGRATED ATMOSPHERIC WATER GENERATION AND GREYWATER RECYCLING
abstract: The present disclosure provides a closed-loop water system. The closed-loop water system may include an atmospheric water generator (AWG) module configured to extract water from ambient air, a greywater recycling module with a membrane bioreactor for treating greywater, water storage units, a humidification module integrated with the AWG and recycling modules, a natural treatment module with a biome for additional natural treatment, and a control and monitoring module with an AI-based controller. The AWG module, greywater recycling module, and humidification module may operate in tandem to form a closed loop, minimizing external water input. The system may extract atmospheric water to compensate for losses and supplement supply, while continuously reusing treated greywater. The AI-based controller may monitor system parameters and automatically adjusts operations based on real-time data and environmental conditions.

titulo: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR MULTI-DESELECTION IN WASTEWATER TREATMENT

The method and system include supplying an influent to an inlet of a reactor comprising at least one of a bioreactor, an internal deselector, a particle deselector, and one or more return lines; dispersing the influent in the bioreactor to form a solid-liquid mixture containing biological solids; retaining, retarding, or providing a differential of, by the internal deselector, biological solids from the solid-liquid mixture to form a deselected solid-liquid mixture and returnable biological solids; feeding said deselected solid-liquid mixture to the particle deselector; deselecting, by the particle deselector, remainder biological solids from the deselected solid-liquid mixture; and supplying, by the one or more return lines, the returnable biological solids to the bioreactor.

titulo: BIOREACTOR INCLUDING PROBE FOR ELECTRICAL OR ELECTROMAGNETIC MEASUREMENTS
abstract: [0000]    A bioreactor includes a rigid-walled vessel for containing a biological medium, the vessel having a lid. The bioreactor further includes a probe passing through an aperture in the lid and having a sensing end inside the vessel and a remote end outside the vessel. The sensing end has plural electrodes for immersion in the biological medium, and the remote end is configured for coupling to external devices and transmission thereto of electrical or electromagnetic measurements made by the electrodes. One of the lid and the probe has one or more resiliently deformable mechanisms and the other of the lid and the probe has one or more respective complementary surfaces. The resiliently deformable mechanisms and the complementary surfaces are configured such that, on insertion of the probe through the aperture to assemble the probe to the lid, the one or more resiliently deformable mechanisms are first deformed on sliding against the one or more complementary surfaces and then resile when the probe reaches a predetermined insertion position relative to the lid to secure the probe to the lid. One of the lid and the probe carries a sealing element which seals the probe to the lid when the probe is secured at the predetermined position.

titulo: ÉCHAFAUDAGES EXPANSÉS SANS COMPOSANTS ANIMAUX POUR LA PRODUCTION DE VIANDE CULTIVÉE
abstract: A cellular scaffold for cultivated meat production containing at least one nanofiber arranged to provide cellular attachment, the at least one nanofiber forming a three-dimensional porous structure, wherein the three-dimensional porous structure is formed by gas expansion of a two-dimensional nanofiber mat, the gas expansion creating volumetric expansion and increased porosity within the nanofiber structure, and wherein the cellular scaffold is edible and animal-component free. Methods of making the cellular scaffold include forming nanofibers into a two-dimensional mat by electrospinning, electrospray, or extrusion, immersing the mat in an effervescent system to generate gas and induce volumetric expansion, and stabilizing the three-dimensional porous scaffold by freeze-drying. Methods of culturing cells for cultivated meat production using the cellular scaffold in a bioreactor are also provided.

titulo: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR CONVERTING PLASTIC TO BIOLOGICALLY DEGRADABLE MATERIALS
abstract: A method of converting plastic to biologically degradable materials includes receiving plastic materials and preprocessing the received plastic to create a plurality of plastic ingots. The plastic ingots are fed into a pyrolysis vessel where they are heated and cooled. Vapors from the heating and cooling process are captured and cooled to create a polymer oil. The polymer oil is introduced into a bioreactor. Bacteria are slowly introduced to the bioreactor over a period of several days to several weeks. The bacteria consumes and digests the polymer oil within the bioreactor. Metabolites from the bacteria create a biodegradable suspension of plastic-free biomass that is harvested from the bioreactor. The harvested biomass is mixed with a gelling agent to create a solid puck of biodegradable, plastic-free, and shelf stable biogel for any number of different uses.

titulo: SYSTÈMES ET PROCÉDÉS D'ÉLECTROFERMENTATION
abstract: The present disclosure provides an electro-fermentation bioreactor containing a culture of Clostridium species, which optimizes metabolic pathways to enhance carbon fuel production, demonstrating a sustainable and efficient method for converting waste into valuable biofuels with minimal energy consumption. The present disclosure also provides methods of using the microbial electro-fermentation bioreactor to generate biofuels from food waste products and/or algae.

titulo: SYNTHÈSE AUTOMATISÉE D'ARN PAR TRANSCRIPTION IN VITRO
abstract: The invention pertains to a method and system for monitoring and controlling the concentration of individual nucleoside triphosphates (NTPs) during in vitro transcription (IVT) mRNA synthesis using a chemometric model. The method involves training a machine-learning algorithm with specialized data sets that replicate IVT conditions, refining the model through real-time monitoring of the IVT reaction in a bioreactor, and optimizing it with a proprietary pulse-feed IVT designed for co-transcriptional capping. The chemometric model is validated using pre-processed digital spectra signals corresponding to known concentrations of the four NTPs. Additionally, the system employs a Raman Spectroscope to collect and analyze Raman signals during the IVT process, enabling real-time quantification of NTP concentrations. The system is equipped with a computer that utilizes the chemometric model to communicate quantified NTP levels to a pump system, facilitating automated re-feeding of NTPs based on pre-defined concentration thresholds. This invention enhances the efficiency and accuracy of IVT mRNA synthesis, providing a robust solution for real-time monitoring and control of critical reaction components.

titulo: SYSTÈMES DE BIORÉACTEUR, COMPOSITIONS ET PROCÉDÉS, COMPRENANT LA MODÉRATION DE L'ENCRASSEMENT BIOLOGIQUE DANS DES BIORÉACTEURS
abstract: Compositions and/or methods for growing biological material are generally described. In certain embodiments, an emulsion having an aqueous fluid and a non-aqueous fluid is described. The non-aqueous fluid may have greater wettability than the aqueous fluid, which may be advantageous for preventing biofouling, for example. The aqueous fluid may comprise a biological material, and the non-aqueous domain may comprise a compound. The compound may be capable of exiting the non-aqueous fluid and entering the aqueous fluid, where the compound may be at least partially consumed by the biological material. The compound entering the aqueous fluid may benefit the biological material (e.g., increase growth rate).

titulo: METHOD FOR DETERMINING A CELL DENSITY OF A DOSING LIQUID, DOSING APPARATUS AND BIOREACTOR
abstract: [0000]    A method for determining a cell density of a dosing liquid using a dosing apparatus with a fluid channel, a valve, a pressure source, a first dosing liquid reservoir, a processing apparatus, and a fluid channel pressure sensor. The fluid channel includes a first fluid channel section and a second fluid channel section fluidically connected to the first fluid channel section. The valve includes a valve member that is arranged between the first and second fluid channel sections and can be moved into an open position, in which the fluidic connection of the first fluid channel section to the second fluid channel section is opened, and into a closed position, in which the fluidic connection of the first fluid channel section to the second fluid channel section is closed. The first dosing liquid reservoir is fluidically connected to the first fluid channel section, and the dosing liquid includes biological cells.

applicante: KUNSHAN PINHONG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD
titulo: Membrane bioreactor sewage treatment device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, and discloses a membrane bioreactor sewage treatment device which comprises a sewage pool and a lifting cavity, the sewage pool is used for containing sewage and suspended filler balls, the lifting cavity is formed in the water outlet side of the sewage pool and provided with a water suction opening, a falling channel and a guiding channel, the water suction opening is immersed below the liquid level, and the falling channel is communicated with the guiding channel. The guide channel enables water and the filler ball to flow in from the water suction port, and the filler ball flows out from the falling channel. The membrane bioreactor sewage treatment device breaks through the traditional'passive interception 'thinking, initiates an active circulation mechanism, forcibly conveys the filler detained on the water outlet side to the water inlet side to form a filler large circulation flow penetrating through the reactor, synchronously and radically solves the two industrial problems of outlet accumulation and internal fluidization dead angles, and has a wide application prospect. And the circulation process has the benefits of moderate updating of the biological membrane and energy consumption optimization.

titulo: Fish gene editing method and application
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of genetic engineering, in particular to a fish gene editing method and application. The efficient gene editing method suitable for fishes is developed on the basis of Cas-SF01 nuclease, compared with a CRISPR/Cas9 system, the selection range of fish gene editing targets is expanded, better flexibility is achieved, diallele mutation of target genes can be achieved, and efficient and stable gene editing efficiency is shown in different fishes. The invention provides a set of efficient gene editing method for fishes, and the method has wide application prospects in the aspects of aquatic product economic character genetic improvement and new variety breeding, model fish disease model construction, bioreactor development, fish population control, invasive species management and the like.

titulo: Mesenchymal stem cell three-dimensional culture method based on carbon dioxide culture shaking table
abstract: The invention discloses a three-dimensional culture method for mesenchymal stem cells based on a carbon dioxide culture shaking table, and belongs to the technical field of three-dimensional culture of cells. The three-dimensional culture method comprises the following steps: adding mesenchymal stem cells into a serum-free three-dimensional culture medium, adding a 3D micro-frozen gel bracket, uniformly shaking, and culturing in a carbon dioxide culture shaking table in a continuous low-speed uniform shaking mode. According to the invention, efficient, stable and sterile three-dimensional culture is realized, the quality of the cultured cells is stable, and clinical application requirements are met. Dependence on a special closed bioreactor is abandoned, a conventional carbon dioxide culture shaking table is adopted as culture equipment, the requirements of conventional laboratories, scientific research institutions and small and medium-scale production are met, the equipment threshold of three-dimensional culture is remarkably reduced, and popularization and application of the technology are facilitated.

titulo: Converter blowing control method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a converter blowing control method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. Comprising the following steps: acquiring basic production parameters of a target smelting heat, and determining a corresponding target oxygen transfer rate based on the basic production parameters; wherein the basic production parameters comprise the mass of newly increased solid waste, the proportion of iron oxide in the newly increased solid waste, the oxidation degree of the solid waste, the blowing time and the initial temperature of molten iron; determining a nitrogen-oxygen proportion needing to be distributed based on the target oxygen transfer rate, and determining target nitrogen supply intensity and target oxygen supply intensity based on the total air supply intensity and the nitrogen-oxygen proportion; and based on the target nitrogen supply intensity and the target oxygen supply intensity, after nitrogen-oxygen combined blowing is carried out for a first preset time, nitrogen pulse blowing is carried out for a second preset time based on the preset nitrogen supply intensity. Through the technical scheme provided by the invention, the target oxygen transfer rate can be calculated to reasonably distribute the nitrogen-oxygen ratio, so that a nitrogen-oxygen combined blowing strategy is adopted, the slag overflow splashing probability is reduced, and efficient smelting and stable control are realized.

titulo: Aerobic granular sludge aeration control method based on oxygen transfer feature point recognition
abstract: The invention discloses an aerobic granular sludge aeration control method based on oxygen transfer feature point recognition, and belongs to the field of sewage treatment. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing an SOTE-GS clear water calibration curve and an OTE control algorithm; calculating a real-time oxygen transfer correction coefficient alpha on line in each aeration period; establishing judgment threshold values of a mass transfer improvement inflection point phi 1 and a nitration reaction end point phi 2 by taking stable oxygen transfer correction coefficient mean values alpha ini and alpha end of aeration initial and end stages of a historical period as references, and determining an initial aeration rate GSa and an end aeration rate GSb; sequentially switching the aeration quantity according to the identification conditions of the first feature point phi 1 and the second feature point phi 2; and after each period is finished, four control parameters of alpha ini, alpha end, GSa and GSb are updated in a rolling manner. According to the method, the mass transfer improvement inflection point and the nitration reaction endpoint are accurately recognized by capturing the alpha dynamic evolution rule, low-efficiency and invalid aeration intervals are avoided, and the aeration energy consumption is remarkably reduced.

titulo: Hollow fiber membrane and hollow fiber membrane module
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, in particular to a hollow fiber membrane and a hollow fiber membrane assembly for a membrane aeration bio-membrane reactor. The hollow fiber membrane comprises a hollow core pipe of a strip-shaped structure, through air holes are formed in the pipe wall of the hollow core pipe, and the hole wall of each air hole is of an oxygen permeation structure. The outer peripheral wall of the hollow core pipe is sleeved with the woven layer, and the woven layer is formed by weaving a plurality of plush yarns; wherein the plush yarn is provided with cilia which radiates and extends outwards from the surface of the yarn to form a microorganism attachment carrier. The hollow fiber membrane module comprises a plurality of hollow fiber membranes and at least one sealing head, a connecting channel is arranged in the sealing head; the end part of the hollow fiber membrane is encapsulated and fixed on the end socket, and the connecting channel is communicated with the hollow cavity of the hollow core tube. According to the utility model, the problems that the MABR is slow in biofilm formation and easy to fall off and the carrier is aged and stripped are solved, and the dual purposes of efficient oxygen transfer and stable microbial attachment are achieved.

titulo: Method for promoting bacillus fermentation to produce gamma-polyglutamic acid by using oxygen carrier
abstract: The invention relates to the field of microbial fermentation, in particular to a method for producing gamma-polyglutamic acid by promoting bacillus fermentation through an oxygen carrier. Specific alkane oxygen carriers are added in the initial stage of fermentation production of gamma-PGA from Bacillus atrophaeus NWS-01, n-hexane, n-heptane and n-hexadecane are screened out to serve as effective oxygen production promoting carriers, and the optimal single addition concentration and the optimal synergistic addition ratio of all the oxygen carriers are determined; the problem that the yield of gamma-PGA is limited due to low oxygen transfer efficiency in the traditional fermentation process is solved. Wherein the gamma-PGA yield can reach 39.4 +/-0.19 g/L when only 0.3% of n-heptane is added, and the maximum gamma-PGA yield can reach 42.1 g/L when 0.240% of n-hexane, 0.407% of n-heptane and 1.014% of n-hexadecane are added synergistically, and the yield is increased by 150.6% compared with that of a fermentation system without an oxygen carrier. The method disclosed by the invention is simple to operate, high in oxygen utilization rate, low in energy consumption, few in bubbles of a fermentation system and small in liquid shearing force, and is suitable for aerobic high-density fermentation industrial production of gamma-PGA.

titulo: Novel stirring paddle structure of fermentation tank
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fermentation tanks, and particularly relates to a novel stirring paddle structure of a fermentation tank, which comprises a stirring assembly and an auxiliary stirring assembly arranged on the stirring assembly, the stirring assembly and the auxiliary stirring assembly are both arranged in the fermentation tank, and the stirring assembly comprises a stirring shaft, a connecting shaft and a base. The connecting shaft is detachably connected with the stirring shaft, a defoaming paddle is mounted on the connecting shaft, and the connecting shaft is connected with a power shaft on the fermentation tank. Through cooperation of the stirring assembly and the auxiliary stirring assembly, the two groups of sweepback type stirring paddles of the stirring assembly can form an axial circulation main body flow field, and the sweepback type stirring paddles can generate stable up-and-down convection; meanwhile, an auxiliary stirring assembly is matched to perform shear adduction and turbulent flow mixing on an area near the inner wall of the fermentation tank, so that the overall mixing and flowing effect in the fermentation tank is remarkably improved, the dissolved oxygen transfer efficiency is effectively improved, and the temperature gradient in the fermentation tank is reduced.

titulo: Gas-liquid mixing device with self-suction function
abstract: The utility model discloses a gas-liquid mixing device with a self-suction function, and belongs to the technical field of gas-liquid mixing equipment. The gas-liquid mixing device with the self-absorption function comprises an inner shell, the inner shell is nested in the outer shell, the inner shell and the outer shell are connected and coaxial, and a cavity is formed between the inner shell and the outer shell; a vortex outlet and a liquid inlet are respectively formed in two sides of the inner shell and the outer shell; the channel is tangentially connected with the shell; the flow guide plate is connected with the inner shell, and the rotation direction of the flow guide plate is consistent with that of gas; gas enters the cavity through the channel in a rotary cutting mode, the gas rotates in the cavity and forms negative pressure, liquid is sucked into the cavity from the liquid inlet, and the gas and the liquid are discharged through the vortex outlet after being dispersed and mixed through the flow guide plate in the cavity. According to the gas-liquid mixing device, the mixing time is shortened, the vacuum degree and the volume oxygen transfer coefficient are improved, and the gas-liquid mixing device has more efficient gas-liquid mixing capacity and is suitable for gas-liquid mixing processes in the fields of fermentation, chemical engineering, environmental protection and the like.

applicante: QINGDAO XIANGQING ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD
titulo: Sewage treatment system based on gas and liquid entraining disc
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, and discloses a sewage treatment system based on a gas-liquid entraining disc, which comprises a biochemical treatment box, a filter unit and a disinfection unit, wherein a first gas-liquid entraining disc is arranged in the aerobic reaction cavity, the first gas-liquid entraining disc comprises an upper shell and a lower shell which are detachably arranged, the upper shell is provided with a liquid inlet and a gas-liquid outlet, liquid in the aerobic reaction cavity can enter the first gas-liquid entraining disc from the liquid inlet, one side of the lower shell is provided with a gas inlet, and the other side of the lower shell is provided with a gas outlet. External gas can be introduced into the first gas and liquid entraining disc through the gas inlet, and a diaphragm is arranged between the upper shell and the lower shell. Water in the aerobic reaction cavity is introduced into the gas-liquid entraining disc, is fully mixed with external gas introduced from the gas inlet at the position of the diaphragm, and then flows back to the aerobic reaction cavity through the gas-liquid outlet, so that efficient aeration oxygen supply is realized, the oxygen transfer efficiency is improved, and the biochemical degradation effect is guaranteed.

titulo: Safe medical oxygen transfer device
abstract: The utility model discloses a medical oxygen safety transfer device and relates to the field of medical auxiliary instruments, in particular to a medical oxygen safety transfer device which comprises a bottom plate, a damping device and a telescopic rod, a containing groove is formed in the center of the top end of the bottom plate, and square holes are formed in the four corners of the bottom of the bottom plate. The four damping devices are fixedly connected into the square holes correspondingly, the bottoms of the two telescopic rods are fixedly connected to the two ends of one side of the top of the bottom plate, telescopic joints are slidably connected into the telescopic rods, and the tops of the telescopic rods are connected with fixing mechanisms. Due to the arrangement of the fixing mechanism, the expansion joint can be quickly locked or released by rotating the cam shifting rod, and the device is suitable for operators with different heights to use and has the advantages of stable structure, good damping effect, convenience in operation and the like.

applicante: TIANJIN DIYUAN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD
titulo: Hollow fiber membrane material, hydrophilic modified hollow fiber membrane bundle preparation method and hydrophilic modified hollow fiber membrane bundle
abstract: The invention provides a hollow fiber membrane material, a preparation method of a hydrophilic modified hollow fiber membrane bundle and the hydrophilic modified hollow fiber membrane bundle. The hollow fiber membrane material is prepared from the following raw materials in percentage by mass: 40%-50% of polytetramethyl pentene, 15%-30% of inorganic powder, 10%-38.5% of a liquid additive, 3%-8% of a toughening modifier and 0.5%-2% of a nucleating agent. According to the invention, the polytetramethylpentene has a relatively high oxygen permeability coefficient and relatively strong hydrophobicity; the inorganic powder and the liquid additive are used for pore forming of the modified fiber membrane yarn, the oxygen transfer rate per unit area is increased through pores formed after elution, and rapid adhesion of microorganisms is promoted; the toughening modifier inhibits excessive crystallization of polytetramethylpentene, and oxygen transfer is facilitated; the nucleating agent is used for refining polytetramethylpentene crystal grains and improving the gas permeation flux; a hydrophilic modified hollow fiber membrane bundle prepared from the hollow fiber membrane material is not easily wetted by condensed water at an internal gas supply end and external sewage, stably conveys oxygen, promotes rapid adhesion of microorganisms and stably plays a role for a long time.

titulo: Intensive treatment device for coastal aquaculture and processing wastewater
abstract: The invention discloses a coastal aquaculture and processing wastewater intensive treatment device, which belongs to the technical field of aquaculture tail water treatment, and comprises a solid-liquid separation unit, an adjusting unit, a light treatment unit, an anaerobic treatment unit, an aerobic treatment unit, a filtering unit and a clean water tank which are integrally arranged and sequentially communicated, all the units are debugged to form a complete machine structure before leaving a factory, a detection end of a water quality detection system is arranged in each unit, the light treatment unit conveys generated oxygen to the aerobic treatment unit through the oxygen transfer unit, and algae in the light treatment unit is converted into activated carbon through the carbonization treatment mechanism and conveyed into the filtering unit; the integrated whole machine is adopted, the construction period is short, and migration is convenient; the resource utilization of oxygen and algae is realized; an operator performs manual or semi-automatic control according to water quality detection, does not depend on complex automation, and is suitable for places with weak technologies.
