titulo: Energy-saving type MABR (Membrane Aeration Biofilm Reactor) sewage treatment device and wastewater treatment method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an energy-saving type MABR (Membrane Aeration Biofilm Reactor) sewage treatment device and a wastewater treatment method thereof. The device comprises a top membrane shell, a bottom membrane shell and a composite membrane assembly arranged between the top membrane shell and the bottom membrane shell. The composite membrane assembly is composed of an oxygen permeable membrane and a sleeve arranged outside the oxygen permeable membrane in a sleeving mode, the sleeve is made of surface functionalization modified inert materials, an annular interval of 3-10 mm is arranged between the inner wall of the sleeve and the outer surface of the oxygen permeable membrane, and a high-oxygen water area channel is formed. The structure realizes physical separation of oxygen transfer and a biological membrane carrier, so that the oxygen permeation membrane is specially used for supplying oxygen, and the sleeve is used as a main attachment carrier of microorganisms. When the device runs, under low aeration pressure, water flow is pre-oxygenated through the annular interval and then is in contact with the sleeve biological membrane, so that synchronous nitrification and denitrification are realized, and pollutants are efficiently removed. The method is particularly suitable for energy-saving and efficient treatment of low-carbon-nitrogen-ratio freshwater aquaculture wastewater, and has the advantages of light membrane pollution, low energy consumption, high pollutant removal efficiency and the like.

applicante: JIANGSU HEMINGS NEW MAT TECHNICAL CO LTD
titulo: Hectorite-based layered barrier type flame-retardant heat-insulating coating material as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of inorganic non-metallic materials and functional coatings, and discloses a hectorite-based layered barrier type flame-retardant heat-insulating coating material and a preparation method and application thereof, the flame-retardant heat-insulating coating material is a coating material which is formed by compounding hectorite, an inorganic binder and a flame-retardant additive and has a layered barrier structure; wherein the lamellar barrier structure is formed by arranging lamellar hectorite along the direction parallel to the surface of the base material. The hectorite-based lamellar barrier type flame-retardant heat-insulating coating material provided by the invention can form a continuous and compact inorganic heat-insulating layer under a high-temperature condition to effectively block heat and oxygen transfer, so that the flame-retardant property and heat-insulating property of the material are remarkably improved, and the hectorite-based lamellar barrier type flame-retardant heat-insulating coating material has excellent flame-retardant property, heat-insulating property and structural stability; the material can be applied to the fields of building fire prevention and high-temperature protection.

applicante: HEBEI ANMINUO AMINO ACID TECH CO LTD
titulo: Kasugamycin fermentation medium and kasugamycin fermentation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of kasugamycin production, and particularly discloses a kasugamycin fermentation culture medium and a kasugamycin fermentation method, and the kasugamycin fermentation culture medium is composed of a fermentation basic culture medium and a supplementary culture medium; the fermentation basal culture medium is prepared from the following components in percentage by volume: 5 to 8 percent of soybean cake powder, 0.1 to 0.5 percent of sodium glutamate, 0.26 to 0.5 percent of monopotassium phosphate, 0.25 to 0.5 percent of corn steep liquor, 7 to 9 percent of soybean oil and 1 to 3 percent of maltodextrin; by optimizing the formula of the basic culture medium and adding the soybean cake powder and the inositol in the middle and later periods, the fermentation titer of the kasugamycin is effectively increased, and meanwhile the problems that in the traditional fermentation process, the viscosity of fermentation liquor is increased easily due to the unreasonable carbon-nitrogen ratio, the fermentation time is shortened, and the yield of the kasugamycin is increased are solved. The dissolved oxygen transfer is influenced. The viscosity of the fermentation liquor is obviously reduced, the oxygen supply capacity is improved, and the growth of thalli and the synthesis of secondary metabolites are facilitated.

titulo: Multi-stage extrusion spiral mixing jet aerator and jet aeration method
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-stage extrusion spiral mixing jet aerator which comprises an extrusion mixing cavity, one end of the extrusion mixing cavity is connected with a water inlet pipe, the side wall of the extrusion mixing cavity is connected with an air inlet pipe, and the end, away from the water inlet pipe, of the extrusion mixing cavity is connected with a double-spinning spiral ribbon stirring mixing cavity. The end, away from the extrusion mixing cavity, of the double-spinning helical ribbon stirring mixing cavity is connected with an acceleration conical pipe, and the end, away from the double-spinning helical ribbon stirring mixing cavity, of the acceleration conical pipe is connected with a six-branch rotating nozzle. The invention also discloses a jet aeration method of the multi-stage extrusion spiral mixing jet aerator. The jet aerator can cooperate with various stirring and mixing methods, has the capabilities of bubble cluster refinement and oxygen transfer acceleration, comprehensively improves the comprehensive efficiency of a sewage treatment system, and solves the problems of poor mixing effect and low oxygen transfer rate of the existing jet aerator.

applicante: DONGFANG YUEDA LVJIAN TECH BEIJING CO LTD
titulo: Sewage treatment aeration equipment with waste heat recovery function
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, and discloses sewage treatment aeration equipment with a waste heat recovery function, which comprises a pipe body, an air blower is arranged at the top end of the pipe body, a plurality of aeration pipes are arranged outside the pipe body and close to the bottom end, a plurality of aeration discs are arranged outside the aeration pipes, and the aeration discs are connected with the air blower. A heat exchange assembly is installed at the position, close to the top end, of the exterior of the pipe body, a stirring assembly is installed at the position, close to the bottom end, of the exterior of the pipe body, the heat exchange assembly comprises a protective sleeve, the protective sleeve is connected to the exterior of the pipe body in a sleeving mode, a spiral pipe surrounds the portion, located in the protective sleeve, of the exterior of the pipe body, and a water inlet pipe is connected to the top end of the spiral pipe; and an electromagnetic valve is mounted at the joint of the water inlet pipe and the spiral pipe. Through a spiral pipe and an electromagnetic valve, heat of a pipe body can be recycled conveniently, the temperature of the water body after heat exchange can be monitored, and conveying of the water body can be controlled conveniently; and through the stirring blades, aeration can be uniformly dispersed, and the oxygen transfer efficiency is improved.

titulo: Functional fertilizer based on potamogeton crispus
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of manufacturing of organic fertilizers and microbial fertilizers, and discloses a functional fertilizer based on potamogeton crispus. The method comprises the following steps: crushing fresh potamogeton crispus to adjust the water content, inoculating a first compound bacterium system containing tannase activity and polyphenol oxidase activity to carry out first-stage aerobic fermentation, and controlling oxygen transfer by turning to convert polyphenol substances; after fermentation, adding a mixed aqueous solution containing ferrous sulfate and hydrogen peroxide to regulate and control the material, inoculating a second compound bacterial system containing nitrogen-fixing bacteria and phosphate solubilizing bacteria, and adding a thallus protection composition composed of trehalose and diatomite to carry out second-stage micro-aerobic standing fermentation; and granulating by adding a binder containing microcrystalline cellulose, and coating by using a coating liquid containing potamogeton crispus oligosaccharide, thereby obtaining the functional fertilizer. According to the scheme, phenols and tannin allelochemicals in potamogeton crispus are degraded, the biotoxicity of a fertilizer product is eliminated, the seed germination index is improved, the survival number of functional microorganisms is maintained, and the physical stability of particle morphology is ensured.

titulo: Sub-micron level air diffusion membrane and air diffusion tube and air diffusion disc using the same greatly improving the dissolved oxygen and oxygen transfer efficiency and reducing the installation costs
abstract: The present invention provides a sub-micron level air diffusion membrane including: a coating layer provided with micropores having a pore diameter of 0.10 [mu]m ~ 0.20 [mu]m, wherein the porosity is 70% ~ 80%; and a supporting layer provided with pores having an average pore diameter of 5.0 ~ 10.0 [mu]m. The coating layer is formed on the surface of the supporting layer. The coating layer contains a polymer compound selected from the group consisting of PC, PVDF, PSF, PES, PVP, and PVC. By using the sub-micron level air diffusion membrane of the present invention, the dissolved oxygen and oxygen transfer efficiency can be greatly improved, and the installation costs can also be reduced.

applicante: CHANGJIANG ECOLOGY ENVIRONMENTAL PROT GROUP CO LTD
titulo: Double-layer pressurizing aeration tank and aeration method
abstract: The invention provides a double-layer pressurized aeration tank and an aeration method, and belongs to the technical field of sewage treatment. The aeration tank comprises a tank body, aeration function areas and an air supply system, the bottom of the tank body is obliquely arranged, every two aeration function areas form a group and are divided into an upper-layer independent aeration area and a lower-layer independent aeration area through a partition plate, the air supply system comprises a main pipe, an annular branch pipe, branch pipes with the same length and a flow guide cover, a Venturi pipe is installed at the front end of the flow guide cover, and a microbubble aeration plate is arranged in the upper-layer aeration area. A middle bubble aeration plate is arranged on the lower layer; the device can further comprise a driving assembly, an interlayer backflow pipe and the like. The aeration method comprises the steps of water inlet and distribution, equal-length air supply, double-layer pressurization aeration, 8-shaped rotational flow circulation, backflow adjustment, water outlet and sludge discharge and the like, and can also comprise the steps of intelligent adjustment and online aeration plate cleaning. Through a double-layer structure, equal-length air supply and rotational flow circulation design, air supply pressure and energy consumption are reduced, aeration uniformity and oxygen transfer efficiency are improved, a dead zone and sludge precipitation are avoided, maintenance is convenient, and applicability is high.

titulo: Magnetized oxygen-rich and nitrogen-rich microporous aerator capable of automatically reducing flow velocity
abstract: The invention discloses a magnetized oxygen-rich and nitrogen-rich microporous aeration device capable of automatically reducing the flow rate, and belongs to the technical field of water treatment. The device mainly comprises an air pump, an air inlet device, a slow air cylinder, a magnetized nitrogen-oxygen separation device and a microporous aeration disc. The core of the device is that oxygen and nitrogen separation is realized by using the action difference of a magnetic field on gas molecules: air enters an underwater magnetizing device after being decelerated and stirred by a slow-speed fan in a slow-speed cylinder. In the device, magnetic ring strings arranged in a Halbach array are matched with a concave inner container to form a high-gradient magnetic field and swirling airflow, so that the magnetized action time of gas is prolonged, oxygen is enriched around magnetic poles, and nitrogen moves towards the pipe wall and enters a hollow floating disc through a nitrogen pipe to provide buoyancy for the device. Enriched oxygen is sucked by the oxygen separation suction port in the special shape and enters the microporous aeration disc through the one-way baffle to be released. Through underwater magnetization temperature stabilization and structure innovation, the flow velocity is reduced, the oxygen transfer efficiency is remarkably improved, the energy consumption is reduced, and the problems of low efficiency and equipment corrosion of a traditional aeration machine are solved.

titulo: LIPOSOME DE TRANSFERT D'OXYGÈNE POUR THÉRAPIE SONODYNAMIQUE AMÉLIORÉE
abstract: The present invention relates to an enhanced sonodynamic therapeutic agent using a liposome having the ability to transfer oxygen, and more particularly, to lipid nanoparticles having the ability to transfer oxygen in which perfluorocarbon (PFC) and indocyanine green (ICG) are loaded inside liposomes to increase the efficiency of sonodynamic therapy.

titulo: Multi-working-condition optimization control method for urban sewage treatment process
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-working-condition optimization control method for an urban sewage treatment process, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, constructing an operation cost prediction model of each working condition by utilizing a fuzzy neural network, and establishing a multi-working-condition data driving model of dissolved oxygen, nitrate nitrogen concentration, effluent quality and operation energy consumption; secondly, developing an automatic topology multi-modal optimization algorithm, taking a multi-working-condition comprehensive objective function and the number of topological branch particles as particle optimization variables at the same time, dynamically planning performance to solve a multi-working-condition dynamic optimization set of dissolved oxygen and nitrate nitrogen concentration, and deciding a proper set value according to an operation cost prediction result of each working condition; finally, a PID controller is used for adjusting the dissolved oxygen transfer coefficient and the internal reflux amount, tracking control is conducted on the optimized set values of dissolved oxygen and nitrate nitrogen, the high calculation burden of multi-working-condition complex constraint modeling is avoided, and efficient and intelligent optimization control under the multiple working conditions in the urban sewage treatment process is achieved.

titulo: Multi-stage pretreatment-enhanced biochemical coupled high-fluctuation chemical sewage treatment system
abstract: The invention discloses a multistage pretreatment-enhanced biochemical coupled high-fluctuation chemical sewage treatment system, which relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, and comprises a negative pressure monitoring module, a bubble phase analysis module, a bubble blockage identification module, a ventilation control planning module and a reverse ventilation regulation module, a negative pressure change signal is collected at a water inlet end of the sewage treatment system, a synchronous change curve of a gas flow signal and a liquid flow signal is extracted, a complete operation time chain is formed according to an operation time sequence, and a negative pressure characteristic curve is generated according to the operation time chain to establish a pressure fluctuation monitoring reference. Real-time regulation and control of gas-liquid flow are achieved through negative pressure monitoring and bubble phase analysis, and oxygen transfer stability and dissolved oxygen balance are improved; through bubble blockage identification, ventilation control planning and reverse ventilation adjustment, the gas flow direction and the exhaust rhythm are optimized, blockage and pressure accumulation are prevented, and continuous and stable operation of the high-fluctuation sewage treatment process is ensured.

titulo: Airlift bioreactor for amplification culture of taxus cuspidata stem cells
abstract: The utility model discloses an airlift bioreactor for amplification culture of taxus cuspidata stem cells. The airlift bioreactor comprises a tank body, a rotatable spiral guide cylinder and a microbubble generator, the microbubble generator is arranged in the middle of the bottom of the tank body, and the rotatable spiral guide cylinder is arranged in the tank body and fixed above the microbubble generator. According to the utility model, the micro-bubble generator is arranged at the air vent at the bottom of the bioreactor tank body, the rotatable spiral baffle is designed in the guide cylinder, and the spiral baffle in the guide cylinder is driven to rotate by utilizing kinetic energy generated by uniform rising of micro-bubbles through a micro-bubble group generated by the micro-bubble generator, so that fluid forms vortex flow in a spiral channel; and meanwhile, the collision probability of the microbubbles is reduced under the action of centrifugal force. Through a non-mechanically driven dynamic mixing mode, the oxygen transfer and mass transfer bottleneck in a high-viscosity culture system is effectively solved, and efficient reaction equipment is provided for large-scale culture of plant cells.

applicante: SUZHOU COTT ENVIRONMENTAL PROT CO LTD
titulo: High-oxygen permeability hollow fiber membrane material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-oxygen permeability hollow fiber membrane material and a preparation method thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: step S1, adding a matrix material into an internal mixer to fully plasticize the matrix material and form a uniform continuous phase; s2, adding a reinforcing filler into the uniform system obtained in the step S1, so that the reinforcing filler is uniformly distributed in the matrix material to form a nano reinforcing structure; s3, cooling the system, and adding a functional material into the dispersion obtained in the step S2, so that the functional material is uniformly distributed in the matrix material; step S4, putting the rubber material obtained in the step S3 into an open mill for roll coating treatment, adding a cross-linking agent to uniformly disperse the cross-linking agent, and then calendaring into a sheet; and step S5, putting the sheet obtained in the step S4 into a hot press, carrying out primary vulcanization, controlling the thickness of the film, and then carrying out secondary vulcanization to obtain a film product. The membrane material prepared by the preparation method provided by the invention can improve oxygen transfer efficiency, mechanical strength and biocompatibility.

titulo: ATTACHMENT FOR THE HEAT AND MASS TRANSFER PROCESS

A stiffening ring is secured to the inner surfaces of the crossbars in the central part of the attachment.

The attachment has the shape of a right regular quadrangular prism. The vertices of the prism are connected in pairs by diagonally arranged rods. The lateral edges of the prism are connected in pairs by diagonally arranged longitudinal partitions.

applicante: THE NATIONAL UNIV OF WATER AND ENVIRONMENTAL ENGINEERING [UA]
titulo: METHOD FOR DRYING GRANULAR MATERIAL IN DRUM WITH SELF-OSCILLATING INTERNAL CHAMBER LOADING
abstract: Method for drying granular material in drum with self-oscillating internal chamber loading, which is rotated relative to a horizontal axis, comprises feeding material and drying agent into drum chamber. Moisture removal from material by evaporation is carried out through convective external heat and mass transfer, as moist material interacts with drying agent, and through diffusive internal heat and mass transfer, as moisture moves from central layers to outer surface of material, followed by removal of dried material from chamber. Granular charge is subjected to a pulsating motion with variable dilatancy across cross-section of chamber. Moisture removal is carried out by inducing self-excited oscillations of charge in a mild mode.

applicante: LAIR LIQUIDE SA POUR LETUDE ET LETUDE ET LEXPLOITATION DES PROCEDES GEORGES CLAUDE [FR]
titulo: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR VENTING A GAS
abstract: [0000]    An apparatus for separating CO2 and venting a gas comprises a contacting tower (T) comprising a lower section (I) and an upper section (C), mass transfer promoting means (P) in the lower section, a CO2 capture unit (PSA, CB), means for feeding a gas to the capture unit, means for feeding a nitrogen-enriched gas (N) from the capture unit to the bottom of the lower section of the cooling tower, means for feeding water (H) above the lower section and below the upper section of the tower, and means connected at a level above the lower section for feeding thereto a gas (G) that is to be vented and is a portion of the gas that is to be separated in the capture unit.

titulo: GENERATION OF NANO AND PICO BUBBLES WITH VARIABLE GAS/LIQUID RATIOS FOR EFFECTIVE INTERFACE TRANSPORT AND PARTICLE SEPARATION
abstract: The present invention relates to a membrane-based system and process for generating nano- and pico-scale gas bubbles in a liquid phase with precise control over bubble size and gas-liquid ratio. The system comprises a porous substrate coated with a dense, non-porous, gas-permeable thin film that is preferably superhydrophobic when used with aqueous liquids. Gas is supplied to the porous side of the membrane, while a liquid flows along the dense film side under controlled shear conditions, causing the permeating gas to form nano- or pico-scale bubbles at the membrane-liquid interface. Bubble size and gas-liquid ratio are independently controlled by adjusting gas pressure, liquid flow rate, shear conditions, and temperature. The dense thin film may be polymeric or metallic. Polymeric films enable superhydrophobic, fouling-resistant membranes for efficient gas delivery, while metallic films, such as palladium, enable permeation of reactive gases at elevated temperatures. The coated membranes may be configured in high-surface-area modules, including hollow fiber modules. The invention enables enhanced gas-liquid mass transfer, improved reaction kinetics, and reduced energy consumption in chemical processing, catalysis, wastewater treatment, biological systems, and other industrial applications.

titulo: Improvements in or relating to baffle plates
abstract: A baffle plate 100 for a gas/liquid mass transfer apparatus comprising a substantially channel shaped body comprising a substantially planar base 102, which defines a liquid support surface, with opposed substantially planar walls 104,106 extending on the opposite side of the base. The walls may extend partially or fully along the length of the base and may be of substantially equal or different heights. The baffle may be of unitary construction from folding of a single sheet of material or multi-part construction with one or two walls being separate sections. A gas/liquid mass transfer apparatus comprising housing containing a plurality of superposed baffle plates that define a plurality of flow paths with one or two walls positioned above a lower liquid support surface, liquid inlet 46 and gas outlet 48 in an upper portion and gas inlet 40 and liquid outlet 42 in a lower portion is also presented. titulo: Gas diffusion layer beneficial to improving mass transfer effect and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of membrane electrodes, and particularly relates to a gas diffusion layer beneficial to improving the mass transfer effect and a preparation method thereof. Aiming at the contradictory problem of mass transfer and water drainage in the membrane electrode, the invention mainly utilizes cracks formed in the microporous layer, controls the shape of the cracks, strengthens the water drainage effect in the operation process of the battery, improves the mass transfer effect, further improves the performance of the battery, and particularly improves the mass transfer effect under high current density. By adding the adhesive into the slurry of the microporous layer and controlling the coating condition, the diameter size of cracks in the microporous layer meets the corresponding drainage requirement, and the cracks are beneficial to discharge of liquid water in the reaction process of the fuel cell. The prepared gas diffusion layer is subjected to reinforced preparation of hydrophilic channel drainage, and a corresponding hydrophilic drainage channel is formed through sintering, so that reaction water of the fuel cell is induced to be efficiently discharged from the gas diffusion layer through the formed drainage channel, and the gas diffusion layer provides more mass transfer pore structures for reaction gas.

applicante: HENAN JULI WIRE ROPE MFG CO LTD
titulo: Gas film mass transfer evaporation water treatment system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water distillation treatment, in particular to a gas film mass transfer evaporation water treatment system which comprises a water return pool, an evaporation unit, a liquid distribution system and a control system. The evaporation unit is arranged above the water return pool and comprises at least one frame and a plurality of evaporation membrane materials installed on the frame at intervals, and the evaporation membrane materials are configured to form an expansion surface for liquid evaporation on the frame; and the liquid distribution system is used for pumping wastewater in the water return pool and conveying the wastewater to the evaporation unit to wet the evaporation membrane material. According to the invention, a hydrophilic evaporation membrane material is used as an evaporation carrier, so that a hydrophobic microporous membrane depended by traditional membrane distillation is completely abandoned; wastewater is spread into an extremely thin liquid membrane on the surface of the hydrophilic membrane material under the capillary action and is in direct contact with naturally flowing external air, mass transfer of water molecules from a liquid phase to a gas phase is realized on a gas membrane interface, and real zero-power driven evaporation is realized in the whole process.

applicante: ZHEJIANG HENGYI PETROCHEMICAL RESEARCH INST CO LTD
titulo: Mass transfer enhanced ethylbenzene adsorbent bed layer and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a mass transfer enhanced ethylbenzene adsorbent bed layer and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of chemical engineering. Adsorbent particles formed in the adsorbent bed layer comprise first-stage particles and second-stage particles, the number ratio of the first-stage particles to the second-stage particles is 7: 3, and the size ratio of the first-stage particles to the second-stage particles is (4-20): 1. The formed adsorbent particle component contains a metal modified molecular sieve with a low silica-alumina ratio, and the size is 20-100 nm; the molded adsorbent particles adopt a surface modifier to improve adsorption sites. The adsorbent bed layer with high loading density and enhanced mass transfer is contacted with a C8 aromatic isomer mixture, so that selective separation of ethylbenzene in C8 aromatic can be effectively realized at a relatively low temperature.

titulo: Mixing transfer head, mass transfer device and transfer method
abstract: The invention relates to a hybrid transfer head, a huge transfer device and a transfer method.The hybrid transfer head is used for picking and hybrid of multi-color LED chips, the light color types of the LED chips needing hybrid are N. The hybrid transfer head comprises a supporting shaft and a transfer array arranged on the supporting shaft in a sleeving mode, the transfer array comprises at least N transfer surfaces which are distributed in an annular array by taking the axis of the supporting shaft as a center, each transfer surface comprises a plurality of transfer tangent planes which are stacked in the axial direction of the supporting shaft, the transfer tangent planes are used for picking up monochromatic LED chips, and the transfer tangent planes can be in relative angular displacement around the axis of the supporting shaft; and adjusting the spatial position arrangement of the single-color LED chips on the transfer tangent plane to form mixed arrangement of the multi-color LED chips on the transfer plane. The invention provides a mixing transfer head which can realize efficient mixing of multi-color LED chips and further improve the chip transfer efficiency.

titulo: Method and device for predicting corrosion rate of carbon dioxide pipeline
abstract: The invention relates to a carbon dioxide pipeline corrosion rate prediction method and device. The method comprises the following steps: inputting real-time monitoring data along a pipeline into a trained pipeline corrosion rate prediction model; extracting electrochemical activation characteristics in the real-time monitoring data by using the electrochemical activation branch, extracting mass transfer limitation characteristics in the real-time monitoring data by using the mass transfer limitation branch, and extracting environmental medium characteristics in the real-time monitoring data by using the environmental medium branch; inputting the electrochemical activation characteristics, the mass transfer limitation characteristics and the environmental medium characteristics into a multi-branch fusion adaptive attention module, and performing weighted summation on the electrochemical activation characteristics, the mass transfer limitation characteristics and the environmental medium characteristics to obtain a fusion characteristic vector; and outputting a corrosion rate prediction value under the current working condition, the contribution degree of each physical mechanism and an uncertainty quantized value of a prediction result based on the fusion feature vector. The scheme improves the prediction accuracy of the corrosion rate of the carbon dioxide pipeline.

applicante: GREEN CLOUD BEIJING HEALTH MAN CO LTD
titulo: Supergravity extraction method of ganoderan and immune synergistic anti-tumor effect of ganoderan
abstract: The invention discloses a supergravity extraction method of ganoderan and an immune synergistic anti-tumor effect of ganoderan, and relates to the technical field of biomedicine.Ganoderma lucidum fine powder is subjected to ethanol degreasing and ultrasonic dispersion and then injected into a supergravity rotating packed bed, hot water extraction is conducted for 0.25-4 hours under the conditions that the liquid-solid ratio is 10: 1-80: 1 mL/g, the temperature is 30-90 DEG C and the speed is 500-1500 rpm, and a ganoderan extracting solution is obtained. According to the supergravity extraction method of the ganoderma lucidum polysaccharide and the immune synergistic anti-tumor effect of the ganoderma lucidum polysaccharide, the mass transfer resistance of a conventional extraction method is large, a supergravity environment can weaken diffusion and mass transfer obstacles caused by compact cell walls by strengthening the permeation of a solvent into a material and the diffusion process of polysaccharide molecules to an extraction medium, and the quality of the ganoderma lucidum polysaccharide is improved. An ideal polysaccharide dissolution effect can be achieved under a relatively mild temperature condition and a relatively short operation time in an extraction process, so that a process guarantee is provided for efficient extraction of the ganoderma lucidum polysaccharide on a microscopic mass transfer level.

titulo: Flow velocity-frequency coupled alternating current electrochemical water treatment method
abstract: The invention discloses a flow velocity-frequency coupled alternating current electrochemical water treatment method, and belongs to the field of pollutant treatment. The method comprises the following steps: introducing organic pollutant wastewater containing electrolyte into a cross-flow electrolytic tank for electrochemical treatment; the used treatment parameters are as follows: the alternating current frequency is 0.0001-100Hz, the duty ratio is 0%-100%, the wastewater introduction flow rate meets the condition that the cross section area per unit square centimeter is 0.01-100mL/min, and the alternating current frequency and the flow rate need to be coupled and matched. The switching frequency and the duty ratio of alternating current are optimized on the basis of the principle that interface mass transfer is combined with electron transfer, the circulation type electrolytic tank is designed, electrode interface reaction and material mass transfer are coupled, and enhanced removal of organic pollutants under space-time coupling is achieved. The method is expected to be widely applied to the wastewater treatment fields of organic pollutant wastewater and sewage treatment plants, organic matter polluted underground water and the like.

applicante: PUYANG NEW SPINNING TECH CO LTD
titulo: Cotton spinning fiber quality online monitoring method and system based on intelligent sensor
abstract: The invention provides a cotton spinning fiber quality on-line monitoring method and system based on an intelligent sensor, and relates to the technical field of spinning production monitoring, non-contact multi-parameter synchronous detection is carried out on cotton spinning fibers, an obtained local quality parameter vector is converted into a breadth statistical characteristic quantity with macroscopic spatial semantics, and the breadth statistical characteristic quantity is calculated; the method realizes matching of a detection result space scale and a process parameter regulation scale, improves process adjustment accuracy, establishes a mass parameter evolution database including an inter-process mass transfer relationship and thermodynamic energy balance, and fits a process mass transfer function of each process, so as to improve process adjustment accuracy. And calculating a sensitivity matrix of the final product quality parameters to the process parameters of each process through a disturbance method, and further solving the global optimal process parameter adjustment amount for minimizing the weighted quality deviation, thereby realizing the spatial positioning of the quality abnormality and the cross-process combined process optimization, realizing the global coordinated optimization of the process parameters of multiple processes, and improving the quality of the product. And the systematicness and effectiveness of whole-process quality control are improved.

titulo: Method for enhancing performance of ammonia-induced phosphogypsum direct carbonation for fixing CO2
abstract: The invention provides a method for fixing CO2 by intensifying ammonia-induced phosphogypsum direct carbonation, according to the method, a low-pressure microbubble generator is introduced in an ammonia medium system to replace a conventional gas pipe bubbling mode in the phosphogypsum direct carbonation process, and gas-liquid mass transfer in the CO2 mineralization process is promoted by changing the CO2 gas release mode and the bubble size, so that the CO2 mineralization effect is improved. The CO2 mineralization rate and the phosphogypsum saturated carbon sequestration amount are improved; the method comprises the following steps: preparing a suspension from ardealite, ammonia water and deionized water, introducing CO2 gas into a reactor, carrying out a stirring reaction, and finally carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain nano calcium carbonate and an ammonium sulfate-rich solution; according to the method, the micro CO2 bubbles are released, the mineralization rate and the saturated carbon sequestration amount are remarkably increased under the normal-pressure mild condition, the problems that in an existing process for immobilizing CO2 through phosphogypsum direct carbonation, the mass transfer efficiency is low, and phosphogypsum conversion is not thorough are solved, the mineralization process is simple, the mineralization period is short, and the method is suitable for industrial application of a CO2 mineralization storage path.

applicante: TIANJIN HIGH ENERGY TIMES WATER TREAT TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
titulo: Airlift power reactor coupled with modularized annular three-phase separator
abstract: The invention discloses an airlift power reactor coupled with a modularized annular three-phase separator. The airlift power reactor comprises an airlift power reactor tower body, the modularized annular three-phase separator and a modularized airlift power circulating cover, through the modular design of all main parts, the integration level and the production, installation and operation and maintenance convenience of the system are improved, the investment cost and the operation and maintenance cost are reduced, and the construction period is shortened; the modularized annular three-phase separator is compact in structure, the separation capacity is enhanced, an efficient gas, water and mud separation channel is formed, a water outlet channel is linked with an overflow system, the gas-liquid-solid separation path is short, and the efficiency is high; through functional coupling of the upper module and the lower module and backflow guiding of the conical flow guide cover, a uniform and consistent high-speed circulation mass transfer reaction flow state and a low-speed radiation three-phase separation flow state are formed on the vertical breadth from the center to the periphery of the reactor, the mass transfer reaction efficiency of the system is enhanced, and the impact resistance is improved.

titulo: Sandwich type desiccant composite vacuum film dehumidification assembly and desiccant preparation method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of air humidity regulation, and provides a sandwich type drying agent composite vacuum film dehumidification assembly and a drying agent preparation method. The assembly comprises a water vapor selective permeable membrane, a porous supporting layer, a membrane supporting base body, a drying agent, an internal heat source and an external negative pressure source. A plurality of cavities are formed in the membrane supporting base body, the filling cavities are communicated with one another through channels, and the cavities are filled with the drying agent. Water vapor in wet air enters the permeation side space through the water vapor selective permeation membrane and is adsorbed by the drying agent, so that the water vapor partial pressure on the permeation side is reduced, and the mass transfer driving force on the two sides of the membrane is enhanced; under the action of an external negative pressure source and an internal heat source, moisture adsorbed by the drying agent can be desorbed and discharged through a channel, and regeneration is achieved. By constructing a membrane separation and adsorption coupling structure, the dehumidification efficiency is improved, and the regeneration energy consumption is reduced. Particularly, by constructing a drying agent filling structure, the partial pressure of water vapor is continuously reduced, so that the dehumidification and mass transfer efficiency of the film is remarkably improved.

titulo: Tubular spiral structure flow field and electrochemical reactor
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrochemistry, in particular to a tubular spiral structure flow field and an electrochemical reactor. The tubular spiral structure flow field comprises a tubular flow field body and a spiral flow channel which is of a tubular spiral structure and is distributed in the flow field body. Centrifugal force and secondary flow are introduced through the spiral flow channel, mass transfer of reactants to the gas diffusion electrode is enhanced, meanwhile, pressure drop is reduced, and the electrochemical performance of the electrochemical reactor is effectively improved. The electrochemical reactor can be used as a reaction device in water electrolysis, fuel cells, electrochemical sensors and carbon dioxide electrochemical reduction.

titulo: Preparation method and application of wall coating type enzyme-loaded microchannel reactor based on microemulsion method
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a wall coating type enzyme-loaded micro-channel reactor based on a micro-emulsion method. According to the method, O/W microemulsion is used as a soft template to replace traditional PEG pore forming, PDA/PEI codeposition pretreatment and deionized water are combined to remove a surface compact layer, a through porous sol-gel enzyme coating is formed in situ on the inner wall of a microchannel, and the accessibility and mass transfer efficiency of enzyme are remarkably improved while CALB firm fixation is achieved. According to the method, the catalytic efficiency and the operation stability are greatly improved, and the enzyme catalytic rate is increased by 1.56 times or above.

titulo: Nickel-based multistage porous oxygen electrode and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a nickel-based multistage porous oxygen electrode and a preparation method and application thereof. The electrode comprises an IN625 nickel-based perforated framework, a graphene layer and a graphene coupling Ni oxyhydroxide/Cr-Mo oxide reconstruction layer, wherein the IN625 nickel-based perforated framework and the graphene layer are integrally formed, and the graphene coupling Ni oxyhydroxide/Cr-Mo oxide reconstruction layer is formed through alkaline activation. And the porous working part adopts a TPMS (Tire Pressure Monitor System) structure of Gyandroid, Diamond, Schwarz P or gradient combination thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of powder screening, three-dimensional modeling, SLM forming, aftertreatment, graphene construction and electrochemical activation. The electrode is continuous in electric conduction, designable in pore channels, smooth in mass transfer and gassing, and suitable for alkaline oxygen evolution reaction.

titulo: Gas component dynamic change prediction method after shutdown of fuel cell engine and shutdown method
abstract: The invention discloses a method for predicting dynamic change of gas components after shutdown of a fuel cell engine and a shutdown method, belongs to the technical field of fuel cell engines, and comprehensively considers shutdown working condition parameters, auxiliary load parameters and structural design parameters of an electric pile and the engine. The system describes reaction and mass transfer processes such as transmembrane permeation, hydrogen-oxygen reaction, concentration diffusion and differential pressure convection in the galvanic pile after shutdown, and accurately predicts dynamic evolution laws of concentrations of hydrogen, oxygen and nitrogen components in cathode and anode cavities of the galvanic pile in different shutdown modes; meanwhile, the appearance time of the hydrogen-air interface is quantitatively analyzed, so that performance degradation induced by the hydrogen-air interface is effectively inhibited, and the durability of the vehicle fuel cell engine is improved.

titulo: Cellulose-based aerogel and preparation method thereof
abstract: The preparation method comprises the following steps: by taking an anionic cellulose nano material and a cationic natural polymer nano material as main skeleton raw materials, constructing a composite three-dimensional network structure through electrostatic interaction, hydrogen-bond interaction and nanofiber entanglement effect; under the action of auxiliary foaming of a surfactant and induced curing of an acidic gas phase, preparation of the cellulose-based aerogel under the conditions of normal temperature and normal pressure is realized. The cellulose-based aerogel prepared by the preparation method disclosed by the invention is low in density, has a rich pore structure and relatively good structural stability, and can provide a sufficient contact interface and a mass transfer channel for micro-plastics, suspended particles and colloidal pollutants in a water body; meanwhile, the anion and cation active sites reserved in the material are beneficial to enhancing the adsorption and trapping capability of the material on particulate pollutants with different surface properties.

titulo: Device for testing permeability of all-vanadium redox flow battery electrode
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of redox flow batteries, and particularly relates to a device for testing the electrode permeability of an all-vanadium redox flow battery, which comprises an electrode packaging component, a corrosion-resistant pipeline system and a parameter monitoring system, the electrode permeability in different compression ratios, different electrolyte temperatures and different charging and discharging states can be obtained, and the momentum transfer and mass transfer processes of the electrolyte in the electrode can be more accurately obtained by performing multi-physical field simulation calculation on the all-vanadium redox flow battery by utilizing the electrode permeability obtained by the device disclosed by the utility model. The accuracy of multi-physical field simulation calculation of the all-vanadium redox flow battery is improved, and more accurate parameter information in the electrode is provided for design and development of the all-vanadium redox flow battery with higher performance.

titulo: Application of surface partially embedded nano high-entropy structure catalyst
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrochemical reaction catalysts, and discloses application of a surface partially embedded nano high-entropy structure catalyst. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding a ligand and a non-noble metal salt precursor into deionized water, and uniformly stirring to form a solution; adding ammonia water into the solution, continuously stirring and drying to obtain dry gel; and carrying out self-combustion on the dry gel at a high temperature of 250 DEG C or above to obtain the surface partially embedded nano high-entropy structure catalyst. The surface partially embedded non-noble metal nano high-entropy structure is synthesized by coupling a sol-gel method with a self-combustion method and is applied to the field of electro-catalysis; the electro-catalytic performance is improved through the high stability, the high-entropy cocktail effect/hysteresis diffusion effect and the like of an embedded interface confinement, surface diffusion mass transfer and improvement of substrate adsorption activation behaviors.

titulo: Method for determining press-fitting force of electric pile on line
abstract: The invention discloses a method for determining the press-fitting force of an electric pile on line, and belongs to the technical field of fuel cells. The method comprises the steps of theoretical design height calculation, reference press-fitting force range primary selection, press-fitting force uniformity verification, candidate press-fitting force range determination, optimal press-fitting force dynamic optimization based on impedance spectroscopy analysis and multi-dimensional criterion intersection decision making. The method comprises the following steps: monitoring impedance response of a galvanic pile under different current densities on line by utilizing an EIS technology, and analyzing an impedance spectrum by combining a DRT method, so as to realize quantitative distinguishing of a multi-scale electrochemical process in the galvanic pile; according to the invention, key electrochemical behaviors such as mass transfer capability under different press-fitting forces are incorporated into a core evaluation system, and dual optimization of the performance and reliability of the galvanic pile is truly realized.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ ET SYSTÈME DE TRAITEMENT DES EAUX
abstract: This water treatment method comprises: irradiating water being treated that contains organic matter with ultraviolet rays by using an ultraviolet irradiation device 34; passing the water being treated that is irradiated with the ultraviolet rays through an ion exchanger filling device 35 downstream of the ultraviolet irradiation device 34; and acquiring the total organic carbon concentration and the dissolved oxygen concentration of the water being treated by the ultraviolet irradiation device 34. The irradiation with the ultraviolet rays includes adjusting the irradiation amount of the ultraviolet rays on the basis of the total organic carbon concentration and the dissolved oxygen concentration.

titulo: STABLE LIQUID BORTEZOMIB FORMULATIONS
abstract: Described herein are liquid pharmaceutical compositions comprising bortezomib, a polyol comprising mannitol, and an aqueous carrier, wherein the compositions are suitable for intravenous or subcutaneous administration. In certain embodiments, the compositions are substantially free of organic solvents and comprise controlled levels of impurities, including not more than 1.0% of each of Impurity E, Impurity L, Impurity J, Impurity F, Impurity I, and Impurity U, and not more than 3.0% total impurities. The compositions are prepared under controlled process conditions, including control of temperature, dissolved oxygen, and headspace oxygen, to reduce impurity formation and improve stability during storage. In certain embodiments, the compositions exhibit extended stability under refrigerated conditions. The disclosure further relates to methods of preparing such compositions and to dosage configurations aligned with clinically administered doses to improve dose matching and reduce residual drug following administration.

titulo: SYSTÈME ET PROCÉDÉ POUR AUGMENTER LA CROISSANCE ET LE RENDEMENT DE PLANTES
abstract: A plant growing system and method utilizing a hyperbaric growing chamber configured for growing plants in a pressurized CO2 enriched atmosphere while roots are substantially completely immersed in a hyperoxygenated aqueous hydroponic growing medium. The chamber has an enclosure with atmosphere holding and medium holding compartments separated by a gas and liquid impermeable barrier. An oxygenation system utilizes an electrolyzer and nebulizer to produce hyperoxygenated water containing nanosized oxygen bubbles maintaining 2-8 mg/L dissolved oxygen in the medium for extended periods. A growing atmosphere operating system maintains pressure in the chamber at 150-1200 kPa and CO2 concentration at 0.05-0.40% through a CO2 supply system employing direct air capture. A feeding system employs a fertilizer dispenser, preferably a nebulizer, configured to discharge nanosized surfactant-enhanced fertilizer droplets for stomatal uptake. An acoustic stimulation system uses transducers operating at frequencies and sound pressure levels that controllably open and close stomata pores during feeding. A lighting system collects sunlight via solar collectors, filters UV and certain IR wavelengths through a light bandpass filter preferably composed of acrylic and delivers filtered light through fiber optic bundles to emitter arrays in the chamber. The system is optimally disposed underground at depths of at least 10-20 meters to maintain constant growing temperatures of 20-32°C, preferably above an aquifer that provides water for system operation. The system can perform pre-harvest ozone sterilization followed by ultra high-pressure CO2 treatment to extend shelf life dramatically without refrigeration. The system achieves unprecedented growth rates, yields, and sustainability even in arid environments.

titulo: CAPTEUR OPTIQUE EN TEMPS RÉEL ET SES PROCÉDÉS D'UTILISATION
abstract: An optical sensor includes an optical waveguide having at least one sensing region; and a detector configured to receive a return signal from the optical waveguide; wherein the at least one sensing region is capable of determining pH, temperature, dissolved oxygen concentration, glucose concentration, lactate concentration, NAD+/NADH, pressure, flow rate, reactive oxygen species (ROS), or moisture level. The optical sensor can be particularly well-suited for determining or monitoring various parameters in real time. Methods of using the optical sensor are also provided.

applicante: BEIJING NAURA MICROELECTRONICS EQUIPMENT CO LTD [CN]
titulo: APPAREIL DE NETTOYAGE DE SEMI-CONDUCTEURS ET ENSEMBLE TUYAUX ASSOCIÉ
abstract: A pipe assembly (10) applied to a semiconductor cleaning apparatus, the pipe assembly (10) being configured to be placed in a cleaning tank (20) of the semiconductor cleaning apparatus. The pipe assembly (10) comprises a gas injection pipe assembly (100), the gas injection pipe assembly (100) comprising a plurality of gas injection pipes (110) distributed at intervals; each gas injection pipe (110) is used for separately introducing oxygen purging gas into the cleaning tank (20); in an extension direction of the gas injection pipes (110), each gas injection pipe (110) is provided with a plurality of gas outlet holes (110a) arranged at intervals. The oxygen purging gas is introduced into the cleaning tank (20) through the gas injection pipes (110), so as to change an oxygen dissolution equilibrium between a gas phase and a liquid phase, drive dissolved oxygen to transfer from the liquid phase to the gas phase, and reduce the oxygen content, thereby establishing a new dissolution equilibrium state having a lower oxygen content, avoiding insufficient contact between a cleaning liquid and a wafer due to an excessively high oxygen content, and improving the wafer cleaning effect and process effect. Further provided is a semiconductor cleaning apparatus.

titulo: System and Method for Increasing Plant Growth and Yield
abstract: [0000]    A plant growing system that includes a hyperbaric growing chamber having a growing atmosphere holding compartment overlying a liquid growing medium holding compartment separated by a gas and liquid impermeable barrier. The growing atmosphere is pressurized to at least 150 kPa and enriched with CO<2 >to at least 0.05% by volume. An oxygenation system employing an electrolyzer and nebulizer produces hyperoxygenated hydroponic growing medium containing oxygen nanobubbles maintaining at least 5 mg/L dissolved oxygen. A foliar feeding system discharges nanosized surfactant-enhanced fertilizer droplets into the growing atmosphere for stomatal uptake. An acoustic stimulation system selectively varies sound frequencies emitted by transducers to controllably open and close stomata during feeding cycles. A lighting system collects sunlight via solar collectors, filters UV wavelengths, and delivers filtered light through fiber optic bundles to emitters within the chamber. The chamber is preferably disposed underground to maintain stable growing temperatures without active climate control.

titulo: A kit for providing dissolved oxygen in the water for a long time and a method of using it
abstract: 본 발명은 물의 유입 및 배출량이 조절될 수 있도록 벨브가 구성되는 용기 내부에 서방형(Slow release type) 산소 소스(Source) 저장부가 단독으로 이루어지거나, 서방형 산소 소스 저장부와 산소 발생을 위한 촉매부가 용기 내부에 개별적으로 이루어지고, 수중에 용존산소를 제공하기 위하여 용기를 수중에 넣을 때 용기의 위치를 시각적으로 확인하기 위하여 용기의 몸체에 부표가 구성되어 수중에 용존산소를 장기간 제공하기 위한 키트(Kit)가 구성되어 지고, 키트 내부에 유입되는 물에 용출, 희석되면서 전이금속으로 오염된 물 내지는 산소 발생을 위한 촉매부와 반응하면서 산소 발생에 따른 수중의 용존산소를 장기간 제공하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

applicante: JIANGSU ZHONGNONG IOT TECH CO LTD
titulo: Pond dissolved oxygen monitoring device with anti-collision protection function
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of dissolved oxygen measurement, in particular to a pond-side dissolved oxygen monitoring device with anti-collision protection, which is characterized in that a floating plate is placed on the water surface of a pond, is moved to a monitoring position and is fixed on the monitoring position through a positioning component; the solar cell panel assembly absorbs solar energy in the daytime and converts the solar energy into electric energy to be stored in the storage battery to be supplied to the dissolved oxygen monitor, a worker sends a signal instruction to the controller through remote control, the dissolved oxygen monitor monitors dissolved oxygen in pond water through the detection end, and convenience is improved; comprising a dissolved oxygen monitor, a floating plate and a waterproof box, the dissolved oxygen monitor is installed at the top end of the floating plate, the detection end of the dissolved oxygen monitor extends to the position below the floating plate, the waterproof box is installed at the top end of the floating plate, and a storage battery and a controller are arranged in the waterproof box; and a plurality of groups of solar cell panel assemblies are circumferentially arranged at the top end of the floating plate.

titulo: Intelligent river dissolved oxygen prediction method and system based on segmentation mechanism constraint
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of water environment intelligent prediction and model optimization, and provides an intelligent river dissolved oxygen prediction method and system based on segmentation mechanism constraint, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a dissolved oxygen prediction value based on the obtained historical time sequence data of a target river monitoring section and a constructed basic dissolved oxygen prediction model; calculating the theoretical saturated dissolved oxygen concentration corresponding to the current water temperature; constructing a water quality condition index; comparing the predicted value of the dissolved oxygen with the theoretical saturated dissolved oxygen concentration, carrying out segmented judgment on the state of the sample to obtain the state of the sample, constructing penalty terms corresponding to different states in allusion to the samples in different states and in combination with corresponding dissolved oxygen mechanism rules, and constructing a segmented mechanism constraint loss function; and training the basic dissolved oxygen prediction model by using a segmentation mechanism constraint loss function, carrying out dissolved oxygen prediction on the target section based on the trained dissolved oxygen prediction model, and outputting a dissolved oxygen prediction value of the target section. And the physical consistency and interpretability of a model prediction result are improved.

applicante: HUATIAN NANJING ENGINEERING & TECHNOLOGY CORP MCC
titulo: System and method for treating degradation-resistant organic wastewater through low-concentration dissolved oxygen period regulation and control
abstract: The invention discloses a system and a method for treating degradation-resistant organic wastewater through low-concentration dissolved oxygen period regulation and control. Comprising the following steps: inoculating activated sludge into a reactor, and controlling the dissolved oxygen concentration in the reactor to be between a first dissolved oxygen concentration and a second dissolved oxygen concentration in a periodic alternating mode; wherein the first dissolved oxygen concentration is smaller than the second dissolved oxygen concentration. Under the regulation and control mode, the system can enrich functional florae with degradation potential of refractory organics, maintain the micro-bulking state of the sludge and avoid malignant bulking. According to the process, the impact resistance of the activated sludge to organic pollutants is remarkably improved, the expansion and deterioration of filamentous bacteria are effectively inhibited, the aeration energy consumption is reduced, and the yield of residual sludge is reduced. The technology provides a feasible scheme for energy conservation and consumption reduction of a sewage treatment plant and deep removal of refractory organic matters.

titulo: Dissolved oxygen control method and device based on microporous nucleation-mechanical shearing two-stage coupling
abstract: The invention discloses a dissolved oxygen control method and equipment based on microporous nucleation-mechanical shear two-stage coupling, and belongs to the technical field of biological process engineering.The equipment comprises a gas supply system, a microporous aeration assembly, a mechanical shear driving device and a process control system, and the gas supply system is used for providing gas with controllable pressure and flow; the microporous aeration assembly is immersed in liquid to be aerated and comprises at least one microporous material with a micron-sized pore channel structure; according to the invention, high shear force required for generating bubbles is strictly limited in an extremely small local area around the microporous aeration assembly, and the average shear stress experienced by most of liquid and cells in a culture system is extremely low and is equivalent to a mild mixing environment provided by a low-speed stirring paddle, so that the bubble generation effect is greatly improved. Therefore, the method is particularly suitable for culturing animal cells which are extremely sensitive to shearing force, and the cell activity and the product quality can be remarkably improved.

titulo: Integrated equipment for converting sewage into recyclable reclaimed water
abstract: The utility model discloses integrated equipment for changing sewage into recyclable reclaimed water, which comprises a barrel, a wastewater inlet is arranged at the top of the barrel, an hourglass-shaped water inlet cavity is arranged inside the barrel, and a screen is fixedly connected to the bottom of the hourglass-shaped water inlet cavity; a biological membrane reaction area is formed in the cylinder body, a plurality of suspended biological fillers are filled in the biological membrane reaction area, a partition plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of the biological membrane reaction area, an annular aeration pipe is fixedly connected to the partition plate, and a dissolved oxygen sensing probe is arranged at the top of the biological membrane reaction area. A biological membrane reaction area is linked with an annular aeration pipe through a suspended filler and a dissolved oxygen sensing probe, an anoxic and aerobic alternating environment is created in a single reaction area through intermittent aeration intelligent regulation and control, and the nitrogen and carbon removal efficiency is synchronously enhanced; and a double barrier is formed by no-dead-corner sterilization of an annular lamp tube in the subsequent ultraviolet disinfection area and physical adsorption of an activated carbon filter cartridge in the deep filtering area.

titulo: Environment DNA self-adaptive sampling method based on water quality parameter change
abstract: The invention discloses an environment DNA self-adaptive sampling method based on water quality parameter change, and belongs to the technical field of water ecological environment monitoring and environment DNA sampling. Water quality parameters such as dissolved oxygen are continuously collected, the change rate, amplitude and trend are calculated after pretreatment, triggering conditions are judged according to preset rules, environment DNA sampling frequency is dynamically controlled, the sampling frequency is reduced in a stable stage, quick response is made in an abnormal stage, and false triggering is avoided through a hysteretic mechanism. According to the method, time-driven environment DNA sampling is converted into ecological process-driven environment DNA sampling, water quality abnormity and biological response key stages are accurately captured, the sample representativeness is improved, the cost is reduced, the emergency monitoring capability is enhanced, and the method is suitable for biodiversity monitoring and ecological risk early warning of rivers, lakes, reservoirs and other water bodies and is easy to integrate and popularize.

applicante: TAIHU BASIN HYDROLOGY WATER RESOURCES MONITORING CENTER TAIHU BASIN WATER ENV MONITORING CENTER
titulo: Lake flooding prevention and disposal method based on hydrodynamic regulation and control
abstract: The invention discloses a lake flooding prevention and disposal method based on hydrodynamic regulation, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a lake flooding comprehensive risk evaluation index through obtaining multi-source environment data, and defining the spatial risk gradient distribution of a high-incidence area; reversely deducing a target hydrodynamic regulation and control parameter by using the three-dimensional hydrodynamic-water ecology coupling model and taking a dissolved oxygen concentration safety threshold as a constraint; and determining the layout density and the spatial point location of the plug flow device. And in the operation stage, the instantaneous dynamic risk state is determined by combining real-time monitoring data, and the real-time operation power of the plug flow device is continuously adjusted according to the instantaneous dynamic risk state. According to the invention, full life cycle management from static risk assessment and physical demand deduction to dynamic servo control is realized, accurate targeted prevention and control can be carried out for lake flooding outbreak risks, and formation of an anaerobic environment is effectively blocked while energy consumption is reduced.
scores_por_categoria: Bioreactor & Mass Transfer:4 | Process Monitoring & Control:7

titulo: Active sludge operation method, device and system based on magnetic suspension regulation and control
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, in particular to an activated sludge operation method, device and system based on magnetic suspension regulation, diamagnetic substances and conductive carbon-based materials are compounded in activated sludge, and a magnetic field with controllable spatial distribution can be constructed in a reaction area in combination with a modular electromagnetic actuator, so that the activated sludge can be efficiently treated. Stable suspension and dynamic regulation and control of the sludge are realized. The system can adjust the spatial distribution of sludge as required, maintain a target state in different operation stages, and improve the contact efficiency of microorganisms with pollutants, dissolved oxygen and the like and the sludge retention capacity; meanwhile, energy consumption and shearing disturbance are reduced, and the sludge structure stability is enhanced; and in combination with real-time sensing feedback, uniform suspension, directional migration and controllable reconstruction can be realized, so that low-energy-consumption, flexible and controllable sludge space distribution management is realized, and the process efficiency and the operation reliability are improved.

applicante: GUANGZHOU LIYANZHUANG BIOLOGY TECH CO LTD
titulo: Preparation method of low-molecular-weight sodium hyaluronate as well as product and application of low-molecular-weight sodium hyaluronate
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method of low-molecular-weight sodium hyaluronate as well as a product and application of the low-molecular-weight sodium hyaluronate. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) performing fermentation culture on a streptococcus agalactiae strain to obtain hyaluronidase fermentation liquor; (2) extracting the hyaluronidase fermentation liquor to obtain hyaluronidase; (3) adding hyaluronidase into the high-molecular-weight sodium hyaluronate aqueous solution, and performing enzymolysis reaction to obtain low-molecular-weight sodium hyaluronate enzymatic hydrolysate; and (4) removing impurities from the enzymatic hydrolysate, concentrating to obtain a concentrated solution, and drying to obtain the low-molecular-weight sodium hyaluronate. The method does not need to use an organic solvent, hyaluronidase is synthesized through self metabolism of microorganisms, and in the fermentation process, the enzyme activity and specificity are more stable and the enzymolysis effect is more controllable by regulating and controlling carbon and nitrogen sources, temperature and dissolved oxygen and optimizing the expression quantity and folding efficiency of the enzyme; furthermore, the low-molecular-weight sodium hyaluronate with accurate and uniform molecular weight can be prepared.
