titulo: Subsurface wetland system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of wetlands, in particular to a subsurface flow wetland system. Comprising a sewage pipeline, a planting wetland, a water collecting main pipe, a water level control assembly and a backwashing assembly, one end of the sewage pipeline is connected with a nearby factory heat exchange pipeline, the other end of the sewage pipeline is arranged in the planting wetland, the water collecting main pipe is arranged in the planting wetland and located at the bottom of the sewage pipeline, and the water collecting main pipe is connected with the water level control assembly and the backwashing assembly. The backwashing assembly is arranged between the planting wetland and the water level control assembly, and one end, far away from the planting wetland, of the water collecting main pipe extends into the water level control assembly. The invention solves the key technical problems of non-adjustable water level, difficult operation in winter, easy blockage, insufficient dissolved oxygen and the like of the existing subsurface flow wetland. The invention is mainly applied to a subsurface wetland system.

titulo: Fermentation product and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, and particularly discloses a fermented product and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: (1) separating lactose and whey protein from animal milk, mixing, degassing, and sterilizing to obtain a culture solution of the bifidobacterium longum subsp. Longum BBMN68; performing pasteurization on the other animal milk components to obtain pasteurized milk; (2) inoculating BBMN68 into a bifidobacterium longum subsp. Longum BBMN68 culture solution, and fermenting to a platform phase to obtain a first-stage culture solution; (3) performing fermentation preparation of yoghourt by taking pasteurized milk as a raw material to obtain a yoghourt base material; adjusting the dissolved oxygen of the yoghurt base material, mixing with the first-stage culture solution, and carrying out secondary fermentation and demulsification to obtain a second-stage fermentation solution; (4) cooling, sealing and after-ripening the second-stage fermentation liquor; and (5) sterilizing. According to the method disclosed by the invention, the BBMN68 can be efficiently proliferated, the bacterial count of the product before sterilization is increased, and the effect of enhancing the immunity of the final product is improved.

titulo: Treatment method for improving environmental stability of molybdenum disulfide nanosheet
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of nano material surface modification, and discloses a treatment method for improving the environmental stability of molybdenum disulfide nanosheets, the molybdenum disulfide nanosheets are dispersed in a polar solvent system, and a dissolved oxygen scavenger and a peroxide scavenger are added to regulate and control the oxidation environment of the system; further introducing a sulfur chemical potential buffer pair composed of a sulfur transfer donor and a sulfur affinity capture body, and then adding a competitive adsorption gating agent and a zwitter-ion dynamic ion pair passivator to form a stable passivation layer on the surface of the nanosheet; finally, the reaction environment is adjusted through a red oxygen circulation system, purification treatment is conducted, and the molybdenum disulfide nanosheet subjected to stabilization treatment is obtained. The sulfur chemical potential buffer pair SB is introduced in the treatment process and is matched with the defect directional end-capping reagent A, so that defect sites on the surfaces of the molybdenum disulfide nanosheets can be directionally repaired and stably capped under controlled conditions, and the reaction activity of the defect sites is reduced.

applicante: ZHANJIANG HONGZHEN MACHINERY EQUIPMENT CO LTD
titulo: Plug flow oxygenation device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of aquaculture industry, and discloses a plug flow oxygenation device which comprises a motor, a connecting piece is fixed to the top of the motor, a second air inlet pipe communicates with the front of the outer surface of the connecting piece, a vertical pipe is inserted into a top port of the connecting piece, and a first air inlet pipe communicates with the upper portion of the outer surface of the vertical pipe. A motor shaft sleeve is arranged on the lower portion of the interior of the second air inlet chamber, a water impeller is connected to the top of the motor shaft sleeve in an inserted mode, and a water seal air seal ring is arranged on the upper portion of the outer surface of the motor shaft sleeve in a sleeving mode. Compared with a traditional plug flow oxygenation device, the plug flow oxygenation device has the advantages that the effect is improved by 50%, water and gas are mixed more sufficiently, the function value of the oxygenation device is effectively improved, the requirement for the high dissolved oxygen value of aquaculture water required by modern agricultural high-density aquaculture is met, and the purposes of high efficiency and energy conservation are achieved.

applicante: CHONGQING ZHONGJIAXIN HEALTH MAN CO LTD
titulo: Intelligent regulation and control method for fermentation production of bacteriostatic agent based on pH and temperature coupling feedback
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of fermentation engineering control, in particular to a pH and temperature coupling feedback-based intelligent regulation and control method for fermentation production of a bacteriostatic agent, which comprises the following steps of: establishing an offline prior knowledge base containing a pH temperature product synthesis three-dimensional response curved surface model and a bidirectional coupling influence coefficient; the current pH value and temperature value are collected in real time in a hardware synchronization mode, and the fermentation stage is automatically identified in combination with auxiliary parameters such as dissolved oxygen and carbon dioxide release rate; calculating a deviation value of the current value deviating from the optimal coupling interval, and superposing the deviation value with a coupling disturbance estimated value to generate a comprehensive regulation and control demand signal; and according to the effective state of the demand signal and the priority of the fermentation stage, single-variable regulation and control with feed-forward compensation or double-variable coordinated regulation and control based on stepped alternating output are executed. Decoupling cooperative control of pH and temperature is achieved, the fermentation titer of the bacteriostatic agent is effectively improved, the fermentation period is shortened, acid-base and energy consumption is reduced, and batch-to-batch production consistency is enhanced.

applicante: CHINA INST OF WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER RESEARCH
titulo: Aeration weir-water bundling-boosting system for treating algal bloom pollution of jacking section of warehousing branch
abstract: The invention provides an aeration weir-water restraining-boosting system for treating water bloom pollution of a reservoir branch jacking section, which comprises an aeration oxygenation unit, a water restraining and flow generating unit and a flow pushing unit, and the aeration oxygenation unit, the water restraining and flow generating unit and the flow pushing unit are sequentially arranged in a riverway from upstream to downstream along the water flow direction. According to the invention, three functional units of oxygenation, water binding and boosting are arranged along the longitudinal direction of water flow to form a continuous action gallery; the aeration oxygenation unit increases dissolved oxygen from water quality; the water flow generating unit actively collects water flow through a V-shaped flow guide component which is high in structural strength, fixed in included angle and rigidly anchored in bottom, and the flow speed is increased; the intelligent plug flow unit performs accurate regulation and control according to the real-time water quality risk; the water power and chemical environment for stable growth of algae is fundamentally destroyed by systematically increasing the flow rate and dissolving oxygen through physical and mechanical methods, and the treatment effect is direct and lasting; and each unit adopts an assembly type or modular design, so that rapid deployment, adjustment and maintenance are facilitated, and the application is flexible.

applicante: JIANGSU HUAISHUN CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD
titulo: Water conservancy ecological wetland filler filtering and purifying device
abstract: The invention discloses a water conservancy ecological wetland filler filtering and purifying device, and relates to the technical field of water conservancy ecological governance, the water conservancy ecological wetland filler filtering and purifying device comprises a filtering and purifying integrated box and a water inlet, the water inlet is formed in one side wall of the filtering and purifying integrated box, and the water inlet is located below the horizontal plane; a feeding groove is welded to the position, located at the water inlet, of one side of the filtering and purifying integrated box, and a fishing assembly is arranged in the feeding groove. The first fishing claw can fish aquatic plants on the horizontal plane of the feeding groove, the second fishing claw fishes the aquatic plants in the first fishing claw again, the fished aquatic plants are prevented from flowing to the water inlet along with water flow again, the water inlet of the filtering and purifying integrated box cannot be blocked, a shear knife can shear the aquatic plants on the second fishing claw, and the water inlet is prevented from being blocked. Therefore, aquatic plants or foreign matters on the second fishing claw are prevented from being wound on the second fishing claw, the water body is driven to flow by stirring, so that the water body is in large contact with air, and the dissolved oxygen content of drainage water flow is increased.

titulo: A HYBRID INTEGRATED AQUAPONIC-AEROPONIC FARMING SYSTEM WITH ADAPTIVE NUTRIENT CONTROL
abstract: The present invention is related to a hybrid integrated aquaponic-aeroponic farming system with adaptive nutrient control. A hybrid integrated farming system in the field of controlled environment agriculture comprises an aquaculture tank for fish rearing and waste generation, a HEPA filter for particulate removal, and a biofiltration unit housing nitrobacteria to convert ammonia to nitrates. The treated water is further processed in a nutrient enrichment chamber where supplemental NPK fertilizer is added, then conveyed via silicon piping and a doser pump to an aeroponic mist sprayer that delivers a fine nutrient mist to plant roots. An ESP32-based control unit monitors multiple sensors, including water level, EC, pH, and dissolved oxygen sensors, to control dosing and misting. The system also features recirculation, manual override, and mechanical backup for enhanced reliability and adaptive nutrient management.

titulo: METHODS FOR CARBON-CONSERVING CELL-FREE BIOPRODUCTION
abstract: A method for cell-free bioproduction of a desired chemical compound by engineering a multi-step metabolic pathway, comprising (a) producing one or more enzymes utilized for producing a desired chemical compound from one or more DNA templates in a lysate-based cell-free expression system, and (b) producing one or more desired chemical compounds in a cell-free metabolic engineering reaction by reacting one or more substrates with the one or more enzymes in the diluted expression system.

titulo: Construction method and application of engineering escherichia coli for producing pro-humulin
abstract: The invention discloses a construction method and application of engineering escherichia coli for producing prelupurone, and the construction method comprises the following steps: transferring a pTrcHis2B-IDI plasmid and a pACYDuet-1-CCL2-VPS-PT1-linker-PT2 plasmid into a Trc-low competent cell, so as to obtain the engineering escherichia coli for producing the prelupurone. According to the invention, starting from an engineering strain existing in a laboratory, a metabolic engineering technology is utilized, and a key enzyme gene of a lupulone synthesis route is introduced into an engineering escherichia coli strain through a carrier, so that a fermentation strain for full-biosynthesis of lupulone is constructed; the method for synthesizing the pro-humulone is simple to operate, short in process and low in cost, gets rid of dependence on a humulus lupulus raw material, can realize large-scale production, is high in synthesis efficiency, avoids large consumption of a solvent, fully retains the biological activity of the pro-humulone, and is high in selectivity.
scores_por_categoria: Fermentation Process:1 | Strain & Metabolic Engineering:9 | Scale-up & Industrialization:5

titulo: Construction method and application of recombinant strain for producing glabridin
abstract: The invention discloses a construction method and application of a recombinant strain for producing glabridin, and belongs to the technical fields of synthetic biology, metabolic engineering, natural product biological manufacturing and engineering microorganism construction. The invention provides a method for constructing a glabridin recombinant strain by taking modular block construction as a core, which comprises the following steps: constructing a high-capacity isopentene donor platform, screening key enzymes, breaking through cyclization and five-membered ring opening, and realizing module-level integration by adopting yeast mating, thereby obtaining the recombinant strain capable of directly producing glabridin from glucose. The synthesis of the glabridin is realized in the saccharomyces cerevisiae, and an operable, amplifiable and extensible technical route is provided for the biological manufacturing of complex isopentene isoflavone natural products.

titulo: Prokaryotic multifunctional gene expression regulation tool based on engineered Cas13 and application of prokaryotic multifunctional gene expression regulation tool
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of gene engineering, and provides a prokaryotic multifunctional gene expression regulation and control tool based on engineering Cas13 and application of the prokaryotic multifunctional gene expression regulation and control tool. According to the invention, through a crRNA engineering design strategy, a continuous mismatched basic group is introduced at the 5'end of a guide sequence, so that modular switching of transcript degradation and translation inhibition functions on a single effect protein is realized; further, the atnCas13d is fused with a translation initiation factor IF3, so that the multifunctional effector protein integrating three functions of transcript degradation, translation inhibition and translation activation is constructed. The invention also provides a method for carrying out multiple and orthogonal gene expression regulation and control on prokaryotes (especially polycistron mRNA) by the system and application of the system in metabolic engineering, gene function screening or synthetic biology.

titulo: Construction method for synthesizing taxifolin from beginning through mixed bacteria culture and application of taxifolin
abstract: The invention discloses a construction method and application for synthesizing taxifolin from the beginning through mixed bacteria culture, and belongs to the field of synthetic biology and metabolic engineering. The invention provides a strain combination capable of being used for preparing the taxifolin through mixed fermentation. The strain combination comprises recombinant escherichia coli capable of synthesizing naringenin from the beginning and recombinant escherichia coli capable of converting the naringenin into the taxifolin. The strain combination is put in a culture medium with glucose as a substrate, and fermentation is performed at 25-37 DEG C for 10-72 hours after IPTG induction, so that de novo synthesis of the taxifolin can be realized. The invention provides a brand-new green and efficient taxifolin biosynthesis route through mixed bacteria synergistic regulation, can be applied to preparation of taxifolin and taxifolin-containing products, and has extremely high application value.

titulo: Hansenula polymorpha engineering bacterium for producing squalene and application of hansenula polymorpha engineering bacterium
abstract: The invention discloses hansenula polymorpha engineering bacteria for producing squalene and application of the hansenula polymorpha engineering bacteria, and belongs to the field of microbial metabolic engineering and biotechnology application. According to the application, hansenula polymorpha HR10 is taken as a host, a CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing technology is adopted, a squalene synthesis pathway is enhanced, a mevalonic acid pathway is used for inhibiting, supply of acetyl coenzyme A and NADPH is increased, the squalene synthesis pathway is introduced into peroxisome, supply of acetyl coenzyme A and NADPH in the peroxisome is enhanced, lipid droplets are expanded, and the squalene synthesis capability is improved; and constructing a squalene high-efficiency production strain. When a basic salt culture medium is used for fermentation, the yield in a shake flask reaches 976.3 mg/L, the yield in a 5L fermentation tank reaches 17.2 g/L, and a foundation is laid for subsequent low-cost synthesis of squalene.

titulo: Method for producing retinol palmitate based on enzyme mutation optimization approach
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of gene and metabolic engineering, and particularly relates to a method for producing retinol palmitate based on an enzyme mutation optimization approach, retinol palmitate is produced by fermenting genetic engineering modified saccharomyces cerevisiae, and a plasmid for transforming the genetic engineering modified saccharomyces cerevisiae is integrated with encoded beta-carotene-15, beta-carotene-15, beta-carotene-15, beta-carotene-15, beta-carotene-15, beta-carotene-15, the first gene is used for coding retinol dehydrogenase, the second gene is used for coding retinol acyltransferase, and the third gene is used for coding retinol acyltransferase; wherein the amino acid sequence of the beta-carotene-15, 15 '-dioxygenase has at least one mutation of N124G and F169W on the basis of SEQ ID NO.1, the amino acid sequence of the retinaldehyde dehydrogenase is as shown in SEQ ID NO.2, and the amino acid sequence of the retinol acyltransferase is as shown in SEQ ID NO.3. The yield of the retinol palmitate is further increased through an enzyme mutation optimization approach.

titulo: High-methanol-tolerance yeast chassis strain, high-yield 3-hydracrylic acid engineering bacteria and application
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of microbial metabolism engineering and synthetic biology technology application, and particularly relates to a high-methanol-tolerance yeast chassis strain, a high-yield 3-hydracrylic acid engineering bacterium and application. Wild pichia pastoris or fatty acid-producing pichia pastoris is used as an original strain, conditions are modified according to at least one of the following records (a)-(h), and the high-methanol-tolerance yeast chassis strain is obtained, specifically, (a) MIOX genes are knocked out, (b) MIOX genes are knocked out, (c) MIOX genes are knocked out, and (h) MIOX genes are knocked out; (b) knocking out the DMA2 gene; (c) knocking out the MET17 gene; (d) knocking out the BUB2 gene; (e) knocking out the CLB4 gene; (f) knocking out the UBP12 gene; (g) ZFP gene knockout; and (h) AOX1 gene mutation. And transforming by using a high-methanol-tolerance yeast chassis strain to obtain the high-yield 3-hydracrylic acid engineering bacterium. By combining rational and irrational metabolic engineering strategies, efficient biosynthesis of fatty acid and 3-hydracrylic acid with methanol as a unique carbon source is realized, and an important foundation is laid for low-carbon green biological manufacturing of chemicals.

applicante: BEIJING GREEN KANGCHENG BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD
titulo: Production method of decarboxylated carnosine
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of metabolic engineering and industrial microbial fermentation, and relates to a production method of decarboxylated carnosine. The production method comprises the following steps: inoculating recombinant microorganisms into a fermentation culture medium; carrying out first fermentation under a first dissolved oxygen content; under the condition that the obtained fermentation liquor reaches a preset OD600 value, adjusting the first dissolved oxygen content to a second dissolved oxygen content; performing second fermentation under a second dissolved oxygen amount to prepare the decarboxylated carnosine; the first dissolved oxygen content is 20%-40%; the second dissolved oxygen content is 3%-10%; adjusting the first dissolved oxygen amount to a second dissolved oxygen amount by adopting the following path: continuously reducing the first dissolved oxygen amount to the second dissolved oxygen amount within 2-6 hours; or, the dissolved oxygen amount is reduced once every 20-30 min, and the dissolved oxygen amount is reduced by 1%-2% each time; compared with an original strain, the recombinant microorganism has the advantages that the expression of the mdtK gene is enhanced, and the original strain is escherichia coli for producing decarboxylated carnosine. According to the application, the high yield of the decarboxylated carnosine can be achieved through a specific dissolved oxygen regulation means, and histamine accumulation is effectively avoided.

titulo: Escherichia coli genetically engineered bacterium for producing isoprene as well as construction method and application of escherichia coli genetically engineered bacterium
abstract: The invention discloses an Escherichia coli genetically engineered bacterium for producing isoprene as well as a construction method and application of the Escherichia coli genetically engineered bacterium, and belongs to the technical field of microorganisms and isoprene production. The research finds that the prp operon is an important metabolic engineering target which affects the isoprene synthesis capability of escherichia coli BL21 (DE3). On the basis, the Escherichia coli genetically engineered bacterium for producing the isoprene is provided, the yield of the isoprene of the Escherichia coli genetically engineered bacterium can be remarkably increased by modifying a prp operon, especially deleting at least one of prpR, prpB, prpC, prpD and prpE, and the yield can reach 1500 mg/L and is increased by about 5 times.

titulo: Method for analyzing gibberellin GA4 high-yield mechanism of gibberellin GA4 based on comparative transcriptomics
abstract: The invention discloses a method for analyzing a gibberellin GA4 high-yield mechanism of gibberellin GA4 based on comparative transcriptomics, and belongs to the field of industrial microorganisms. According to the method, a correlation model of specific genotype strain-standardized fermentation-sequential transcriptome analysis is constructed, and a dynamic regulation and control network of product synthesis is systematically analyzed through multi-time-point high-fidelity sampling and high-throughput sequencing in combination with differential expression analysis, time sequence clustering and weighted gene co-expression network analysis. The core of the method is that mass data are converged into a key target gene short list which is stably associated with high-yield characters, and the key target gene short list comprises rate-limiting enzymes, transporters and regulatory factors, so that rational design and strain improvement of metabolic engineering are guided. According to the invention, a set of standardized and iteratable systematic scheme is formed, and a clear molecular target and an efficient methodological tool are provided for breaking through the yield bottleneck of natural product fermentation.

titulo: SgWRKY50 gene, protein, expression vector, host cell and application of SgWRKY50 gene in regulating and controlling biosynthesis of mogroside V
abstract: The invention discloses an SgWRKY50 gene, a protein, an expression vector, a host cell and application of the SgWRKY50 gene in regulation and control of mogroside V biosynthesis, and belongs to the technical field of plant molecular biology and metabolic engineering. Aiming at the problems that the existing mogroside V is low in natural content, high in extraction cost, indefinite in biosynthesis upstream transcription regulation mechanism and lack of effective molecular breeding targets, the invention provides an SgWRKY50 gene from siraitia grosvenorii and an encoding protein thereof, a transcription factor is positioned in a cell nucleus, can be directly combined with W-box elements of SgSQE and SgCS promoters and activates transcription of the W-box elements, and a transcription factor of the SgWRKY50 gene is obtained. The SgVQ26 can interact with the gene and enhance the activation capability, and the accumulation of the mogroside V can be regulated and controlled by overexpressing or silencing the gene. The method can be applied to mogroside V content improvement, functional gene verification, molecular breeding and metabolic engineering, and important gene resources and technical support are provided for creation of high-mogroside V siraitia grosvenorii materials.

applicante: HANGZHOU BOHUI HESHENG TECH CO LTD
titulo: Glutamine high-yield microbial chassis bacterium and construction method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a glutamine high-yield microbial chassis bacterium and a construction method of the glutamine high-yield microbial chassis bacterium. The core of the system is that the system is obtained through metabolic engineering modification comprising one or more of the following modules: a nitrogen metabolism feedback inhibition removal module, a glutamine degradation blocking module, a bypass metabolism and reuptake reduction module and a global regulation and membrane permeability optimization module. According to the present invention, the synthesis, the accumulation and the supply ability of the host endogenous glutamine are systematically enhanced, the experiment results show that the extracellular glutamine accumulation amount of the constructed chassis bacterium (such as JM101-Gln) is significantly increased without adding L-glutamine, and the chassis bacterium can be used as the general type precursor enhancement platform so as to provide the new application prospects. The method is used for efficiently constructing engineering bacteria of a product (such as natural blue pigment Indigoidine) taking glutamine as a key precursor, so that the production cost of downstream products is remarkably reduced, and the stability of a fermentation process is improved.

applicante: ZHINUO FUTURE BIOTECHNOLOGY QINGDAO CO LTD
titulo: Engineering bacterium for high-yield production of sialic acid by using glucose in non-PTS way and construction method of engineering bacterium
abstract: The invention discloses recombinant escherichia coli for high yield of sialic acid by using glucose and a construction and application method of the recombinant escherichia coli, and belongs to the field of bioengineering and metabolic engineering. According to the invention, escherichia coli is taken as a host, and a genome is subjected to multiple modification through a CRISPR/Cas9 technology: firstly, key genes (ptsG and ptsHIcrr) of a phosphotransferase system (PTS) are knocked out to block PTS transport of glucose, so that a key precursor substance phosphoenolpyruvic acid (PEP) for synthesizing sialic acid is retained; secondly, by-products are knocked out to synthesize related genes (poxB, arcA and iclR), so that acetic acid accumulation is reduced, and metabolic flux is optimized; and finally, integrating a heterologous glucose transporter gene (galP) and a kinase gene (glk) at specific sites (ykgh, ybfc) of the genome to construct a non-PTS-dependent glucose utilization way. In addition, a complete synthesis system is constructed by introducing recombinant plasmids carrying sialic acid synthesis pathway genes (neuB, neuC and the like). The engineering bacterium disclosed by the invention can realize efficient synthesis of sialic acid by taking cheap glucose as a unique carbon source, effectively solves the contradiction between PEP consumption and carbon source cost in traditional fermentation, and has remarkable industrial application value.

titulo: Key polynucleotides for synthesizing genistein in klebsiella pneumoniae and application of key polynucleotides
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and discloses a group of key polynucleotides for synthesizing genistein in klebsiella pneumoniae and application of the key polynucleotides. The invention systematically identifies and provides a group of key polynucleotide sequences which are separated from klebsiella pneumoniae ATCC 43816 and are necessary for synthesizing genistein and encoded proteins of the key polynucleotide sequences for the first time, and reveals a genetic basis for synthesizing the previous unknown flavonoid in the strain; the technical blank that the biosynthesis path of the bacterium-derived flavonoid is lack of genetic evidence for a long time is filled. By constructing a rigorous and reliable functional verification system, the invention confirms the necessary effect of the identified and separated polynucleotide sequence in the synthesis of genistein, and defines the functional contribution of the polynucleotide sequence to the formation of a product. According to the achievement, a complete genetics evidence system for synthesizing genistein by bacteria is established for the first time, and a key target gene is provided for subsequent regulation, enhancement or reconstruction of the synthetic route through metabolic engineering.

titulo: Cationic lipid hybrid membrane vesicle for genetic transformation of diatom as well as preparation method and application of cationic lipid hybrid membrane vesicle
abstract: The invention discloses a cationic lipid hybrid membrane vesicle for genetic transformation of diatom and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of microbiology. Based on a natural membrane vesicle secreted by bacteria, the cationic lipid hybrid membrane vesicle is constructed through ultrasonic fusion with artificially synthesized cationic lipidosome; the exogenous plasmid DNA is efficiently loaded into the cavity of the cationic lipid hybrid membrane vesicle by using an electrotransfection method. The cationic lipid hybrid membrane vesicles loaded with exogenous plasmids are co-incubated with diatom cells, so that mild delivery and stable expression of exogenous genes across a diatom siliceous shell barrier are realized. By utilizing the function of transboundary delivery of nucleic acid of the bacterial membrane vesicles, the delivery efficiency of the bacterial membrane vesicles across the diatom biological barrier is improved through cationic lipid modification, and an efficient and mild novel genetic manipulation tool with biocompatibility is provided for gene function research, metabolic engineering modification and high-value compound production of diatom.

titulo: Bacillus licheniformis for enhanced expression of yobN gene and application of bacillus licheniformis in synthesis of poly gamma-PGA
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological genetic engineering, and discloses bacillus licheniformis for enhanced expression of a yobN gene and application of the bacillus licheniformis in synthesis of poly gamma-PGA. The bacillus licheniformis for enhanced expression of the yobN gene is obtained by introducing a recombinant expression vector into original bacillus licheniformis, the original bacillus licheniformis is bacillus licheniformis WX-02 (bacillus licheniformis WX-02), and the original bacillus licheniformis is bacillus licheniformis WX-02 (bacillus licheniformis WX-02); the yobN gene is derived from bacillus licheniformis WX-02, and the nucleotide sequence of the yobN gene is as shown in SEQ ID NO. 1. According to the invention, the recombinant expression vector carrying the yobN gene is constructed, and the recombinant expression vector is transferred into the bacillus licheniformis to promote the synthesis of the poly gamma-glutamic acid (gamma-PGA), so that a new metabolic engineering strategy is provided for improving the yield of the gamma-PGA. Compared with an empty vector control strain WX-02/pHY300-P43u12, the gamma-PGA yield of the recombinant bacillus licheniformis WX-02/pHY-yobN constructed by the invention is increased by 89.4%, and the gamma-PGA yield reaches 6.99 g/L. The recombinant bacillus licheniformis WX-02/pHY-yobN has the advantages that the recombinant bacillus licheniformis WX-02/

titulo: Yarrowia lipolytica engineering strain with high yield of astaxanthin as well as construction method and application of Yarrowia lipolytica engineering strain
abstract: The invention provides a yarrowia lipolytica engineering strain with high yield of astaxanthin as well as a construction method and application of the yarrowia lipolytica engineering strain. According to the present invention, by using the gene engineering means, the Yarrowia lipolytica is subjected to multi-target metabolic engineering modification, and the four gene clusters of McCarRP-McCarB, PnCrtW-linker-HpCrtZ, SpHMGR-DGA1 and ZWF1-GND1 are subjected to overexpression on the basis of the wild type Yarrowia lipolytica strain so as to finally obtain the engineering strain yyYLA004; the coding genes of the proteins are over-expressed in yarrowia lipolytica, so that the astaxanthin synthesis capability of cells can be directly improved, and the method has a large-scale production level and a good industrial application prospect.

applicante: SHENZHEN INST OF ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES
titulo: DNA fragment with TDH3 promoter activity and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a DNA fragment with TDH3 promoter activity and application of the DNA fragment. The nucleotide sequence of the DNA fragment with the TDH3 promoter activity is shown as any one of SEQ ID NO: 4-11. According to the invention, a group of DNA fragments with TDH3 promoter activity are screened from candida, the DNA fragments with TDH3 promoter activity are used in candida tropicalis, and a new universal element is provided for candida tropicalis metabolic engineering. The invention also provides a gradient intensity promoter combination stably expressed in candida tropicalis. The expression intensities of the promoters in the combination are different, the promoters are used for regulating and controlling the yield and metabolic flux of a target product in the candida tropicalis, and any one promoter sequence and the endogenous TDH3 promoter of the candida tropicalis can be expressed at the same time and have no homologous recombination risk.

applicante: DONGLIAN JIHAI GUANGDONG BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD
titulo: Genetic engineering bacillus subtilis for producing Shinorine as well as construction method and application of genetic engineering bacillus subtilis
abstract: The invention discloses genetic engineering bacillus subtilis for producing Shinorine as well as a construction method and application of the genetic engineering bacillus subtilis, and belongs to the technical field of microbial metabolic engineering and fermentation. According to the engineering bacterium, a food safety level host bacillus subtilis WB600 is taken as a starting bacterium, a competitive pathway gene ywjH is knocked out, a key gene cluster NpmysABC is synthesized by heterologous expression of Shinorine from nostoc punctiforme, and mysD from different sources is compared. On the basis, the promoter and the 5 '-untranslated region are systematically screened and optimized to finally obtain an optimal combination driven and expressed by the strong constitutive promoter Pveg and the efficient UTR4, so that the expression efficiency of pathway enzyme is remarkably improved. The Shinorine yield of the strain in shake flask fermentation reaches 0.85 g/L, and the tank loading yield reaches 5.32 g/L.

applicante: AIBIOUYI HANGZHOU BIOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD
titulo: Metabolic engineering six-dimensional strategy space modeling and collaborative optimization method
abstract: The invention provides a metabolic engineering six-dimensional strategy space modeling and collaborative optimization method, and relates to the technical field of biology. According to the method, a metabolic engineering problem is formally decomposed into six orthogonal transformation dimensions including heterologous synthesis pathway construction, competitive pathway reduction and flux redistribution, cofactor and precursor supply enhancement, product efflux and transport protein engineering, stress tolerance improvement and process engineering optimization, and candidate strategies are enumerated on each dimension by using a large language model; and evaluating a cooperation and conflict relationship between dimensions through a genome scale metabolism model (GEM) and an enzyme constraint model, and outputting a Pareto optimal strategy combination in combination with a hierarchical checkpoint man-machine interaction mechanism. Experiments prove that the strategy design efficiency is improved by 87.3% in the case of producing lactic acid by saccharomyces cerevisiae, and the strategy dimension coverage degree is improved from average 2.7 dimensions of manual design to 6-dimension full coverage.

titulo: Microorganism manufacturing and yield increasing method based on gene dynamic down-regulation algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a microorganism manufacturing and yield increasing method based on a gene dynamic down-regulation algorithm, relates to the technical field of crossing of synthetic biology, metabolic engineering and computational biology, and is used for rationally designing a high-yield and robust microorganism cell factory. The core of the method lies in that static gene knockout target prediction, transcriptional regulation element data information collection driven by a large language model and global metabolic correlation analysis based on a graph theory are combined, so that a whole-process rational design from who regulation to what is used is realized; and finally, outputting a strain modification scheme for converting gene knockout into gene down-regulation, so as to realize efficient coupling of cell growth and product synthesis.
termos_detectados: metabolic engineering, synthetic biology, gene knockout

titulo: Flexible pressure sensor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of a flexible pressure sensor, and belongs to the technical field of flexible electronic devices and materials. Comprising the following steps: (1) preparing a sacrificial layer by spin coating; (2) preparing a packaging layer and a bonding layer; (3) placing a lower mask and spin-coating a lower electrode; (4) spin-coating a piezoresistive layer, (5) removing the lower mask and spin-coating a dielectric layer, (6) placing an upper mask and spin-coating an upper electrode, (7) removing the upper mask and spin-coating a packaging layer, and (8) stripping a finished product. In-plane strain is limited in a non-sensing area through strain engineering, multi-sensor integration or a complex microstructure is not needed, and in-plane strain and out-plane pressure signals are effectively decoupled.

titulo: TECHNOLOGIES FOR STRAIN ENGINEERING IN GATE-ALL-AROUND TRANSISTORS
abstract: [0000]    Technologies for strain engineering in gate-all-around (GAA) field-effect transistors (FETs) are disclosed. In an illustrative embodiment, the source/drain contacts for N-type metal-oxide-semiconductor (NMOS) FETs extend deeper into the source/drain regions than the source/drain contacts for P-type metal-oxide-semiconductor (PMOS) FETs. The source/drain contacts for the NMOS FETs may cause a tensile strain in the channel of the NMOS FETs, while the source/drain region of the PMOS FETS may cause a compressive strain in the channel of the PMOS FETs. The tensile and compressive strains on the NMOS and PMOS channels, respectively, can increase the speed of the NMOS and PMOS transistors.

titulo: TRANSISTOR WITH 2D CHANNEL MATERIAL CLADDING GATE STACKS
abstract: In a transistor structure, a 2D channel material is formed after fabrication of a gate insulator and gate (electrode). In accordance with some exemplary “channel-material last” embodiments, a contact area between the 2D channel material and a source terminal and/or drain terminal is much larger than an edge or layer thickness of the 2D channel material, which may only be a few nanometers, for example. This larger contact area may significantly reduce external resistance of a transistor structure. Doping and strain engineering may also be more successfully applied to the “channel-material last” transistor structures disclosed herein, further boosting transistor performance.

applicante: XIAMEN JINGWEI PRECISION TECH CO LTD
titulo: Heteroepitaxial composite substrate with in-situ thermal-mechanical coupling inhibition characteristic and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a heteroepitaxial composite substrate with an in-situ thermal-mechanical coupling inhibition characteristic and a preparation method of the heteroepitaxial composite substrate. According to the substrate, a vapor phase epitaxy process is adopted on a monocrystalline silicon supporting substrate, and a stress release section, a component balance section and a prestress compensation section which are coherent in crystal lattices continuously grow on the monocrystalline silicon supporting substrate. The asymmetric strain field is constructed in situ in the single crystal lattice through the synergistic effect of the stepped decreasing germanium component and the pulse type fluctuation carbon component. In the preparation process, cyclic thermal annealing treatment is combined, so that deep pinning of penetrating dislocation and precise arrangement of a micro strain trap array are realized. The method not only solves the inherent lattice constant mismatch problem in heteroepitaxy, but also ensures that the top epitaxial layer has extremely high single crystal quality and structural integrity through in-situ strain engineering, and realizes dynamic balance of internal stress of a material system in a wide temperature range.

applicante: JIANGSU VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF INF TECH
titulo: Two-dimensional gallium nitride band gap regulation and control method based on strain engineering and application of two-dimensional gallium nitride band gap regulation and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a two-dimensional gallium nitride band gap regulation and control method based on strain engineering, and the method comprises the following steps: fixing a single-layer two-dimensional gallium nitride sample on a flexible substrate, guaranteeing that the sample is flat and free of wrinkles, applying uniaxial tensile strain to the single-layer two-dimensional gallium nitride in the direction of an armchair, only 0.10 low uniaxial tensile strain is applied in the armchair direction, so that the valence band top of the two-dimensional gallium nitride can be migrated to the gamma point from the K point of the Brillouin region, the valence band top and the conduction band bottom are located at the gamma point, conversion from an indirect band gap to a direct band gap is completed, and the two-dimensional gallium nitride can be applied to the armchair. Phonons do not need to participate in electron transition under a direct band gap structure, the energy loss is greatly reduced, the photoelectron transition efficiency is remarkably improved, the problem of low light emission efficiency caused by indirect band gaps of existing two-dimensional gallium nitride is fundamentally solved, and a foundation is laid for preparation of efficient ultraviolet electronic devices.

titulo: Semiconductor device and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductors, in particular to a semiconductor device and a preparation method thereof, and the semiconductor device comprises a first channel, a dielectric isolation layer and a second channel which are sequentially stacked; the dielectric isolation layer comprises a first stress layer, an isolation layer and a second stress layer which are stacked in sequence; the first stress layer is adjacent to the first channel. According to the semiconductor device, stress can be applied to the upper channel region and the lower channel region, and independent stress regulation and control can be carried out, so that collaborative optimization of carrier mobility can be realized, and the strain engineering problem in an advanced node strain silicon complementary field effect transistor device can be effectively solved.

applicante: GUANGXI VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF WATER RESOURCES AND ELECTRIC POWER
titulo: Preparation method and application of vibration device based on h-BN/GaN heterojunction piezoelectric sensor
abstract: The invention provides a preparation method and application of a piezoelectric sensor vibration device based on an h-BN/GaN heterojunction, and belongs to the technical field of piezoelectric sensors, a third-generation semiconductor material gallium nitride is used as a core material of a novel piezoelectric sensor, and the piezoelectric sensor vibration device based on the h-BN/GaN heterojunction is prepared by using piezoelectric characteristics determined by inherent asymmetry of a GaN wurtzite crystal structure. The problem of heat temperature failure caused by Curie temperature limitation of conventional piezoelectric materials such as piezoelectric ceramics is solved, and meanwhile, the technical problems that a traditional piezoelectric sensor is narrow in frequency response range, poor in temperature stability and slow in dynamic response are solved by utilizing the characteristics of high forbidden bandwidth, high electron mobility and high temperature resistance of GaN. On the basis of a GaN material, an h-BN/GaN heterostructure is constructed by means of hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN), the piezoelectric effect of a strain engineering and interface collaborative polarization enhancement device is utilized, the technical problem that the piezoelectric coefficient is low when GaN is singly used for preparing a piezoelectric sensor is solved, meanwhile, the two-dimensional structural characteristic of the h-BN is utilized, the flexible piezoelectric detector can be prepared in cooperation with the GaN, and the flexible piezoelectric sensor has the advantages of being simple in structure, low in cost and the like. And light-weight and thin-film device design is realized.

titulo: STRAIN ENGINEERING FOR COMPLEMENTARY FIELD-EFFECT TRANSISTOR DEVICES
abstract: A method of forming a semiconductor device includes: forming a layer stack over a fin by successively forming a dielectric material, a sacrificial material, a first semiconductor material, and a second semiconductor material over the fin; forming a dummy gate structure over the layer stack; forming source/drain regions on opposing sides of the dummy gate structure; forming an inter-layer dielectric layer over the source/drain regions around the dummy gate structure; removing the dummy gate structure to expose a first portion of the layer stack; after removing the dummy gate structure, selectively removing the sacrificial material in the first portion of the layer stack, where after the selectively removing, the first semiconductor material and the second semiconductor material in the first portion of the layer stack form a first channel layer and a second channel layer, respectively; and forming a replacement gate structure around the first and the second channel layers.

titulo: CHANNEL STRAIN ENGINEERING FOR SEMICONDUCTOR DEVICES
abstract: [0000]    A semiconductor structure according to the present disclosure includes an undoped semiconductor feature in a substrate, a first bottom nanostructure and a second bottom nanostructure over the substrate, a bottom epitaxial feature over the undoped semiconductor feature and between the first bottom nanostructure and the second bottom nanostructure, a first isolation layer over the first bottom nanostructure, a second isolation layer over the second nanostructure, a bottom contact etch stop layer (CESL) over the bottom epitaxial feature, a first top nanostructure over the first isolation layer, a second top nanostructure over the second isolation layer, a top epitaxial feature over the bottom CESL and extending between the first top nanostructure and the second top nanostructure, and a top CESL over the top epitaxial feature. A composition of the bottom CESL is different from a composition of the top CESL.

applicante: GUANGZHOU FIRST PEOPLES HOSPITAL GUANGZHOU DIGESTIVE DISEASE CENTER THE FIRST PEOPLES HOSPITAL AFFIL
titulo: Application of shewanella alginate in promoting colorectal adenoma ferroptosis
abstract: The invention discloses an application of shewanella algal in promoting colorectal adenoma ferroptosis, and relates to the technical field of biology, the shewanella algal is Shewanella algal, the preservation number of the strain is BNCC386875, and the strain is preserved in the Henan Province Industrial Microbial Strain Engineering Technology Research Center. According to the application disclosed by the invention, the Shewanella algal BNCC386875 is determined for the first time and can promote colorectal adenoma ferroptosis, the action mechanism of the strain in the occurrence and development of colorectal adenoma is determined by regulating and controlling ferroptosis related protein expression and mitochondrial morphological change, and a new microbiological target is provided for etiological research of colorectal adenoma.

titulo: Bacillus subtilis strain and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of microbial strain engineering, and relates to a bacillus subtilis strain and application thereof. The strain is preserved in the China General Microbiological Culture Collection Center on April 17, 2020, the preservation number is CGMCC NO.19582, and the preservation name of the strain is Agrowech2016. The invention further discloses a preparation method of the strain. Metabolite generated by fermentation of the strain contains enzyme systems such as chitin decomposition enzyme, cellulose decomposition enzyme, sugar decomposition enzyme and the like, and indoleacetic acid and small molecular amino acid for promoting root development. An enzyme system can decompose cell walls of fungi and cell membranes of bacteria, indoleacetic acid can quickly and effectively promote development of root systems, meanwhile, micromolecular amino acid can supplement nutrition for newborn root systems, harmful microorganisms in soil are reduced, development of the root systems is achieved, the growth vigor of trees is improved, and finally the purpose that the trees become strong from weak is achieved. And rejuvenating weak trees.

titulo: KONTROLLE VON VERSPANNUNGEN UNTER VERWENDUNG VON GATESCHNITTEN
abstract: [0001]    Techniques are provided herein to form semiconductor devices that include one or more gate cuts having materials that impose either a compressive or tensile stress on the adjacent semiconductor devices to improve performance. A semiconductor device includes a gate structure around or otherwise on a semiconductor region. The gate structure may be interrupted, for example, between two transistors with a gate cut that extends through an entire thickness of the gate structure and includes dielectric material to electrically isolate the portions of the gate structure on either side of the gate cut. The gate cut is confined within the gate trench. A first gate cut is arranged between adjacent NMOS devices and includes a dielectric material that imposes a tensile stress on the NMOS devices, and a second gate cut is arranged between adjacent PMOS devices and includes a dielectric material that imposes a compressive stress on the PMOS devices.

titulo: Bismuth-based nanosheet catalyst based on strain engineering as well as preparation method and application of bismuth-based nanosheet catalyst
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy materials, in particular to a strain-engineering-based bismuth-based nanosheet catalyst and a preparation method and application thereof.The preparation method comprises the steps that bismuth oxide is subjected to ball milling treatment, washed and dried, and bismuth oxide powder which is uniform in size and has tensile strain is obtained; the preparation method comprises the following steps: stirring and mixing bismuth oxide powder and a potassium salt aqueous solution, carrying out carbonization reconstruction, carrying out centrifugation to collect a precipitate, and carrying out washing and freeze drying to obtain the bismuth-based nanosheet catalyst with the strain effect. Strain is successfully introduced into the bismuth-based nanostructure through a simple mechanical ball milling treatment and carbonization reconstruction method, and no impurity atom is doped; the bismuth-based nanosheet catalyst prepared by the method has excellent performance in the aspect of generating formate ions through reduction reaction of carbon dioxide, and has excellent durability. In a solid electrolyte reactor, CO2 can be effectively converted into pure HCOOH by the catalyst under the current density of 100mAcm <-2 >, and formic acid solutions with different concentrations can be continuously generated.

titulo: SOI GAA device using bulk silicon substrate and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an SOI GAA device using a bulk silicon substrate and a preparation method of the SOI GAA device. The preparation method of the substrate comprises the following steps: epitaxially growing a laminated structure of a first sacrificial layer/a second sacrificial layer/a first sacrificial layer/a silicon layer on the silicon substrate; depositing a hard mask on the laminated structure; photoetching and etching are carried out to form a Fin structure; partially corroding the first sacrificial layer by adopting a wet etching mode, and reserving the first sacrificial layer left after corrosion; and oxidizing the first sacrificial layer left after corrosion to form a buried oxide layer, and removing the hard mask to form a strain SOI substrate structure with double buried oxide layers. The SOI GAA device is prepared on the common bulk silicon substrate, the double buried oxide layers are arranged in the SOI substrate, the Si < 1-x > Ge < x > layer is clamped in the double buried oxide layers, stress is introduced into a channel from the buried oxide layers, stress can be provided for the device, cost is greatly saved, the SOI GAA device has the advantages of SOI low power consumption and strain engineering, and the mobility of the device is improved.

titulo: METHOD FOR MODIFYING A HIGH-YIELD L-LYSINE-PRODUCING STRAIN ENGINEERING AND APPLICATION THEREOF
abstract: [0000]    The present disclosure relates to the field of biotechnology, and in particular to method for modifying a high-yield L-lysine-producing strain engineering and application thereof. The present disclosure provides a recombinant strain obtained by knocking out the cbrB gene and/or the cbrC gene in the genome of E. coli. Fermentation of the recombinant strain can increase the yield and conversion rate of L-lysine and reduce the mortality rate of the strain during the fermentation process. The present disclosure has significant application value. Through experimental studies, it was found that these two genes have a synergistic effect on E. coli. L-lysine hydrochloride imposes osmotic stress resistance on the strains, and silencing the related gene proteins can alter the membrane lipid composition (increasing a proportion of unsaturated fatty acids), maintain membrane fluidity, improve tolerance to lysine hydrochloride, and reduce the mortality rate in the late stage of fermentation.
termos_detectados: fermentation, fermentation process, strain engineering, recombinant

titulo: Preparation and application of photocatalyst for regulating CsPbBr3 electronic structure based on strain engineering
abstract: The invention discloses preparation and application of a photocatalyst for regulating and controlling a CsPbBr3 electronic structure based on strain engineering.The preparation method comprises the following steps that a series of CsPb1-xCuxBr3 (x = 0, 0.05, 0.1 or 0.2) quantum dots are synthesized through a thermal injection method, due to the structural characteristics of ionic bonds, soft lattices and the like of CsPbBr3, precise lattice compression strain can be achieved through Pb-site equivalent cation substitution, and the CsPbBr3 electronic structure is obtained; specifically, the electronic energy band structure of CsPb0. 9Cu0. 1Br3 is changed by regulating and controlling the distortion of the [PbBr6] 4-octahedron, so that the separation of photon-generated carriers is effectively promoted; due to the introduction of the strain, the central position of a d band of Pb in CsPb0. 9Cu0. 1Br3 is closer to the Fermi level, so that the adsorption strength of CO2 and the desorption process of a key reaction intermediate are enhanced. The research reveals an influence mechanism of strain engineering on photocatalytic CO2 reduction reaction, provides theoretical guidance for designing high-performance photocatalytic materials, and has potential application prospects.

titulo: Gradient phononic crystal resonator based on two-dimensional material
abstract: The invention discloses a gradient phononic crystal resonator based on a two-dimensional material. The gradient phononic crystal resonator comprises a substrate and a gradient phononic crystal beam made of the two-dimensional material, the gradient phononic crystal beam comprises a fixed area in contact with the substrate and a suspension area not in contact with the substrate, the suspension area comprises bilaterally symmetrical forbidden band phononic crystals and a middle phononic crystal defect, each forbidden band phononic crystal is composed of a plurality of unit primitive cells, and each unit primitive cell is composed of a plurality of unit primitive cells. And the width of each unit primitive cell is gradually reduced from the two ends to the middle defect area so as to realize co-positioning of stress and a displacement field. According to the scheme of the gradient phononic crystal resonator based on the two-dimensional material, the problem that due to the positive correlation of mechanical wave loss and frequency, the ultrahigh quality factor and the resonance frequency of a mechanical resonator are generally difficult to obtain at the same time is solved, and soft clamping and strain engineering technologies are applied to the phononic crystal based on the two-dimensional material; and the ultra-high quality factor mechanical resonator of GHz or even higher frequency band is realized.

titulo: Method for in-situ characterization of local strain by using photoelectric measurement
abstract: The invention relates to the field of two-dimensional semiconductor detection, in particular to a method for in-situ characterization of local strain by photoelectric measurement, and aims to solve the problems that in-situ accurate characterization means for local strain are deficient, and local strain cannot be measured in an in-situ refined and quantitative manner. Compared with a traditional piezoelectric force microscope and an electrical measurement technology, a photocurrent imaging technology is adopted, so that a measurable system can be enriched, measurement materials are not limited to a traditional ferroelectric system any more, the localized strain engineering effect can be represented, the strain engineering test can be finer, and the measurement accuracy is improved. Compared with the prior art, the method is more effective in understanding a local strain regulation and control mechanism and testing strain engineering effects, and meanwhile, the photocurrent test generally applies zero bias voltage to a device, and the used exciting light power is lower, so that the sample is not easy to damage, and the method is more lossless compared with a piezoelectric force microscope or electrical measurement.

applicante: IMAM MOHAMMAD IBN SAUD ISLAMIC UNIV [SA]
titulo: P-GaN high electron mobility transistor (HEMT) with MOS2-based 2D barrier
abstract: A bandgap tuneable p-GaN high electron mobility transistor (HEMT) having a structure stacked on a silicon carbide substrate. The device incorporates an indium nitride nucleation layer, followed by an aluminum nitride nucleation layer, and a first aluminum gallium nitride buffer layer. A gallium nitride channel layer is deposited on this stack, with an aluminum source and a drain contact at either end. The bandgap tuneable p-GaN HEMT includes a two-dimensional molybdenum disulfide layer over the channel, covered by a second AlGaN buffer layer. A p-type gallium nitride cap layer and a platinum gate contact complete the structure. This configuration facilitates bandgap tuning and strain engineering, enhancing electron mobility and density in the two-dimensional electron gas region, making it suitable for high-power and high-frequency applications.

titulo: Preparation method and application of blue light regulated escherichia coli
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological engineering, and discloses a preparation method and application of Escherichia coli regulated by blue light, and the preparation method comprises the steps of blue light response element construction, strain engineering transformation, fermentation system design, culture condition optimization and product purification work.The blue light response element construction comprises the steps that a, a core light sensing assembly is selected; b, designing and synthesizing an EL222 coding sequence, c, constructing and synthesizing a promoter, and d, optimizing an EL222 binding site; the engineering modification of the strain comprises the following steps: a, integrating a photosensitive promoter and a target gene, and b, optimizing the expression level of EL222 protein. According to the invention, directional regulation and control of metabolic pathways can be realized at a subcellular level through the blue light response element, and through accurate control of illumination intensity and time, metabolic flux can be dynamically adjusted according to requirements, accumulation of metabolic intermediates is reduced, cytotoxicity is reduced, purity of a target product is improved, and the method is suitable for industrial production. The yield and the quality of a target product are improved through precise space-time regulation and control on escherichia coli metabolism.

titulo: INGÉNIERIE DE CONTRAINTE DE COUCHES DE MEMBRANE DANS DES HÉTÉROSTRUCTURES
abstract: Provided are methods of generating strain in membrane layers, including diamond membrane layers, in heterostructures. titulo: Preparation method and application of seawater electrolysis catalyst based on strain engineering
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of strain engineering materials, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a Mo-doped Fe2O3 HER electrocatalyst and application of the Mo-doped Fe2O3 HER electrocatalyst in large-current seawater electrolysis. The preparation method comprises the following steps: growing Fe2O3 on a self-supporting material through molten salt, soaking (NH4) 6Mo7O24. 4H2O, and calcining to obtain the final Mo-doped Fe2O3 electrocatalyst (2%-Mo-Fe2O3). Under the condition that an anion exchange membrane electrolyzes seawater (electrolyte: 1M KOH seawater, and temperature: 60 DEG C), the current density of 1A/cm < 2 > can be reached only by a working voltage of 2V, and stable operation can be performed for 100 hours under the condition of industrial seawater. Compared with a traditional method for preparing a bifunctional electrocatalyst, the method has the advantages that the problem of slow dynamics in the process of electrolyzing alkaline seawater is solved by utilizing strain engineering, and the catalytic stability can be kept under the condition of high current density while efficient catalysis is ensured; the work provides a strategy for applying strain engineering to preparation of a catalyst for seawater hydrogen production.

applicante: WUHAN RES INSTITUTE OF POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS
titulo: Electrooptical modulator based on high Curie temperature barium titanate film and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an electro-optical modulator based on a high Curie temperature barium titanate film and a preparation method thereof, a barium titanate optical waveguide layer is arranged on a substrate, and the barium titanate optical waveguide layer is provided with a ridge part; titanium dioxide crystals are doped in the barium titanate optical waveguide layer; the electrodes are arranged on the barium titanate optical waveguide layer, and the electrodes are arranged on the two sides of the ridge part; and the upper cladding covers the barium titanate optical waveguide layer and the electrode. Film strain engineering and the phase change principle of barium titanate at high temperature are combined, certain chemical or mechanical stress is provided between different crystals, the titanium dioxide crystal doped barium titanate film is adopted as the waveguide layer of the modulator, and the modulator has a relatively large use temperature range, so that the modulator can work at high temperature. According to the titanium dioxide doped barium titanate crystal film and the preparation method thereof, the titanium dioxide doped barium titanate crystal film can ensure that oxygen vacancies appear as few as possible during crystal crystallization by utilizing the characteristics of the similar crystal structures of the titanium dioxide crystal and barium titanate, so that the film defects are reduced, and the film quality can be further ensured.

titulo: Engineered microorganism and method for biosynthesizing liquid rubber using same

applicante: NATIONAL YANG MING CHIAO TUNG UNIV [TW]

titulo: PROCÉDÉ DE CONVERSION DE FARNÉSYL PYROPHOSPHATE SYNTHASE EN GÉRANYL PYROPHOSPHATE SYNTHASE

The engineered enzyme may include a first peptide (such as a linker peptide) fused to a C-terminus of a farnesyl pyrophosphate synthase. Optionally, a second peptide (such as a Myc-tag or a HA-tag) be fused to the first peptide. The method may include exposing the engineered microorganism to a carbon source (such a glucose). The method may include allowing the engineered microorganism to generate (i) a first product from the mevalonate pathway and (ii) the engineered enzyme. The method may include forming a monoterpene by allowing the first product and the engineered enzyme to interact.

titulo: Production of methionine by condensation of C1-derived formyl-coA with 3-hydroxypropionaldehyde derived from multiple substrates

The present invention also provides a genetically engineered microorganism for the production of liquid methionine or methionine.

titulo: Engineered bacteria for improving soil quality

The invention also provides a method of producing the genetically engineered microorganism. Methods of improving soil quality are also described.

titulo: Production of DL-pantoic acid and DL-pantolactone by condensation of hydroxypivalaldehyde and C1-sourced formyl-coenzyme A

The invention relates to a method for preparing 2, 4-dimethyl oxacyclopentane-2-one. The present invention also provides a genetically engineered microorganism for use in the production of DL-2, 4-dihydroxy-3, 3-dimethylbutyric acid and/or DL-3-hydroxy-4, 4-dimethyl oxacyclopentane-2-one, and also provides a genetically engineered microorganism for use in the production of DL-3-hydroxy-4, 4-dimethyl oxacyclopentane-2-one. In addition, the key enzyme has been engineered to improve its performance in the production of DL-pantoic acid or DL-pantolactone.

titulo: Production of methionine by condensation of 3-methylthiopropionaldehyde with C1-sourced formyl-coA
abstract: The invention provides a method for producing liquid methionine or methionine, and particularly provides a method for producing liquid methionine or methionine through condensation reaction of 3-methylthiopropionaldehyde and formyl coenzyme A derived from a C1 substrate. The present invention also provides a genetically engineered microorganism for the production of liquid methionine or methionine. Furthermore, the key enzyme has been engineered to improve its performance in liquid methionine or methionine production.

titulo: MICRO-ORGANISMES GÉNÉTIQUEMENT MODIFIÉS POUR LA DÉTECTION DE CELLULES MALADES
abstract: Methods of using genetically engineered microorganisms for detecting and/or treating diseases are provided. In some embodiments, a method includes administering a genetically engineered microorganism to a subject. The genetically engineered microorganism can deliver a payload gene specifically to a target cell in the subject. The payload gene can encode at least one gene product that has a first form when expressed by the target cell and a second form when expressed by the genetically engineered microorganism, the second form being different from the first form. The method can further include collecting a biological sample from the subject, and detecting whether the first form of the at least one gene product is present in the biological sample.

applicante: BEIJING WEIGOU GONGCHANG BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD
titulo: Engineered microorganism and application thereof in production of microbial cells or metabolites
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganisms, in particular to an engineered microorganism and application thereof in production of microbial cells or metabolites. The invention provides application of expression quantity of homoserine lactone synthetase gene hdtS and/or activity reduction of encoded protein thereof in improvement of biomass of microorganisms and/or production performance of metabolites. The invention finds that the reduction of the expression quantity of the homoserine lactone synthase gene hdtS and/or the activity of the encoded protein can relieve the growth limitation of thalli and prolong the growth period of the thalli, the fermentation biomass is remarkably improved, and the yield of growth-coupled metabolites such as PHA is also remarkably improved. The biomass and PHA yield of the engineered microorganism provided by the invention are obviously improved, and an effective modification strategy and method are provided for breeding of PHA producing bacteria.

titulo: Triterpene cyclase and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a triterpenoid cyclase, a nucleic acid molecule for coding the triterpenoid cyclase, an expression vector containing the nucleic acid molecule, an engineered microorganism containing the corresponding vector, and application of the triterpenoid cyclase in production of ailanthus type 6-6-5-ring triterpenes. Site-specific mutagenesis is carried out on the basis of the triterpenoid cyclase, and the obtained mutated triterpenoid cyclase can generate triterpenoid analogues with various structures and biological activity.

titulo: MICRO-ORGANISME MODIFIÉ POUR CATALYSER LA SYNTHÈSE DE SULFATE DE CHOLESTÉROL ET UTILISATION ASSOCIÉE
abstract: An engineered microorganism for converting redundant cholesterol to produce beneficial small molecule cholesterol sulfate in a human intestinal tract and use thereof. The engineered microorganism comprises a combination of a sulfotransferase, a PAPS synthesis pathway, an inorganic pyrophosphatase, a polyphosphate kinase, and a cholesterol transport protein cluster. The amino acid sequence of the protein comprises any one of or a combination of at least two of the sequences set forth in SEQ ID NO: 1 to SEQ ID NO: 23. The sulfotransferase capable of efficiently catalyzing the production of cholesterol sulfate from cholesterol is obtained by means of screening, the PAPS synthesis pathway, the PAPS enhancement pathway, and the cholesterol transport protein cluster are introduced, and the engineered bacterial strain is obtained by means of laboratory directed evolution. The engineered bacterial strain is applied to the degradation of excess cholesterol in the body while generating small molecules beneficial to the body.

titulo: SÉQUENCE NUCLÉOTIDIQUE DE FLAVIVIRUS MODIFIÉE, UTILISATION DE LA SÉQUENCE NUCLÉOTIDIQUE, AGENT THÉRAPEUTIQUE, UTILISATION D'UN VIRUS ONCOLYTIQUE, VECTEUR VIRAL, PROCÉDÉ D'OBTENTION ET MÉTHODE DE TRAITEMENT
abstract: The present invention relates to the fields of synthetic biology, molecular biology, biotechnology, nanotechnology, pharmacology, vaccinology, medicine, virology and oncology. More specifically, the invention provides a modified flavivirus nucleotide sequence, a therapeutic agent, a viral vector and a process for obtaining same, and a method of treatment using said sequence, agent or vector. The invention is associated with the "iOZ platform", which harnesses the potential of the viral genome of flaviviruses – in particular the African strain of the Zika virus (ZIKV) – to provide advanced therapeutic approaches, whilst also providing targeted and effective treatments for complex diseases, including the treatment of malignant tumours and other types. In one embodiment, the therapeutic agent of the invention is a viral vector for gene therapy. In one embodiment, the therapeutic agent of the invention is a non-natural RNA sequence, suitable for use in vaccines and/or gene therapy. One embodiment of the therapeutic method of the invention is oncolytic therapy. Another embodiment of the therapeutic method of the invention is gene therapy based on use of the modified virus, the viral vector or the modified RNA of the invention.

titulo: Method for synthesizing biologically modified monascus to produce lovastatin with high yield
abstract: The invention discloses a method for producing lovastatin with high yield by modifying monascus through synthetic biology, and belongs to the technical field of microbial synthetic biology and fermentation engineering. Aiming at the problems that wild monascus lovastatin is low in yield, accompanied with citrinin toxin, long in fermentation period and not in accordance with green production, a synthetic biological strategy is adopted, citrinin synthesis key regulatory genes ctnr are knocked out, lovastatin synthesis key genes mokE and mokC are over-expressed, a precursor synthesis key gene acc is over-expressed, and a multi-gene synergistic modification engineering strain is constructed; agricultural waste tea residue powder is adopted for compounding a green culture medium and an optimized fermentation process. According to the present invention, the lovastatin synthesis flux can be significantly improved, the citrinin generation can be completely blocked, the fermentation period can be substantially shortened, and the engineering strain has characteristics of good genetic stability, environmental protection and safety, and is suitable for industrial green prevention and control and large-scale production application.

titulo: Multi-enzyme system for synthesizing chrysanthol or chrysanthemic acid, recombinant strain and application of multi-enzyme system
