The multi-enzyme system comprises an isopentenyl kinase, an isopentenyl phosphokinase, a chrysanthemyl diphosphate synthase, a Nudix hydrolase, an inulin dehydrogenase and an inulin dehydrogenase. By screening the high-activity enzyme and optimizing the ratio of the high-activity enzyme, the yield of chrysanthol reaches 1.2 mg/L, and the yield of chrysanthemic acid reaches 30.7 mg/L. The invention also constructs a recombinant strain for co-expressing six enzymes, and the yield of catalytic chrysanthemic acid reaches 9.5 mg/L. According to the method, an isopentenol utilization way is applied to in-vitro synthesis of irregular monoterpenoid chrysanthol and chrysanthemic acid for the first time, the product is of a highly single (1R, 3R) configuration, the method has the advantages of being green, efficient, controllable in reaction condition, few in by-product and the like, and a new technical way is provided for biological manufacturing of pyrethrin.

titulo: ENSEMBLE MULTIPLEXÉ SANS CICATRICE DE SÉQUENCES D'ADN
abstract: Provided herein are comprehensive, high-throughput, and cost-effective methods, systems, and compositions, for multiplexed long-fragment DNA synthesis using scar-less assembly of DNA sequences. The disclosed methods streamline the entire workflow, from computational sequence segmentation to experimental assembly, enabling the efficient synthesis of thousands of DNA constructs. By achieving high recall rates and accuracy through optimized assembly protocols, the disclosed methods, systems, and compositions have the potential to accelerate synthetic biology applications such as protein design, enzyme engineering, synthetic genomics, and gene therapy.

titulo: Engineering synbiotics microcapsule as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of synthetic biology, and particularly relates to an engineering synbiotic microcapsule as well as a preparation method and application thereof. Specifically, engineered Escherichia coli is transformed into a safe whole-cell biocatalyst with hypoxia responsiveness, and the whole-cell biocatalyst is used for targeted secretion of inulase. Meanwhile, a multi-stage W/O/W double emulsion gelation method is adopted, and firm ES-CG-W/O/W emulsion gel is constructed, so that the probiotics and the inulin are co-embedded in a uniform microstructure, effective embedding and integration of the synbiotics components are successfully realized, and therefore, the method has a good practical application value.

applicante: KUNSHAN ASIA AROMA PERFUME CO LTD
titulo: High-activity ambergris synthetic epoxidase mutant, and coding gene, recombinant vector, engineering bacterium and application of high-activity ambergris synthetic epoxidase mutant
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of synthetic biology, enzyme engineering and biological catalysis, and discloses a high-activity ambergris synthesis epoxidase mutant, and a coding gene, a recombinant vector, an engineering bacterium and application thereof, and the mutant is based on an amino acid sequence of parent epoxidase. Through system codon optimization and multiple rounds of screening, 13 epoxy enzyme amino acid sequences SEQ-ID-NO: 1-SEQ-ID-NO: 13 from different sources are optimized to obtain nucleotide sequences SEQ-ID-NO: 14-SEQ-ID-NO: 26 after corresponding codon optimization, and finally, an ambergris synthesized epoxy enzyme No.5 parent enzyme with efficient soluble expression in escherichia coli, namely SEQ-ID-NO: 5, is obtained. The shake flask expression level is up to 51.37 mg/L, and the industrial pain points that inclusion bodies are easily formed by heterologous expression of the enzyme and the soluble expression level is low are solved.

titulo: Saccharomyces cerevisiae strain as well as construction method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of synthetic biology and genetic engineering, and particularly relates to a saccharomyces cerevisiae strain as well as a construction method and application thereof. The strain is Saccharomyces cerevisiae WZ 214, and is preserved in the China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCC), the preservation number is CCTCC NO: M20251331, and the preservation date is June 10, 2025. Beta-NMN synthesis key enzyme genes (Nampt and PRPS) and yeast surface anchoring protein genes are fused to construct a fusion gene, and after original saccharomyces cerevisiae is converted, a recombinant strain of which the surface displays a key enzyme is obtained; and the FYV5 gene of the recombinant strain is knocked out to optimize the cell wall structure and reduce the secretion resistance of the product. According to the method, the problems of intracellular product accumulation, high separation difficulty and low production efficiency in the prior art are effectively solved, and a new technical support is provided for efficient and green production of beta-NMN.

titulo: Enzyme composition containing P450 enzyme and application of enzyme composition in steroid production
abstract: The invention discloses amino acid sequences and coding sequences of sterol side chain cutting enzymes and 3 beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase/4, 5 isomerase from different sources and application of the amino acid sequences and the coding sequences of the sterol side chain cutting enzymes and the 3 beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase/4, 5 isomerase. According to the invention, based on the theoretical basis of synthetic biology and molecular biomedicine, sterol side chain cutting enzyme and 3 beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase/4, 5 isomerase from different plants are excavated, and coding sequences of the obtained sterol side chain cutting enzyme and 3 beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase/4, 5 isomerase are respectively constructed into expression cassettes; according to the present invention, the efficient pregnenolone or progesterone synthesis strain is obtained by using the saccharomyces cerevisiae as the chassis strain, the yield of pregnenolone in the constructed strain is up to 14.46 +/-2.16 mg/L, and the yield of progesterone is up to 32.78 +/-1.84 mg/L, such that the high-level synthesis of pregnenolone and progesterone by using the gene engineering method is achieved, and the important basis is provided for the green synthesis of steroid hormones.

titulo: Virtual gene knockout system and method based on fusion of FBA and ML
abstract: The invention relates to the field of bioinformatics and computational biology, in particular to a virtual gene knockout system and method based on fusion of FBA and ML. The virtual gene knockout system is composed of an FBA knockout module, an ML knockout module, a consensus scoring module, an iterative learning module and an evaluation report module. Results of the FBA method and the ML method are integrated, advantage complementation of the two methods is achieved, a reliable result verification and conflict resolution mechanism is established, continuous accumulation and iterative updating of knowledge are achieved, and the method has important application in drug target screening, drug resistance mechanism research, virulence factor analysis and synthetic biology.

titulo: EXTRACTION ET STRUCTURATION D'INFORMATIONS DE VULNÉRABILITÉ À PARTIR DE DIVERSES SOURCES DE DONNÉES
abstract: A computer-implemented method and system for transforming unstructured cybersecurity advisories from diverse sources into schema-compliant machine-readable documents is provided. Aspects include receiving an unstructured cybersecurity advisory and transmitting, to a trained large language model, the unstructured cybersecurity advisory along with a corresponding prompt. The trained large language model has been fine-tuned on paired training data including unstructured cybersecurity advisories from multiple formats and corresponding machine-readable documents formatted according to a predefined cybersecurity advisory schema. Aspects also include receiving, from the trained large language model, structured vulnerability data corresponding to the unstructured cybersecurity advisory, the structured vulnerability data formatted according to the predefined cybersecurity advisory schema and outputting the structured vulnerability data as a unified machine-readable advisory file for downstream processing.

titulo: Continuous subsea multi-camera pose verification and calibration lifecycle management
abstract: Computer-implemented methods and subsea systems automatically determine and verify inter-camera pose relationships for multi-camera subsea rigs without relying on scene-based features. Dedicated pose-observation channels actively observe adjacent imaging sensors or shared reference targets bearing pressure-stable fiducial markers. Inter-camera pose estimates are computed via marker detection, assembled into a spatial configuration representation, and scored on a normalised confidence-metric scale. Verified poses are stored as versioned entries in a calibration state store and output to a 3D/4D Gaussian Splatting scene reconstruction pipeline. Concurrently, a lifecycle management layer evaluates confidence against environment-compensated drift models. If automated pose calculation degrades due to turbidity and fails to recover within a recalibration window, degraded sensors are functionally excluded from downstream processing via data-path isolation or sub-threshold operational weighting. A continuity placeholder is substituted and explicit uncertainty bounds are propagated to protect reconstruction integrity. [Fig. 1]

titulo: Dynamic supervision method and system for solid waste treatment

And then constructing an exchangeability criterion, dividing candidate exchange pairs, calculating an exchange matching degree, carrying out scanning exchange and position rearrangement on a material queue according to the exchangeability criterion and the candidate exchange pairs, and sequentially releasing the rearranged materials to a downstream processing unit so as to realize full-process operation control management of the industrial solid wastes. The technical problems that in the whole industrial solid waste treatment process, operation stability is poor, unit connection is unbalanced, load management and control precision is insufficient, and efficient and stable operation is difficult to achieve are solved, and the technical effects that process loads are accurately matched, queues are optimally arranged, and the operation stability of the whole process and the overall treatment efficiency are improved are achieved.

titulo: EFFICIENT VISION TRANSFORMER ARCHITECTURE WITH OPTIMIZED TOKEN PROCESSING
abstract: [0000]    A vision transformer architecture processes images while improving hardware utilization through selective token handling. Described architectures receives input images, generates image tokens, and processes the tokens through transformer layers without requiring a classification token. The adapter layer integrates with existing model weights and can merge with downstream processing layers. This approach addresses computational inefficiencies in vision transformer models when used primarily as encoders rather than classifiers. Implementations can be utilized in vision-language models for autonomous driving, mobile applications, and data center operations where processing efficiency impacts system performance.

According to the utility model, the automatic standing of the flexible plate sample and the automatic connection of upstream and downstream processing procedures can be realized, the processing efficiency is higher, and the processing quality of the flexible plate sample can be better ensured.

A medical data governance (MDG) engine ingests heterogeneous patient-related data from clinical systems, medical devices, and clinician inputs, validates and normalizes the data under governance rules, and emits structured, context-constrained representations for identified patients and episodes. One or more intermediary components collect and relay real-time device data so downstream processing operates only on governed data. A reasoning layer with artificial-intelligence models, including at least one large language model, cooperates with modular AI components to process clinician queries and generate candidate clinical outputs. A cryptographic governance subsystem evaluates candidate outputs against patient-safety rules, regulatory mandates, institution-specific policies, and stored consent artefacts using machine-verifiable constraints, enforces dual-factor clinician authentication, and maintains immutable, hash-chained audit trails with trusted timestamps that gate workflow progression. The system enables defensible use of AI-assisted clinical insights across hospital, clinic, and virtual-care environments.

The functional nano pre-dispersed slurry for the fertilizer and the preparation method of the functional nano pre-dispersed slurry have the advantages of excellent stability, function integration and synergism, extremely high downstream processing adaptability, standardization and traceability.

titulo: Sludge treatment system
abstract: The invention provides a sludge treatment system, and relates to the technical field of sludge treatment, the system comprises: N preorder treatment units connected in parallel, each preorder treatment unit comprises a sludge concentration tank, a sludge lift pump and a centrifugal dehydrator which are connected in sequence, a first liquid level sensor is arranged on the sludge concentration tank, and a second liquid level sensor is arranged on the sludge lift pump; the dosing pump is connected with the medicine box, the second liquid level sensor is arranged on the medicine box, and the dosing pump is further connected with the centrifugal dehydrator; the downstream treatment unit is respectively connected with the N preorder treatment units and comprises a scraper conveyer and a sludge storage bin which are connected in sequence, and a third liquid level sensor arranged on the sludge storage bin; and the controller is used for receiving the liquid level signal and/or the equipment state signal, generating a target control instruction according to the liquid level signal and/or the equipment state signal, and controlling the target preorder processing unit and/or the downstream processing unit to execute the target control instruction according to the target control instruction.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ DE RÉCUPÉRATION DE PRODUIT D'OCCASION
abstract: This used product recovery method includes: a usage status evaluation step (S10) for estimating a usage status related to use of a used product, which is a used lighting fixture; an economic value determination step (S12) for determining the economic value of the used product on the basis of the usage status estimated in the usage status evaluation step; a transaction price determination step (S14) for determining a transaction price for the used product on the basis of the economic value; and a product acceptance step (S16) for accepting the used product in exchange for payment of a fee or granting of points corresponding to the transaction price.

titulo: Natural gas pyrolysis reactor and product recovery method
abstract: 본 발명은 천연가스 열분해 반응기 및 이의 생성물 회수 방법에 관한 것이다. 상세하게는, 청록수소를 생산하는 천연가스 열분해 반응기에 있어서, 상기 천연가스 열분해 반응기의 하부에 배치되며 반응가스를 주입하는 반응가스 주입부, 용융촉매가 충진되어 있으며 상기 반응가스를 열분해 반응하는 촉매 반응부, 상기 천연가스 열분해 반응기의 내부 중심에 배치되며 반응에 의해 생성된 수소 및 탄소 부산물을 포함하는 반응 생성물을 외부로 회수하는 생성물 회수관을 포함하며, 상기 천연가스 열분해 반응기의 상부는 돔형 구조를 갖는 것을 특징으로 한다.

titulo: SYSTÈME ET PROCÉDÉ AMÉLIORÉS DE POLYMÉRISATION D'OLÉFINES
abstract: The present application provides for improved systems and processes for olefin polymerisation, particularly wherein the slurry is conveyed from a reactor vessel to a product recovery system by at least one slurry withdrawal lines, particularly a plurality of slurry withdrawal lines, wherein a mass flow meter, particularly a single straight tube Coriolis type mass flow meter is provided on each of the at least one or plurality of slurry withdrawal lines, and particularly positioned upstream of the discharge valve, particularly the continuous take off (CTO) valve, of each individual flash line. Additionally, the position of the valve of each flash line of the plurality of flash lines is individually adjusted based on the mass flow and/or the slurry density measured by the (mass) flow meter of that individual flash line. Additionally, the heating of the flash line may be individually controlled based on the flow of the slurry measured by the flow meter of that individual flash line, and the temperature measured at the end of the flash line. Additionally, the transfer of preferably a diluent, and/or, optionally, a monomer and/or a catalyst to the reactor vessel is adjusted based on the slurry density measured by the mass flow meter.

titulo: Phosphogypsum multi-element synergistic leaching and by-product recovery method
abstract: The invention discloses an ardealite multi-element synergistic leaching and by-product recovery method, which comprises the following steps: carrying out pretreatment, leaching and solid-liquid separation on ardealite to obtain a leaching solution serving as a mother solution I and purified ardealite, and in the leaching step, carrying out a reaction by using a mixed acid composed of sulfuric acid and an organic complex acid; reacting the mother liquor I by adopting an oxalic acid precipitation method, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a second precipitate and filtrate serving as mother liquor II, washing, drying and firing the second precipitate to obtain a mixed rare earth oxide enriched product, and further carrying out fine separation to obtain a rare earth oxide product; adjusting the pH value of the mother liquor II, performing precipitation reaction, performing solid-liquid separation to obtain a third precipitate and filtrate serving as mother liquor III, and washing and calcining the third precipitate to obtain an aluminum oxide product. According to the method, synergistic efficient leaching of multiple elements in ardealite can be achieved, and directional purification and high-valued conversion of all valuable elements are completed in combination with gradient precise separation.

titulo: Soybean full-resource high-value utilization processing whole-process intelligent control system
abstract: The invention discloses a full-process intelligent control system for soybean full-resource high-value utilization processing, and belongs to the technical field of food processing and automatic control. The system comprises a raw material multi-dimensional feature sensing unit, a dynamic soaking and precise pulping control unit, a component directional separation and conversion control unit, a functional component refining and extraction control unit and a full-resource closed-loop feedback scheduling unit. And process parameters such as soaking and pulping, component separation and component extraction are dynamically adjusted, and cross-process feedback scheduling and reverse compensation are executed based on a full-life-cycle value maximization model. The problems of poor processing procedure coupling, large raw material fluctuation, low by-product recycling efficiency and the like are solved, and the product consistency, the by-product recovery rate and the full-resource utilization efficiency are remarkably improved.

applicante: ZHENJIANG NEW DISTR SOLID WASTE DISPOSAL CO LTD
titulo: Fly ash constant volume extraction device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of fly ash treatment, in particular to a fly ash constant-volume extraction device which comprises an extraction tank body, a reaction cavity, a sealing cover, a metering assembly, a stirring assembly, a constant-temperature water jacket, a slurry discharging pipe and the like. Fly ash is accurately conveyed through the metering assembly, the constant-temperature water jacket keeps the reaction temperature constant, the stirring assembly enhances the mixing effect and prevents deposition, the spraying assembly evenly sprays chemicals, and the slurry discharging pipe is provided with a filter screen and a sampling opening so as to monitor slurry components. According to the device, the mixing mode of the fly ash and the medicament can be optimized, the extraction efficiency is improved, the resource waste is reduced, the by-product recovery rate is improved, and the device has relatively high practicability and popularization value.

titulo: Difunctional polyether amine auxiliary agent for realizing efficient purification and separation of raw gas and application of difunctional polyether amine auxiliary agent
abstract: The invention discloses a difunctional polyether amine auxiliary agent for realizing high-efficiency purification and separation of raw gas and application of the difunctional polyether amine auxiliary agent. The auxiliary agent takes lauryl alcohol as an initiator, the lauryl alcohol, epoxypropane and ethylene oxide are subjected to block polymerization in sequence, epoxy-terminated polyether is generated through epoxy chloropropane bridging and alkali closed-loop reaction, and finally, the epoxy-terminated polyether and polyethylene polyamine are subjected to amination end-capping reaction in a micro-channel reactor according to the molar ratio of epoxy groups to primary amine groups being 1: 1, and a linear polyether amine compound is formed. The assistant has a hydrophobic-hydrophilic-polyamido linear structure, can simultaneously realize efficient cleaning and rapid demulsification in a weakly alkaline ammonia water system, has double effects by one agent, obviously improves the oil-water separation efficiency and the oil product recovery rate, simplifies the dosing process and reduces the operation cost. The preparation process adopts a micro-channel reactor for continuous synthesis, reaction conditions are accurate and controllable, the product structure is clear, molecular weight distribution is narrow, and the method is suitable for raw gas purification and emulsion treatment in coal chemical industry, coking and other industries.

applicante: WUYANG HONDA MOTORS GUANGZHOU CO LTD
titulo: Bolt and gasket assembling and screening device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical assembly, and particularly discloses a bolt gasket assembling and screening device which comprises a workbench, a bolt gasket sleeving vibration disc is arranged on the workbench, the bolt gasket sleeving vibration disc is provided with a bolt discharging rail and a gasket discharging rail, the bolt discharging rail is located above the gasket discharging rail, and the gasket discharging rail is located above the gasket discharging rail. A defective product recovery box is arranged on the side wall of the bolt sleeve gasket vibration disc; the finished product guiding pipe is arranged on the workbench through a guiding fixing seat, and the finished product guiding pipe is communicated with the gasket discharging rail; the inferior-quality product screening mechanism is located above the inferior-quality product recycling box, the inferior-quality product screening mechanism is arranged between the gasket discharging rail and the finished product guiding pipe, and the inferior-quality product screening mechanism communicates with the gasket discharging rail and the finished product guiding pipe; and the finished product transferring assembly is arranged on the workbench. The automatic assembling device has the advantages that automatic assembling of bolts and gaskets and automatic screening of defective products can be achieved, and therefore the assembling precision and efficiency are improved.

titulo: Epoxy chloropropane by-product recovery and separation integrated equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical wastewater treatment and resource recovery, in particular to epoxy chloropropane by-product recovery and separation integrated equipment which comprises a tank body, a liquid inlet assembly is arranged on the outer side wall of one side of the tank body, and liquid outlet assemblies are arranged on the upper surface and the lower surface of the tank body. A plurality of baffles are fixedly installed on the inner wall of the tank body, three sets of rotating holes are formed in each baffle, each set of rotating holes comprises two rotating holes, rotating rollers are rotationally connected into the rotating holes, heavy liquid is guided to flow in a bow shape through the multiple layers of baffles with staggered through holes, the contact path of the heavy liquid is prolonged, and the retention time of the heavy liquid is prolonged; the gravitational potential energy of flowing heavy liquid impacts the pushing plate, the gear-bevel gear transmission assembly drives the rotating roller to synchronously rotate, the rotating speed is self-adaptively adjusted along with the flow of the heavy liquid, the rotating roller upwards disperses light liquid through the containing groove to form uniform tiny liquid drops, the interphase contact area is enlarged, efficient transfer of ECH/dichloropropanol is promoted, and the deep recovery requirement is met.

titulo: Mixed type pressure control method and device for coke oven with multiple sections of gas collecting pipes and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention provides a mixed type pressure control method and device for a multi-section gas collecting pipe coke oven and electronic equipment, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a coke oven production stage signal, gas collecting pipe real-time pressure and turning plate opening data, setting a monotone section pressure steady-state value in stages, compensating non-monotone section pressure as required, dynamically generating an adjustment parameter corresponding to a turning plate, and performing adjustment. The multi-section gas collecting pipe pressure control device realizes stable control of multi-section gas collecting pipe pressure in a mixed process, effectively solves the problems of non-uniform suction distribution and unstable adjustment caused by steady-state difference of different sections, reduces the phenomena of smoke leakage and fire on the furnace top, and provides guarantee for environmental protection, prolonging of the service life of a coke oven, improvement of coke quality, improvement of chemical product recovery rate and safety production.

applicante: FUYANG DAFENGYE RENEWABLE RESOURCES CO LTD
titulo: Recovery equipment for disassembled plastic products of waste household appliances
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of plastic product recovery, in particular to recovery equipment for disassembled plastic products of waste household appliances, which comprises a recovery bin, an entering bin, a conveying line, a lifting device, an electric roller, a rotating roller, a magnetic attraction part, a collecting device, a softening device, a vibration separation device, a rolling friction device, a cleaning device, a linkage device and a winnowing device. The device can solve the problems that the magnetic separation unit mostly adopts a static arrangement or low-speed rotation structure, the effective adsorption area is limited, the surface is easily covered and shielded by non-magnetic plastic fragments when crushed aggregates continuously pass through, the capturing capacity for internal and deep metal impurities is greatly reduced, the rejection rate is low and unstable, and the product quality is influenced. The existing stripping mode mainly tries to remove the label through a single mechanical scraping mode, the process mode is extensive, the mode is not provided with a preheating softening link aiming at an adhesive sticker adhesive, a vibration or flapping mechanism for preliminarily loosening the label from an interface is also lacked, and colloid is easy to remain on the plastic surface.

applicante: SHAANXI LANYAO ENERGY TECH CO LTD
titulo: Doping modification and granulation preparation method for improving combustion heat value of iron powder
abstract: The invention discloses a doping modification and granulation preparation method for improving the combustion heat value of iron powder, and belongs to the technical field of new energy storage and zero-carbon fuel. The method comprises the following steps: reducing iron oxide raw material hydrogen into metal iron powder by taking light-abandoned wind-abandoned electric power electrolysis hydrogen production as a reducing agent, doping high-calorific-value metal powder such as aluminum powder, silicon iron powder, magnesium powder and boron powder, granulating by combining a binder, and carrying out surface passivation treatment to prepare millimeter-scale fuel particles with the calorific value of more than or equal to 18 MJ/kg and the ignition temperature of less than or equal to 600 DEG C. The combustion heat value of the iron powder fuel is obviously improved (50-100% higher than that of pure iron powder), the ignition temperature is reduced, the storage stability and the combustion characteristic are improved, iron oxide can be recovered from combustion products through magnetic separation for recycling, and other components are sold as raw materials of building materials. A zero-carbon energy circulation system of'green electricity hydrogen production-hydrogen reduction-iron powder combustion-product recovery 'is constructed, and a technically feasible, economical and reasonable solution is provided for replacing coal power generation.

titulo: Chemical product recovery device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of coal chemical industry devices, and particularly discloses a chemical product recovery device which comprises a cooling box, a gas inlet pipe is arranged in the cooling box, a plurality of branch pipes are arranged on the gas inlet pipe, a plurality of gas outlet holes are formed in the branch pipes, and the gas inlet pipe penetrates through the top end of the cooling box to be rotationally and hermetically communicated with a gas pipe; the air inlet pipe is equivalent to a rotating shaft of the motor. Coal gas generated by the coal furnace is introduced into the gas inlet pipe through the coal gas pipe and then flows into the cooling box through the gas outlet holes in the branch pipes, the gas is dispersed into a plurality of small gas flows through the gas outlet holes in the branch pipes to make contact with water in the cooling box, water-soluble waste gas in the coal gas is absorbed, and meanwhile the motor is started to drive the gas inlet pipe to rotate; and the plurality of branch pipes and the gas inlet pipe synchronously rotate so as to stir the water solution in the cooling box, so that the dissolving efficiency of water-soluble waste gas in the coal gas is improved.

applicante: DONGGUAN XINGXING SANYOU TECH CO LTD
titulo: Battery electric quantity automatic detection, sorting and plate placing integrated equipment and battery electric quantity automatic detection, sorting and plate placing integrated method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of battery production detection, and provides a battery electric quantity automatic detection and sorting and placing integrated device and method. The method comprises the steps that a material disc loaded with a to-be-detected battery is placed on a feeding station, and stepping feeding of the material disc is achieved through servo driving; the servo-driven displacement module drives the electricity testing mechanism to perform two-dimensional plane displacement, batch electric quantity detection is performed on all the batteries on the temporary storage station, and qualified batteries and unqualified batteries are obtained through distinguishing; the detected unqualified batteries are accurately sucked and placed into an empty tray of an unqualified product recovery station from a raw material tray through a suction cup assembly driven by an air cylinder; empty trays are sucked from an empty tray feeding station and transferred to an unqualified product recycling station for empty tray supply; and the qualified product trays after unqualified product sorting are transferred to a qualified product recovery station for stepping storage, so that full-process automatic closed-loop operation of battery electric quantity detection, sorting, tray placement and empty tray supply is realized.

titulo: Method for purifying chenodeoxycholic acid crude product
abstract: The invention discloses a method for purifying a chenodeoxycholic acid crude product, which comprises the following steps of: pre-washing the chenodeoxycholic acid crude product serving as a raw material with n-hexane, dispersing the pre-washed chenodeoxycholic acid crude product in water, heating for dissolving, regulating the pH value to be alkaline, dissolving chenodeoxycholic acid, removing impurities, filtering, regulating the pH value of filtrate to be acidic, and carrying out temperature control operation to obtain a primary refined product; and recrystallizing to obtain a high-purity chenodeoxycholic acid product. The purity of the final product obtained through the purification method can reach 98% or above, and the purity can reach 99.5% or above after secondary polishing; the content of toxic impurity lithocholic acid is lower than 0.1%, and the international pharmacopoeia standard is met; the product recovery rate can reach 85% or above, and the material utilization rate is high; according to the method, bile acid homologues with similar structures are effectively separated through temperature reduction recrystallization of a uniquely designed acetonitrile seed crystal program, and the problem of insufficient selectivity of a traditional method is solved; the purification process is more environmentally friendly and simple, the technological process is coherent, parameters are controllable, the technological steps are flexible and adjustable, and the method is very suitable for industrial production.
scores_por_categoria: Downstream Processing:10 | Process Monitoring & Control:3 | Scale-up & Industrialization:5
termos_detectados: product recovery, purification, temperature control, industrial production

titulo: Efficient coal tar residue filtering and recycling device
abstract: The invention provides an efficient coal tar residue filtering and recycling device, and relates to the technical field of coal tar treatment, the filtering and recycling device comprises a recycling tank body, a filtering mechanism, a preheating conveying part and a control decision module; the filtering mechanism comprises a filtering box body mounted on the recycling tank body, a vacuum pump and a filtering belt assembly horizontally penetrating through the box body, the preheating conveying component is arranged at the top of the filtering box body, and a collecting probe is mounted at the communicating position of the preheating conveying component and the filtering box body and used for monitoring the viscosity and temperature of coal tar in real time. And the control decision module is in communication connection with the probes, calculates the oil content based on the acquired viscosity and temperature data, compares the data of the oil product to be filtered with the data of the oil content of the actually measured filter residue, and dynamically adjusts the preheating power, the running speed of the filter belt and the negative pressure strength of the filter box body. Closed-loop intelligent control over the whole filtering process is achieved, the oil residue separation efficiency and the oil product recovery rate are remarkably improved, it is guaranteed that the oil content of filter residues stably reaches the standard, and meanwhile energy consumption is optimized.

titulo: Pretreatment device for recovering alcohol byproducts from polyester
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of by-product recovery processing, in particular to a pretreatment device for recovering alcohol by-products from polyester, which comprises a reaction kettle and a base, an arc-shaped protective block is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the reaction kettle, and a stirring rod is rotatably connected to the inner top wall of the reaction kettle. The top end of the stirring rod penetrates through the upper surface of the reaction kettle and is fixedly provided with a motor, a gear ring is rotationally arranged on the lower surface of the arc-shaped protection block, a reverse stirring mechanism is arranged on the lower surface of the gear ring and comprises a sliding sleeve fixedly connected with the lower surface of a gear, and the inner wall of the sliding sleeve is slidably connected with a spherical rod; one end of the spherical rod is fixedly connected with a Z-shaped rod, and the surface of the Z-shaped rod is fixedly connected with a plurality of through hole blades; according to the utility model, the bidirectional stirring mechanism is arranged, so that centrifugal force can be prevented from being generated during stirring to influence the mixing effect, the problem that the centrifugal effect can be generated by the same-direction stirring of the stirring rods is solved, and a better pretreatment effect on alcohol by-products is achieved.

applicante: DONGGUAN YAYI COLOR PRINTING CO LTD
titulo: Die cutting device for printing production
abstract: The utility model discloses a die cutting device for printing production, which relates to the technical field of printing processing, and comprises a rack, a die cutting mechanism, a die cutting mechanism, a die cutting mechanism and a die cutting mechanism, the feeding assembly is installed on the feeding side of the workbench and used for conveying the laminated sheet; the die cutting assembly is arranged on the workbench, located on the discharging path of the feeding assembly and used for conducting die cutting on the laminated sheet conveyed by the feeding assembly to form a preset shape. The separating assembly is installed on the discharging side of the workbench, located on the discharging path of the die cutting assembly and used for separating and conveying finished products obtained after die cutting and film covering excess materials; the film covering excess material recycling assembly is used for recycling the film covering excess materials separated by the separating assembly; the finished product recovery assembly is used for collecting finished products separated by the separation assembly; directional separation conveying of finished products and film covering excess materials after die cutting is achieved, and the production efficiency is improved.

applicante: TIANJIN CITY ZHONGTIAN SCIENCE & TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD
titulo: System and method for directly producing battery-grade ferrous oxalate by using dimethyl oxalate
abstract: The invention discloses a system and a method for directly producing battery-grade ferrous oxalate by using dimethyl oxalate. The system comprises a hydrolysis reactor; an adsorption filler is arranged in the adsorption stripping tower, and the adsorption stripping tower is used for countercurrent contact stripping impurity removal and adsorption impurity removal of the oxalic acid solution and steam in the tower; the precipitation reaction kettle is used for mixing the oxalic acid solution and ferric salt for precipitation reaction and aging to obtain a reaction product; and the product recovery unit is used for separating and recovering the reaction product to obtain battery-grade ferrous oxalate, and circulating the synthesized mother liquor to the ferric salt preparation unit. According to the method, DMO, MMO and methanol are selectively removed from the hydrolysis solution by steam stripping impurity removal, the impurity removal effect is obviously superior to that of conventional distillation, adsorption impurity removal and metal impurity removal are synchronously carried out in steam stripping impurity removal, and the product is good in crystallinity, regular in crystal form, concentrated in particle size distribution and stable in chemical purity, can meet the requirements of a battery-grade material precursor, and is suitable for industrial production. Extra energy consumption is not increased, and the universality is high.

titulo: Single-permeable membrane freeze-drying disc system for freeze-drying process
abstract: The invention discloses a one-way permeable membrane freeze-drying tray system for a freeze-drying process, belongs to the field of matched consumables of freeze-drying equipment, and is suitable for an industrial freeze-drying process of a rigid freeze-drying tray. The system comprises a rigid material disc, a cover body assembly and a three-layer composite single-permeable membrane fixed on the cover body assembly, wherein a sealed space is formed by the cover body assembly and the material disc; the one-way permeable membrane is composed of an ePTFE microporous membrane, a non-woven fabric supporting layer and an anti-static coating, wherein the side, away from ePTFE, of the supporting layer is coated with the anti-static coating, and all the layers cooperate to achieve water vapor selective ventilation, solid-liquid and bacterium blocking and electrostatic adsorption inhibition. The invention also designs two implementation schemes of reusable stainless steel and disposable polypropylene, which are respectively adapted to different production requirements. The core contradictions of ventilation and barrier, electrostatic adsorption prevention and membrane hole smoothness and membrane material and rigid freeze-drying disc adaptation in the freeze-drying field are broken, the product recovery rate is remarkably increased, and the method is suitable for freeze-drying of high-value biological drugs, protein, natural products and the like and has process suitability and cost effectiveness.

titulo: Unloading platform with damping speed reduction function at tail end of slope
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of waste electronic product recovery, and discloses an unloading table with a damping speed reduction function at the tail end of a slope, which comprises a fixed disc, a motor I is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the fixed disc, a turntable is fixedly arranged at the output end of the motor I, and the outer wall of the turntable is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the fixed disc. An intermittent block is rotatably connected to the outer wall of the rotating disc, the outer wall of the first spring is arranged on the inner wall of the fixed disc, a hollow block is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the rotating block, a sliding piece is slidably connected to the inner wall of the hollow block, the outer wall of the right side of the second spring is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the hollow block, and a damping assembly is arranged on the inner wall of the hollow block. According to the utility model, the motor I is started to push the turntable to rotate and simultaneously drive the intermittent block to synchronously rotate, the arranged hollow block can stably reduce the speed and buffer falling goods, and intermittent blanking can prevent the goods from accumulating, so that the effect of preventing the goods from bumping operators is achieved.

applicante: HUNAN HONGTUO ALUMINUM IND CO LTD
titulo: Waste aluminum product recycling mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a waste aluminum product recovery processing mechanism, and relates to the technical field of waste metal recovery, the mechanism comprises a smelting furnace, the upper part of the smelting furnace is provided with a processing cover body and a crushed material feeding cover, and the smelting furnace is internally provided with a screening plate, an aluminum ash separation body and a smelting disc in sequence; the furnace body is provided with a heat guide pipe to drive a rotating part, and a rotating pipe is driven to rotate and move up and down in a reciprocating mode, so that the screening plate and the aluminum ash separation body conduct centrifugal and small-amplitude opening and closing movement. An external negative pressure component adsorbs aluminum ash at a feeding position and sends the aluminum ash to a separation body area, air is introduced into an aluminum ash separation body through a rotating pipe, air blowing and ash raising are carried out through an air floating opening, and the aluminum ash is guided into the furnace bottom in cooperation with an ash discharging pipe. Screening, aluminum ash collection and smelting ash removal are integrated, the structure is driven by waste heat to operate, aluminum ash mixing is reduced through centrifugal classification and air flotation separation, the purity of secondary aluminum is effectively improved, dust pollution is reduced, the structure is compact, energy is saved, and efficiency is high.

titulo: Chemical cleaning agent for low-value waste plastic surface composite stains and cleaning method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of plastic product recovery, in particular to a chemical cleaning agent for composite stains on the surface of low-value waste plastic and a cleaning method of the chemical cleaning agent. The invention relates to a chemical cleaning agent for composite stains on the surface of low-value waste plastic. The chemical cleaning agent comprises the following raw materials: 9-25% of a surfactant system; 8%-15% of sodium bicarbonate; 2%-6% of sodium citrate; 3%-8% of sodium percarbonate; 1%-5% of a green cosolvent; 0.5%-1% of a mild corrosion inhibitor; 1.5%-4% of a chelating synergistic system; 1%-3% of a dispersing anti-redeposition agent; and the balance of deionized water. Through the synergistic process of pre-crushing and pre-wetting, ultralow-temperature chemical soaking, mechanical friction cleaning, two-stage countercurrent rinsing and low-temperature drying, the grease removal rate is larger than or equal to 99%, the glue removal rate is larger than or equal to 96%, the ash content is smaller than or equal to 0.22%, the whiteness is larger than or equal to 91, the strength retention rate is larger than or equal to 98%, stress cracking and yellowing are avoided, and composite stains on the surface of low-value waste plastic can be efficiently removed.

titulo: Taking equipment for paper packaging box production
abstract: The utility model discloses a taking device for paper packaging box production, which comprises a support and a taking component, the support is longitudinally arranged above a qualified product conveying line and a defective product recovery line in a crossing manner, the taking component is arranged in the support and is used for transferring defective products on the qualified product conveying line to the defective product recovery line, and a driving part is arranged on the inner bottom wall of the support. The number of the taking parts is two, the two taking parts are located on the two sides of the surface of the driving part correspondingly, and the driving part drives the two taking parts to synchronously and reversely move and exchange positions. The output end of the driving motor drives the driving belt wheel to rotate, then the transmission belt is driven to move under the cooperation of the driven belt wheel, the transmission belt moves to drive the two taking components to synchronously and reversely move, and the two taking components exchange positions and are located above a qualified product conveying line and a defective product recycling line respectively. Compared with the prior art, the defective product removing and transferring device has the advantages that the resetting process of the taking component is reduced, and the control program is simplified.

titulo: Method for recovering organic matters from phenol wastewater by using cold energy
abstract: The invention discloses a method for recycling organic matters from phenol wastewater by using cold energy, and belongs to the field of sewage treatment. The invention aims to solve the problems of complex process, high energy consumption and difficulty in solid-liquid separation and product recovery in the existing oxidative polymerization process of phenolic wastewater. The method comprises the following steps: adjusting phenol-containing wastewater to be alkaline, and adding persulfate as an oxidant; the waste water is in a frozen state by utilizing cold energy; a local high-concentration reaction microenvironment is constructed on an unfrozen liquid phase and an ice crystal interface by utilizing a freezing concentration effect, phenol organic matters, alkali and persulfate are enriched on a crystal boundary liquid layer under the action of salt elimination and solute elimination of ice crystals, phenol oxygen free radicals are induced to be subjected to oxidative coupling, and settleable or filterable macromolecular oligomers or polymers are generated; and then carrying out solid-liquid separation, washing and drying to obtain an organic matter recovery product, or eluting the organic matter recovery product by adopting an organic solvent. According to the method, the energy consumption in the phenol wastewater recycling process is remarkably reduced, the reagent utilization rate is high, and recycling is convenient.

titulo: ADSORPTION-MEMBRANE-DISTILLATION DIRECT AIR CAPTURE SYSTEMS AND METHODS
abstract: [0000]    The present disclosure relates generally to carbon dioxide capture systems and methods, and more particularly to direct air capture systems and methods that combine adsorption, membrane separation, and distillation technologies to capture and purify carbon dioxide from ambient air. A direct air capture system includes a first separation stage configured to receive an air stream containing carbon dioxide and to produce a first enriched stream having a higher carbon dioxide concentration than the air stream. The direct air capture system includes a second separation stage configured to receive the first enriched stream and to produce a second enriched stream having a higher carbon dioxide concentration than the first enriched stream. The first separation stage and the second separation stage employ different separation technologies selected from the group consisting of adsorption, membrane separation, and distillation.

titulo: CONTINUOUS SIZE-EXCLUSION MEMBRANE SEPARATION OF POLYURETHANE DECONSTRUCTION PRODUCTS FOR THE RECOVERY OF PRISTINE POLYOLS
abstract: [0000]    Described herein are systems and methods for the conversion of polymers into monomer and polymer components utilizing deconstruction (for example, acetic acid solvolysis) and filtration of both insoluble and soluble reaction products.

titulo: Livestock wastewater treatment system using biological process and electrochemical membrane separation device
abstract: 본 발명은 축산폐수에 포함되어 있는 고농도의 암모니아성 질소를 효과적으로 제거함과 함께 암모니아성 질소 제거에 소비되는 전력을 최소화할 수 있는 생물학적 공정 및 전기화학적 분리막장치를 이용한 축산폐수 처리시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 생물학적 공정 및 전기화학적 분리막장치를 이용한 축산폐수 처리시스템은 축산폐수를 소화시키는 축산폐수 전처리조; 축산폐수 전처리조를 거친 축산폐수를 처리대상수로 하여, 축산폐수에 포함되어 있는 암모니아성 질소를 질산화 및 탈질 반응을 통해 제거하는 생물학적 수처리장치; 생물학적 수처리장치를 거친 축산폐수를 처리대상수로 하여, 축산폐수에 포함되어 있는 불순물을 제거하여 전처리수를 생산하는 전처리장치; 역삼투막 공정을 통해 전처리수를 처리수와 농축수로 분리하는 역삼투막모듈; 및 역삼투막모듈의 농축수를 처리대상수로 하여, 농축수에 포함되어 있는 암모늄이온(NH4+)을 전기화학적 반응을 통해 암모니아기체(NH3)로 변환시켜 회수하는 전기화학적 분리막장치;를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다.

titulo: SYSTÈME DE SÉPARATION MEMBRANAIRE ET SON PROCÉDÉ DE FONCTIONNEMENT
abstract: This membrane separation system includes: a membrane separation device having a nanofiltration membrane or a reverse osmosis membrane; and a pressure recovery device for pressurizing feed water fed to the membrane separation device, such pressurization achieved by using the pressure of concentrated water from the membrane separation device. The membrane separation system is characterized in that the recovery rate of the membrane separation device is 60% or more; and a rise in the concentration of a solute in the feed water fed to the membrane separation device is no more than 5%, the rise caused by passage through the pressure recovery device.

titulo: RÉCUPÉRATION DE CO2
abstract: A process of recovering CO2 from an aqueous liquid comprising CO2, the process comprising the steps of: providing a CO2-rich aqueous solution containing CO2 in the form of amino acid-CO2 complexes; contacting the CO2-rich solution with a heterogeneous acidic catalyst to facilitate desorption of CO2 from the amino acid-CO2 complexes; and extracting gaseous CO2 from the CO2-rich solution by vacuum membrane separation, thereby recovering CO2, wherein the vacuum membrane separation is performed at a temperature below the boiling point of the CO2-rich solution.

titulo: CARBON DIOXIDE SEPARATION DEVICE
abstract: A carbon dioxide separation device includes a first membrane separator and a second membrane separator coupled together in series, a circulation path configured to circulate a non-permeate gas not permeated by membrane separation with the second membrane separator into a raw material gas introduction line connected to the first membrane separator, flow rate adjustment part provided in the circulation path and configured to adjust the flow rate of the non-permeate gas, and effective membrane area adjustable part configured to change the effective membrane area of a separation membrane in the second membrane separator.

titulo: CARBON DIOXIDE SEPARATION DEVICE
abstract: A carbon dioxide separation device includes a first membrane separator configured to introduce a raw material gas containing carbon dioxide, a second membrane separator configured to introduce a first non-permeate gas that has not permeated through membrane separation in the first membrane separator, a combustor provided on the downstream side of the second membrane separator and configured to combust a second permeate gas, a third membrane separator provided on the downstream side of the combustor, and at least one fourth membrane separator provided on the downstream side of the third membrane separator.

titulo: IMPURITY REMOVAL FROM BRINES PRE/POST DIRECT LITHIUM EXTRACTION
abstract: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide a method of reducing impurities in a brine stream. The method includes exposing a brine stream including one or more impurities to a precipitation reagent to produce a precipitate including a first amount of the one or more impurities and an intermediate brine stream comprising a residual amount of the one or more impurities. The method further includes filtering a second amount of the one or more impurities from the intermediate brine stream or a derivative thereof in a membrane separation unit to produce a purified brine stream. The one or more impurities include one or more multivalent metal cations, silica, boron, or a combination thereof.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ DE SÉPARATION DE DIOXYDE DE CARBONE D'UN GAZ DE COMBUSTION
abstract: A process includes combusting a carbon dioxide depleted light hydrocarbon stream in a gas turbine comprising a compressor, a combustor and a turbine to drive the gas turbine, thereby producing an exhaust flue gas stream comprising carbon dioxide having a first temperature, passing the exhaust flue gas stream comprising carbon dioxide having the first temperature through a heat recovery unit, thereby producing a cool flue gas stream comprising carbon dioxide having a second temperature less than the first temperature, passing the cool flue gas stream comprising carbon dioxide through a membrane separation unit comprising a membrane that is selectively permeable to carbon dioxide, thereby producing a carbon dioxide rich permeate stream at the permeate side of the membrane, and passing the carbon dioxide rich permeate stream to a post-combustion amine unit comprising an amine absorber and an amine stripper, thereby producing a wet carbon dioxide stream.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ DE TRAITEMENT DES EAUX ET DISPOSITIF DE TRAITEMENT DES EAUX
abstract: Provided are a water treatment method and a water treatment device that make it possible to improve a granule existence ratio in a continuous biological treatment tank in the water treatment device configured to charge granule sludge formed in a semi-batch type reaction tank into the continuous biological treatment tank and treat the granule sludge by membrane separation. The water treatment method includes: a continuous biological treatment step for biologically treating water to be treated, with biological sludge, while causing the water to be treated to continuously flow into a continuous biological treatment tank (14) and stirring the water to be treated by a stirring device (26); a membrane separation step for separating biologically treated water obtained in the continuous biological treatment step and the biological sludge by a filtration membrane; and a sludge supply step for supplying granule sludge formed in a semi-batch type biological treatment tank (12) to the continuous biological treatment tank (14). The peripheral speed of stirring by the stirring device (26) in the continuous biological treatment step is 120 cm/sec or less.

titulo: SUPERCRITICAL EXTRACTION PURIFICATION METHOD AND CONTROL METHOD
abstract: Disclosed are a supercritical extraction purification method and a control method. Carbon dioxide is used as a supercritical fluid, supercritical conditions of 10 MPa-40 MPa and 35°C-80°C are established by raw material drying and pulverizing pre-treatment, charging and displacement, pressurizing, and heating, and at least two segments of segmented extraction are performed, wherein a co-solvent such as ethanol/isopropanol/ethyl acetate is added in at least one segment to adjust selectivity; the extraction fluid enters at least two stages of separators connected in series and is precipitated in a staged manner according to pressure/temperature steps, and a target enriched fraction is cut and collected in combination with collection tank switching and/or segmented program switching and/or separator condition segmented adjustment triggered by an on-line monitoring threshold; the target fraction is desolvated and subjected to adsorption, crystallization, membrane separation, or molecular distillation polishing.
termos_detectados: purification, extraction, membrane separation, crystallization, drying, on-line monitoring

titulo: RECOVERY OF KINETIC HYDRATE INHIBITORS FROM PRODUCED WATER BY MEMBRANE FILTRATION
abstract: [0000]    A produced water stream that includes a kinetic hydrate inhibitor (KHI) flows towards a water oil separator (WOSEP). The WOSEP removes the large oil droplets and total suspended solids and discharges the produced water stream with or without an additional pretreatment step to a membrane separation unit. The membrane separation unit filters the produced water stream to form a permeate stream and a retentate stream. The retentate stream includes the concentrated KHI which can be recovered and regenerated for reuse as a treatment chemical in the produced water stream. In some cases, the retentate stream is filtered a second time using another membrane separation unit to increase the KHI recovery by concentrating it in a second retentate stream formed from the second filtration. The KHI can be reformulated using alcohols and/or water to regenerate the KHI molecules for reuse, which are chemically stable.

titulo: MEMBRANE DE SÉPARATION, MODULE DE MEMBRANE DE SÉPARATION, PROCÉDÉ DE SÉPARATION DE GAZ, DISPOSITIF DE SÉPARATION DE GAZ ET PROCÉDÉ DE FABRICATION DE MEMBRANE DE SÉPARATION
abstract: Provided are a separation membrane, a separation membrane module, and a gas separation device, which have high separation performance for gases having a high warming coefficient and have excellent processability and heat resistance. The separation membrane is mainly composed of a polyolefin resin and has a dense layer and a porous layer. At least one surface of the separation membrane is composed of the dense layer. The ratio (degree of orientation S/degree of orientation B) of the degree of orientation (degree of orientation S) measured by laser Raman spectroscopy in a region extending to a depth of 150 nm (or the lowermost point of the dense layer if the thickness of the dense layer is less than 150 nm) from the surface on the side where the dense layer is present to the degree of orientation (degree of orientation B) measured using the entire separation membrane as a bulk is 3.30-6.00.

titulo: LOW ENERGY CONSUMPTION PROCESS FOR CONTINUOUS REDUCTION OF CARBON DIOXIDE TO METHANOL
abstract: The present invention discloses a low energy consumption process for the continuous reduction of carbon dioxide to methanol, belonging to the technical field of chemical preparation. The preparation steps comprise: S1. Purifying CO₂ and H₂ by low energy consumption membrane separation, mixing them according to a prescribed ratio, and preheating the mixture by utilizing waste heat; S2. Using CeO₂ as a shell layer and a Cu–Zn alloy as a core, wherein the shell layer is doped with a trace amount of gallium (Ga) to form Ce–Ga–O oxygen vacancy channels, and single-atom Pd is loaded within the pore channels of a molecular sieve to construct a synergistic catalyst for CO₂ adsorption–hydrogen dissociation–carbon–hydrogen coupling, introducing the mixed feed gas into a fixed-bed reactor filled with the synergistic catalyst for continuous reaction, wherein the interior of the reactor is a honeycomb microchannel array. The present invention adopts low energy consumption membrane separation for feedstock purification, in combination with waste heat recovery and recycling of unreacted feedstocks, to construct a closed-loop energy-saving system, thereby significantly reducing the overall process energy consumption. A core–shell structured synergistic catalyst is designed, the entire process generates no harmful by-products, the resource recovery rate is high, the emission reduction benefits are remarkable, the process is suitable for continuous production, and the control system exhibits strong compatibility.

applicante: LCFC HEFEI ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
titulo: Material-membrane separation device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of electronic equipment, in particular to a material-membrane separation device. The material and film separation device comprises a rack, a workbench, a material taking plate, a first moving mechanism, a second moving mechanism and a transmission mechanism. The first moving mechanism is used for driving the first end of the material film so that the first end can move in the first direction X; the second moving mechanism is used for driving the second end of the material film, so that the second end passes through the gap along the end part of the first direction X through the workbench and then moves along the second direction Z; the transmission mechanism is connected with the first moving mechanism and the second moving mechanism and used for driving the material film to move. Wherein the side, deviating from the first surface, of the second direction Z inclines relative to the first direction X, so that when the second end moves in the second direction Z, the structural adhesive moves to the material taking plate in the first direction X. The material membrane separation device provided by the utility model can complete the separation process without manual intervention.

titulo: Membrane separation oxygen and nitrogen production system based on multi-cycle coupling
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of gas separation, and particularly relates to a membrane separation oxygen and nitrogen production system based on multi-cycle coupling. The system is formed by mechanically coupling two stages of membrane separation circulating systems; the first-stage membrane separation circulating system comprises two stages of membrane separators which are connected in series front and back, and a set of compression equipment, and can obtain nitrogen-rich gas with the purity of more than 95%; the second-stage membrane separation circulating system comprises two stages of membrane separators which are connected in series front and back and a set of compression equipment, and oxygen with the concentration of 95% or above can be obtained; organic coupling of the first and second membrane separation cycles includes a compression device for compressing a mixed gas at a permeation side of a preceding stage membrane separator of the first cycle separation system to a higher pressure to meet mixing with a retention side gas of a following stage membrane separator of the second cycle separation system, circulating separation is formed by taking the raw material gas as the raw material gas of the preceding-stage membrane separator of the second circulating separation system; the device is particularly suitable for industrial application scenes needing high-pressure and high-purity oxygen and nitrogen at the same time.

titulo: Pressure swing adsorption-membrane separation-low-temperature rectification coupled ultrapure nitrogen and high-purity oxygen production device and preparation method
abstract: The invention provides a pressure swing adsorption-membrane separation-low-temperature rectification coupled ultra-pure nitrogen and high-purity oxygen production device and a preparation method. The device comprises an air pressurization and post-treatment unit, a membrane separation unit, a pressure swing adsorption unit and a rectification unit. The device is coupled with a pressure swing adsorption technology, a membrane separation technology and a low-temperature rectification technology, so that the resource utilization efficiency and the economical efficiency are greatly improved, and ultra-pure nitrogen and high-purity oxygen can be stably, efficiently and simultaneously obtained from a common air source. The V/V of the ultra-pure nitrogen is greater than or equal to 99.99995%, and the V/V of the high-purity oxygen is greater than or equal to 99.999%.

applicante: TIANBANG NATIONAL ENGINEERING RESEARCH CENTER OF MEMBRANE TECH CO LTD
titulo: Hydrogen and fluorinated hydrocarbon membrane separation device and process in fluorinated hydrocarbon production
abstract: The invention discloses a hydrogen and fluorinated hydrocarbon membrane separation device and process in fluorinated hydrocarbon production. The device comprises a pretreatment unit and a membrane separation unit which are sequentially connected through a pipeline in the material flow direction, a separation membrane assembly is made of modified polyimide or polyether sulfone, the surface of a separation layer is coated with a fluorine-resistant polymer layer, and a shell and a flow channel are made of corrosion-resistant metal. Aiming at the strong corrosion characteristic of the fluorinated hydrocarbon production tail gas, special corrosion-resistant material selection and design are carried out from a membrane material, a process pipeline to an equipment shell; the gas quality at the inlet of the membrane component is guaranteed through an optimized pretreatment process, and efficient and high-selectivity separation of hydrogen and fluorinated hydrocarbon is realized by combining a special high-performance separation membrane; through high-value recovery of hydrogen and cyclic utilization of fluorinated hydrocarbon, raw material consumption and waste discharge are effectively reduced; an integrated process and control system ensures that the whole separation device can be tightly coupled with a main production device, and continuous, stable and automatic operation is achieved.

applicante: ZHOUZHI TIANYI GUBENTANG BIOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD
titulo: Low-purine whole bean protein peptide powder and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of protein peptide powder preparation, and discloses low-purine whole-bean protein peptide powder and a preparation method thereof.According to the low-purine whole-bean protein peptide powder and the preparation method thereof, a traditional preparation technology of pumpkin seed protein peptide is optimized through an orthogonal experiment, meanwhile, the pumpkin seed protein peptide is purified through a membrane separation technology, and better industrial production of the pumpkin seed protein peptide is facilitated; and economic benefits are generated. The results are as follows: under the optimal process conditions, the yield of the pumpkin seed protein peptide is 86.52%, the content of the pumpkin seed protein peptide is greater than or equal to 55% (on a dry basis), and the content of crude protein is greater than or equal to 80% (on a dry basis, N * 6.5%); meanwhile, a membrane separation technology is adopted for impurity removal and concentration process research, the pumpkin seed protein peptide is effectively subjected to impurity removal and concentration to improve the purity of the protein peptide, so that the pumpkin seed protein peptide is better applied to downstream products, the crude protein content of the pumpkin seeds prepared by the process is more than or equal to 90% (N * 6.5% on a dry basis), and the protein peptide content is more than or equal to 80% (on a dry basis).

titulo: Roll type membrane element and rolling method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of membrane separation, in particular to a spiral-wound membrane element and a winding method thereof. The spiral-wound membrane element comprises a central water collecting pipe and a water purification membrane assembly; the water purification membrane component is wound on the central water collecting pipe by taking one end of the water purification membrane component in the length direction as a starting point. The rolling method is used for rolling to obtain the spiral-wound membrane element. The flow rate of wastewater is increased, deposition of concentrated crystalline substances in a water outlet flow channel is reduced, membrane hole blockage is delayed, and the service life of a membrane element is prolonged.

titulo: Click chemistry functionalized covalent organic framework film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a click chemistry functionalized covalent organic frame membrane as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of membrane separation. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly synthesizing a COF material, and respectively and accurately introducing three functional groups with different electronegativity and coordination capabilities, namely a sulfonic group, a carboxyl group and an amino group, into a COF pore channel through click chemistry, so as to obtain a series of COF membranes (TADA-R membranes) with continuous channels. The click chemistry functionalized covalent organic frame membrane can be used for Li < + >/Mg < 2 + > separation, and can independently and systematically research the influence of the change of the chemical properties of the pore surface on the selective transmission of lithium ions and magnesium ions on the premise of keeping the COF skeleton structure and the pore size unchanged.

applicante: XINGKONGJIHUA SHANGHAI AUTOMOBILE TECH CO LTD
titulo: Vehicle-mounted oxygen supply control method, system, product and vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted oxygen supply control method and system, a product and a vehicle, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining multi-source sensing data which at least comprises an environment state parameter, a passenger physiological feature parameter and a vehicle operation state parameter; based on the multi-source sensing data, determining a target oxygen supply scene corresponding to the current vehicle; according to the target oxygen supply scene, membrane separation oxygen production and molecular sieve oxygen production are controlled to execute corresponding collaborative oxygen production modes; generating personalized oxygen supply distribution strategies corresponding to different seats according to the target oxygen supply scene and the physiological feature parameters of the passengers; and the distributed oxygen supply module is controlled according to the personalized oxygen supply distribution strategy, and the oxygen supply flow output to different seats is controlled respectively, so that differential oxygen supply control among different seats is realized while dynamic switching according to different target oxygen supply scenes is realized.

titulo: Method for synchronously extracting high-purity torreya grandis ester and pimaric dienoic acid from torreya grandis black coat
abstract: The invention discloses a method for synchronously extracting high-purity torreya grandis ester and pimaric dienoic acid from torreya grandis black coat, and belongs to the technical field of medicinal deep processing of agricultural and forestry byproducts. The preparation method comprises the following steps: by taking torreya grandis black coat as a raw material, carrying out pretreatment, composite enzymolysis-assisted extraction, inactivation solid-liquid separation, macroporous resin adsorption purification, graded membrane separation and enrichment, preparative chromatography precise separation, monomer crystallization and drying to synchronously prepare torreya grandis ester and pimaric dienoic acid monomers with the purity of not less than 98%. The process is scientific and controllable, harmful residues are avoided, continuous production can be achieved, the extraction rate and purity are remarkably improved, high-value utilization of the torreya grandis black coat is achieved, and the product can be used for parasite expelling, cardiovascular protection and antiviral drug preparation and has outstanding creativity, practicability and industrial value.
termos_detectados: purification, chromatography, extraction, membrane separation, crystallization, drying

titulo: Functionalized graphene oxide membrane material for extracting cesium in radioactive nuclear wastewater as well as preparation and application of functionalized graphene oxide membrane material
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of radioactive wastewater treatment and membrane separation, and discloses a functionalized graphene oxide membrane material for radioactive nuclear wastewater cesium extraction and preparation and application thereof, and a preparation method comprises the following steps: S1, respectively preparing a graphene oxide nanosheet dispersion liquid and a solution containing a metal chelating agent; s2, mixing the graphene oxide nanosheet dispersion liquid with a solution containing a metal chelating agent, and fully stirring for reaction to obtain a mixed solution; and S3, depositing the mixed solution on a substrate in a suction filtration, spraying or slit coating manner, completely covering the substrate, and drying to obtain the modified functionalized graphene oxide composite film material. The GO membrane is functionally modified by using the metal chelating agent, so that the selectivity of monovalent metal ions (especially Cs < + >) and other multivalent metal ions (such as Sr < 2 + > and La < 3 + >) can be effectively improved.

titulo: Radial mesoporous silica nanotube based on loaded polyethyleneimine and preparation method thereof, mixed matrix membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of gas membrane separation, and particularly relates to a radial mesoporous silica nanotube based on loaded polyethyleneimine and a preparation method thereof, and a mixed matrix membrane and a preparation method and application thereof. Blending a solution of a polyether-polyamide block copolymer with the radial mesoporous silicon dioxide nanotube based on the loaded polyethyleneimine to obtain a membrane casting solution; and forming the membrane casting solution on a substrate, and drying to obtain the mixed matrix membrane based on the radial mesoporous silicon dioxide nanotube loaded with polyethyleneimine. According to the mixed matrix membrane, the three-dimensional open pore channel advantage of HSiNTs and the specific affinity effect of amino groups in PEI on CO2 are synergistically exerted, and the CO2 permeability and CO2/CH4 selectivity of the membrane are remarkably improved. The preparation process is simple, green, pollution-free and controllable in cost, and has important scientific research value and industrial application prospect in the CO2/CH4 mixed gas separation fields such as natural gas purification and biogas resource utilization.

titulo: EXTRAIT DE BAIES DE SUREAU À DOUBLE NORMALISATION DES ANTHOCYANES-POLYSACCHARIDES, SON PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION ET SON UTILISATION
abstract: The present invention discloses an anthocyanin-polysaccharide dual-standardized elderberry extract, a preparation method thereof, and use thereof. Mature Sambucus nigra fruits are subjected to acidic aqueous-phase enzymolysis with pectinase and cellulase, followed by pressing, centrifugation, and microfiltration to obtain a clarified elderberry liquid. The clarified elderberry liquid is subjected to ultrafiltration, wherein the ultrafiltration retentate is collected as a polysaccharide-enriched fraction. The ultrafiltration permeate is subjected to nanofiltration, and the nanofiltration retentate is collected as an anthocyanin-polyphenol enriched fraction. The two fractions are reconstituted at a solids mass ratio of 1:2.5 to 1:4.0, followed by low-temperature concentration, sterilization, and drying to obtain the extract. The extract simultaneously standardizes total anthocyanins, total polyphenols, and water-soluble polysaccharides and is suitable for use in immune-support oral nutritional products for non-therapeutic purposes.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION D'UN EXTRAIT AQUEUX DE GRAINES DE BROCOLI AYANT UN TAUX DE RÉTENTION DE GLUCORAPHANINE ÉLEVÉ ET SON APPLICATION
abstract: The present invention discloses a method for preparing a broccoli seed aqueous extract having a high glucoraphanin retention rate, and use thereof. Intact broccoli seeds are subjected to short-time saturated-steam treatment to inactivate endogenous myrosinase, rapidly cooled, and pulverized. The resulting seed powder is extracted with purified water at pH 5.8–6.6 and 45–55°C. The aqueous extract is subjected to crude separation to remove insoluble residues and lipid layers, followed by sequential microfiltration, ultrafiltration, and nanofiltration to remove fine particles, macromolecular proteins, colloidal polysaccharides, and residual enzyme proteins and to enrich glucoraphanin. The nanofiltration retentate is concentrated under reduced pressure at low temperature and spray-dried. The resulting powder has high glucoraphanin content, low sulforaphane content, reduced enzymatic loss, good water dispersibility, and improved storage stability, and is suitable for non-therapeutic food and nutritional supplement applications.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ DE PRODUCTION D'EAU POUR INJECTION ET DISPOSITIF DE PRODUCTION D'EAU POUR INJECTION
