abstract: Provided are a method for producing water for injection and a device for producing water for injection, wherein the occurrence of rouging on a stainless steel pipe interior surface in a device for producing cold WFI can be suppressed.　The method and device for producing water for injection have: a production step in which water for injection is produced by ultrafiltration; a circulation step in which the produced water for injection is circulated and stored; and a degassing step in which dissolved gas in the water is removed, wherein the water temperature in the circulation step is adjusted to be less than 50°C at least in a portion of a period during which the water for injection is supplied to a point of use, and the water for injection which has been degassed in the degassing step is supplied to the circulation step.

titulo: EXTRACT OF HUMAN UMBILICAL CORD MESENCHYMAL STEM CELLS AND APPLICATION IN SKINCARE PRODUCTS THEREOF
abstract: The invention provides a extract of human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells and an application in skincare products thereof, belonging to the fields of biotechnology and cosmetics. The extract is an active component complex obtained by separating and purifying a culture supernatant of human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells. A preparation method thereof comprises: isolating mesenchymal stem cells from Wharton’s jelly of a human umbilical cord; subculturing the mesenchymal stem cells in a serum-free and phenol red-free culture medium and collecting a culture supernatant; concentrating and purifying the culture supernatant through a tangential flow ultrafiltration system to remove small-molecule impurities; and finally adding a lyophilization protectant and performing vacuum freeze-drying to obtain a lyophilized powder of the extract. The extract is rich in various growth factors, cytokines, and exosomes, and has effects of promoting skin repair, resisting wrinkles and delaying aging, and whitening by inhibiting melanin production. The invention has advantages of a simple preparation process, high purity, strong activity, no irritation to skin, and good safety, and has broad market application prospects.

titulo: NANOCOMPOSÉ-BIOCIDE
abstract: The present invention relates to a nanocomposite comprising polyphenolic extracts obtained from green walnut husk which are encapsulated in chitosan for use as a controlled-release agricultural biocide. The antioxidant polyphenolic compounds extracted from green walnut husk have antibacterial, antifungal, antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, but are highly unstable, their properties being reduced by exposure to temperature, oxygen and solar radiation. Therefore, these compounds must be encapsulated in a natural biopolymer to maintain their properties. In order to obtain this product, enzymatic extraction of the green walnut husk is carried out in an aqueous medium, thereby obtaining polyphenolic extracts that are sequentially filtered through a bag filter, tangential microfiltration and tangential ultrafiltration, thus making it possible to obtain an extract free of pathogenic microorganisms. Said polyphenolic extracts are subsequently encapsulated by ultrasound-assisted coagulation, flocculation, sedimentation and concentration techniques.

titulo: HYDROPHILIC NANOFILTRATION/ULTRAFILTRATION MEMBRANE AS A CO2 ABSORBER FOR AIR CAPTURE
abstract: [0000]    An apparatus, for capturing carbon dioxide from a gas stream, includes: (a) a combined carbon dioxide absorbent and electrolyte, (b) a membrane chamber including a hydrophilic nanofiltration membrane adapted to act as a carbon dioxide absorber whereby upon contact, carbon dioxide from the gas stream reacts with the combined carbon dioxide absorbent and electrolyte, and (c) an electrochemical regenerator adapted to release captured carbon dioxide and regenerate the combined carbon dioxide absorbent and electrolyte. The apparatus is useful in a method of capturing carbon dioxide from a gas stream such as directly from the air.

applicante: AYE EXOCURE TIBBI URUNLER SANAYI VE TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI [TR]
titulo: PROCÉDÉ D'OBTENTION D'EXTRAIT VÉGÉTAL PURIFIÉ ET D'EXOSOMES AYANT UNE TAILLE DE PARTICULE INFÉRIEURE À 250 NANOMÈTRES
abstract: The invention relates to a method for the separation, purification, and industrial-scale production of exosomes from plant raw materials for use both as active and/or auxiliary substances in the food, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical industries and in scientific research conducted in the fields of molecular biology, biotechnology, food, agriculture, genetics, and medicine; and additionally for obtaining plant exosomes and purified and concentrated plant extracts while preserving their biological activity and without leaving chemical residues, characterized in that it comprises the process steps of: preparing the plant raw material by drying and grinding plant raw materials into powder form; performing filtration of the mixture of distilled water and plant raw material to remove coarse particles; performing low-speed centrifugation to allow the particles in the solution to settle and to achieve solid–liquid separation; cooling the mixture; performing a second filtration to remove remaining particles from the cooled and rested liquid; applying evaporation to remove excess water; performing ultrafiltration to remove impurity-forming particles; and performing homogenization to ensure uniform distribution of exosomes in the solution.
termos_detectados: purification, filtration, ultrafiltration, centrifugation, drying, industrial-scale

titulo: ULTRAFILTRATION MEMBRANE FOR EMULSION SEPARATION
abstract: An ultrafiltration membrane comprising: a microporous support layer including polyvinylidene fluoride; and, an active layer disposed on and in the support layer. The active layer comprises a polyamide matrix in which are dispersed nanoparticles of strontium titanate (SrTiO3) which have been functionalized with an amino-functional alkoxysilane. The nanoparticles of strontium titanate are covalently bonded to the polyamide matrix, and the polyamide matrix is obtained by the polycondensation reaction of a C2-C6 alkylene diamine and an aromatic dicarboxylic acid or a reactive derivative thereof.

titulo: FORMULATION D'ANTICORPS ANTI-BAFF-R
abstract: Provided is an aqueous liquid pharmaceutical formulation comprising a human anti-BAFF-R antibody or an antigen-binding portion thereof. The aqueous liquid pharmaceutical formulation comprises an anti-BAFF-R antibody at a high concentration and has suitable viscosity. The viscosity at room temperature is no higher than 10 cp, such that ultrafiltration buffer exchange/concentration and filling production are smoothly carried out, and the viscosity requirements for subcutaneous injection can be met, thereby expanding self-administration modes by patients, such as pre-filled syringes/injection pens, improving the medication compliance of patients, and exhibiting improved bioavailability after subcutaneous administration to a subject. Compared with antibody formulations in the prior art, the aqueous liquid pharmaceutical formulation can be free of surfactants, has a simpler production process, and reduces the side effects of surfactants in clinical practice. In addition, the aqueous liquid pharmaceutical formulation exhibits excellent stability, thereby satisfying the stability during production, storage, and transportation.

titulo: METHOD FOR STABILIZING WATER FROM SEDIMENT DEPOSITS IN BAROMEMBRANE WATER TREATMENT PROCESSES
abstract: Water treatment method used in baromembrane water purification processes involves the use of strong-acid cation exchange resins in the sodium form. Raw water is clarified using mechanical and ultrafiltration filters. The clarified water is passed through a cation exchange filter filled with a strong-acid cation exchange resin in the sodium form, and the softened water is fed to a reverse osmosis system. The strong-acid cation exchange resin is regenerated using the concentrate produced during reverse osmosis desalination of the water.

titulo: RÉGULATION DE FLUIDE SUR LA BASE DU POIDS DANS LE CADRE D'UN TRAITEMENT EXTRACORPOREL DU SANG
abstract: A system for extracorporeal treatment of blood comprises a container (R1; R2) on a weight scale (31; 32). The container is arranged to hold a fluid that is consumed or produced when the system is operated to perform the treatment. During treatment, the container (R1; R2) is intermittently refilled or emptied. In a calibration procedure, while a pump (P0; P3) is operated to fill or empty the container, a signal (SS1; SS2) from the weight scale is processed for determination of calibration data indicative of a relation, for the pump, between speed and resulting flow rate. During treatment, while the container is filled or emptied, the pump is operated at a first speed with a known resulting flow rate according to the calibration data, and an ultrafiltration parameter is updated based on the known resulting flow rate and a momentary weight change rate in the weight signal (SS1; SS2).

applicante: DONGGUAN FENGSHENG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD
titulo: Ultrafiltration membrane device for waste acid recovery
abstract: The invention discloses an ultrafiltration membrane device for waste acid recovery, and belongs to the technical field of ultrafiltration membranes. Comprising a plurality of filtering units arranged according to concentration gradient decreasing, each filtering unit comprises a concentrated chamber and a diluted chamber, an anion exchange membrane is arranged between the concentrated chamber and the diluted chamber, and the preparation method of the anion exchange membrane comprises the following steps: preparing zirconium-based metal organic framework powder, growing carbon nanotubes in situ, grafting polyethylene glycol after carboxylation treatment, and preparing the zirconium-based metal organic framework powder. The polyethylene glycol grafted Zr-coated carbon nanotube is obtained; the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing chloromethylated polysulfone, carrying out quaternization modification, dissolving in dimethyl sulfoxide, adding 1, 4-dibromobutane, polyethylene glycol grafted Zr-coated carbon nanotubes and polyvinylpyrrolidone, carrying out ultrasonic dispersion uniformly, pouring into a mold, carrying out vacuum drying, demolding, washing and drying to obtain a cross-linked polysulfone membrane material, and carrying out ion exchange and activation to obtain the anion exchange membrane. The anion exchange membrane of the ultrafiltration membrane device for waste acid recovery has the advantages of high conductivity, low swelling, high strength, pollution resistance and long service life.

applicante: BINZHOU LVDONG THERMAL POWER CO LTD
titulo: Internal pressure type ultrafiltration membrane element leak detection device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of ultra-filtration membrane element leak detection, in particular to an internal pressure type ultra-filtration membrane element leak detection device. The device comprises an inflation assembly and a detection assembly, the inflation assembly comprises a connector, a gas pipeline and a pipeline switch, the connector is used for being connected to a water outlet of the internal pressure type ultrafiltration membrane element, one end of the gas pipeline is connected to the connector, and the other end of the gas pipeline is connected with a gas generation device. The detection assembly comprises a transparent water bin, the transparent water bin is detachably connected to the connector, and the transparent water bin can cover the opening end of the internal pressure type ultrafiltration membrane element. When the internal pressure type ultrafiltration membrane element is detected, the transparent water sump needs to be detached from the connector and the water filling cover is arranged at the opening end; and the connector is connected with the water outlet. And then a gas pipeline connected with a gas generating device can input gas into the water outlet through the connector, and the position of the broken membrane filament can be simply and efficiently judged by observing the bubbling condition of the membrane filament at the opening end through the transparent water sump.

applicante: DONGGUAN FENGSHENG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD
titulo: Ultrafiltration membrane device for waste alkali recovery
abstract: The invention discloses an ultrafiltration membrane device for waste alkali recovery, and belongs to the technical field of ultrafiltration membranes. Comprising a plurality of filtering units arranged according to concentration gradient decreasing, each filtering unit comprises a concentrated chamber and a diluted chamber, a cation exchange membrane is arranged between the concentrated chamber and the diluted chamber, and the preparation method of the cation exchange membrane comprises the following steps: carrying out ester group hydrolysis and acidification on phenolphthalein to obtain carboxylated phenolphthalein; 4, 4 '; 4, 4 '-dichlorodiphenyl sulfone, 4, 4'-dichlorodiphenyl sulfone; -biphenol and carboxylated phenolphthalein are used as raw materials to synthesize hydrophilic polysulfone; performing acylating chlorination modification on carboxyl of the hydrophilic polysulfone to obtain acylating chlorinated polysulfone; reacting the acyl chloride group of the acylating chlorinated polysulfone with the amino group of 8-aminopyrene-1, 3, 6-trisulfonic acid trisodium salt to obtain modified polysulfone resin; and preparing a membrane by taking the modified polysulfone resin, polyvinyl pyrrolidone and N-methyl pyrrolidone as raw materials, so as to obtain the cation exchange membrane. The method is used for improving the hydrophilicity and the anti-pollution capacity of the polysulfone membrane and improving the separation efficiency and the operation stability.

titulo: Ultrafiltration device for phospholipid molecular ball external phase liquid replacement
abstract: The utility model relates to an ultrafiltration device used for phospholipid molecular ball external phase liquid replacement, and relates to the technical field of ultrafiltration equipment, the ultrafiltration device comprises a mixing barrel, the top of the mixing barrel is fixedly connected with a feeding pipe, the middle of the feeding pipe is fixedly connected with a connecting pipe, the other end of the connecting pipe is fixedly connected with a circulating pipe, and the circulating pipe is fixedly connected with a water inlet pipe. A circulating pipe is installed at one end of the mixing barrel, a mixing assembly is installed at the other end of the circulating pipe, the outer side of the mixing assembly is installed on the outer side of the mixing barrel, the mixing assembly comprises a connecting cover, and the connecting cover is fixedly connected to the end of the circulating pipe. The device has the advantages that filtered liquid and raw materials are preliminarily mixed through the mixing cavity and the flow deflectors in the shell, so that the mixing effect is improved, the subsequent mixing time is shortened, the filtered liquid and the raw material liquid can be fully mixed, and the mixing efficiency is improved. Therefore, the subsequent filtering and extracting effect is improved.

applicante: AVIC XIAN AIRCRAFT INDUSTRY GROUP CO LTD
titulo: Electroplating wastewater cross-flow filtration ultrafiltration membrane self-adaptive pulse cleaning control method and system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electroplating wastewater cross-flow filtration ultrafiltration membrane cleaning, and particularly relates to an electroplating wastewater cross-flow filtration ultrafiltration membrane self-adaptive pulse cleaning control method and system.The electroplating wastewater cross-flow filtration ultrafiltration membrane self-adaptive pulse cleaning control method comprises the steps that S1, in the electroplating wastewater cross-flow filtration treatment process, the electroplating wastewater cross-flow filtration ultrafiltration membrane is subjected to pulse cleaning; the transmembrane pressure difference and the water production flux of the ultrafiltration membrane column are collected in real time; s2, calculating a comprehensive pollution index representing a membrane pollution state and a change rate of the comprehensive pollution index according to the transmembrane pressure difference and the water production flux; s3, based on the comprehensive pollution index and the change rate thereof, dynamically determining pulse cleaning parameters through an adaptive decision rule base; s4, according to the pulse cleaning parameters, generating a pulse control signal, and driving a hydraulic drive type self-cleaning device embedded in the ultrafiltration membrane column to execute radial pulse jet cleaning on the ultrafiltration membrane; and S5, evaluating the cleaning effect of the ultrafiltration membrane, adaptively adjusting a decision threshold and a weight coefficient in the adaptive decision rule base according to an evaluation result, and carrying out closed-loop self-optimization.

titulo: Polyampholyte surface modified PES (Polyether Sulfonate) high-pollution-resistance ultrafiltration membrane as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a polyampholyte surface modified PES high-pollution-resistance ultrafiltration membrane and a preparation method and application thereof.The preparation process of the PES high-pollution-resistance ultrafiltration membrane comprises the steps that a PES base membrane is subjected to ozone activating treatment and then soaked in a PEI solution, then PEI is grafted through plasma, bonding of the PEI on the surface of the membrane is enhanced, and the PES high-pollution-resistance ultrafiltration membrane is obtained. And sequentially soaking in a cross-linking agent solution, a tannic acid TA solution and an aluminum ion solution, and finally soaking in water for balancing to obtain the aluminum ion cross-linked PEI/TA polyampholyte surface modified PES hollow fiber ultrafiltration membrane D-PES. The obtained modified ultrafiltration membrane has high stability, a modified layer is not prone to falling off, a flexible macromolecular chain plays a role in energy dissipation due to slippage of a molecular chain, and the mechanical property of membrane filaments is improved. The hydrophilic modified PES hollow fiber ultrafiltration membrane has a wide application prospect in the field of hydrophilic modified PES hollow fiber ultrafiltration membranes for water treatment.

applicante: XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO
titulo: Intelligent regulation and control system and method for ultrafiltration device of boiler make-up water system of thermal power plant
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent regulation and control system and method for an ultrafiltration device of a boiler make-up water system of a thermal power plant, belongs to the technical field of water treatment of the thermal power plant, and aims at solving the technical problems that an existing ultrafiltration device is lagged in control response, blind in membrane pollution control and the like. The system comprises equipment such as a raw water tank, an ultrafiltration feed pump and an ultrafiltration device and various monitoring instruments, parameters such as flow and pressure are collected in real time through a sensing layer, and the parameters are preprocessed and then transmitted to a regulation and control module. Strategies such as load self-adaption, membrane pollution intelligent pre-judgment and medicament adding optimization are adopted, and methods such as double-PID adjustment and membrane pollution index calculation are combined, so that constant flow of the ultrafiltration device, graded cleaning of membrane pollution, automatic fault early-warning disposal and self-use water rate control are realized. The full-flow intelligent closed-loop control of the ultrafiltration device is realized, the energy consumption, the chemical consumption and the operation and maintenance cost are effectively reduced, the operation stability of the system is improved, and the system is suitable for a boiler make-up water ultrafiltration treatment scene of a thermal power plant.

applicante: ZHEJIANG SHENGTENG ENV ENGINEERING CO LTD
titulo: Ultrafiltration membrane water purification system and water purification control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water purification data processing, in particular to an ultrafiltration membrane water purification system and a water purification control method. According to the method, before and after each backwashing process, a constant pressure test and a constant water flux test are set, a corresponding data sequence is collected, and a backwashing utility vector is obtained according to the characteristic difference before and after the backwashing process. The backwashing utility vector is mapped into two removal mode reference axes, and the backwashing balance degree can be obtained according to the difference of mapping results. According to the change of the unit backwashing energy cost of the physical backwashing process, the starting of the chemical backwashing process is controlled in time. The overall physical backwashing difficulty under the current working condition is evaluated according to the change of the backwashing utility vector in the physical backwashing process, and a fixed chemical backwashing process period is set. By timely controlling the starting of the chemical backwashing process, the water purification of the ultrafiltration membrane is effectively intervened, the backwashing efficiency is improved, and the accumulation of irreversible pollution on the surface of the membrane is slowed down.

applicante: WUDI SHENGXING SALT IND CO LTD
titulo: Large-scale seawater desalination ultrafiltration pretreatment device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of sea water desalination, and discloses a large-scale sea water desalination ultrafiltration pretreatment device which comprises a filter bin, a sealing cover is arranged at the top of the filter bin, a connecting pipe is fixedly connected in the filter bin, a threaded pipe is in threaded connection in the sealing cover, and the threaded pipe is in threaded connection with the connecting pipe. The lower surface of the threaded pipe is fixedly connected with a filter screen, the filter screen is attached to the connecting pipe, the bottom of the filter bin is fixedly connected with a water outlet pipe, the top of the sealing cover is fixedly connected with a handle, and the interior of the filter bin is fixedly connected with a first telescopic rod. Seawater is firstly filtered through the filter screen, meanwhile, the sealing cover and the filter screen are convenient to disassemble and replace, when a new filter screen is installed, the connecting rod is fixed in the preset clamping groove through the first spring, the structural stability is guaranteed, the sealing plate and the sealing cover are tightly attached through the elastic force of the second spring in the sealing cover installation process, and the sealing cover is not prone to falling off. The sealing performance of the filtering bin is ensured, so that reliable conditions are provided for seawater filtering.

applicante: BEIJING TINGLAN YOUNENG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD
titulo: AI-based intelligent optimization method and system for chemical cleaning of ultrafiltration membrane
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water treatment, in particular to an AI-based intelligent optimization method and system for chemical cleaning of an ultrafiltration membrane. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation data, adaptively decomposing the operation data into multi-scale time sequence components, quantifying an interaction contribution degree based on an interaction influence matrix to generate a pollution characteristic representation vector, decoupling independent pollution source components through source separation, and identifying types and weights; establishing a cleaning agent cooperative relationship network according to the pollution source type to generate a multi-cleaning agent combination formula and a staged cleaning time sequence scheme, collecting membrane flux response in real time during cleaning, and dynamically adjusting the feeding rate and time sequence parameters according to the deviation from a preset target until the membrane flux reaches the standard. According to the invention, intelligent optimization of chemical cleaning is realized, the cleaning efficiency and the membrane flux recovery effect are improved, and the agent dosage and the operation cost are reduced.

titulo: Method for preparing tremella aurantialba polypeptide and application of tremella aurantialba polypeptide
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of cosmetics, and particularly discloses a method for preparing tremella aurantialba polypeptide and application of the tremella aurantialba polypeptide. Comprising the following steps: (1) degreasing tremella aurantialba powder with petroleum ether to obtain degreased tremella aurantialba powder; (2) adding the degreased tremella aurantialba powder and a compound enzyme into water, and performing ultrasonic-assisted enzymolysis, enzyme deactivation and centrifugation to obtain supernate; (3) performing ultrafiltration on the supernate by using an ultrafiltration membrane with the molecular weight cutoff of 3000Da, collecting filtrate, and drying to obtain tremella aurantialba polypeptide; the preparation method comprises the following steps: degreasing tremella aurantialba powder, carrying out ultrasonic-assisted enzymolysis by using a compound enzyme, and finally carrying out ultrafiltration by using an ultrafiltration membrane with the molecular weight cut-off of 3000Da and an ultrafiltration membrane with the molecular weight cut-off of 10000Da in sequence to obtain the tremella aurantialba polypeptide with excellent moisturizing performance and oxidation resistance, and the yield of the tremella aurantialba polypeptide is high.

applicante: ENERGY CHINA NORTHWEST ELECTRIC POWER TEST RESEARCH INST CO LTD
titulo: Electrode electric heat storage peak shaving electric boiler
abstract: The utility model discloses an electrode electric heat storage peak regulation electric boiler, and belongs to the field of boilers, the electrode electric heat storage peak regulation electric boiler comprises a boiler body and a placing plate, the outer edge of the boiler body is fixedly connected with a connecting pipe, the inner wall of the connecting pipe is fixedly provided with a supporting rod, and one side of the supporting rod is provided with a ceramic filter element layer; water is filtered by arranging the ultrafiltration membrane layer, the reverse osmosis membrane layer and the ceramic filter element layer, the cleanliness of water entering the furnace body is guaranteed, meanwhile, a connecting bolt of a connecting pipe and a communicating pipe can be taken down, and then an abutting ring can be removed from the outer wall of the ultrafiltration membrane layer, so that positioning of the ultrafiltration membrane layer can be relieved, and the service life of the ultrafiltration membrane layer is prolonged. Further, the ceramic filter element layer, the reverse osmosis membrane layer and the ultrafiltration membrane layer can be conveniently taken out to be cleaned and maintained, the passing ability of water flow is ensured, when a starting instruction and peak regulation power given by a DCS are received, if a furnace body is found to have a fault through self-inspection, the fault is reported to the DCS, meanwhile, the power of the fault furnace body is subtracted from the total power of a heat supply network, and the furnace body is prepared for starting.

applicante: HUNAN WUXING BIOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD
titulo: Process for preparing high-activity cartilage extract through efficient enzymolysis
abstract: The invention discloses a process for preparing a high-activity cartilage extract through efficient enzymolysis, and belongs to the technical field of bioactive substance extraction. The process comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out low-temperature cleaning, crushing and fluid extraction degreasing on a cartilage raw material, then preparing a suspension from pretreated cartilage and a phosphate buffer solution, carrying out constant-temperature enzymolysis and in-situ assembly by adopting MCM-41 type mesoporous silica loaded compound enzyme and combining with a soybean peptide template, and separating a carrier to obtain an enzymatic hydrolysate; carrying out pH adjustment, argon and air mixed gas microbubble and ultrasonic treatment, and filtering to obtain a crude extract; and then carrying out ultrafiltration grading, nanofiltration desalination, pH regulation stirring reinforcement, ultrafiltration concentration, spray drying and sieving to obtain the high-activity cartilage extract. Through the synergistic effect of mesoporous confinement targeted enzymolysis and polypeptide template in-situ assembly, the enzymolysis efficiency and the active ingredient retention rate are remarkably improved, so that the product forms a stable nano structure, the water solubility and dispersion uniformity are greatly improved, and the purity and storage stability of the product are effectively improved.
termos_detectados: ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, extraction, drying, spray drying

applicante: KUNMING EDIBLE MUSHROOM RESEARCH INST ALL CHINA FEDERATION OF SUPPLY AND MARKETING COOPERATIVES
titulo: ACE inhibitory active peptide derived from tricholoma matsutake as well as preparation method and application of ACE inhibitory active peptide
abstract: The invention discloses a tricholoma matsutake-sourced ACE (angiotensin converting enzyme) inhibitory active peptide as well as a preparation method and application thereof, relates to the technical field of biology, establishes an integrated method of double enzymolysis-ultrafiltration fractionation-LC-MS/MS identification-bioinformatics and molecular docking simulation screening, and realizes efficient and directional screening and identification from tricholoma matsutake to obtain a novel ACE inhibitory peptide. The tricholoma matsutake-sourced ACE inhibitory peptide with a clear sequence, high activity and excellent properties is obtained by screening through the method, so that the biological source of the ACE inhibitory peptide is expanded, the precise development of tricholoma matsutake which is a precious edible mushroom protein resource is also realized, and the high-added-value utilization approach of tricholoma matsutake is expanded.

titulo: SUPERCRITICAL FLUID RELATED PROCESS MONITORING APPARATUS AND METHOD OF USE THEREOF
abstract: [0000]    The invention comprises a method for monitoring a material processed with a supercritical fluid, comprising the steps of: generating a control signal from photons passed through at least a portion of the material; processing the material in the supercritical fluid inside a supercritical fluid chamber, the supercritical fluid chamber pressurized to a pressure of greater than thirteen bar; and controlling the step of processing with a controller and the control signal, with optional steps any of: determining a termination time of the step of processing with the control signal; controlling movement of a mechanical system, subsequent to the step of determining the termination time, to move the material out of the supercritical fluid chamber; and injecting molecular hydrogen from the supercritical fluid chamber into a Fischer-Tropsch system.

titulo: System and Method for Adaptive Semiconductor Process Control
abstract: [0000]    A system and method for adaptive semiconductor process control integrates multi-modal sensor data, predictive modeling, and real-time optimization to dynamically manage semiconductor manufacturing processes. The system includes sensors collecting diverse process data, a processor that maintains a state model using particle-based estimation techniques, a knowledge graph for representing process relationships and economic factors, and a controller that adaptively adjusts manufacturing equipment. The processor generates topology-aware features from the state model by computing persistent homology at multiple scales and performing feature matching with confidence scoring. An upper confidence tree (UCT) optimization algorithm with super-exponential regret bounds dynamically adjusts exploration factors based on risk-weighted calculations. The system incorporates economic factors such as wafer value, energy costs, and maintenance costs while implementing just-in-context, just-in-time, and just-in-place measurement strategies. This enables comprehensive process monitoring and control while optimizing both technical performance and economic outcomes.
