titulo: METHODS FOR SYSTEM MONITORING AND ASSESSMENT
abstract: [0000]    A process monitoring system, the system comprising: one or more sensors; and a processor in communication with the one or more sensors, the processor is configured to: select a first system checkpoint for performing process monitoring on a robotic system; measure system variables using the one or more sensors at the first system checkpoint; capture one or more images of the robotic system using a vision sensor at the first system checkpoint; generate at least one prediction image of the robotic system using a prediction model with the system variables as input to the prediction model; and perform anomaly detection by comparing the one or more images of the robotic system against the at least one prediction image.

titulo: CONTINUAL LEARNING METHOD AND DEVICE WITH ADAPTIVE MEMORY MECHANISM FOR PREDICTIVE PROCESS MONITORING
abstract: 예측적 프로세스 모니터링을 위한 적응형 메모리 기반의 연속 학습 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 일실시예에 따른, 예측적 프로세스 모니터링을 위한 적응형 메모리 기반의 연속 학습 방법은, 시간 경과에 따라 실시된 태스크에서 생성되는 데이터를, 태스크 별 메모리 버퍼에 유지하면서 학습하는 연속 학습에 있어, 메모리 버퍼와, 현재의 태스크에서 생성되는 데이터에 대한 관계 엔트로피를 계산하는 단계; 상기 메모리 버퍼에 대해 계산된 관계 엔트로피를 포함하는 분포(Bi)와, 상기 현재의 태스크에서 생성되는 데이터에 대해 계산된 관계 엔트로피를 포함하는 분포(DT) 간의, 와서스테인 거리 기반의 발산을 측정하는 단계; 및 상기 측정된 발산을 근거하여 상기 메모리 버퍼 각각에 대해 적응적 가중치를 할당하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

titulo: METHOD OF OPTIMAL PROCESS MONITORING WASTERWATER TREATMENT PLANT AND SYSTEM PERFORMING THEREOF
abstract: 본 발명에 따른 하폐수처리장 최적공정모니터링 방법은 반응기 내 생물학적 처리 데이터를 실시간으로 수신하는 데이터 수신 단계; 상기 수신된 데이터를 기반으로 용존 산소 곡선 및 미생물 산소 섭취율 곡선을 생성하고, 상기 곡선의 변화 패턴을 분석하여 미생물 활성도 및 유입수 독성 여부를 판단하는 분석 단계; 상기 분석 결과에 따라 반응기의 운전 상태 및 진행 중인 공정 단계를 포함하는 제어 상태 정보를 생성하는 상태 판단 단계; 상기 분석 결과에 따라 산소 섭취율이 기준값 이하로 감소하는 경우 독성 물질 유입 가능성을 판단하고 경고 신호를 생성하는 이상 판단 단계; 및 상기 실시간 데이터, 분석 결과 및 이상 판단 결과를 데이터 로그 형태로 저장 및 표시하는 로그 관리 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

titulo: SYSTÈME ET PROCÉDÉ DE SUIVI DE PROCESSUS CMP
abstract: A method for monitoring a chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) process, according to an aspect of the technical idea of the present disclosure, comprises the steps of: sensing a gas generated from the surface of a substrate during the CMP process; monitoring, on the basis of the sensing results, a polishing state of a material to be polished, which is deposited on the substrate; and storing the monitoring results.

titulo: System for Monitoring, Logging, and Traceability of Operational Data for a Towable Recreational Vehicle
abstract: [0000]    The present invention relates to a safety status monitoring and traceable management system for a travel trailer. The safety status monitoring and traceable management system for a travel trailer collects data such as total driving mileage, maintenance status, vehicle speed, wheel status, hitch weight, temperature and humidity inside and outside the travel trailer, and the travel trailer's level attitude via a sensor module; a data processing center analyzes the data and generates operating logs or abnormal logs, a data storage module stores the logs to achieve full-process monitoring and assist in accident reconstruction, and a user interaction interface displays the current travel trailer status and related alert information to the travel trailer user.

titulo: INSPECTION DE VOLUME 3D RAPIDE DE TRANCHES DE SEMI-CONDUCTEUR À RÉSOLUTION EN PROFONDEUR ACCRUE
abstract: The present invention relates to a three-dimensional circuit pattern inspection method of repetitive semiconductor structures within wafers, more particularly, to a method, computer program product and a corresponding semiconductor inspection system for determining parameters of 3D objects such as HAR structures within a semiconductor wafer with increased depth resolution. The method employs a milling and imaging of at least one cross-section surface at a slanted angle with respect to the surface of a wafer. The method, computer program product and device can be used for quantitative metrology, defect detection, process monitoring, defect review, and inspection of integrated circuits within semiconductor wafers.

titulo: ENSEMBLE DE CONDENSATEURS ET PROCÉDÉ DE FABRICATION D'ENSEMBLE DE CONDENSATEURS
abstract: In the present invention, a plurality of capacitors are arranged in a capacitor formation region in a plan view from the thickness direction of a silicon wafer. Each of the plurality of capacitors includes a first porous portion, an insulator portion, a dielectric layer, and a conductor layer. The first porous portion has a plurality of first pores extending along the thickness direction of the silicon wafer. The insulator portion surrounds the first porous portion in the plan view from the thickness direction of the silicon wafer. At least one process monitoring portion includes a second porous portion. The second porous portion includes a first porous region and a second porous region. The first porous region has a plurality of second pores extending along the thickness direction of the silicon wafer. The second porous region surrounds the first porous region and has a plurality of third pores extending along an oblique direction inclined with respect to the thickness direction of the silicon wafer.

titulo: FIELD REPLACEABLE ELECTRONIC RETURN FOR ACTUATOR
abstract: Systems/methods for providing an electronic return module for a valve and damper actuator that can be easily installed and replaced in the field includes a backup power source. The backup power source ensures that the actuator has sufficient power to return a valve or damper to a predefined fail-safe position in case of a power supply interruption. The electronic return module advantageously uses supercapacitors as the backup power source that can quickly release the electrical energy stored and require a relatively short recharge time. Circuitry and firmware are provided for monitoring the supercapacitors for indications of operational or performance degradation and issue an alert signal to a user or process monitoring system to indicate that repair or replacement is needed. In some embodiments, the electronic return module may include an optional protective enclosure that protects the module.

applicante: YANCHENG TECHNICIAN COLLEGE OF JIANGSU PROVINCE JIANGSU YANCHENG SENIOR TECHNICAL SCHOOL YANCHENG IN
titulo: Welding operation process monitoring method and system based on visual perception
abstract: The invention discloses a welding operation process monitoring method and system based on visual perception, and relates to the technical field of industrial production process monitoring, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining image data containing a welding area and human body key points of an operator at the same time; recognizing the image data through a human body key point recognition model and a solder tip recognition model, and performing human body posture safety monitoring; cutting out a human body local image needing to be protected from the image data based on the position information of the human body key points, performing identification through a corresponding protector identification model, and performing protector wearing safety monitoring; acquiring a reference position of a bonding pad, and performing welding contact time monitoring in combination with the position information of the solder tip; and cutting out a welding spot local image from the image data after welding based on the reference position of the bonding pad, carrying out identification through a welding spot identification model, and carrying out welding quality monitoring. According to the invention, the integrated automatic monitoring of the welding operation can be realized, and the welding consistency and the operation safety are improved.

titulo: Lubricating oil filtering separation process monitoring intelligent control system and method
abstract: The invention relates to the field of industrial intelligent control, and discloses an intelligent control system and method for monitoring a lubricating oil filtering and separating process, and the method comprises the steps that edge control equipment calculates an equivalent structure resistance coefficient and a gradient of a filter material in real time, and generates an action space mask, so as to carry out prospective safety constraint on action selection of a reinforcement learning module; and the industrial cloud platform gathers cluster data uploaded by the plurality of edge devices, and executes joint decoupling optimization to calculate to-be-updated control parameters. Before the to-be-updated parameters are issued, physical and control double-layer off-line evaluation needs to be carried out through the cloud platform; and after being issued to the edge equipment, the edge equipment can be formally started through shadow mode verification, and a version rollback mechanism is set. According to the method, a closed-loop optimization architecture of cloud edge cooperation is constructed, physical mechanism constraint and swarm intelligent optimization are combined, the contradiction between control strategy adaptability and operation safety is solved, and the self-adaptive capacity of the system and the overall process benefits are improved.

titulo: Intracellular enzyme activity parameter acquisition method based on dynamic metabolic disturbance
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic metabolic disturbance-based intracellular enzyme activity parameter acquisition method, which comprises a pulse application step and a process monitoring step, the pulse application step is to apply at least one controlled pulse to a substrate in a steady-state or quasi-steady-state culture process; the process monitoring step is to record process parameters after the controlled pulse is applied. Dynamic changes of extracellular glucose, ethanol, glycerol, biomass, CER, OUR and other parameters are monitored online or offline, samples are collected at multiple time points after pulse disturbance, and corresponding proteomics data are obtained. On the basis of flux estimation and absolute quantitative proteomics results under the disturbance condition, intracellular enzyme activity parameters at different time points and in different physiological states are calculated, and enzyme parameters with higher coverage are obtained. According to the method, a repeatable dynamic disturbance scheme capable of being popularized among multiple chassis microorganisms is established, and a more comprehensive and reusable parameter basis is provided for metabolic flux analysis and dynamic modeling.

titulo: Design method supporting heterogeneous serial port communication of multiple terminal nodes
abstract: The invention provides a design method for supporting multi-terminal node heterogeneous serial port communication, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a serial port instruction communication control basic structure which comprises an instruction communication main body structure used for a master control node to send an instruction to a terminal, and a process monitoring structure used for monitoring an instruction communication process; constructing a serial port telemetering transmission processing basic structure which comprises a telemetering transmission main body structure for the terminal to send telemetering data to the master control node and a process monitoring structure for monitoring a telemetering data transmission process; on the basis of the basic structure, a heterogeneous serial port instruction communication processing mechanism is executed, diversified instruction communication requirements of terminal nodes can be supported, and the instruction communication process is monitored and evaluated; and executing a heterogeneous serial port telemetering transmission processing mechanism, supporting different types of telemetering data transmission requirements of the terminal nodes, and monitoring the acquisition and receiving process of the telemetering data. Therefore, the differential serial port communication requirements of a large number of different types of terminal equipment nodes of satellites can be met.

applicante: SHANGHAI QUZHI NETWORK TECH CO LTD
titulo: Vending machine intelligent interaction UI design method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a vending machine intelligent interaction UI design method and system. According to the method, environment light and user biological characteristic data are collected in real time by deploying a hardware sensing module, a user portrait engine is utilized to identify a user type, and a dynamic portrait is constructed in combination with historical purchase records; three-dimensional scene adaptation decisions such as environment adaptation based on light intensity, barrier-free adaptation based on user types and layout adaptation based on deployment scenes are executed, a UI interface is dynamically reconstructed and rendered, intelligent content recommendation and multi-mode interaction are executed, and finally closed-loop control is completed through a transaction process monitoring and emergency feedback mechanism. Through cooperative work of the hardware sensing module, the user portrait engine, the scene adaptation algorithm and the dynamic interaction module, full-dimension optimization of the UI is realized.

titulo: Coating production control method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of coating production, in particular to a coating production control method and system, and the method comprises the following steps: data collection: collecting key process data of each production process in real time, including raw material feeding amount, dispersion fineness, reaction temperature and viscosity value; model establishment: establishing an error accumulation model, and dynamically calculating a deviation accumulation value of a current process input parameter and an upstream process output parameter; performing risk grading judgment: triggering high/medium/low three-level risk early warning according to the accumulated deviation value and a preset threshold value; and directional process compensation: process parameters are automatically adjusted or a remedial formula is started for a high-risk process. The system comprises a memory and a processor. According to the method, cross-process cooperative control is achieved, the problem of islanding of a traditional process is solved, full-process linkage is achieved through quantization error transmission, and cutting of single-process monitoring is reduced.

applicante: SHIHENG SPECIAL STEEL GROUP CO LTD
titulo: Intelligent slag disintegrating treatment method and system for steel slag
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of process control, in particular to an intelligent slag disintegrating treatment method and system.The method comprises the steps that in response to a starting instruction, an automatic control system obtains initial characteristic parameters of steel slag, and a corresponding steel slag treatment model is matched and called from a model library; in the slag disintegrating process, temperature, pressure and humidity parameters are obtained in real time through an intelligent sensing system, the pressure, the temperature and the slag disintegrating time are dynamically adjusted according to the model, and meanwhile the slag disintegrating state is dynamically monitored through the process monitoring model; carrying out self-optimization correction on the model according to the deviation between the whole-process recorded data and an expected treatment target after slag disintegration is finished, and generating an optimized steel slag treatment model; and storing the optimized model into a model library, and updating the steel slag treatment model corresponding to the initial characteristic parameters. Intelligent, self-adaptive control and continuous optimization of steel slag disintegrating treatment are achieved.
termos_detectados: process monitoring, process control, automatic control

titulo: Investigation and sampling method for high-iron-manganese underground water
abstract: The invention discloses a high-iron-manganese underground water investigation and sampling method, and relates to the technical field of water resource management, sampling data of high-iron-manganese underground water can truly reflect an in-situ chemical state of a water-bearing layer through oxidation-reduction whole-process monitoring, inert material guarantee, an anaerobic technical chain and accurate form separation treatment, and investigation preparation is carried out before sampling; performing low-flow pre-well-flushing operation; collecting samples and performing grading treatment; sample treatment and quality control; according to the method, oxidation-reduction potential (ORP) monitoring is introduced, an inert material is adopted to isolate oxygen, graded filtration and in-situ fixation are implemented, biological inactivation control measures are configured, and layered accurate collection is realized by adopting a layered sampler; the problem of oxidation distortion in the sampling process of the high-iron-manganese underground water is solved, the accuracy of subsequent data detection is ensured, and reliable data support is provided for subsequent environmental survey, hydrogeological survey and drinking water source assessment.

titulo: Recovery mode firmware self-repairing method and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention provides a recovery mode firmware self-repairing method and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring system firmware, wherein a pre-compiled recovery mode firmware mirror image file is preset in a preset path of the system firmware; the method comprises the following steps: in a normal mode in a device starting process, monitoring the number of abnormal boot times of a recovery mode, and if the number of abnormal boot times exceeds a threshold value, judging that firmware in the recovery mode is damaged, recording a damage mark and normally starting the system firmware; and when the system firmware is started, repairing the recovery mode firmware partition by using the preset recovery mode firmware mirror image file according to the damage mark. According to the method and the device, automatic and accurate repair of the recovery mode firmware is realized, the problems that equipment cannot be upgraded, factory settings cannot be recovered and bricks are possibly changed due to damage of the recovery mode firmware are solved, and the reliability and the maintainability of the equipment are improved.

applicante: BEIYI SEMICONDUCTOR TECH GUANGDONG CO LTD
titulo: Furnace temperature curve acquisition and analysis method based on multi-channel thermocouple
abstract: The invention discloses a furnace temperature curve acquisition and analysis method based on multi-channel thermocouples, and relates to the field of thermal process monitoring, and the method comprises the steps: synchronously acquiring temperature data output by thermocouples at a plurality of temperature measurement positions in an industrial furnace and corresponding time information based on preset acquisition parameters, and forming a multi-channel original temperature data set; the multi-channel original temperature data set is analyzed and calibrated, and furnace temperature curves corresponding to the channels are reconstructed based on a unified time axis; based on preset process model parameters, process section identification and feature extraction are carried out on the furnace temperature curve of each channel, and quantitative evaluation indexes are calculated; and performing visual presentation based on the furnace temperature curve, the process section identifier, the characteristic parameters and the quantitative evaluation result, and generating a furnace temperature analysis report. Through multi-channel synchronous acquisition and process model analysis, automatic quantitative evaluation of the furnace temperature curve is realized, single-point process conformity and multi-point collaboration can be evaluated at the same time, and accurate guidance is provided for process optimization.

applicante: CHENGDU BOWEI SHULUAN TECH CO LTD
titulo: Multi-modal fusion field operation process verification method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-modal fusion field operation process verification method and system, and relates to the field of operation process monitoring, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the initialization and clock synchronization of multi-modal hardware, and carrying out the streaming collection of field operation multi-modal data; generating an allowable action set according to the current SOP node, and obtaining a plurality of expected action vectors and risk level thresholds; sequentially performing spatial hard filtering and action feature coding on the field operation multi-modal data to obtain a real-time action vector; and obtaining a semantic consistency score based on the real-time action vector and the expected action vector, and verifying the field operation process and determining a verification result in combination with a risk level threshold. The system comprises a multi-mode acquisition module, an expected action determination module, a real-time action acquisition module and an operation verification module. According to the method, the problems that in the prior art, accurate monitoring of field operation cannot be achieved, and missing detection exists are solved, and real-time semantic consistency verification and hierarchical intervention of the field operation process are achieved.

applicante: CHENGDU XINCHUANGJIE AUTOMATION EQUIPMENT CO LTD
titulo: Intelligent monitoring method and system of high-voltage reactive power compensation device for new energy station
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electrical equipment, in particular to an intelligent monitoring method and system for a high-voltage reactive power compensation device of a new energy station, and aims to accurately predict the theoretical temperature of a component under a specific working condition by using an LSTM model trained based on health data and combining a control signal and in-cabinet and environment temperature to construct input characteristics. The residual error is generated by comparing the actual temperature, the deviation degree can be quantified, and a basis is provided for early abnormality discovery. Residual error distribution is analyzed, and temperature difference distribution characteristics between components and a cross-period residual error change trend are fused. The three-dimensional analysis of space (temperature difference) + time (trend) + deviation (residual error) can effectively distinguish cooling system faults, sudden component damage and progressive component aging, and avoids misjudgment of a single index. According to the invention, the problem of lagging fault discovery in the prior art is solved, various abnormal situations can be accurately analyzed, and operation and maintenance personnel are helped to carry out automatic whole-process monitoring on the reactive power compensation device.

titulo: Universal Construction for Storing, Pumping, Mixing, Diffusing, Reacting, and Separating Fluids
abstract: [0000]    A construction and a methodology for handling common fluid unit operations: pumping, mixing, separating, reacting, diffusing, storing. A single universal design is parametrized per each unit operation. The construction is modular, basic unit operations are fit together into concise, efficient, manufacturing process. Designed to fit into AI-guided process control.

titulo: VERTEILUNG VON STEUEREINHEITEN IN PROZESSLEITSYSTEMEN
abstract: [0001]    Generation of a computational time slot distribution schedule for a set of control units is described in the present application. The set of control unit represents computer processing tasks that are performed by a plurality of computer controllers included in a process control system, such as but not limited to an industrial process control system, in order to operate the process control system in a desired manner.

titulo: Hybrid Quantum-Enhanced Process Control System
abstract: [0000]    A quantum-enhanced semiconductor process control system addresses quantum effects in advanced semiconductor manufacturing through integrated tunneling prediction and physics-informed neural networks with quantum corrections. The system combines a quantum tunneling prediction module using high-resolution edge sensors and coherence detectors, a state model with particle-based quantum estimation, and a physics-informed neural network incorporating both classical and quantum physics layers. An upper confidence tree optimization algorithm with super-exponential regret bounds generates control signals for manufacturing equipment. The dynamic process window adaptation module performs quantum state assessment, potential barrier recalculation, and edge roughness projection in real-time. This quantum-aware approach achieves significant improvements in edge placement accuracy, pattern variation control, and manufacturing yield at sub-5 nm technology nodes where quantum phenomena directly impact fabrication outcomes.

titulo: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR MEDICAL DEVICE MODULE DETECTION
abstract: [0000]    Certain aspects of the disclosure provide systems and techniques for operating medical devices. An example method includes obtaining over a period of time, an inrush current of one or more hardware modules connected to the process control unit; determining a respective type of each of the one or more hardware modules based on the inrush current; and operating the process control unit based on the respective type of each of the one or more hardware modules.

titulo: VORRICHTUNG UND VERFAHREN ZUR STEUERUNG EINES BATTERIEPACKPROZESSES
abstract: [0001]    The present disclosure relates to a battery pack process control apparatus and method, and a technical problem to be solved is to effectively track a wireless battery management system (WBMS) by identifying a location and movement speed thereof in real time, and to accurately identify the WBMS (10). Thus, the present disclosure provides a battery pack process control apparatus (100), which transmits and receives signals for detecting a WBMS (10) moving along a production line, detects the WBMS (10) based on the transmitted signal and received signal of the communication unit (130), determines a location and speed of the WBMS (10), identifies and tracks the WBMS (10) in real time, and controls a designated program to be flashed to the WBMS (10) when the WBMS (10) reaches a designated flashing location, and a battery pack process control method.

titulo: AI AI-BASED REAL-TIME PROCESS CONTROL SYSTEM FOR MULTI-TYPE DISPENSING
abstract: 본 발명은, 다종 디스펜싱용 AI 기반 실시간 공정 제어 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 디스펜싱 장비에 교환 장착되는 디스펜싱 모듈의 종류를 식별하고 모듈 식별 정보를 출력하는 모듈 식별부; 기판 위에 도포된 유체의 도포 결과물을 촬영하여 도포 결과 이미지를 생성하는 이미지 비전부; 다종의 디스펜싱 모듈별로 공정 파라미터 세트와 도포 결과 이미지와 양부(良不) 여부 및 불량 유형을 학습한 다종 AI 검사 모델을 포함하고, 상기 모듈 식별부로부터 출력된 모듈 식별 정보에 대응하는 AI 검사 모델로 전환하여, 상기 이미지 비전부로부터 획득된 도포 결과 이미지에 근거하여 도포 품질이 불량으로 판정되는 경우 기학습된 불량 유형에 따라 보정된 공정 파라미터 세트를 출력하는 AI 처리부; 및 상기 AI 처리부의 보정된 공정 파라미터 세트에 따라 상기 디스펜싱 장비의 공정 파라미터를 실시간으로 조정하는 과정을 공정 중에 반복하는 시스템 제어부를 포함한다.

titulo: REDUNDANT ALIAS MANAGEMENT
abstract: [0000]    Various implementations described herein relate to managing redundant aliases. In various implementations, an alias registered to multiple nodes of a process automation facility may be identified, each node including a sensor or actuator. The method includes using the alias, concurrently subscribing to first and second nodes of the multiple nodes. While concurrently subscribed to both the first and second nodes, and while a first criterion is satisfied, the method includes exchanging data with the first and second nodes. The method further includes, based on the data exchanged with the first node, contributing to a process control loop of the process automation facility. The method further includes disregarding data received from the second node. Upon determining that the first criterion is no longer satisfied or that a second criterion is satisfied, the method includes exchanging data with at least the second node. The method further includes, based on the data exchanged with the second node, contributing to the same process control loop or a different process control loop of the process automation facility.

titulo: COMMANDE DE MOTEUR D'OUTIL À IMPULSIONS ÉLECTRIQUES À L'AIDE DE MULTIPLES ENTRÉES
abstract: A pulse tool may include a motor which may be configured to output rotational movement via a motor shaft, a drive assembly which may be operably coupled to the motor shaft to transmit rotational movement of the motor shaft to an end effector for acting upon a work piece, an angle sensor which may measure an angular position of the motor shaft, position control circuitry which may control the angular position of the motor shaft based on feedback from the angle sensor, and process control circuitry which may control the position control circuitry using a combined control value and feedback from the position control circuitry. The process control circuitry may include a control algorithm that may control the position control circuitry based on the angular position of the motor shaft and the combined control value. The combined control value may be based on multiple other control values.

titulo: COMMANDE DE MOTEUR D'OUTIL À IMPULSIONS ÉLECTRIQUES
abstract: A pulse tool may include a motor which may output rotational movement via a motor shaft, a drive assembly which may be operably coupled to the motor shaft to transmit rotational movement of the motor shaft to an end effector for acting upon a work piece, an angle sensor which may measure an angular position of the motor shaft, position control circuitry which may control the angular position of the motor shaft based on feedback from the angle sensor, and process control circuitry which may control the position control circuitry using a control value and the position control circuitry. The control value may be a torque output value indicative of the amount of torque applied to the end effector. The process control circuitry may include a control algorithm that may control the rotational movement of the motor based on the angular position of the motor shaft.

titulo: COMMANDE DE MOTEUR D'OUTIL À IMPULSIONS ÉLECTRIQUES PAR RIGIDITÉ D'ARTICULATION
abstract: A pulse tool may include a motor which may output rotational movement via a motor shaft, a drive assembly which may transmit rotational movement of the motor shaft to an end effector for acting upon a work piece, an angle sensor which may measure an angular position of the motor shaft, position control circuitry which may control the angular position of the motor shaft based on feedback from the angle sensor, and process control circuitry which may be configured to control the position control circuitry using a first control value and feedback from the position control circuitry. The process control circuitry may include a control algorithm that may control the rotational movement of the motor based on the angular position of the motor shaft and the first control value. The first control value may be based on the angular position of the motor shaft and a joint stiffness value.

titulo: COMMANDE DE MOTEUR D'OUTIL À IMPULSIONS ÉLECTRIQUES UTILISANT UNE VITESSE DE REBOND
abstract: A pulse tool may include a motor which may be configured to output rotational movement via a motor shaft, a drive assembly which may be operably coupled to the motor shaft to transmit rotational movement of the motor shaft to an end effector for acting upon a work piece, an angle sensor which may measure an angular position of the motor shaft, position control circuitry which may control the angular position of the motor shaft based on feedback from the angle sensor, and process control circuitry which may control the position control circuitry using a first control value and feedback from the position control circuitry. The process control circuitry may include a control algorithm that may control the position control circuitry based on the angular position of the motor shaft and the first control value. The first control value may be based on a rebound velocity of the motor shaft.

titulo: COMMANDE DE MOTEUR D'OUTIL À IMPULSIONS ÉLECTRIQUES À L'AIDE D'UNE DÉCÉLÉRATION DE MOTEUR
abstract: A pulse tool may include a motor which may be configured to output rotational movement via a motor shaft, a drive assembly which may be operably coupled to the motor shaft to transmit rotational movement of the motor shaft to an end effector for acting upon a work piece, an angle sensor which may measure an angular position of the motor shaft, position control circuitry which may control the angular position of the motor shaft based on feedback from the angle sensor, and process control circuitry which may control the position control circuitry using a first control value and feedback from the position control circuitry. The process control circuitry may include a control algorithm that may control the position control circuitry based on the angular position of the motor shaft and the first control value. The first control value may be based on a deceleration of the motor shaft.

titulo: COMMANDE DE MOTEUR D'OUTIL ÉLECTRIQUE À IMPULSIONS COMPORTANT UNE PHASE DE RÉDUCTION DE PUISSANCE
abstract: A pulse tool may include a motor which may rotate a motor shaft, a drive assembly which may be operably coupled to the motor shaft to transmit rotational movement of the motor shaft to act upon a work piece, an angle sensor which may measure an angular position of the motor shaft, position control circuitry which may control the angular position of the motor shaft based on feedback from the angle sensor, and process control circuitry which may control the position control circuitry using a control value and the position control circuitry. The control value may be a torque output value indicative of the amount of torque applied to the end effector. The process control circuitry may include a control algorithm that may include a first phase in which the tool may operate at a first pulse intensity and a second phase in which the tool may operate at a reduced pulse intensity.

titulo: ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING SYSTEM WITH ROTATABLE DEPOSITION HEAD AND INTEGRATED MATERIAL FEED
abstract: An additive manufacturing machine (AMM) features a deposition head capable of rotation in a range of 360 degrees or more relative to a material holder. A material pathway delivers additive manufacturing material to the deposition head. This pathway either utilizes a rotary union with the material routed internally or externally or comprises a flexible conduit with a support system. A two-stage material supply is also described. This rotation capability facilitates a consistent path-relative deposition orientation for improved process control.

titulo: SYSTÈMES ET PROCÉDÉS DE MESURE PAR COURANTS DE FOUCAULT IN SITU À COMPENSATION GÉOMÉTRIQUE
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for detecting, characterizing, and correcting defects and material property variations in additively manufactured components using geometry‑aware analysis of in‑situ sensor data. Multi‑channel sensor data acquired during a layer‑by‑layer build is spatially registered to build coordinates and organized along paths that follow geometric features such as edges, corners, walls, holes, or other evolving features. Sensor responses along the paths are processed to extract characteristic signatures associated with defects and non‑defect indications. Ground‑truth defect information from seeded defects and/or post‑production inspection is used to label the signatures and train supervised machine‑learning models. The trained models are applied to additional in‑situ data to identify defect locations, types, and severity during or after fabrication. The disclosure further includes techniques for estimating material properties from eddy current sensor measurements while compensating for geometric effects using electromagnetic modeling, deconvolution, or combinations thereof, enabling real‑time monitoring, post‑production analysis, and process control.

titulo: PROZESSSTEUERUNGSSYSTEM MIT AUTOMATISCHER ERZEUGUNG VON MENSCH-MASCHINE-SCHNITTSTELLEN
abstract: A system for generating a human-machine interface (HMI) from control code having standard objects. Control code is generated from a model of an automation system suitable for generating a three-dimensional rendering of the automation system and simulating the automation system. The model may also be used for is used for SIL and HIL testing. Standard objects form the control code are used to generate an HMI that includes status indicators for an actuator and control elements for an actuator. The generated HMI is linked to the data sources for the status indicators and the actuator controlled by the control elements. Interacting with the HMI causes a change in the behavior (e.g., position, etc.) of the actuators and results in affecting a condition of the process control environment.

titulo: BELICHTUNGSVERFAHREN UND -VORRICHTUNG
abstract: [0001]    A method of exposing a substrate to a patterned radiation beam, the method comprising: providing a patterning device for a multi-field exposure, the patterning device having at least two identical patterns arranged thereon in a scanning direction; determining at least one process control parameter; determining an exposure layout for the substrate based on the at least one process control parameter; and exposing the substrate according to the exposure layout.

titulo: DISPOSITIF, PROCÉDÉ ET PROGRAMME DE PRISE EN CHARGE DE COMMANDE DE PROCESSUS
abstract: Provided is a device comprising: a first measurement unit that measures a property of a fluid in a first container that contains the fluid; and a processor. The processor performs an index value calculation process for calculating a property index value of the fluid on the basis of the measurement result from the first measurement unit, and a control process for controlling process termination timing for the fluid on the basis of time-series changes in the calculated property index value. The property index value increases as a value indicating the measurement result from the first measurement unit approaches a target value, and decreases or becomes constant after reaching the target value, or decreases as the value indicating the measurement result from the first measurement unit approaches the target value, and increases or becomes constant after reaching the target value.

titulo: Adaptive Multi-Tier AI System with Hierarchical Tiny LLM Architecture, Hybrid AI Mesh Network Integrating Bluetooth and Multi-Protocol Communication, Offline-to-Online AI Learning, Dual-Mode Operations, and AI-Optimized Industrial Control for Scalable Applications
abstract: An adaptive AI system employing hierarchical tiny LLM architecture, a hybrid AI mesh network (Bluetooth, Thread, Wi-Fi, and industrial protocols), and offline-to-online learning for robust, real-time industrial control. The invention uses dual-mode operations to switch between low-power and AI-optimized states, maximizing resource efficiency. Embedded, edge, and cloud components cooperate to deliver dynamic process control, predictive maintenance, and anomaly detection across multiple industries. This multi-tier approach enhances scalability, reliability, and adaptability, making it suitable for smart manufacturing, energy management, healthcare, military, and other mission-critical applications.

titulo: MECHATRONIC MOBILE SCRAP PROCESSING LINE WITH INTELLIGENT VISUAL INSPECTION AND PROCESS CONTROL
abstract: The utility model relates to a mechatronic mobile scrap processing line with intelligent visual inspection and process control. The line comprises a functionally integrated mobile scrap processing line, a module for digital monitoring and visual inspection, and a system for monitoring, planning and controlling processes. The mobile scrap processing line includes equipment for sorting, shredding, compacting and/or processing metallic and non-metallic waste materials. The digital monitoring and visual inspection module comprises cameras, sensors and image processing equipment for monitoring technological processes, identifying materials, controlling loading and tracking the condition of equipment. The monitoring, planning and control system comprises hardware and/or software tools for collecting, processing and analysing data, as well as for the centralised management, coordination and planning of scrap processing operations. This utility model is used in recycling and metallurgical plants, waste treatment sites and other industrial facilities.

titulo: PROCESS TARGET OPTIMIZATION PROCESSES
abstract: The present disclosure relates to target optimization processes and, more particularly, to an advanced process control method for process target optimization and methods of use. The method includes: updating, by the computing device, target metrology values in a metrology vector with measured metrology values; predicting, by the computing device, an effect on a set of final process targets using the updated metrology vector using a model based on simulation data; adjusting, by the computing device, one or more downstream metrology targets in the metrology vector to achieve the set of final process targets; and applying, by the computing device, process retargeting for the one or more downstream metrology targets.

titulo: SYSTÈME ET PROCÉDÉ DE SURVEILLANCE EN TEMPS RÉEL ET DE COMMANDE ADAPTATIVE DE BATTERIE
abstract: A system (100) for real-time monitoring and adaptive control of a battery is disclosed A pre-installed battery management system (105) measures battery data including cell voltage, pack voltage, current measurements, state of charge, cell temperature, and state of health. The supervisory control board (115) receives an operational command from the host (110) to manage battery operations including regulating battery parameters, controlling charge and discharge processes, managing safety mechanisms, and optimizing battery performance. A data acquisition module (130) captures real-time battery data, while a processing module (135) analyzes it using a combination of one or more methods to re-estimate battery state parameters. The processing module generates a renewed control strategy and modifies operational commands to enhance battery longevity. A control module (140) transmits these commands. A connectivity module (145) enables cloud-based remote monitoring and analytics. A plurality of integration tools (150) configures the supervisory control board for first-time use.

titulo: Modular Water Disinfection System with Integrated UV-C, Ozone, and IoT Monitoring.
abstract: [0000]    A modular water disinfection system and method utilizing ultraviolet (UV-C) radiation, ozone oxidation, and IoT-based real-time monitoring for scalable water purification. The system features a buoyant housing with a central flow passage configured for bottom-to-top vertical fluid movement. A venturi throat within the passage facilitates passive ozone induction, while a quartz-encapsulated UV-C unit provides germicidal irradiation. An integrated sensor suite and control logic enable autonomous adjustment of disinfection intensity based on real-time water quality metrics. The system is configured for diverse applications, including the treatment of natural water bodies to eliminate pathogens such as amoebas, and industrial upstream conditioning to reduce chemical demand in downstream municipal utility facilities.

titulo: Computer Implemented Data Structure and Architecture for Managing Two Separate Data Stores and an Associated Method
abstract: The present disclosure provides a computer implemented data structure and architecture for managing separate data stores and processing data for monitoring and controlling a system in real time. The architecture comprises a first architecture portion for managing a first data store containing mutable data, and a second architecture portion for managing a second data store containing immutable data. The first architecture portion includes a first data layer, a first logic layer, and a first application programming interface layer. The first data store contains reference attributes reflecting current system variable states and process parameters reflecting ongoing processes. The first logic layer requests data from both stores, processes the data to determine updated values or actions, and stores or outputs the results. The architecture enables efficient management of current and historical system data for real-time monitoring and control.

titulo: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TRACEABILITY AND CONTROL SYSTEM
abstract: An artificial intelligence (AI) traceability system for real-time monitoring of a group of AI agents generates a lineage tag for new data created by downstream applications using AI-generated data. The system generates a baseline, for each AI agent of the plurality of AI agents, comprising one or more metric derived from AI-generated data generated from the execution of each AI agent, and continuously evaluates AI-generated data output from each AI agent as each AI agent is executed, to detect an output exceeding a threshold for a given metric. The system uses a lineage tag for the AI-generated data to trace actions that led to the AI-generated data output, based on detecting AI-generated data output exceeding a threshold for a given metric, to execute a predefined action.

titulo: SURVEILLANCE DE DÉBIT EN TEMPS RÉEL AVEC DÉTECTION DE TEMPÉRATURE DISTRIBUÉE ET INTERPRÉTATION AUTOMATIQUE BASÉE SUR UN MODÈLE
abstract: A system for real-time monitoring of fluid flow rate in a wellbore penetrating a subsurface formation includes at least one distributed temperature sensing (DTS) system deployed along at least a portion of the wellbore and configured to provide real-time temperature measurements along a depth of the wellbore, at least one additional sensor at a surface configured to measure well head pressure or temperature, memory storing instructions, and at least one processor. The processor is configured to automatically receive the real-time temperature measurements and well head pressure or temperature measurements, automatically simulate transient thermal and fluid flow behavior using a model, automatically solve an inverse problem to fine tune model parameters by iteratively determining residuals and adjusting parameters to minimize differences, and automatically determine a real-time fluid flow rate profile based on the fine-tuned model.

titulo: ECHTZEIT-ML-MODELLAKTUALISIERUNG
abstract: [0001]    A real-time machine learning (ML) model updating method is described, which comprises monitoring input data to a deployed ML model, detecting drift of the input data over time, identifying new patterns in the input data, and responsive to detected drift, retraining the ML model using the identified new patterns. In some implementations, the ML model is deployed in a cyber-threat detection application operating on a computer network, wherein the input data comprises network metadata, and wherein the new patterns are indicative of new network threats. In this way, a need for real-time monitoring of ML models for detecting the changes in the behaviour of known threats and exposing the ML models to the newly identified traits of the threat can be provided to achieve a reliable threat detection system.

titulo: METHODS, SYSTEMS, AND APPARATUSES FOR MEASURING DEPTH-RESOLVED TISSUE KINEMATICS
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatuses for employing frequency-modulated continuous wave signals to simultaneously measure tissue depth and velocity using a single transducer element are described. The system operates at low voltages and utilizes time-delay spectrometry techniques to extract both range and kinematic information from backscattered ultrasound signals. This approach enables real-time monitoring of muscle movement and blood flow during dynamic activities without requiring precise transducer placement or complex image processing. The compact, energy-efficient design makes the system suitable for applications in rehabilitation monitoring, athletic performance assessment, and control of powered prosthetic and orthotic devices, among other applications.

titulo: ENSEMBLE ET PROCÉDÉ D'ÉTALONNAGE CHIRURGICAL POUR L'ÉTALONNAGE D'UN INSTRUMENT CHIRURGICAL
abstract: A method (1200) for calibrating a surgical instrument (140) involves mounting the surgical instrument (140) on a sterile adapter (302) connected to a drive system (304), enabling operation across multiple axes Physical stops defining axis limits are identified, and real-time monitoring of position, torque, and force is conducted 5 while moving the instrument along each axis. Contact with the physical stops is detected by analysing actuator positional changes, such as cessation of movement or mechanical resistance exceeding a threshold. Positional offsets for each axis are calculated based on the detected contact. The surgical instrument (140) is calibrated by applying these offsets to movement commands, compensating for backlash and 10 ensuring precise operation.

titulo: ADAPTIVE COOKING METHOD AND APPARATUS
abstract: The present invention provides an apparatus and a method for optimizing cooking processes through adaptive temperature control, real-time monitoring, and innovative design features. The methods dynamically adjust cooking temperatures based on food properties, such as size, shape, and density, using predictive algorithms and real-time feedback from infrared cameras and thermometers. Multi-stage cooking processes allow simultaneous preparation of meals with varied food groups, using temperature adjustments to ensure optimal doneness while preventing overcooking. A multi-zone cooking system creates temperature gradients within the cooking chamber, enabling precise and efficient preparation of foods requiring different heat levels. The apparatus features halogen lamps operating within a controlled wavelength range for precise searing and includes integrated cameras to analyze food properties and adjust heating parameters dynamically. Additional enhancements, such as angled fins for air circulation and high-powered fans, improve heat distribution, ensuring even cooking, reduced cooking times, and enhanced food quality.

titulo: System and Assay for On-Site Detection and Quantification of Corrosion Causing Microbes
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a real-time polymerase chain reaction based system and assay for rapid and accurate on-site detection of corrosion-causing microbes in diverse industrial settings. The present disclosure provides RT-PCR-reagents comprising agnostic DNA isolation bio-buffer PCR augmenter and PCR reaction medium that enable efficient DNA extraction and amplification with real-time monitoring capabilities, facilitating the efficient identification of corrosion-causing microbes. The present disclosure also relates to an RT-PCR based assay for the on-site detection and quantification of corrosion-causing microbes. The assay entails collecting samples from corroded surfaces or surrounding environments, followed by microbial DNA extraction utilizing a specific DNA isolation bio-buffer, PCR augmenter and PCR buffer composition. During the RT-PCR assay, specific primers targeting conserved genetic regions associated with microbial corrosion are employed for amplification. The assay of the present disclosure is simple making it well-suited for rapid and accurate detection of corrosion causing microbes in real field applications.

applicante: THE FIRST AFFILIATED HOSPITAL OF CHONGQING MEDICAL AND PHARMACEUTICAL COLLEGE [CN]
titulo: INTELLIGENT BELT SYSTEM FOR WORK-RELATED MUSCULOSKELETAL DISORDERS AND METHOD OF USE
abstract: An intelligent belt system for work-related musculoskeletal disorders, the system comprises a motion state monitoring module, a risk assessment module, an intervention adjustment module, an early warning prompt module, and a human-computer interaction module; the motion state monitoring module collects multi-dimensional motion data of a user's waist in real time, the risk assessment module performs feature extraction and analysis on the collected motion data, identifies risk factors, and predicts a probability of occurrence of waist injury; the intervention adjustment module performs massage intervention based on acquired multi-dimensional motion parameters and morphological characteristics of the user's waist; the early warning prompt module performs comparison and analysis based on a preset safety threshold and real-time monitoring data. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantage of providing an intelligent belt system and method for work-related musculoskeletal disorders, achieving early warning and active protection against waist injury.

applicante: LIANTOU INDUSTRIAL INVEST CO LTD JINGZHOU HIGH TECH ZONE HUBEI PROVINCE [CN]
titulo: A moisture-retention and humidity-preservation maintenance system and method for summer transplantation of camphor trees in Central China
abstract: The present invention discloses a moisture-retention and humidity-preservation maintenance system and method for summer transplantation of camphor trees in Central China, relating to the technical field of plant transplantation and maintenance. The system comprises the following components: a data acquisition module, a blockchain storage module, a smart contract processing module, a maintenance resource scheduling module, and a moisture-retention and humidity-preservation execution module. By integrating the data acquisition module, the blockchain storage module, the smart contract processing module, the maintenance resource scheduling module, and the moisture-retention and humidity-preservation execution module, the present invention achieves comprehensive, real-time monitoring and precise regulation of the growth environment after transplantation of camphor trees. Maintenance operations are automatically triggered through smart contracts, and resource scheduling is optimized using reinforcement learning algorithms, thereby ensuring that transplanted camphor trees receive optimal moisture-retention and humidity-preservation care under high-temperature and drought conditions in summer.

titulo: ITS Real-time monitoring system for lane conditions in tunnels using ITS traffic facilities
abstract: 본 발명은 ITS 교통시설을 활용한 터널 내 차로 상태 실시간 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 터널의 입구와 출구, 터널의 내부 교통량, 속도, 점유율을 포함하는 교통정보를 측정하는 차량검지부; 터널 내 차로에 일대일 대응하여 터널의 입구와 출구에 각기 형성되는 영상촬영부; 상기 각 차로의 노면의 상부에 잔재된 고정 물체를 감지하여 노면의 이물질을 감지하는 이물질 감지부; 상기 각 차로의 노면에 매립 형성되어 노면 온도를 측정하는 온도감지부; 상기 각 차로의 노면에 형성되어 노면 습도를 측정하는 습도감지부; 상기 차량검지부에서 측정된 교통정보, 온도감지부와 습도 감지부에서 측정된 온도, 습도 정보와, 이물질 감지부에서 측정된 노면 이상 여부에 대한 노면이물질 확인정보를 서버에 전송하는 데이터 전송부; 터널의 내부벽에 형성되며, 터널 내 온도, 습도 정보와, 터널 내 사고 상황 발생을 표시하여 차량에 알려주는 도로 노면 상황 표시부; 상기 서버에 연동되며, 서버에 전송된 터널 내의 온도와 습도, 노면온도와, 터널 외부의 온도, 습도, 노면 온도에 대한 정보와, 터널 내에서 발생되는 사고 유무에 대한 정보와, 사고가 발생된 차로에 대한 위치정보를 터널 진입하기 전의 차량에 구동되는 네비게이션에 전송하는 터널 노면 정보 제공부; 상기 데이터 전송부와 연계되고, 서버의 정보를 토대로 하여 터널 내,외의 온도, 습도, 노면온도 차이를 연산하고, 온도, 습도, 노면온도의 차이값이 허용기준치를 유지하는지 감시하는 터널 환경 감시부와, 상기 이물질 감지부와 연계되고, 터널 내 사고 발생 차로 또는 이물질 잔재 차로에 대한 정보에 기반하여 도로 노면 상황 표시부에 정보 표시를 송출하는 정보표시 지지부와, 외부에 마련된 사고대책부서에 연락하여 차로에 대한 문제 해결을 지시하는 사고대책 지시부를 구비한 관제실;을 포함한다.

titulo: Research and Training Device
abstract: The present invention is directed to a research and training device that can simulate fluctuations in gas concentrations, flow rates and pressures of breathing gas mixture delivered to the aircrew and it monitors changes in the aircrew's breathing pattern. The inventive research and training device supports simulation of real flight oxygen and ventilation conditions and permits real-time monitoring of aircrew's breathing. This invention may be used in combination with a flight simulation, hypobaric chamber, or other diagnosis methods such as MRI.

titulo: BIORESORBABLE TAGS FOR MONITORING DEEP TISSUE HOMEOSTASIS
abstract: This invention relates to a bioresorbable, shape-adaptive materials structure that enables real-time monitoring of deep-tissue homeostasis using conventional ultrasound, CT or MRI instruments. Collections of small, bioresorbable metal discs distributed within thin, pH-responsive hydrogels, deployed by surgical implantation or syringe injection, allow ultrasound, CT or MRI based measurements of spatio-temporal changes in pH for early assessments of anastomotic leaks following gastrointestinal surgeries, where bioresorption after a recovery period eliminates the need for surgical extraction. Demonstrations in small and large animal models illustrate capabilities in monitoring leakage from the small intestine, the stomach, and the pancreas.

titulo: REAL-TIME VALUATION AND RISK MANAGEMENT INTERFACE FOR COMMODITY-BASED OPERATIONS
abstract: [0000]    Systems and methods are provided for obtaining historical and real-time data inputs for generating one or more predictions, estimates, or recommendations for a commodity-based operation. Using machine learning models, estimates relating to asset yield prediction, at least one revenue, at least one profit, or at least one assessed risk associated with at least one parcel of land or at least one commodity may be estimated. Estimates may be further refined via user selections that update the determinations with up-to-date estimate and recommendations being provided via a dynamically updated dashboard. Through real-time monitoring, estimates and recommendations may be updated and provided to users without additional inputs.

titulo: GRAPH BASED MULTIMODAL SYSTEM FOR GENERATIVE MODEL DRIVEN THERAPEUTIC INTERVENTION
abstract: A system and method provide continuous, data-driven support for mental health treatment by maintaining a persistent state graph that records patient progress across therapy sessions. The system collects multimodal data such as text, audio, video, physiological, and interaction signals to analyze behavioral and emotional patterns. Using these inputs, the system employs a generative language model to propose therapy interventions that are contextually appropriate for the patient’s current psychological state. After intervention, the system monitors new data to measure the patient’s response to the therapy and updates the state graph with relevant session outcomes and relationships among historical, dynamic, and intervention variables. The accumulated information supports both patient-facing and clinician-facing outputs, enabling real-time monitoring, tailored guidance, and longitudinal analysis of progress, engagement, and risk trajectories within a governed digital mental healthcare framework.

titulo: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR ADAPTIVE PATIENT MONITORING DURING MEDICAL IMAGING PROCEDURES
abstract: A patient monitoring system includes a camera array positioned around a medical imaging device comprising facial cameras with integrated infrared sensors configured to capture facial images from multiple angles and light detection and ranging (LiDAR) based depth sensors configured to generate three-dimensional body mapping data. A processor initializes the system by activating the cameras and sensors, establishes baseline facial expression and body position data, performs parallel real-time monitoring during a medical imaging scan of facial expressions using facial landmark detection and body movements using skeletal reconstruction, analyzes deviations from baseline data against notification and auto-pause thresholds, generates notifications to a technologist when notification thresholds are exceeded, automatically pauses the scan when auto-pause thresholds are exceeded, confirms return of the patient to an acceptable state, and resumes the scan. The system enables comprehensive patient monitoring while maintaining image quality and patient safety.

titulo: DEVICES, SYSTEMS, AND METHODS FOR PROVIDING CONTROLS IN BATTERY SYSTEMS
abstract: [0000]    Embodiments of the present invention disclose a remote battery control system that can integrate advanced controls, fast pulse charging, open architecture, and grid and off-grid compatibility. The system can provide a robust framework for real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance, and energy optimization through IoT-enabled communication modules, machine learning algorithms, and artificial intelligence. A high-frequency switching circuit facilitates fast pulse charging, optimizing charging efficiency while reducing battery wear and thermal degradation. Open architecture ensures seamless interoperability with multiple power sources, including grid power, renewable energy systems, electric vehicles, and standalone generators. Mesh network options provide enhanced communication security and robustness. Open architecture can employ end-to-end encryption, dynamic routing, and intrusion detection mechanisms to protect against cyberattacks and ensure data integrity. The system's grid and off-grid compatibility enables uninterrupted power delivery, dynamically transitioning between power sources during outages, and provides comprehensive energy management, situational awareness, and AI decision support.

titulo: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR CONDITIONAL PREDICTIVE MAINTENANCE USING SURROGATE MODELING
abstract: [0000]    A method for conditional predictive maintenance in aircraft systems using machine learning-based surrogate models is disclosed. The described method addresses the challenge of accurately detecting anomalies and predicting maintenance needs amidst complex operational and environmental variables. The method involves receiving operational data from aircraft sensors, aircraft devices, and/or a memory, training a surrogate model to predict aircraft device operations, and predicting operational outputs. Deviations between predicted and actual outputs are analyzed to identify potential anomalies, distinguishing between noise and actual faults. This approach enables real-time monitoring and proactive maintenance scheduling, reducing reliance on scheduled inspections and enhancing aircraft reliability. The system is adaptable to various environmental conditions and operational modes, ensuring consistent performance across different flight profiles. This method is particularly useful for improving the efficiency and accuracy of aircraft maintenance operations.

titulo: USER RESPONSE ANALYSIS-BASED REAL-TIME MONITORING AND MARKETING COMBINATION OPTIMIZATION APPARATUS WITH BUDGET ALLOCATION ENGINE
abstract: 실시예들은 고객의 선호에 따라 마케팅 콘텐츠와 매체를 자동으로 매칭하고, 예산을 최적화하여 마케팅 효율을 극대화하는 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 특히, 행동 기반 고객 데이터를 분석하여 콘텐츠 및 매체별 선호도 점수를 산출하고, 이들 점수와 예측 비용을 기반으로 매칭 점수 및 광고 예산을 자동 분배하는 기능을 제공한다.

titulo: IMPLANT DE CAPTEUR SANS FIL POUR LA SURVEILLANCE DES NERFS
abstract: An implantable assembly for detecting electrical activity in nerves or tissue for real time monitoring of neural regeneration interfaces with a nerve conduit surgically located at treatment site. A flexible cuff with an electrode assembly detects electrical signals generated within the nerve conduit and communicates the signals via a flexible interconnect to a control/sensor device with a power source, an analog front end, and a wireless communications module that transmits output signals to an external device. The flexible cuff, interconnect, and a control/sensor device are encapsulated in a flexible, biocompatible material that can be implanted at or near the treatment site.

titulo: System and Method for Detecting a Seizure in a Subject
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and a method for detecting a seizure in a subject. The method includes receiving electrocardiogram (ECG) signals from sensors and identifying patterns associated with the ECG signals. Further, upon identification of the one or more patterns, the method includes extracting variations from the patterns. Further, the method includes predicting, an occurrence of the seizure in the subject within a predefined duration based on the extracted variations using Artificial Intelligence (AI) models. Further, the method includes transmitting an alert signal to at least one device upon prediction of the occurrence of the seizure in the subject. The system and the method enhance seizure detection accuracy by utilizing the AI models, ensuring real-time monitoring and enabling early seizure prediction for timely intervention.

titulo: Automated Training And Use Of Predictive Dynamics Models For Autonomous Control Of Powered Earth-Moving Vehicles
abstract: Systems and techniques are described for implementing autonomous control of powered earth-moving vehicles, including to automatically control movement of a vehicle's component parts on a job site to perform tasks. The techniques may include obtaining actual operational data from manual control of multiple powered earth-moving vehicles of a common vehicle type that show how the states of the vehicles and of their surrounding environments change over time in response to inputs to the vehicles' controls, and preparing the obtained actual operational data (e.g., translating the vehicles' poses to be relative to a common single starting pose) and using it to train a model predictive control (MPC) vehicle behavior and environment dynamics model or other predictive dynamics model for that vehicle type to predict changes over time to a powered earth-moving vehicle of that vehicle type and/or a surrounding environment that result from further inputs to the vehicle's controls.

titulo: Automated Use Of Trained Predictive Dynamics Models For Autonomous Control Of Powered Earth-Moving Vehicles
abstract: [0000]    Systems and techniques are described for implementing autonomous control of powered earth-moving vehicles, including to automatically control movement of a vehicle's component parts on a job site to perform tasks. The techniques may include using an MPC-based Control System to perform a training and deployment cycle for a predictive dynamics model specific to a particular earth-moving vehicle to control that vehicle's autonomous operations, and to further using resulting data in additional manners—such a cycle may include using a data gathering module on the vehicle to gather actual operational data of the vehicle during manual control of the vehicle on job site(s) by human operator(s) during performance of task(s), generating a 3D site map modeling the vehicle's surroundings, training a Model Predictive Control (MPC) model based on the actual operational data and 3D site map, and deploying the trained model to the vehicle for use in autonomous operations.

titulo: VERFAHREN ZUR VORHERSAGE EINES GLYKÄMISCHEN ZUSTANDES EINES BENUTZERS IN EINEM VORGEGEBENEN VORHERSAGEZEITHORIZONT
abstract: [0001]    The invention pertains to a computer- or processor-implemented method for predicting a user's glycemic state within a specified prediction time horizon. It involves estimating the user's current metabolic state using an Extended Kalman Filter, with hyperparameters derived from the user's historical continuous glucose monitoring data, insulin, and optionally meal records. The method further predicts the user's glycemic state utilizing a personalized glucose prediction model tailored for a specific demographic group. This model customization involves determining parameters and further refining n≥2 key parameters relevant to personalizing the model, utilizing the user's historical data and meal records for enhanced accuracy.

titulo: A dynamic obstacle avoidance path planning method for an unmanned aerial vehicle in a complex flow field environment
abstract: [0001]    Abstract            The invention discloses a dynamic obstacle avoidance path planning method for 5     unmanned aerial vehicles in a complex flow field environment, belonging to the       technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control. The method comprises: constructing       an environment map through onboard sensors, establishing an obstacle wake model by       utilizing a pre-stored CFD database and calculating flow field disturbance forces;       secondly, constructing a coupled repulsive potential field and attractive potential field 10    containing flow field gradient information to generate virtual control forces;       subsequently, taking the virtual control forces as external disturbance inputs to a model       predictive control framework and solving an optimal control sequence in combination       with dynamic constraints; finally, introducing an RVO algorithm for dynamic obstacles       to calculate an optimal avoidance velocity, converting the optimal avoidance velocity 15    into an additional control force superimposed on the MPC output, and smoothing the       trajectory by using a B-spline curve. The invention effectively solves the obstacle       avoidance problem under the coexistence of complex flow fields and dynamic       obstacles, and improves the flight safety and trajectory smoothness of unmanned aerial       vehicles. 20

titulo: PHYSICS-GUIDED THERMAL HISTORY CONTROL AND MICROSTRUCTURE PREDICTION FOR LASER POWDER BED FUSION ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING
abstract: A thermal model for a laser powder bed fusion process discretizes a part geometry into nodes connected by edges to form a network graph, constructs a Laplacian matrix from the network graph, and computes eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the matrix. The thermal model predicts a thermal history of the part as a product of a part-shape-dependent term and a processing-condition-dependent term that are decoupled, enabling rapid iteration over candidate processing parameter levels without re-computing the eigenvalues and eigenvectors. A model predictive control approach determines a target thermal history based on a control strategy, iteratively simulates the thermal history at the candidate processing parameter levels over a prediction horizon, selects a processing parameter level that minimizes deviation from the target thermal history, and outputs a layer-by-layer process parameter plan. Characteristics of the solidified microstructure may be predicted by combining sensor-derived features and simulation-derived thermal history quantifiers in a machine learning model.

titulo: Model predictive control in a closed loop control system for continuous glucose monitoring
abstract: A system which provides closed loop insulin administration is disclosed. A closed loop insulin administration system which bases insulin administration on accurate glucose measurements may improve a patient's quality of life.

titulo: VERFAHREN, VORRICHTUNG UND COMPUTERLESBARES MEDIUM ZUR PRÄDIKTIVEN VERZWEIGUNGSMODELLSTEUERUNG IN DER AUTONOMEN NAVIGATION
abstract: [0001]    Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to methods for autonomous navigation and for enhancing the performance of a model predictive control, BMPC. A computer program, a computer-readable data carrier and an apparatus are also disclosed. The BMPC being configured to generate control commands to an autonomous system over successive control intervals. The method for autonomous navigation using the BMPC comprises: obtaining, for each control interval, candidate navigation corridors for the autonomous system; obtaining, using backward reachability analysis, respective backward reachable navigation corridors for at least two of the candidate navigation corridors; obtaining, for each control interval, a highest-progress corridor and a lowest-progress corridor from the backward reachable navigation corridors, wherein the highest-progress corridor is associated with the backward reachable navigation corridor where the autonomous system makes most longitudinal progress, and the lowest-progress corridor is associated with the backward reachable navigation corridor where the autonomous system makes least longitudinal progress; and
