titulo: Neural network-based double-vector model predictive control method and system for doubly-fed motor
abstract: The invention provides a doubly-fed motor double-vector model predictive control method and system based on a neural network, and relates to the technical field of doubly-fed motor control, and the method comprises the steps: collecting a stator current, a rotor current, a slip angular velocity and a rotor voltage of a doubly-fed motor double-vector model at a current moment under a two-phase rotating coordinate system; inputting into the constructed rotor current prediction model, and predicting to obtain the rotor current at the next moment; selecting an optimal vector based on the predicted rotor current, and substituting the optimal vector and a zero vector into a value function to obtain an optimal duty ratio; and realizing control of the double-vector model of the doubly-fed motor by using the optimal vector and the optimal duty ratio. According to the method, the problems of high modeling complexity and poor parameter matching accuracy of a current doubly-fed motor model are effectively solved.

titulo: Flywheel energy storage system grid-connected operation and power grid frequency support method based on prediction algorithm
abstract: The invention provides a flywheel energy storage system grid-connected operation and power grid frequency support method based on a prediction algorithm. The method comprises the following steps: S1, collecting state data of a power grid and a flywheel energy storage system; s2, data preprocessing and validity verification; s3, constructing a power grid frequency prediction model and a flywheel energy storage system dynamic model; s4, designing and calculating a model predictive control-fuzzy control-PID control fusion algorithm; s5, generating and executing a flywheel energy storage system control instruction; and S6, feedback adjustment and model iterative optimization are carried out. The problems that in the prior art, adjusting precision is low, response is not timely, and working condition adaptability is poor are solved.

applicante: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO
titulo: Discrete space vector model predictive control method and system for bridge arm fault of three-level active filter
abstract: The invention discloses a discrete space vector model prediction control method and system for a three-level active filter bridge arm fault, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the iterative equal division of an output voltage vector plane of the active filter bridge arm fault, and searching a virtual voltage vector based on an active filter bridge arm fault-tolerant structure; taking the virtual voltage vector which minimizes the cost function as an optimal voltage vector obtained by the current search, and determining an area of the next search according to the optimal voltage vector; extracting an optimal voltage vector obtained by the last search as a to-be-reconstructed voltage vector after the search is ended; selecting a corresponding basic voltage vector combination to carry out vector synthesis according to the region of the to-be-reconstructed voltage vector in the voltage vector plane so as to obtain a final voltage vector; and based on the final voltage vector, reversely deducing the on-off state of a three-phase bridge arm, generating a pulse signal, carrying out discrete space vector model prediction control on the bridge arm fault of the three-level active filter, and simultaneously realizing the control targets of high precision, low calculation amount and fault tolerance.

titulo: Walking control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a walking control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: performing nonlinear model predictive control optimization solution based on a mass center dynamic model of the robot to obtain a sole expected contact force of the robot; determining an expected zero moment point of the robot according to the sole expected contact force, and performing kinetic analysis on the robot to obtain an actual zero moment point of the robot; determining a reference centroid velocity of the robot according to the expected motion divergent component trajectory; the expected mass center position and the expected mass center speed of the robot are obtained through zero moment point control; solving through inverse kinematics to obtain an expected joint position and an expected joint speed of the robot; the expected joint torque of the robot is obtained through whole-body control, and walking control is conducted on the robot according to the expected joint torque.

titulo: Hybrid traffic flow simulation method based on cellular automaton model
abstract: The invention discloses a mixed traffic flow simulation method based on a cellular automaton model, and belongs to the technical field of traffic characteristic analysis. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a cellular automaton simulation environment; aiming at a manual driving vehicle, constructing an HAV following rule and an HAV lane changing rule based on a discrete safe distance model; for the networked automatic driving vehicle, introducing a model prediction control method, and constructing to obtain a CAV car-following rule; constructing a collaborative lane changing model between the networked autonomous vehicle and the vehicle behind the target lane, and determining a CAV lane changing rule through game equilibrium; and in each time step, the states of all the vehicles are updated in parallel or in sequence according to a car following rule and a lane changing rule. According to the method, a model predictive control method is introduced for the motion characteristics of the CAV, the advantage of efficient calculation of the cellular automaton is reserved through the improvement, high-fidelity simulation of the smooth and accurate motion characteristics of the CAV is achieved, and the authenticity of mixed traffic flow microscopic simulation is fundamentally improved.

titulo: Tea rolling intelligent control system based on machine vision
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of tea leaf processing, and discloses a tea leaf rolling intelligent control system based on machine vision, which comprises a rolling main machine, a power driving unit, a man-machine interaction unit, a three-dimensional machine vision acquisition unit, a multi-mode sensing unit, an edge calculation processing unit and the like. According to the intelligent tea rolling control system based on machine vision, through MPC model predictive control and a fresh leaf raw material self-adaptive strategy, parameters such as rolling pressure, rotating speed and intermittent time sequence are dynamically optimized, flexible adaptation of raw materials with different tenderness and water content is achieved, the problems that traditional equipment is fixed in parameter and poor in adaptability are solved, and the intelligent tea rolling control system is suitable for large-scale popularization and application. The system has the functions of fault self-diagnosis, safety protection and cloud edge collaborative optimization, can identify abnormities in real time and perform linkage protection, continuously iterates a process model through cloud big data, improves the equipment operation safety and long-term reliability, reduces the labor cost and energy consumption, and promotes the tea processing to be upgraded to the efficient, intelligent and high-quality direction.
termos_detectados: predictive control, model predictive control, large-scale

applicante: QILU UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY SHANDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES
titulo: Visual servo control method and system based on fuzzy disturbance estimation
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a visual servo control method and system based on fuzzy disturbance estimation. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a visual servo system nonlinear model; a Kalman filter is adopted to carry out optimal estimation on the system state, and measurement noise is filtered out; fuzzy clustering is carried out on the optimal state estimation value, a state space is divided, the membership degree is calculated, a fuzzy model is constructed based on a clustering result, real disturbance is replaced with Kalman filtering information, a recursive weighted least square method is adopted to update consequent parameters online, and output of each rule is weighted and fused to obtain a current disturbance estimation value; and taking the estimated value as feed-forward compensation, solving an optimal control quantity by combining pipeline model predictive control, and outputting a final control quantity with disturbance compensation to act on a robot system. According to the method, an accurate dynamic model is not needed, the nonlinear disturbance can be quickly and smoothly estimated, the measurement noise is effectively inhibited, and the robustness and the tracking precision of the visual servo system are remarkably improved.

applicante: NANJING HEHAI NANZI HYDROPOWER AUTOMATION CO LTD
titulo: AGC-AVC cooperative control method and system based on random model predictive control
abstract: The invention discloses an AGC-AVC cooperative control method and system based on random model predictive control, and belongs to the technical field of power system automatic control and optimal scheduling, and the method comprises the following steps: building a unified state space model comprising system frequency deviation, key bus voltage deviation, and generator active power output and reactive power output; taking the automatic power generation control regulating variable and the automatic voltage control regulating variable as unified control vectors; uncertainty modeling is carried out on wind power output, photovoltaic output and load prediction errors, a disturbance scene tree is constructed according to statistical characteristics, and each path in the scene tree corresponds to a group of disturbance sequences and the occurrence probability of the disturbance sequences. The AGC and the AVC are incorporated into a unified optimization framework of random model prediction control, the active-reactive-frequency-voltage coupling dynamic relation is completely described, a traditional sequential/simple feedback coupling adjustment mode is replaced, the problems of repeated adjustment and adjustment lag are avoided, and AGC-AVC coordination efficiency is greatly improved.

titulo: Real-time energy management method based on CNN-BiLSTM prediction and PPO warm start model prediction control
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time energy management method based on CNN-BiLSTM prediction and PPO hot start model prediction control, and belongs to the technical field of aviation power energy management. Establishing a turboshaft engine model, a generator and motor controller model, a power battery model and a degradation model of a power battery of the hybrid power aircraft, and building a complete machine simulation model; the method comprises the following steps: constructing a model predictive control framework, determining an objective function and physical constraints of the energy management method for model predictive control, predicting flight demand power through CNN-BiLSTM, providing an optimal hot start initial value for an SQP solver of MPC by using an offline trained PPO network, and realizing airborne real-time energy management. The MPC online solving speed is improved, airborne real-time control requirements are met, reinforcement learning black box constraint risks are avoided, airborne real-time performance, fuel economy and battery life prolonging requirements are considered, and HIL hardware-in-the-loop test verifies that the engineering deployability is high.

applicante: HARBIN INST OF TECHNOLOGY SHENZHEN SHENZHEN INST OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY INNOVATION HARBIN INST OF
titulo: Partial power converter based on double active bridges, model prediction control method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a partial power converter based on double active bridges, a model prediction control method and a model prediction control system, the partial power converter adopts a series framework of a direct current direct transmission path and a double active bridge unit, most power is directly transmitted, and the voltage stress of a double active bridge device can be reduced. According to the model predictive control method, the optimal predictive current is solved by identifying high-frequency inductance parameters online and updating a discrete predictive model, the triple phase-shifting modulation parameters are solved through the optimal predictive current, then the phase-shifting angles are subjected to weighted fusion at a mode boundary, and finally a grid driving signal is generated to control the partial power converter. Therefore, the voltage of the high-voltage bus output port is adjusted, closed-loop control is realized, and the dynamic response speed, the steady-state voltage precision and the operation reliability of the dual-active bridge converter in a high-voltage satellite bus application scene can be improved.

applicante: GUANGDONG HONGDAXIN ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD
titulo: Hydropower station gate intelligent control system
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent control system for a hydropower station gate, and belongs to the technical field of hydropower station control. The system comprises a multi-source sensing module, an intelligent decision module, an execution control module and a safety protection module. The multi-source sensing module collects reservoir area hydrology, gate operation state and operation environment multi-dimensional parameters. The intelligent decision-making module constructs a multi-gate cooperative control algorithm based on a model predictive control MPC strategy, solves an optimal control variable through an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, and generates a refined opening and closing control instruction; the execution control module achieves instruction execution and closed-loop feedback correction, and the safety protection module completes abnormal early warning, emergency braking and fault diagnosis. The problems that traditional gate control depends on manpower, multi-gate collaboration is poor, flood discharge load distribution is uneven and safety is insufficient are solved, gate opening degree combination and opening and closing time sequences can be dynamically optimized, flood discharge control precision and efficiency are improved, mechanical loss is reduced, and reliable intelligent guarantee is provided for hydropower station gate operation.

titulo: Variable-frequency start-stop control method for cascade refrigeration system
abstract: The invention discloses a frequency conversion start-stop control method for a cascade refrigeration system, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent control of refrigeration equipment. Firstly, a dynamic prediction model is established for the thermodynamic dynamic process of the cascade refrigeration system through a neural network; under a model predictive control framework, taking temperature precision improvement and system energy saving as collaborative optimization targets, and constructing a double-variable constrained optimization problem including discrete start-stop decision and continuous power regulation; solving is carried out through a double-layer nested optimization architecture; an inner layer adopts an intelligent global search algorithm to carry out global optimal search on a high-low temperature compressor start-stop switching time sequence, and an optimal start-stop logic point is determined; and the outer layer adopts an efficient continuous optimization algorithm to carry out collaborative fine adjustment on the operation power of the inverter compressor under a fixed start-stop scheme, and the lowest energy consumption working point meeting the temperature constraint is obtained. The system performs closed-loop execution according to a rolling time domain strategy, and responds to load and environment disturbance in real time. The system energy consumption can be obviously reduced while the refrigerator temperature control precision is improved.

titulo: Unmanned cluster control method based on long-range multi-modal data and visual language model
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned cluster control method based on long-range multi-modal data and a visual language model, and relates to the technical field of unmanned cluster control, and the method comprises the steps: collecting the long-range multi-modal data, carrying out the time-space synchronization and fusion processing of the long-range multi-modal data, and obtaining the standardized fusion data of a unified time-space reference; performing multi-machine collaborative synchronous positioning and map construction based on the standardized fusion data to obtain a global three-dimensional semantic point cloud map; according to the method, long-range multi-modal data are fused, a virtual semantic scene is constructed, precise semantic analysis is realized in combination with an end-cloud collaborative visual language model, and a semantic constrained distributed model predictive control and mixed event triggering mechanism is introduced, so that the stability of positioning and mapping and the environmental semantic understanding depth in a complex environment can be improved; and closed-loop control is carried out through an autonomous and manual scheduling mode, so that the adaptive capability and decision reliability during cooperative operation of the unmanned nodes are enhanced, and an unmanned cluster can stably execute cooperative tasks in a complex scene.

titulo: Floating tunnel self-adaptive damping method and device considering water shock effect
abstract: The invention discloses a floating tunnel self-adaptive damping method and device considering a water shock effect, and relates to the technical field of floating tunnel damping. By collecting a floating tunnel data set, a dynamic model based on fluid-structure interaction is established, and equivalent stiffness and damping requirements are calculated; a model predictive control algorithm is used for generating a current adjusting instruction of the magneto-rheological damper, and graded damping control under the working conditions of small earthquakes, medium earthquakes and large earthquakes is achieved in combination with the passive energy consumption effect of the metal damper and the limiting protection effect of the shape memory alloy limiting stopper. Dynamic model parameters are dynamically corrected by collecting feedback data in real time, and the self-adaptive damping effect is optimized. The device comprises a sensor network, a control unit and an execution mechanism, the sensor network collects multi-dimensional data, a dynamic model and a control algorithm are built in the control unit, and the execution mechanism is formed by connecting three damping assemblies in parallel. According to the method, the fluid-solid coupling effect is fully considered, and the damping accuracy and adaptability of the floating tunnel in the complex water environment are improved.

applicante: HENAN LIANMU VETERINARY MEDICINE CO LTD
titulo: Dedusting treatment device for veterinary drug production
abstract: The invention discloses a dust removal treatment device for veterinary drug production, and belongs to the technical field of veterinary drug production dust removal. The device comprises a cyclone separation bin, a dust removal bin, a conveyor, an induced draft fan, a signal acquisition assembly and an intelligent control assembly. The dust removal bin is provided with a first filter cartridge area and a second filter cartridge area, the two filter cartridge areas can be independently switched between a filtering state and an ash removal state, the effect that the other area keeps filtering when one area removes ash is achieved, and continuous and uninterrupted dust removal is completed. And switching a mechanical ash removal mode, a pulse blowback mode or a combined powerful ash removal mode, and starting preventive ash removal in advance based on blockage trend prediction. In addition, a model predictive control algorithm is adopted to optimize the rotating speed of the induced draft fan, the opening degree of the air door and the switching period, and the comprehensive energy consumption is minimized. The device can adapt to the working condition of high-humidity fine veterinary drug dust, the dust removal continuity, the service life of the filter cartridge and the powder recovery rate are remarkably improved, and the operation energy consumption is reduced.

applicante: JIANGSU JINYAN TRAFFIC ENG CO LTD
titulo: Cooperative anti-collision early warning control method for bridge construction tower crane
abstract: The invention relates to a cooperative anti-collision early warning control method for a bridge construction tower crane, in particular to the field of safety control of tower cranes, which comprises the following steps of: performing sliding window filtering and extended Kalman fusion on multi-source sensor data through edge computing nodes to obtain an accurate complete state vector of each tower crane; on the basis, a multi-machine kinematics model considering swinging of the hoisted object is established, the change trend of the minimum Euclidean distance is predicted through Taylor expansion, and accurate conflict early warning is achieved; model predictive control is adopted for the conflict pair set to solve an optimal control sequence on line, a first control quantity is issued, and motion of the tower crane is actively adjusted to avoid collision; meanwhile, a deep reinforcement learning strategy network is trained in advance, an action instruction is queried preferentially when early warning is triggered, execution is directly carried out only when the safety margin reaches the standard, otherwise, model prediction control is carried out, the millisecond-level response speed and the high-reliability decision are considered, and the safety, the real-time performance and the robustness of collaborative operation of the bridge construction multi-tower crane are comprehensively improved.

titulo: Loader hydraulic hybrid power control method and system based on model predictive control
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of hybrid power control of engineering machinery, and provides a hydraulic hybrid power control method and system for a loader based on model predictive control. According to the hydraulic hybrid power control method for the loader based on model predictive control, rolling optimization control is carried out on the system by adopting a model predictive control algorithm, and the system stability is improved. The system state in the future time domain can be predicted based on the prediction model, and the optimal control sequence can be solved. The method can better adapt to the operation characteristics of large load fluctuation and frequent working condition switching of the loader, so that dynamic and optimal coordination of engine output, the working state of a hydraulic element and the energy charging and discharging process of an energy accumulator is achieved, and the defects of a traditional method in multi-power-source cooperative control are overcome.

applicante: SHANGHAI ZHONGCHEN ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD
titulo: Motor speed regulation method based on model predictive control, inverter and control system
abstract: The invention provides a motor speed regulation method based on model predictive control, an inverter and a control system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining motor parameters and d-axis and q-axis current reference signals; the motor parameters comprise d-axis inductance and q-axis inductance; starting to track the d-axis current reference signal and the q-axis current reference signal in a model predictive control mode in combination with the motor parameters, and determining the output voltage of an inverter connected with the motor; transforming the output voltage into a dq coordinate system through park transformation, and determining a finite element set; in the finite element set, all possible switching sequences are traversed to determine a switching signal of the inverter, the switching signal acts on a switching tube of the inverter, and the switching tube is made to execute on-off, so that the current of the motor completes the task of tracking the d-axis current reference signal and the q-axis current reference signal. The motor speed regulation mode based on model predictive control is high in response speed, and overshoot is not prone to being generated.

titulo: Optical Switch with Fast Switching and Fast Transceiver Acquisition
abstract: This disclosure presents systems and methods for an optical circuit switch (OCS), optical burst switch (OBS), and hybrid OBS (HOBS) featuring microsecond-range reconfiguration times—critical for modern AI/ML workloads demanding both low latency and high bandwidth. By combining fast switching elements (e.g., silicon photonics) with burst-mode transceivers that reduce acquisition from seconds to microseconds, the proposed architectures enable efficient data center interconnects. The design coordinates switch reconfiguration and transceiver lock-in through in-band or out-of-band control, minimizing overhead to under ten percent of each burst's duration. Additional optimizations—such as buffering packet headers, using a second wavelength for control signals, and employing partial DSP training—further boost performance while reducing power consumption. These fast optical switches support both short, frequent bursts (scale-up) and large, stable flows (scale-out), delivering high-throughput, low-latency connections suitable for AI/ML clusters, HPC environments, and other dynamic data center applications.

applicante: COUNCIL OF SCIENT AND INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH [IN]
titulo: COPOLYMÈRE FORMANT DES TUMOROÏDES ET SON PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION
abstract: The development of an in vitro mimic of in vivo tumor is an urgent priority. Making tumoroid using Matrigel is considered as gold-standard but lacks batch-to- batch reproducibility due to its compositional complexity. Other relevant techniques have scale-up complications and suffer from air sensitivity. Herein, we demonstrate a simple, economically viable, emulsion polymer-based coating approach for efficient tumoroid production. N-vinylpyrrolidone (NVP)-stabilized copolymer latex of styrene and n-butyl acrylate was synthesized as coating material with excellent film-forming ability, exceptional adhesiveness, non-toxicity, pH stability, and superior biocompatibility thus providing base for excellent tumoroid-forming applications. NVP as an in situ monomeric stabilizer for the aqueous polymerization process widens the industrial-scale production prospect. We demonstrate that the tumoroids, as observed in multitude of cancer cells, grow gradually and adapt in vivo tumor quiescence- enhancing survival mode under chemotherapeutic conditions, while exhibiting cancer stem cell-like property. This invention allows mimicking in vivo tumor condition within in vitro setup.

titulo: INTERCONNECT METHOD FOR MEMORY EXPANSION, SCALE-UP AND SCALE-OUT OF AI/ML SYSTEMS
abstract: [0000]    Interconnect systems and methods for processors are provided. A described interconnect system includes a plurality of switches, each of the plurality of switches having a first interface coupled to a respective one of a plurality of I/O interfaces of a processor, and N second interfaces providing selective connectivity between the first interface and N external connections. Some interconnect systems further include plurality of scale-out switches providing selective connectivity between the processor and N planes of inter-rack switching, and an inter-rack switch cluster including the N planes of inter-rack switching. Each plane provides interconnectivity between the processor other processors provided on other racks.

titulo: NETWORK INFRASTRUCTURE INCLUDING INTERCONNECTED SYSTEM-ON-PACKAGE (SOP) STRUCTURES WITH BUILT-IN ACCELERATORS AND SWITCHES
abstract: A structure and, particularly, a network infrastructure for a data center backend network includes networked compute clusters (CCs). Each CC includes multiple nodes. Each node includes an arrangement of interconnected system-on-package (SOP) structures. In a network infrastructure with a scale-up topology, the network infrastructure, each SOP structures can have similar configurations. For example, each SOP structure can include: switch ports; network ports; and a network subsystems block. The network subsystems block can include switch subsystems (i.e., switches) coupled to the switch ports, respectively; network interface subsystems coupled to the network ports, respectively; and an accelerator coupled to the switch subsystems and the network interface subsystems. The network infrastructure can further include network port-to-switch port interfaces between the SOP structures. In other network infrastructure embodiments with a combined scale-up and scale-out topology, some of the SOP structures within the arrangement of interconnected SOP structures may have different configurations.

titulo: DIRECT MEMORY ACCESS (DMA) OVER SCALE-UP BACKEND NETWORK
abstract: Disclosed is a data center backend network including compute clusters (CCs). Each CC includes a scale-up network, which includes a scale-up switch and a group of nodes. Each node can be a networked computer including, amongst other components, a scale-up network interface card (NIC) in communication with the scale-up switch. The NICs of the different nodes can each include a subsystems block including a network infrastructure subsystem configured to support scale-up operations across the scale-up network. Scale-up operations include, for example, memory access operations (such as conventional load and store operations and direct memory access (DMA) operations) between any two nodes using the scale-up switch. Also disclosed is an operating method including performing a DMA operation between any two nodes in a scale-up network using the scale-up switch and performing a load operation or a store operation between any two nodes in the scale-up network using the scale-up switch.

titulo: Processor with CXL NTB and Address Translation for Disaggregated Memory and Scale-Up AI Fabrics
abstract: Modern processors maintain their own physical address space, mapping processing cores, memory channels, and memory-mapped devices onto a coherent internal fabric. External hosts communicating via CXL, however, operate within their own distinct physical address space, creating an addressing gap that conventionally prevents a host from accessing resources within a processor's internal fabric. Some implementations describe a processor that bridges this gap. The processor includes processing cores coupled via a coherent interconnect, memory channels for accessing external memory, and MMUs for translating virtual addresses to physical addresses within the processor's internal address space. A port receives CXL requests from an external host carrying physical addresses within a second address space, and a resource provisioning unit (RPU) translates those host physical addresses to the processor's internal physical addresses, which enables the host to access memory and other resources within the processor's coherent fabric without modifying its own addressing scheme.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ DE PHYCOREMÉDIATION À BASE DE MICROALGUES POUR LE TRAITEMENT DE BOUES HUILEUSES
abstract: Components of oily sludge contaminate the environment, disrupt the endocrine system, and are carcinogenic. Proper and complete treatment of the oily sludge followed by its safe disposal is essential to minimize environmental impact and protect human health. Existing treatment methods for oily sludge include incineration, landfilling, pyrolysis, and supercritical water oxidation; however, these techniques are energy-intensive, costly, and pose higher risks of environmental pollution. The present invention discloses a novel process for oily sludge degradation using a mild hydrothermal-assisted microalgae-based phycoremediation strategy. The method achieves 70– 75% degradation of long-chain aromatic and aliphatic hydrocarbons within 4–6 weeks. The degradation efficiency may further increase when the treatment period exceeds 6 weeks. Compared with conventional energy-intensive technologies for oil sludge treatment, the proposed method is more economical, environmentally sustainable, and suitable for long-term scale-up, with added potential for revenue generation.

titulo: Providing scalable electrical grid simulations
abstract: A grid simulation (GS) service performs scalable electrical grid simulations for clients of the service. The GS service receives, from a client (e.g., a utility/grid operator), a request to initiate a simulation session for an electrical grid. Based on the request, the service determines an initial amount of compute capacity to be provisioned for the simulation session. The service initiates the simulation session and provisions the initial amount of compute capacity. The service receives a request to implement a number of electrical grid simulations. If needed, the service will scale up or down the amount of compute capacity to implement the requested electrical grid simulations. The results may be provided to an endpoint.

titulo: Method and Devices of Communication in a Computing Network using Switch Proxy
abstract: [0000]    Methods for communicating in a computing network and corresponding devices are described. An example method of communicating in a computing network includes, by a scale-up switch, receiving a command packet generated by a compute component of a computing network, the command packet including a destination identifier and a memory address. The method further includes identifying a destination compute component based on the command packet received and determining if the destination compute component is in a scale-up network or a scale-out network. Responsive to the destination compute component being in the scale-out network, the method includes translating the command packet received into a network message, the translating including mapping the destination identifier to a network address and the memory address to a network resource index, and transmitting the network message to a scale-out fabric. Said communicating in the computing network can reduce demands upon the compute component and streamline network communication.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ DE MISE À L'ÉCHELLE POUR LES MICRO-ORGANISMES PRÉSENTS IN SITU DANS LES FILONS DE CHARBON, ET SON UTILISATION
abstract: The present invention relates to the technical field of coalbed methane development, and provides a scale-up method for in-situ coal seam microorganisms, and a use. The method comprises an anaerobic control stage before inoculation; an inoculation stage: placing an in-situ seed liquid into a fermenter for oxygen-limited stepwise scale-up inoculation to obtain an in-situ coal seam microbial liquid; and a scale-up stage: monitoring the gas production capacity, structure, metabolic intermediates, and microbial nucleic acids of a microbial community in the in-situ coal seam microbial liquid, and performing the next round of inoculation when the in-situ coal seam microbial liquid meets criteria for discharge from the fermenter. In the present invention, the in-situ coal seam microbial liquid is obtained by performing anaerobic control during inoculation and scale-up of in-situ coal seam microorganisms, monitoring the in-situ coal seam microbial liquid from various dimensions at the scale-up stage to identify growth characteristics of the microbial community, and establishing the criteria for discharge from the fermenter.

applicante: ZHUHCARBON CLOUD INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD [CN]
titulo: DISPOSITIF DE PRÉPARATION DE MICRORÉSEAU PEPTIDIQUE SYNTHÉTISÉ IN SITU ET SYSTÈME D'ALIMENTATION EN LIQUIDE ASSOCIÉ
abstract: The present application discloses a device for preparing an in-situ synthesized peptide microarray and a liquid supply system therefor, comprising: an amino acid coupling module, the amino acid coupling module comprising a first synthesis unit; and an amino acid liquid supply module, which is used for providing the amino acid coupling module with an amino acid solution and a coupling agent required by the synthesis unit, and comprises: a plurality of amino acid liquid supply units, a coupling agent liquid supply unit, a cleaning agent liquid supply unit, a first manifold valve assembly, and a first liquid mixing unit. The first liquid mixing unit is used for mixing a selected amino acid monomer and coupling agent in the first manifold valve assembly, the first liquid mixing unit is connected to an output port of the first manifold valve assembly, and an output port of the first liquid mixing unit is connected to the first synthesis unit for the microarray by means of a control valve. The present application has the advantages of flexibility and low cost in research and development and pilot scale-up stages and in small-batch prepared peptide microarray synthesis or development post-processing processes and application research.

applicante: ZHUHCARBON CLOUD INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD [CN]
titulo: APPAREIL POUR SYNTHÈSE IN SITU DE PUCE POLYPEPTIDIQUE ET SYSTÈME D'ALIMENTATION EN LIQUIDE ASSOCIÉ
abstract: Disclosed in the present application are an apparatus for the in-situ synthesis of a polypeptide chip, and a liquid supply system thereof. The apparatus comprises: an amino acid coupling module, the amino acid coupling module comprising a first synthesis unit; an amino acid liquid supply module, which is configured to provide to the amino acid coupling module an amino acid liquid and a coupling agent that are required by a synthesis unit, and which comprises a plurality of amino acid liquid supply units, a coupling agent liquid supply unit, a cleaning agent liquid supply unit, and a first liquid-metering device corresponding to the first synthesis unit, wherein the first liquid-metering device is connected to output tubes of the plurality of amino acid liquid supply units, the coupling agent liquid supply unit and the cleaning agent liquid supply unit; and a first liquid-mixing unit connected to an output port of the first liquid-metering device, wherein the first liquid-mixing unit comprises an output port and a control valve, and the output port is connected to the first synthesis unit of a chip by means of the control valve. In the stages of research and development and pilot scale-up, the present application has the advantages of flexibility and low cost in terms of the small-batch preparation and synthesis of polypeptide chips or the development of post-treatment processes and applied research.

titulo: VERFAHREN UND VORRICHTUNGEN ZUR KOMMUNIKATION IN EINEM COMPUTERNETZWERK MIT TUNNELUNG ÜBER EIN SCALE-OUT-NETZWERK
abstract: [0001]    Methods for communication in a computing network and accompanying scale-up switches and design structures are described herein. According to an example embodiment, a method of communication in a computing network includes, by a scale-up switch, receiving a command packet generated by a compute component of a computing network. The method further includes, by the scale-up switch, identifying a destination compute component based on the command packet received and determining if the destination compute component is in a scale-up network or a scale-out network of the computing network. Responsive to the destination compute component being in the scale-out network, the method further includes, by the scale-up switch, embedding the command packet received in a network message and transmitting the network message to a scale-out fabric of the scale-out network. Communication in the computing network as described can be helpful for reducing demands upon the compute component and streamlining network communication.

titulo: Method and Devices of Communication in a Computing Network Using Tunneling Over a Scale-Out Network
abstract: [0000]    Methods for communication in a computing network and accompanying scale-up switches and design structures are described herein. According to an example embodiment, a method of communication in a computing network includes, by a scale-up switch, receiving a command packet generated by a compute component of a computing network. The method further includes, by the scale-up switch, identifying a destination compute component based on the command packet received and determining if the destination compute component is in a scale-up network or a scale-out network of the computing network. Communication in the computing network as described can be helpful for reducing demands upon the compute component and streamlining network communication.

titulo: Processor with Inter-Die Interfaces and Scale-Up Fabric Interfaces including UALink and CXL
abstract: [0000]    Processor derived from an established CPU design comprises memory channels, processing cores coupled via a coherent interconnect, communication ports selected from at least one of CXL endpoints, CXL switch ports, or UALink ports, a resource provisioning unit (RPU) to translate physical addresses between address spaces, and termination circuits implemented at interfaces of a first silicon die area comprising the communication ports, where the interfaces connect the first silicon die area with a second silicon die area. The termination circuits may incorporate enable inputs and may handle input and output signals differently to maintain signal integrity. A method of manufacturing such a processor comprises fabricating the circuitry and the termination circuits at interfaces between silicon die areas, and may include physically removing the second silicon die area while retaining communication ports and memory controllers. The termination circuits enable creation of multiple processor versions from an established CPU design.

titulo: Scale-Up Memory Access over IEEE 802.3 PMA in Processors and Accelerators including ARM-Based SoCs
abstract: [0000]    Large-scale AI and HPC systems are expected to increasingly deploy heterogeneous accelerators interconnected via high-bandwidth fabrics built on IEEE 802.3 PMA. Implementations disclose a processor comprising processing cores coupled via an interconnect, an interconnect component coupled to the interconnect, an RPU coupled to the interconnect component, a physical layer based on IEEE 802.3 PMA coupled to the RPU for communicating with an external entity, and a CXL device implemented in at least one of the RPU or the interconnect component. At least one of the RPU or the interconnect component translates between CXL transactions associated with data communicated with the external entity via the physical layer and interconnect transactions communicated via the interconnect. In other implementations, a CXL root port is coupled to the interconnect, and at least one of the RPU or the CXL root port translates between the CXL transactions and interconnect transactions communicated via the interconnect.

titulo: Processor with CXL Scale-Up Networking over IEEE 802.3 PMA for Memory Pooling and KV Caching in AI Infrastructures
abstract: [0000]    Implementations disclose a processor architecture with an integrated resource provisioning unit (RPU) for CXL protocol translation over a physical layer based on IEEE 802.3 PMA. An apparatus comprises an IC package with processing cores coupled to a memory controller, memory channels coupled to memory, a physical layer based on IEEE 802.3 PMA to communicate with an external entity, and an RPU comprising a CXL device. The RPU translates between CXL-based protocol data units communicated via the CXL device and carrier protocol PDUs encapsulating data indicative of CXL opcodes and physical addresses transmitted and received via the IEEE 802.3 PMA. The RPU may enable external entities to access the processor's memory, or enable the processing cores to access resources coupled to external entities. The carrier protocol PDUs may include encapsulating headers with routing, sequencing, and multi-tenancy fields.

titulo: Translating Between UALink and CXL.mem for Memory Access Across Heterogeneous Interconnects, Enabling Scale-Up Memory Tier for GPUs and Accelerators
abstract: Translating between UALink UPLI and CXL.mem enables memory access across different protocol domains. Some implementations describe receiving a UPLI request comprising a read command and a first physical address, translating the UPLI request to a CXL.mem M2S request comprising MemRd* and a second physical address, and sending the CXL.mem M2S request to a second entity. The translation may include address, Tag, and opcode translations between the UPLI and CXL.mem domains. Other implementations describe a processing unit providing a first memory path from a UALink port to a first memory via a memory controller, and a second memory path from the UALink port to a second memory via a CXL port. Yet other implementations describe a system with a switch, accelerators, a resource provisioning unit (RPU), and CXL memory devices, wherein the RPU translates UPLI requests and routes them to respective CXL memory devices.

titulo: CXL Scale-Up Memory Tier for GPUs and Heterogeneous PCIe Fabrics Comprising Hosts, Devices, and Switches, Enabling Shared Memory via Protocol Translations
abstract: In computing environments where entities may utilize different protocols while requiring coordinated access to shared resources, there may be scenarios where a first entity supporting PCIe, such as a GPU, needs to access memory resources coupled to a second entity supporting CXL.mem. Translations between PCIe TLPs and CXL.mem messages may facilitate memory operations, data transfers, and resource sharing across different domains while maintaining the requirements of each protocol. Such translations may be performed by a computer, an apparatus, a cable, a Fabric Processing Unit (FPU), a Fabric NIC, or other suitable devices positioned between the first entity and the second entity. Some implementations include translating PCIe memory requests to CXL.mem M2S requests, and translating CXL.mem S2M data responses to PCIe completions. The translations may include physical address translations, Tag translations, and speculative memory reads.

applicante: SICHUAN KELUN BIOTECH BIOPHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD [CN]
titulo: PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION D'UN COMPOSÉ BIOLOGIQUEMENT ACTIF
abstract: The present application provides a preparation method for a biologically active compound. The method has the advantages of low costs, mild reaction conditions, high product yield and simple operation, thereby facilitating process scale-up.

titulo: TOPOLOGIES FOR SCALE-OUT FABRICS
abstract: [0000]    Recently, there has been a dramatic increase in the development and use of machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) applications. The exponentially growing complexity of ML/AI models and their voracious data needs have created needs for large but well-designed data centers—even the network topology needs to be critically considered. Presented herein are embodiments of topologies for data center system that comprise both a high bandwidth scale-up fabric and a scale-out fabric. In one or more embodiments, the scale-out fabric may comprise as many rails as allowed by the radix of the switch (i.e., 36 rails for 64-port switches and 72 rails for 128-port switches), and in one or more embodiments, the rails preferably span a minimum number of tiers as possible and reserve the upper tier for the rail crossing function. If the last tier is used for the rail crossing function, it may be oversubscribed.

titulo: AN AI-DRIVEN QUICK COMMERCE DELIVERY SYSTEM FOR RAPID, LEGAL AND RESPONSIBLE DELIVERY OF ALL TYPES OF BEVERAGES
abstract: The present invention is related to an AI-driven quick commerce delivery system for rapid, legal and responsible delivery of all types of beverages. The invention is a legally compliant AI-driven quick-commerce platform built for the rapid, safe, and responsible delivery of alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, cigarettes, and snacks. It is an app-based and web-based platform that uses AI-driven logistics, real-time inventory management, and legal compliance automation to make deliveries in 15-20 minutes. The system's key features are Aadhaar-based age authentication through face recognition, geo-restricted ordering with prohibition of sales in restricted zones, and auto-shutdown during dry days to meet state-level regulations. The system does away with minimum order requirements, implements secure digital payments (no cash-on-delivery for restricted products), and implements compliance through background-verified delivery staff. It also uses AI-based route optimization to avoid drink-and-drive accidents, real-time inventory management to avoid bulk purchases above legal thresholds, and fraud detection features to avoid identity misuse and unauthorized transactions. The invention is future-proof, with a scalable architecture that can scale up into grocery, pharma, and other quick-commerce verticals. By filling market gaps, improving government tax compliance, and minimizing public disturbances, it will transform the alcohol and beverage delivery market in India.

titulo: Pilot scale-up method for continuously preparing manganese dioxide through acidic hydrothermal method
abstract: The invention relates to the field of inorganic chemical synthesis, in particular to a pilot scale-up method for continuously preparing manganese dioxide through acidic hydrothermal, which comprises the following steps: dissolving divalent manganese salt and persulfate in water according to a certain molar ratio, carrying out oxidation reaction under a specific temperature condition, filtering, washing and drying to obtain high-purity manganese dioxide powder. According to the method, directional growth of the manganese-based low-temperature nano-enzyme can be guided by accurately controlling the reactant proportion and temperature, the process is simple, the reaction conditions are easy to control, the byproduct is sulfate, the method is environment-friendly, and the obtained product is regular in crystal form and suitable for the field of low-temperature degradation of biomass or catalysts.

titulo: Translating Between CXL.cache Messages for Multi-Host Cache Coherence and Memory Sharing
abstract: Translating between CXL.cache messages may enable large-scale AI clusters to interconnect heterogeneous accelerators via scale-up fabrics and disaggregated memory pools. Such translations may include receiving a CXL.cache Host-to-Device (H2D) request from a first entity, translating the H2D request to a CXL.cache Device-to-Host (D2H) request, and sending the D2H request to a second entity. The translation may encompass opcodes, addresses, and transaction identifiers. One system comprises first and second CXL interfaces and a computer that receives an H2D request via the first interface, translates the request to a D2H request, and sends the D2H request via the second interface. The translation may include address translation between Host Physical Address (HPA) spaces utilized by different entities. The translation capabilities may enable communication between entities that cannot communicate directly due to protocol direction constraints, supporting applications such as disaggregated memory systems, multi-GPU clusters, and heterogeneous computing platforms.

titulo: SYSTÈME À L'ÉCHELLE PILOTE SEMI-INDUSTRIELLE POUR ESSAI CONTRÔLÉ DE TRANSPORT DIPHASIQUE GAZ-SOLIDE AVEC RÉGULATION DE PRESSION ET DE DÉBIT INTÉGRÉE
abstract: A system configured to conduct a two-phase gas-solid conveying test under controlled pressure and flow conditions, the system comprising a gas pressure supply unit comprising at least one gas pressurizing device configured to receive and pressurize a gas stream and deliver the pressurized gas stream to a gas inlet line; a cooling unit disposed at a downstream of the gas pressure supply unit and connected in fluid communication therewith, the cooling unit configured to regulate a temperature of the pressurized gas stream; a gas flow control unit disposed at a downstream of the cooling unit and connected in fluid communication therewith, the gas flow control unit configured to regulate either a flow rate and a velocity of the pressurized gas stream through the gas inlet line, the gas flow control unit comprising at least one flow measuring device and at least one flow regulating valve; a two-phase transport unit disposed at a downstream of the gas flow control unit and connected in fluid communication therewith, the two-phase transport unit comprising a two-phase transport line configured to convey a two-phase gas-solid flow and at least one pressure monitoring device disposed along the two-phase transport line and configured to monitor pressure drop during the two-phase gas-solid conveying test; a solid-phase feeding unit mechanically coupled and fluidly connected to the two-phase transport line, the solid-phase feeding unit configured to deliver a plurality of solid particles into the two-phase transport line to form the two-phase gas-solid flow; and a product collection and separation unit disposed at a downstream of the two-phase transport unit and connected in fluid communication therewith, the product collection and separation unit configured to receive the two-phase gas-solid flow, separate a solid phase from a gas phase, and discharge the gas phase to an atmospheric outlet.

titulo: Method for preparing uniform microspheres and used equipment
abstract: The invention provides a method for preparing uniform microspheres and used equipment, and particularly relates to a micro-fluidic chip capable of being used for preparing microspheres. The chip and the equipment can be easily and freely switched among various yield modes of a small-scale research scale, a pilot scale production scale and an industrial production scale, standardized manufacturing and large-scale assembly are easily realized to meet different use scenes, and the equipment can easily realize long-term uninterrupted production. The microspheres prepared by the invention have excellent size uniformity and appearance roundness, can be biodegraded in vivo, and are used for medical cosmetology or clinical treatment.
termos_detectados: pilot scale, large-scale, industrial production, production scale

titulo: Continuous casting crystallizer casting powder and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to continuous casting crystallizer casting powder and a preparation method, and belongs to the technical field of metallurgical materials. The casting powder is prepared from the following chemical components in percentage by mass: 1 percent to 5 percent of Ta2O5, 38.90 percent to 40.80 percent of CaO, 20 percent to 25 percent of B2O3, 6.50 percent to 8.30 percent of CaF2, 8 percent to 10 percent of MgO, 4.30 percent to 5.80 percent of SiO2, 4.80 percent to 5.60 percent of Al2O3, 3.50 percent to 4.60 percent of MnO and the balance of inevitable impurities. Through reasonable proportioning of Ta2O5, CaO, B2O3, CaF2 and other components, a low-reactivity slag system structure is formed, so that the casting powder can effectively inhibit interface reaction in the continuous casting process and maintain stable performance. Pilot-scale tests and industrial tests show that the casting powder has stable consumption rate and excellent lubricating performance, the average heat flux density reaches 1.45 MW/m < 2 >, uniform heat transfer control can be achieved, the surface quality of a plate blank is remarkably improved, and smooth operation of the continuous casting process is guaranteed.

titulo: Preparation method of keratinocyte growth factor-2 (KGF-2)
abstract: The invention relates to a keratinocyte growth factor-2 for engineering and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the step of inoculating the engineering bacteria containing the SEQ ID NO: 1 sequence. According to the application, industrial production of human keratinocyte growth factor-2 is taken as a research purpose, hKGF-2 thallus fermentation culture conditions (such as culture temperature, pH value, dissolved oxygen and the like), induction conditions (such as induction temperature, pH value, IPTG concentration, induction opportunity and the like) and fermentation culture medium screening are preliminarily determined through small-scale fermentation research, and data reference is provided for pilot scale-up research. Meanwhile, the condition of high-yield human keratinocyte growth factor-2 is further defined through the research of related cultivation of pilot test. The process provided by the invention meets the industrial production standard, and can prepare the human keratinocyte growth factor-2 at high yield under the condition of meeting the preparation standard.

titulo: Cosmetic formula digital management and automatic execution method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the field of cosmetic production quality management, in particular to a cosmetic formula digital management and automatic execution method and system, and the method comprises the following steps: constructing a formula total factor digital model, and generating basic data after real-time compliance verification of a dynamic regulation library; collecting small-scale test and pilot-scale test data to construct a digital twinborn model, iteratively determining a process parameter packet, and binding and filing to generate an encrypted execution packet; when the formula is changed, automatically identifying differences, judging grades and finishing compliance updating; a production link issues a desensitization file according to authority, and a butt joint intelligent device realizes closed-loop execution and generates batch full-link data packets; and finally, binding a traceability code, and collecting adverse reaction and regulation change to trigger a continuous optimization closed loop. According to the invention, full-life-cycle closed-loop control of the cosmetic formula is constructed, compliance preposition, accurate production and traceability are realized, the management efficiency and the product quality are greatly improved, and industry supervision requirements are met.

applicante: QINGDAO PETROCHEMICAL M&I ENG CO LTD
titulo: Pilot test catalyst roasting furnace thermocouple protection sleeve
abstract: The utility model discloses a thermocouple protection sleeve for a pilot-scale catalyst roasting furnace, and belongs to the technical field of thermocouples. A pilot plant test catalyst roasting furnace thermocouple protection sleeve comprises a main sleeve, one end, extending into a roasting furnace, of the main sleeve is detachably connected with a plurality of groups of branch sleeves, one end of the main sleeve is fixedly provided with a first flange, the first flange is detachably connected with the roasting furnace, and the branch sleeves are obliquely arranged on the main sleeve. The branch sleeve inclines towards the direction far away from the first flange; the first flange is fixedly arranged on the main sleeve, and the first flange is detachably connected with the roasting furnace through the bolt, so that the main sleeve can be conveniently overhauled or replaced, the main sleeve does not need to be cut by fire in daily overhaul, the overhaul operation risk is reduced, and the overhaul efficiency is improved. The branch sleeve is detachably connected with the second flange on the main sleeve through the third flange, so that the thermocouple is convenient to assemble and disassemble when being assembled or disassembled, the phenomenon that the surface of a wire is scratched can be reduced, and the service life is prolonged.

titulo: Sterile preparation preparation process capable of improving stability and safety of liquid medicine
abstract: The invention discloses a sterile preparation preparation process capable of improving stability and safety of liquid medicine. Comprising the steps of liquid medicine preparation, ultrafiltration treatment, two-stage degerming filtration and sterile filling, and is characterized in that before ultrafiltration, a vitamin E polyethylene glycol succinate and disodium ethylene diamine tetraacetate composite modified solution is adopted to soak a membrane bag, and ultrasonic-assisted flushing is matched; the ultrafiltration adopts segmented pressure regulation and pre-balance, low-intensity ultraviolet disinfection is supplemented, and nitrogen micro-positive pressure protection is performed during filling. The process is suitable for fat-soluble and water-soluble drugs, covers the scale from small-scale test to pilot-scale test, can reduce drug adsorption, efficiently remove impurities and bacterial endotoxin, and significantly improves the initial purity and long-term stability of the preparation.

titulo: Pilot test evaluation decision-making system and method
abstract: The invention provides a pilot plant test evaluation decision-making system and method, and relates to the technical field of chemical engineering, and the system comprises the steps: generating a process model through a process simulation module based on a natural language process demand, and carrying out the simulation to obtain a simulation intermediate representation; an equipment amplification module extracts engineering design basic data, calls equipment specifications and dimensions of chemical equipment corresponding to an operation object of a corresponding amplification rule template generation unit, and packages the equipment specifications and dimensions into equipment intermediate representation; the operability checking module performs operation simulation according to the simulation intermediate representation and the equipment intermediate representation to obtain an engineering operation index value of the chemical equipment, and compares the engineering operation index value with a corresponding operation boundary rule to generate an operability intermediate representation; and the correction module extracts the non-passed check item from the operability intermediate representation, obtains a correction strategy matched with the non-passed check item from a pre-established association mapping table, and automatically triggers the corresponding module to execute a corresponding correction operation based on the correction strategy. The invention aims to improve automation of pilot-scale evaluation decision.

titulo: Application of salt-tolerant immobilized denitrification functional bacterial agent in denitrification of low-temperature salt-containing river water
abstract: The invention discloses an application of a salt-tolerant immobilized denitrification functional microbial inoculum in low-temperature salt-containing river water denitrification, which comprises the following steps: placing the salt-tolerant immobilized denitrification functional microbial inoculum in a net bag, and uniformly suspending the net bag in a river channel; zeolite is used as an immobilization carrier of the salt-tolerant immobilized denitrification functional microbial inoculum, and immobilized microorganisms are the salt-tolerant denitrification functional microbial inoculum obtained by enrichment and screening from an estuary river. The adding amount of the salt-resistant immobilized denitrification functional bacterial agent is 2g. L <-1 >, and the adding amount is the mass-volume ratio of the immobilized denitrification functional bacterial agent to river water. The low-temperature salt-containing river water is a salt-containing river water body taking nitrate nitrogen as a main pollutant. The temperature of the low-temperature salt-containing river water is 10-25 DEG C. In the denitrification process, a carbon source is supplemented into the river water to maintain the denitrification efficiency. The feasibility of the method in practical engineering application is proved through pilot scale tests. River water pollution can be effectively repaired, and the problem that water quality pollution in a salt-containing river channel is serious and difficult to repair is solved.

titulo: Pilot-scale test tool for rectifying drug intermediates
abstract: The utility model discloses a pilot plant test tool for rectifying a drug intermediate, which relates to the technical field of rectifying towers, and comprises a rectifying tower, a first annular plate and a second annular plate are respectively connected to the upper part and the lower part of the surface of the rectifying tower, and a semicircular first shell and a semicircular second shell are also arranged on the surface of the rectifying tower; clamping blocks are symmetrically arranged on one side of the first shell, clamping grooves connected with the clamping blocks are symmetrically formed in one side of the second shell, and arc-shaped grooves used for being filled with rock wool are formed in the first shell and the second shell. According to the rectifying tower, the threaded rods and the fixing rods can be taken out from the interiors of the fixing holes at a time through rotation of a fourth annular plate and pulling of a third annular plate, so that the shell can be detached from the surface of the rectifying tower, heat preservation cotton and the like arranged on the inner wall of the shell can be replaced conveniently, operation is easy, and practicability is high. And a plurality of bolts can be disassembled one by one without using a specified tool.

titulo: Process and device for preparing composite carbon source based on organic waste
abstract: The invention discloses a process and device for preparing a composite carbon source based on organic waste, and relates to the technical field of organic waste treatment and resource recycling, and the process comprises the following steps: S1, screening raw materials: high-concentration traditional Chinese medicine waste liquid, alcohol precipitation dregs and crude glycerol; s2, raw material pretreatment: (1) high-concentration traditional Chinese medicine waste liquid pretreatment; (2) alcohol precipitation medicine residue pretreatment; (3) pretreating crude glycerol; s3, preparing a carbon source: preparing a single raw material carbon source and preparing a compound carbon source; s4, pH adjustment: the pH value of the final carbon source is 6.5-7.5, pH adjustment is not needed, and the carbon source is adaptive to inflow water quality of a sewage treatment plant; s5, application debugging: during application, performing a small-scale test to determine the optimal dosage; and pilot-scale fine adjustment of parameters is carried out. The method can realize preparation of the high-quality composite carbon source from the organic waste materials, is suitable for treatment of imbalance of the carbon nitrogen ratio (CN) of a sewage treatment plant, and can replace a traditional high-cost carbon source, so that the dual goals of resource utilization of the organic waste materials and reduction of the sewage treatment cost are realized.

titulo: Model migration-based pilot scale-up modeling method and system for continuous stirred tank reactor
abstract: The invention discloses a pilot scale-up modeling method and system for a continuous stirred tank reactor based on model migration, and relates to the technical field of process industry modeling. The method comprises the following steps: collecting process data of a laboratory and a pilot scale continuous stirred tank reactor, preprocessing the process data, and constructing a universal nonlinear identification model; respectively identifying laboratory reaction kettles based on sparse Bayesian learning so as to obtain model structure information, and identifying pilot plant test reaction kettles so as to obtain independent posterior distribution of parameters; constructing pilot plant test model prognosis test distribution by reusing laboratory structure information and generating enhanced observation output; and taking independent posterior distribution as an ideal model, solving fused posterior distribution by minimizing distribution difference, determining model parameters and realizing reactant concentration prediction. According to the method, the pilot-scale modeling cost can be reduced, and the model identification precision and stability in a small-sample and high-noise scene are remarkably improved.

applicante: HANGZHOU ZHONGMEI HUADONG PHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD
titulo: Preparation method of 2-halo-4-cyclosubstituted benzyl alcohol and intermediate compound
abstract: The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of 2-halo-4-cyclosubstituted benzyl alcohols and intermediate compounds, in particular to a process according to a first, second and third preparation process. The method is especially developed for large-scale preparation, and it has been proved that pilot-scale preparation, especially industrial production, is achieved, and the method has the advantages of being high in product yield, high in purity, short in production period, high in cost effectiveness, high in safety and the like.

titulo: Cross-scale dynamic regulation and control method and system for traditional Chinese medicine extraction process
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine extraction processes, and particularly relates to a cross-scale dynamic regulation and control method and system for a traditional Chinese medicine extraction process. Collecting a plurality of batches of process parameters and corresponding quality attributes of the traditional Chinese medicine preparation under small-scale test, pilot-scale test and large-scale production of the extraction process; sequentially training a multivariate analysis model, a dynamic control standard identification model, a process cross-scale nonlinear prediction model and a multi-scale coupling dynamic simulation model; and inputting real-time process parameters into the trained process cross-scale nonlinear prediction model and the multi-scale coupling dynamic simulation model to obtain predicted real-time key quality attributes. Through coupling of the multivariate analysis model, the dynamic control standard identification model, the process cross-scale nonlinear prediction model and the multi-scale coupling dynamic simulation model, real-time prediction and dynamic regulation and control of key quality attributes are realized, process parameters are adjusted in time to stabilize production, and the stability of the traditional Chinese medicine extraction process under a large production scale is ensured.

titulo: Small-sized granular bacterial fertilizer low-temperature wrapping integrated equipment and wrapping method
abstract: The invention relates to small-sized granular bacterial fertilizer low-temperature wrapping integrated equipment and a wrapping method, and belongs to the technical field of microbial fertilizer preparation. The equipment comprises a mixing bin, a moisture absorption bin, a wrapping bin, a sifter and a discharge port which are connected in sequence. The ultrasonic pulse atomization device is arranged in the moisture absorption bin, micron-sized moisture absorption of particle surface layers is accurately controlled, and powder is physically solidified and wrapped at the normal temperature through rotational flow air flow in the wrapping bin. According to the method, a traditional high-temperature drying link is omitted, and the biological activity of functional microorganisms is reserved to the maximum extent. Aiming at the problems that small-batch production is difficult and the activity of the microbial inoculum is damaged by high temperature in the prior art, the device has the advantages of high integration degree, low energy consumption, wide strain application range, high coating layer uniformity and the like, and is particularly suitable for scientific research and pilot scale bacterial fertilizer development.
