titulo: Industrial-amplification device and method for producing CH4 through microbial electrochemical reduction of CO2
abstract: The invention discloses an industrially amplified device and method for producing CH4 through microbial electrochemical reduction of CO2. The device comprises a cathode chamber and a plurality of tubular anode chambers, an anode electrode is arranged in each anode chamber, a cathode electrode is arranged in each cathode chamber, and the anode electrodes and the cathode electrodes are connected through a voltage-stabilized direct-current power supply to form a loop; the anode chamber and the cathode chamber are separated by a cation exchange membrane; and the cathode chamber is provided with a gas circulation channel which is used for re-introducing the generated mixed gas into the cathode chamber so as to realize the cyclic utilization of the unreacted gas. Through a multi-electrode parallel mode and high-current-density operation, the CO2 reduction rate is remarkably improved, and equal-proportion amplification from a laboratory scale to a pilot scale is realized; excessive CO2 is introduced, the pH value of the cathode chamber is stable, and additional acid-base adjustment is not needed. The problems that an existing microbial electrochemical device is low in CO2 reduction rate, industrial amplification cannot be achieved, and the CH4 concentration is low are solved, and an efficient technical scheme capable of achieving industrial amplification is provided for resource conversion of CO2.

titulo: Semi-continuous pressurized hydrothermal method for pilot-scale alpha-type high-strength gypsum
abstract: The invention relates to a semi-continuous pressurized hydrothermal method for pilot-scale alpha-type high-strength gypsum, which comprises the following steps: by taking desulfurized gypsum in a power plant as a raw material and using a pilot-scale reaction device comprising a 200L reaction kettle, automatically conveying slurry to dehydration equipment after the hydrothermal reaction is finished; the problem of crystal form degradation caused by temperature reduction in the intermittent dehydration process is effectively avoided, and the optimal process conditions for preparing the alpha-type high-strength gypsum are that the reaction temperature is 130 DEG C, the reaction time is 4 hours, and the doping amount of the crystal modifier is 0.2 wt%. The alpha-type high-strength gypsum prepared by the method disclosed by the invention meets the alpha 25 standard in JC/T 2038-2010 alpha high-strength gypsum. The invention provides a feasible path for promoting the industrialization of the alpha-type high-strength gypsum prepared by the pressurized hydrothermal method.

titulo: Synthesis method and application of 2, 3-dihydroxy ketone compound catalyzed by benzaldehyde lyase mutant
abstract: The invention discloses a benzaldehyde lyase derived from Pseudomonas fluorescens (Pseudomonas fluorescens) and Polymorpha arshaanensis (Polymorpha arshaanensis), a mutant of the benzaldehyde lyase, and an application of the benzaldehyde lyase and the mutant of the benzaldehyde lyase serving as a catalyst in catalysis of chiral aromatic 2, 3-dihydroxyacetone compounds. The invention further discloses a preparation method of the benzaldehyde lyase and the mutant of the benzaldehyde lyase, and application of the benzaldehyde lyase and the mutant of the benzaldehyde lyase in catalysis of the chiral aromatic 2, 3-dihydroxyacetone compounds in preparation of the chiral aromatic 2, 3-dihydroxyacetone compounds in preparation of the chiral aromatic 2, 3-dihydroxyacetone compounds in preparation of the chiral aromatic 2, 3-dihydroxyacetone compounds. The benzaldehyde lyase disclosed by the invention has the advantages of high efficiency, excellent stereoselectivity, wide substrate application and the like, stereocomplementation of configurations can be realized, the yield is as high as 93%, the ee value is as high as 99%, pilot scale-up synthesis is realized, low-cost production is favorably realized, and the benzaldehyde lyase has an industrial application prospect.

titulo: Escherichia coli bacteriophage PE-2 with high blood entry efficiency and fermentation efficiency and application
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bioengineering, and particularly relates to an Escherichia coli bacteriophage PE-2 with high blood entry efficiency and fermentation efficiency and application of the Escherichia coli bacteriophage PE-2. The preservation number of the bacteriophage is CCTCC NO: M20252973, and the bacteriophage specifically lyses pathogenic escherichia coli O2 serotype, has high blood entering efficiency, can enter blood circulation through oral administration, and is widely distributed to the spleen, the liver, the heart and other tissues through blood circulation. The bacteriophage can obtain extremely high titer through pilot-scale preparation, the titer reaches 1.6 * 10 < 12 > PFU/mL, compared with production of antibiotics, the bacteriophage is low in production cost, and a bacteriophage source and a reference example are provided for industrial production of the high-titer bacteriophage.

titulo: Composite iron-based catalyst ball, preparation thereof and application of composite iron-based catalyst ball in wastewater treatment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of iron-based catalysts, in particular to a composite iron-based catalyst ball, preparation thereof and application of the composite iron-based catalyst ball in wastewater treatment. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, adjusting the pH value of a silicate solution to be acidic by utilizing sulfuric acid, and then uniformly mixing with iron-based material powder to obtain a mixture; and preparing the mixture into a spherical granular catalyst by using a disc granulator, and drying the spherical granular catalyst in an inert atmosphere (argon or nitrogen) to obtain the composite iron-based catalyst ball. According to the invention, pilot-scale application of a composite iron-based catalyst ball catalytic ozonation technology in an actual wastewater site is realized for the first time; the provided composite iron-based catalyst ball has a remarkable effect on treating COD (Chemical Oxygen Demand) of various actual wastewater, has universality, and is expected to be widely popularized and used in the actual wastewater.

titulo: Method for large-scale preparation of cell culture meat by using pilot-scale standardized bioreactor
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of cell biology, in particular to a method for preparing cell culture meat on a large scale by using a pilot-scale standardized bioreactor, which comprises the following steps: preparing a photocuring microcarrier by using gelatin and a photoinitiator; mixing larimichthys crocea myoblasts, larimichthys crocea precursor adipocytes and the light-cured microcarrier, and inoculating the mixture into a pilot-scale standardized bioreactor for culture; and collecting the cell-carrying microcarrier cultured by the pilot-scale standardized bioreactor, and treating the cell-carrying microcarrier by using a mold to prepare the cell culture meat. Pseudosciaena crocea myoblasts, pseudosciaena crocea precursor adipocytes and light-cured microcarriers are used as experimental materials, a pilot-scale standardized bioreactor is set through a specific culture process, and by means of real-time monitoring and regulation and control of culture conditions of the pilot-scale standardized bioreactor, the large-scale pseudosciaena crocea precursor adipocytes are obtained. The suspension co-culture of the two stem cells of the large yellow croaker on the light-cured microcarrier is realized, and the large-size cell culture meat is prepared through mold treatment.

titulo: ISOLEMENT ÉLECTROCHIMIQUE DE RHAMNOLIPIDES À PARTIR DE MILIEUX AQUEUX
abstract: The invention concerns the industrial processing of biotechnologically produced rhamnolipids. It is an object of the invention to provide a process for isolating rhamnolipids from aqueous media that reduces the salt load and is ideally carried out without organic solvents. Moreover, the process shall be as energy-efficient as possible. It shall provide rhamnolipids of high purity and be usable on an industrial scale. The process according to the invention uses the proven lowering and increasing of pH to separate the rhamnolipids on the basis of their density. However, the pH is adjusted electrochemically, namely by electrolysis of water. Therefore, an important aspect of the present process is that both the lowering and increasing of pH are effected electrochemically by water splitting. The crucial advantage of this is that there is no need to use inorganic acids or alkaline solutions.

titulo: PLAQUE BIPOLAIRE DE PILE À COMBUSTIBLE
abstract: The present invention relates to a bipolar plate of an industrial-scale PEM fuel cell comprising a first active area face (14), which is an anode or cathode, intended to contact a membrane (12) and a second face (15) intended to contact an end plate (13) or another bipolar plate. The bipolar plate comprises: through holes (2, 3, 4, 5, 6); gas channels (7) in the first face (14) intended to guide the reactant gases; at least one cooling channel (1) in the second face (15) intended to guide the coolant; first obstacles (8) arranged in the gas channels (7) with a quarter cylinder, rectangular prism and another quarter cylinder geometry; and second obstacles (9) with a triangular prism geometry arranged in the gas channels (7) after each of the first obstacles (8).

titulo: PROCÉDÉ DE SÉPARATION ET D'ENRICHISSEMENT D'ISOTOPE CHLORE-37 AU MOYEN D'UNE RÉACTION PHOTOCHIMIQUE PAR LASER
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for separating and enriching a chlorine-37 isotope using a laser photochemical reaction and, specifically, to a method for separating and enriching a high-purity chlorine-37 isotope, which is essential for a next-generation molten chloride fast reactor (MCFR) and the like, by selectively photolyzing specific isotopic molecules of iodine monochloride (ICl) using a high-power fiber laser or a solid-state Raman laser and reacting same with a radical scavenger to effectively terminate a chain reaction. Accordingly, by employing, as a light source, a single-frequency fiber laser or a solid-state Raman laser that has higher power efficiency and easier maintenance than conventional dye lasers and is capable of achieving high power of several kW or more through modular expansion, mass production on an industrial scale can be realized and the economic feasibility of the process can be significantly secured.

titulo: AN ASPEN HYSYS BASED INDUSTRIAL ELECTROLYZER SYSTEM FOR GREEN HYDROGEN (H₂) AND GREEN AMMONIA (NH₃) PRODUCTION
abstract: The present invention is related to an Aspen HYSYS based industrial electrolyzer system for green hydrogen (H₂) and green ammonia (NH₃) production. This invention presents a modeling and simulation framework for industrial-scale alkaline electrolyzers, integrating green hydrogen production with green ammonia synthesis using Aspen HYSYS. The invention optimizes process efficiency, energy consumption, and economic feasibility while ensuring environmental sustainability. The approach significantly reduces carbon footprint and enhances the scalability of green hydrogen production for industrial applications.

titulo: INGÉNIEURISATION DES ALDÉHYDE DÉHYDROGÉNASES EN AMINASES OXIDATIVES ET UTILISATION ASSOCIÉE
abstract: Provided are an engineered aldehyde dehydrogenase for the preparation of amide compounds and use thereof. The said engineered aldehyde dehydrogenase uses aldehydes and amines as substrates and can efficiently catalyze the formation of amide bonds. Provided is an oxidative aminase, developed through the engineering of aldehyde dehydrogenase, which exhibits high catalytic activity and broad substrate recognition. This provides a new approach to the synthesis of amide bonds in medicinal chemistry, being greener and more environmentally friendly compared to traditional chemical coupling reagents, and holds potential for industrial-scale production.

titulo: INGÉNIERIE DE NOUVELLES AMINASES OXIDATIVES ET LEUR UTILISATION
abstract: Provided are an engineered aldehyde dehydrogenase for the preparation of amide compounds and use thereof. The said engineered aldehyde dehydrogenase uses aldehydes and amines as substrates and can efficiently catalyze the formation of amide bonds. Provided is an oxidative aminase, developed through the engineering of aldehyde dehydrogenase, which exhibits high catalytic activity and broad substrate recognition. applicante: NATURAL PRODUCTS RES CENTER OF GUIZHOU PROVINCE [CN]
titulo: A method for promoting ganoderic acid biosynthesis in Ganoderma lucidum mycelium
abstract: The present invention discloses a method for promoting ganoderic acid biosynthesis in Ganoderma lucidum mycelium. The method comprises applying exogenous substances, such as hydrogen peroxide, nitric oxide, adenosine triphosphate, salicylic acid, methyl jasmonate, brassinolide, and strigolactones, to upregulate the gene expression of key enzymes in the mevalonate pathway, specifically 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA reductase, mevalonate diphosphate decarboxylase, farnesyl diphosphate synthase, squalene synthase, and lanosterol synthase. This regulation promotes the synthesis and accumulation of ganoderic acids, including ganoderic acid P, ganoderic acid T1, ganoderic acid Mk, ganoderic acid S, ganoderic acid T, ganoderic acid Me, ganoderic acid R, and ganoderic acid 24. The exogenous substances utilized are commercially available and cost-effective, rendering the method suitable for industrial-scale fermentation and commercial production.

titulo: Quantitative evaluation method for catalyst performance in fluidization reaction
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of petroleum refining and catalysts, in particular to a quantitative evaluation method for catalyst performance in fluidization reaction, which comprises the following steps: performing time sequence analysis and fitting according to reaction time and physicochemical property characterization data corresponding to a catalyst sample to obtain a corresponding physicochemical property time sequence change model of the catalyst sample in the reaction period; analyzing and fitting time sequence change relevance between the physicochemical property characterization data and the reaction performance data to obtain a catalyst performance-physicochemical property relevance model; according to the physicochemical property time sequence change model and the catalyst performance-physicochemical property correlation model, evaluating the performance of the catalyst in the fluidization process to be analyzed. According to the method, the influence of the microstructure change on the catalyst performance represented by the macroscopically participated reaction of the catalyst is quantitatively analyzed on the microscopic level, the subsequent evolution of the catalyst performance is evaluated accordingly, and the method is suitable for industrial-scale catalyst screening, catalyst replacement guidance, performance monitoring and the like.

applicante: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING
titulo: Zero sample prediction method and system for protein mutation effect
abstract: The invention relates to a protein mutation effect zero sample prediction method and system, and the method integrates one-dimensional evolutionary semantics, discrete structure prior and continuous three-dimensional geometric information through an innovative three-flow multi-mode architecture instead of simple splicing information. After one-dimensional evolutionary semantics are aligned, the one-dimensional evolutionary semantics and a three-dimensional space topological structure are combined and subjected to message passing in an equivariant graph neural network encoder, and a prediction result can be directly associated with microcosmic physical changes of a protein structure. And a spatial sensing blind area of a pure sequence model is fundamentally compensated. Besides, implementation of the method depends on a set of inference mechanism completely based on a wild type protein 3D structure and mask context, the whole process only depends on three-dimensional structure coordinates of the wild type protein, and an independent three-dimensional structure does not need to be generated or input for the mutant. The super computing overhead of a traditional structure model in the link is thoroughly eliminated, large-scale zero sample screening becomes feasible, and second-level clinical evaluation and several-hour industrial scale screening can be achieved.

titulo: Method for biologically synthesizing beta-1, 3-glucan in vitro by using cellobiose
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of enzyme engineering, and particularly relates to a method for biosynthesizing beta-1, 3-glucan in vitro by using cellobiose. The invention provides a three-enzyme system for synthesizing beta-1, 3-glucan, and the three-enzyme system comprises cellobiose phosphorylase, beta-1, 3-glucan phosphorylase and polyphosphoglucokinase. The invention also provides an application of the three-enzyme system in the in-vitro biosynthesis of beta-1, 3-glucan by utilizing crop straws or reducing disaccharide. According to the method disclosed by the invention, the beta-1, 3-glucan phosphorylase, the cellobiose phosphorylase and the polyphosphoglucokinase are adopted to form an in-vitro synthesis biological system, so that the beta-1, 3-glucan can be effectively synthesized from the cellobiose. According to the method, 94% of theoretical yield of beta-1, 3-glucan is obtained from 150 mM cellobiose within 1 hour through an in-vitro synthesis biological system, the innovative biological system provides a method with cost effectiveness and environmental sustainability for producing industrial-scale beta-1, 3-glucan from agricultural by-products, and the method has a good application prospect.

titulo: Lovastatin spherical crystal as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a lovastatin spherical crystal as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: adding a lovastatin saturated solution with the temperature of 40-75 DEG C into water with the constant temperature of 5-35 DEG C under the condition that the stirring rate is 150-500r/min and the volume ratio of the lovastatin saturated solution to the water is (1: 2)-(1: 100), so as to obtain the lovastatin spherical crystal. The particle size range of the lovastatin spherical crystal is 0.1 to 5.0 mm, the Hausner ratio is 1.08 to 1.15, the bulk density is 0.20 to 0.40 g/mL, and the compaction density is 0.20 to 0.45 g/mL. The lovastatin spherical crystal prepared by the invention has strong anti-caking ability, solves the problems of difficult filtration, poor flowability, production, storage, preparation and the like caused by a lovastatin needle-like crystal habit, is simple and efficient to operate, and is easy to implement on an industrial scale.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION D'ÉLINZANÉTANT ET INTERMÉDIAIRE DE CELUI-CI
abstract: Provided in the present invention is a method for preparing elinzanetant and an intermediate compound thereof. Specifically, provided are an elinzanetant intermediate compound of formula X and an elinzanetant intermediate compound of formula VIII, which are used in the preparation process of elinzanetant. The elinzanetant intermediate and the preparation method of the present invention feature high yield, simple and readily available starting materials, reduced cost attributed to significant economic advantages in starting materials and reagents, as well as mild and safe reaction conditions, rendering them suitable for industrial scale-up production.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION D'UN INTERMÉDIAIRE D'ÉLINZANÉTANT ET D'ÉLINZANÉTANT
abstract: The present invention provides an elinzanetant intermediate compound, a preparation method therefor, and a process for preparing elinzanetant using same. Specifically, provided are elinzanetant intermediate compounds of formula IV, formula V, and formula VI, and a process for preparing elinzanetant using same. The elinzanetant intermediates and the preparation method of the present invention have a high yield, the raw materials are simple and readily available, and the raw materials and reagents have significant economic advantages, thereby reducing costs. In addition, the reaction conditions are mild and safe, making the preparation method suitable for industrial scale-up production.

titulo: Method for refining HPLC (High Performance Liquid Chromatography) chromatographic grade acetonitrile based on acrylonitrile byproduct acetonitrile
abstract: The invention provides a method for refining HPLC (High Performance Liquid Chromatography) chromatographic grade acetonitrile based on acrylonitrile byproduct acetonitrile, and relates to the field of acetonitrile refining. The method for refining HPLC (High Performance Liquid Chromatography) chromatographic grade acetonitrile based on acrylonitrile byproduct acetonitrile comprises the following steps: pretreatment, directional adsorption, deep dehydration and metal ion synergistic removal, and post-treatment. The method for refining the HPLC chromatographic grade acetonitrile based on the acrylonitrile byproduct acetonitrile can effectively overcome the defects that aldehyde ketone impurities are difficult to remove, the amount of salt-containing waste liquid generated in the refining process is large, the peroxide risk is not controlled, the metal ion residual risk exists, and the purity of the acetonitrile is high in the prior art. The method systematically solves the problem of synergistic removal of various impurities in an acrylonitrile/HCN coexistence system of acrylonitrile byproduct acetonitrile, and can meet the requirement of continuous industrial scale production.

applicante: GUANGZHOU XINGYI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD
titulo: Embedded development learning system based on domestic Loongson framework chip
abstract: The invention discloses an embedded development learning system based on a domestic Loongson framework chip. The system comprises a core processor, a communication interface module, a sensing module, a control execution module and a storage module, the core processor is a system-level chip of a domestic Loongson architecture; the communication interface module comprises a universal wired communication interface, an industrial or vehicle special bus interface and a wireless communication interface; the sensing module is connected with the core processor through an expansion interface and is used for collecting physical environment information; the control execution module is connected with the core processor through an expansion interface and is used for receiving the control instruction and executing corresponding operation; the storage module is used for storing and operating system programs and user programs. The system can support complex complete project development. Students can complete comprehensive projects close to the real industrial scale on one platform, the ability gap between a traditional basic experiment and a complex system actual combat is effectively filled up, and the integrating degree of talent cultivation and industrial requirements is improved.

titulo: FORME CRISTALLINE DE FRUQUINTINIB ET SON PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION
abstract: Provided are a crystal form of fruquintinib and a preparation method therefor. Specifically, a crystal form AZT-III of a compound represented by formula (I) is provided. The crystal form AZT-III of fruquintinib has a significant stability advantage, and avoids spontaneous polymorph transformation in high-temperature and high-humidity environments; the crystal form AZT-III has almost no hygroscopicity and has good fluidity, which are beneficial to the subsequent development of drug formulations; in addition, the preparation process of the crystal form AZT-III is simple, involves a convenient and economical solvent system, and is suitable for industrial scale-up production, thus providing a better choice for the development of fruquintinib-containing drugs.

applicante: CENTRAL UNIV OF FINANCE AND ECONOMICS
titulo: Enterprise main business mining and regional industry atlas construction method based on large model
abstract: The invention discloses an enterprise main business mining and regional industry map construction method based on a large model, relates to the technical field of data processing and industry analysis, and aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, enterprise industry code division is low in efficiency and inaccurate, regional industry analysis lacks contrast support and cannot adapt to risk investment requirements. According to the method, batch accurate division of enterprise industry codes is realized through data acquisition and preprocessing and large model fine adjustment, the automatic correction rate of the large model reaches 95% according to actual measurement of 100,000 enterprises, the overall accuracy can reach 99% or above after the remaining 5% is manually rechecked, and the division efficiency is improved by 198 times; regional industrial data are reconstructed, an industrial basic map containing upstream, middle and downstream positions of an industrial chain and four-quadrant nodes is constructed, incremental industries are screened in combination with cross-regional multi-dimensional comparison (such as industrial scale, acceleration and industrial chain link distribution), and an industrial map adaptive to risk investment and government regulation and control is output after optimization.

titulo: Preparation method of (1R, 3S)-cyclopentane-1, 3-dimethyl dicarboxylate
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of (1R, 3S)-cyclopentane-1, 3-dimethyl dicarboxylate, a fixed bed is used for esterification reaction, and solid acid is used as a catalyst. The method can reduce the generation of three wastes, is simple in post-treatment, improves the production efficiency, and is suitable for industrial-scale production.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ AMÉLIORÉ POUR L'OBTENTION DE ROXADUSTAT DE PURETÉ ÉLEVÉE
abstract: The objective of the present invention is to provide a method for preparing Roxadustat that economically viable, suitable for industrial-scale production and achieving high purity and high yield.

applicante: MAX PLANCK INSTITUT FUER NACHHALTIGE MAT GMBH [DE]
titulo: PROCÉDÉ ET DISPOSITIF DE RÉDUCTION D'OXYDE MÉTALLIQUE
abstract: The proposed invention presents a novel technology of utilizing hydrogen and direct induction heating of metal oxide, such as indium oxide, tin oxide and their mixtures for recycling and reduction purposes to obtain high-grade indium-rich and tin-rich alloys. The invention discloses the fundamentals of the novel procedure as well as the description of a device to utilize the reduction procedure on an industrial scale.

titulo: Rubble Stitching: Method, Apparatus and System for Placement of an Interconnected Cementitious Matrix on a Submerged Substrate
abstract: Rubble Stitching: Method, Apparatus and System for Placement of an Interconnected Cementitious Matrix on a Submerged Substrate Technical field: coral reef restoration; marine substrate stabilisation; coastal protection; underwater placement of cementitious materials. A method, apparatus, and system, known as Rubble Stitching, for placement of an interconnected cementitious matrix on a submerged substrate. A plurality of elongate cementitious bodies are placed on or within the substrate such that adjacent bodies intersect or overlap to form a discontinuous matrix bonded to the substrate. On unconsolidated substrates such as coral rubble, the matrix stabilises the substrate against mobilisation; on consolidated rock substrates, the matrix provides a bonded surface to which a multiplicity of coral fragments may be affixed in a single placement operation. The method may be implemented by manual deployment using a half-pipe trough fitted with a flexible liner, by semi-automated pumped extrusion, or by industrial-scale robotic placement. titulo: VARIANT D'ALLULOSE ÉPIMÉRASE PRÉSENTANT UNE FORTE ACTIVITÉ DE CONVERSION, SON PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION ET PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION D'ALLULOSE PAR L'UTILISATION DUDIT VARIANT
abstract: The present invention provides: a novel allulose epimerase variant in which an amino acid residue present at a specific position of an amino acid sequence of a wild-type D-allulose 3-epimerase derived from Flavonifractor plautii is substituted with another amino acid residue; and various uses thereof. The novel allulose epimerase variant according to the present invention has significantly higher conversion activity of fructose to allulose than a wild-type D-allulose 3-epimerase derived from Flavonifractor plautii or a D-allulose epimerase variant W29K/A77S/G216S/M234I. Therefore, the novel allulose epimerase variant according to the present invention can shorten production time and reduce production costs in an enzyme conversion reaction at an industrial scale for mass production of allulose.

titulo: Corynebacterium glutamicum with high yield of 2, 3-butanediol and application of corynebacterium glutamicum
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of fermentation engineering and genetic engineering, and particularly relates to a corynebacterium glutamicum engineering strain for high yield of 2, 3-butanediol as well as a construction method and application of the corynebacterium glutamicum engineering strain. New 2, 3-butanediol synthesis beneficial mutation targets CtaEL79P and CobTV192V are excavated by utilizing an ARTP mutagenesis technology and a genetic engineering technology and taking 2, 3-butanediol tolerance as a breakthrough point, and a corynebacterium glutamicum engineering strain for efficiently synthesizing 2, 3-butanediol is developed based on the new 2, 3-butanediol synthesis beneficial mutation targets CtaEL79P and CobTV192V, so that a 2, 3-butanediol synthesis beneficial mutation gene bank is expanded, and the 2, 3-butanediol synthesis efficiency is improved. And a new technical support can be provided for green biological manufacturing, and the method has a potential application value in the aspect of industrial fermentation production of 2, 3-butanediol.

applicante: HEFEI COMPREHENSIVE SCIENCE CENTER ENVIRONMENT RESEARCH INST
titulo: Engineering strain for eliminating violacein by-products as well as construction method and application of engineering strain
abstract: The invention discloses an engineering strain for eliminating violacein byproducts as well as a construction method and application of the engineering strain, and belongs to the technical field of biological engineering. The method comprises the following steps: amplifying VioA, VioB, VioC and VioE genes by taking a bacillus purpureus ATCC12472 genome as a template, and amplifying a plasmid skeleton by taking a CITB plasmid as a template; 9 VioD genes with different sources are screened and synthesized from an NCBI database, the gene segments and a CITB plasmid skeleton are connected through a Gibson method to construct recombinant plasmids, and after verification of transformed escherichia coli Turbo, the recombinant plasmids are electrically transformed into escherichia coli MG1655 to obtain a series of recombinant strains; the engineering strain A04 which only synthesizes violacein is obtained through fermentation culture and HPLC (High Performance Liquid Chromatography) detection and screening. The strain can realize single synthesis of violacein, does not generate deoxidized violacein by-products, saves complex separation and purification steps from the source, reduces the production cost of violacein, meets industrial fermentation requirements, and has good application prospects in the fields of biological medicines, food coloring, dye chemical industry and the like.

titulo: Recombinant bacillus subtilis for producing bacteriophage lyase LysJPP58 as well as construction method and application of recombinant bacillus subtilis
abstract: The invention provides recombinant bacillus subtilis for producing bacteriophage lyase LysJPP58 as well as a construction method and application of the recombinant bacillus subtilis. The recombinant bacillus subtilis is obtained by integrating lyase LysJPP58 into a genome of host bacteria bacillus subtilis, the lyase LysJPP58 is derived from staphylococcus aureus bacteriophage, and the amino acid sequence of the lyase LysJPP58 is as shown in SEQ ID NO. 1. The recombinant bacillus subtilis has the advantages that the recombinant bacillus subtilis can be used for preparing the recombinant bacillus subtilis, and the recombinant bacillus subtilis can be used for preparing the recombinant bacillus subtilis. The recombinant bacillus subtilis can effectively secrete the LysJPP58 protein with cracking activity, and can obviously crack the staphylococcus aureus. The recombinant bacillus subtilis provided by the invention has the characteristics of safety, sustainability and industrial fermentation production, and provides a new technical approach for animal health care, food safety and development of medical antibacterial preparations.

titulo: Blue dye and fermentation process thereof
abstract: The invention provides a blue dye and a fermentation process thereof. The dye is prepared from ornamental blue, N-acetyl ornamental blue and pyridone according to the mass percent of (85 to 98): (0.01 to 5): (0.5 to 10), the fermentation process comprises the following steps: inoculating a seed culture medium with an activated recombinant strain solution for culturing to obtain a seed solution; according to the process, the metabolic flux of the strain is accurately regulated and controlled by utilizing the staged change of temperature, pH and dissolved oxygen, the efficient synthesis of the observation blue is ensured, the relative content of the N-acetyl observation blue and the pyridone is increased, and the mass percent of the observation blue to the N-acetyl observation blue to the pyridone in the fermentation liquor is (85-98): (0.005-5): (0.2-10). According to the method, the synthesis proportion of the three components can be accurately controlled, efficient preparation is realized on the premise of ensuring the stability of the components, the process controllability is high, and the method is suitable for industrial fermentation production.

titulo: Intelligent monitoring method and system for lactobacillus fermentation process
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent monitoring method and system for a lactic acid bacteria fermentation process, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent monitoring of microbial fermentation. According to the method, through multi-source sensing parameter acquisition, baseline drift compensation and normalization preprocessing, a fermentation stage is identified based on a viable count soft measurement model, a fermentation state fusion evaluation value is calculated through an original stage adaptive fusion evaluation formula, and finally real-time monitoring and abnormal early warning of the fermentation process are realized. The monitoring accuracy can reach 98% or above, microbiological contamination abnormity can be early warned by 3 h or above in advance, the fermentation batch consistency is remarkably improved, and the method is suitable for whole-process monitoring of industrial fermentation production of various lactic acid bacteria. A stage self-adaptive fusion evaluation formula is created for the first time, a parameter coupling correction item is newly added on the basis of adjusting parameter weights in stages, metabolism interaction interference among multiple parameters can be effectively eliminated, and the core problem of large monitoring deviation in the prior art is solved.

titulo: Recombinant pseudomonas putida for producing L-lactic acid by using all-component lignocellulose hydrolysate as well as construction method and application of recombinant pseudomonas putida
abstract: The invention discloses recombinant pseudomonas putida for producing L-lactic acid by using all-component lignocellulose hydrolysate as well as a construction method and application of the recombinant pseudomonas putida, and belongs to the field of metabolic engineering. According to the invention, pseudomonas putida KT2440 is used as a chassis, and aceEF, ppsA and lldD genes are knocked out to realize convergence of carbon flow to pyruvic acid and prevent degradation of products; introducing optimized lactobacillus plantarum ldhL1 through in-situ replacement to reconstruct an L-lactic acid synthesis route; xylose utilization is enabled by integrating an xylD-yjhH tandem expression box; and through overexpression maeB of a quorum sensing promoter PRox306, funnel transformation of the lignin monomer is realized. According to the method, the lignin derivative in the hydrolysate is creatively used as a natural donor of endogenous acetyl coenzyme A, so that the lethal growth defect caused by aceEF knockout is overcome. According to the engineering bacteria disclosed by the invention, synchronous and efficient conversion of glucose, xylose and aromatic monomers is realized under the condition that an exogenous auxiliary carbon source and a chemical inducer are not added, and the industrial fermentation cost is greatly reduced.

titulo: Application of vitamin D2 in preparation of heat-resistant protective agent for fermentation industry
abstract: The invention discloses an application of vitamin D2 in preparation of a heat-resistant protective agent for fermentation industry, and researches find that VD2 treatment can significantly improve the growth state of S. cerevisiae under a heat stress condition, and at the same time significantly improve the activity of glutathione peroxidase (GPx) and reduce cell membrane damage. The method has the advantages of being low in cost, high in safety, easy to operate and wide in application range, can be widely applied to a saccharomyces cerevisiae high-temperature fermentation system in the fields of food, medicine and the like, effectively solves the problem of industrial fermentation high-temperature stress, and has important industrial application value.

titulo: Application of camptotheca acuminate oxygen methyltransferase CaOMT3 in oxymethylation modification of hydroxycamptothecin and quercetin
abstract: The invention provides an application of camptotheca acuminate oxygen methyl transferase CaOMT3 in catalyzing oxygen methylation modification of hydroxycamptothecin and quercetin. Through transcriptome and genome analysis, four OMT (Oxymethyltransferase) genes exist in clusters; and further combining co-expression analysis of metabolites and transcriptomes, and screening to obtain an OMT gene, namely CaOMT3, which is in significant positive correlation with rhamnetin accumulation. Biochemical function verification shows that the CaOMT1, the CaOMT2 and the CaOMT3 can be used for catalyzing the O-methylation of the 9-hydroxycamptothecin and the 10-hydroxycamptothecin, so that the corresponding methoxy camptothecin is generated. When quercetin is used as a substrate, CaOMT1 and CaOMT3 have bifunctional catalytic activity and can catalyze O-methylation of 4 '-and 7'-hydroxyl sites at the same time to generate rhamnetin, tamarix and phytolaccin; and CaOMT2 can only catalyze the 4 '-hydroxyl site. Enzymokinetic analysis shows that the catalytic efficiency (kcat/Km) of CaOMT3 on quercetin is the highest. The invention provides a new enzyme tool and technical basis for synthetic biological research and industrial fermentation production of rhamnetin and methoxycamptothecin.

applicante: SHENZHEN INST OF ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES
titulo: Fermentation process simulation and optimization method based on multi-scale model coupling
abstract: The invention discloses a fermentation process simulation and optimization method based on multi-scale model coupling. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a multi-scale model consisting of three sub-modules, namely a physical and chemical environment, a cell physiological state and a cell metabolism network model; establishing a global feedback coupling mechanism of bidirectional variable transmission and real-time feedback among the three submodules; a reactor three-dimensional model is constructed based on computational fluid mechanics software, after submodules are initialized, finite volume method spatial discretization is adopted, time step iteration solving is conducted on each submodule equation set through a coupling solver, and fermentation process dynamic data are obtained; optimization applications such as reactor design, process parameter and strain modification are carried out based on simulation results; according to the method, cross-scale dynamic coupling simulation is realized, the interaction between the environment and cells in the fermentation process is reflected, the simulation precision and the prediction capability are improved, and the problems that the production efficiency is reduced and the product yield is unstable in the industrial fermentation amplification process are effectively solved.

titulo: Synthase composition of UDP-D-arabinose and application of synthase composition
abstract: The invention discloses an enzyme combination AfhEF for synthesizing UDP-D-arabinose and an application of the enzyme combination AfhEF. The AfhE protein and the AfhF protein coded by the afhE gene and the afhF gene from the phage can be used for converting D-arabinose 5-phosphate into UDP-D-arabinose. The AfhE protein disclosed by the invention has the activity of D-arabinose 5-phosphokinase and UTP pyrophosphatase in vitro, the AfhF protein has the activity of D-arabinose 1, 5-diphosphate phospholipase in vitro, and UDP-D-arabinose can be synthesized by utilizing ATP (adenosine triphosphate) and UTP (uridine triphosphate) energy supply. The invention provides a new way for biosynthesis and development of UDP-sugar, production of UDP-D-arabinose and derivatives thereof in industrial fermentation, and in-vitro green synthesis of UDP-D-arabinose and derivatives thereof.

titulo: Fermentation medium optimization method for improving yield and purity of lincomycin
abstract: The invention discloses an optimization method of a lincomycin fermentation medium, which is suitable for high-density fermentation of genetic engineering strains. A three-stage progressive strategy of a Plackett-Burman design, a steepest climbing test and a Box-Behnken response surface method is adopted, significant factors are screened from three additives of amino acid, inorganic salt and polyhydric alcohol, and the proportion is optimized. The key combination comprises 0.2 g/L of L-alanine, 0.05 g/L of sodium molybdate and 0.8 g/L of inositol. A 50L fermentation tank verifies and shows that compared with a basic culture medium, the yield of lincomycin A in an optimized formula is increased by 25.04%, and the impurity B is reduced by 16.98%. According to the composite addition strategy, the synthesis route of the product is enhanced by cooperatively regulating and controlling the nitrogen metabolic flux, cofactor supply and cell membrane stability. The invention provides a quantifiable technical scheme for formula optimization of antibiotic industrial fermentation.

titulo: NTG-ARTP compound mutagenesis schizochytrium limacinum mutant strain, mutagenesis method and application thereof, and method for producing eicosapentaenoic acid
abstract: The invention relates to the field of microbial breeding and biological fermentation engineering, and discloses an NTG-ARTP compound mutagenesis schizochytrium limacinum mutant strain, a mutagenesis method and application thereof, and a method for producing eicosapentaenoic acid. The preservation number of the mutant strain is CCTCC (China Center For Type Culture Collection) NO: M 20253077. titulo: Method for producing benzyl alcohol through staged fermentation of recombinant escherichia coli based on reducing power regeneration
abstract: The invention discloses a method for producing benzyl alcohol through staged fermentation of recombinant escherichia coli based on reducing power regeneration, and belongs to the field of metabolic engineering and industrial fermentation. According to the method, recombinant escherichia coli for synthesizing benzyl alcohol from glucose from de novo is used as an initial production strain, an NAD + dependent formic acid dehydrogenation (FDH) reducing power regeneration module is introduced into the strain, and the fermentation process is divided into a thallus growth stage, an induced expression stage and a benzyl alcohol production stage; differentiated glucose concentration control, dissolved oxygen control and feeding strategies are adopted in different stages. Wherein a material supplementing system containing formic acid or formate is adopted in the benzyl alcohol production stage, so that intracellular NADH regeneration is enhanced, reduction conversion of benzaldehyde to benzyl alcohol is promoted, accumulation of an intermediate S-MA is inhibited, and the titer of benzyl alcohol is up to 18.3 g/L. The method is suitable for producing benzyl alcohol by high-density fermentation of recombinant escherichia coli, and has an industrial application basis.

abstract: The invention discloses a production method of spore powder of bacillus coagulans, and provides a production mode of high-concentration and high-quality spore powder of high-temperature-resistant multifunctional phosphorus-dissolving biocontrol bacillus coagulans for tea trees. The strain PPX-13 (the preservation number is CGMCC No.7.608) can be fermented to produce mature spore fermentation liquor with high viable spore number and high stress resistance, centrifugally concentrated spore powder with high viable spore number and high quality spore powder with high viable spore number. A preservation test shows that the PPX-13 high-live-spore-number and high-quality spore bacterial powder product can be preserved at low cost, dark and room temperature, and the shelf life is 1 year. Through industrial mass production mode flow formulation, it can be pre-evaluated that each ton of mature spore fermentation liquor with high living spore number and high stress resistance can produce 8.7 kg of centrifugal concentrated spore powder with high living spore number and 392.81 kg of PPX-13 high-concentration and high-quality spore powder products, and large-scale industrial fermentation production of bacillus coagulans spore powder can be achieved.

titulo: Analytic method for screening key regulatory factors of acid resistance of corynebacterium glutamicum and application of analytical method
abstract: The invention discloses an analytic method for screening a corynebacterium glutamicum acid resistance key regulatory factor and application, and belongs to the crossing field of microbial genetic regulation, biological information calculation and industrial fermentation engineering. The analytic method for screening the acid resistance key regulatory factors of the corynebacterium glutamicum comprises the following steps: sorting strain expression data of the corynebacterium glutamicum under different fermentation acidity conditions; constructing an initial candidate relation framework model; constructing a directional flow feature kernel function in a multi-condition expression mode, and combining the directional flow feature kernel function with the initial candidate relation framework model to deduce directional influence intensity; the stability of the obtained directivity relation is checked; possible direction determination and link rationality check are carried out, and then an acid resistance regulation link and a key gene are output. According to the method, a high-reliability calculation means can be provided for acid resistance improvement of industrial fermentation strains and accurate positioning of key regulatory factors.

titulo: Kluyveromyces marxianus strain and application thereof in fermentation production of ethanol
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of bioengineering, in particular to a kluyveromyces marxianus strain and application thereof in fermentation production of ethanol. The invention provides a kluyveromyces marxianus strain huJ01, and the preservation number of the kluyveromyces marxianus strain huJ01 is CGMCC (China General Microbiological Culture Collection Center) No.22931. The strain can still keep better growth and ethanol synthesis capability under the stress conditions of high temperature, high acid, high ethanol, high salt and the like. Under the condition that the enzyme activity of the inulinase is optimal, the ethanol yield can reach 2.41% vol after 20% of the inulinase is inoculated and is subjected to standing culture at 60 DEG C for 120 hours. The strain is inoculated into 4% of a high-stress culture medium containing 11.4% of ethanol, the pH value of 3.5 and 3.51% of NaCl, and is subjected to standing culture at 40 DEG C for 12 hours, and the concentration of a bacterial solution is obviously increased or not obviously reduced. The bacterial strain still has relatively strong ethanol fermentation performance in an extreme environment, and is suitable for special industrial fermentation scenes of high salt, high acid, high ethanol and the like.

titulo: Pichia kudriavzevii SJTU-BEL-1 for producing single-cell protein and application of Pichia kudriavzevii SJTU-BEL-1

The pichia kudriavzevii SJTU-BEL-1 provided by the invention is a strain obtained by performing primary screening, secondary screening and identification on supermarket over-ripe strawberry residues, and when the pichia kudriavzevii SJTU-BEL-1 is cultured for 72 hours, the dry weight of thalli reaches 41.25 +/-0.69 g/L, which is obviously superior to that of other strains. The strain has great application potential in single-cell protein production, and can still maintain high-yield protein capacity under the condition of high-density fermentation; the total protein content and the total amino acid content are higher than those of a common yeast fermentation product, and good industrial fermentation potential and application prospects are achieved.

The invention also provides this fermented product with a composition which alleviates hangovers by demonstrably stimulating endogenous production of ALDH and lowering accumulated acetaldehyde in the bloodstream. The said functional fermented extract product can be made into an effective and palatable anti-hangover formulation.

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent control and regulation method for high-precision fermentation and purification of stachyose, and relates to the related field of biological fermentation process control, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a stachyose mixed solution in a first sugar degree interval; after sterilization, eurotium cristatum is inoculated at a first preset temperature to start fermentation, and initial fermentation liquor is obtained; the content proportion change of stachyose and non-target saccharides is monitored in real time through HPLC, and sugar content monitoring data is obtained; introducing into membrane separation equipment for selective dialysis to obtain membrane transmittance monitoring data; performing stachyose enrichment dynamic evaluation according to the sugar content monitoring data and the membrane transmittance monitoring data, and generating a fermentation condition dynamic adjustment strategy based on an evaluation result; and adjusting and controlling the fermentation process. titulo: Selecting food ingredients from vector representations of individual proteins using cluster analysis and precision fermentation
abstract: This disclosure provides a technology for developing alternative protein sources for use in industrial food production. The technology evaluates naturally occurring proteins by a process that is done partly in silico and partly by empirical evaluation. A database is created in which each individual protein is characterized by vector representations of structural and functional features. Clusters of individual proteins are formed by pairwise comparison of each protein's vector representation, adjusting the degree of similarity used to define clusters until a desired number of clusters are obtained. A protein representative is selected from each cluster for evaluation by high-throughput expression and laboratory testing for a particular food function. High scoring representatives identify clusters that can be mined for additional protein candidates. Multiple cycles of the machine learning, database mining, expression and testing yield ingredients suitable for assessment as part of a commercial food product.

Compared with a wild algal strain, the mutant strain provided by the invention has the advantages that non-light dependent chlorophyll synthesis is fundamentally cut off, the content of chlorophyll a is reduced by 98% or more, the content of chlorophyll b is reduced by 100%, the algal body is golden yellow, the mutant strain can be used for producing protein, and a high-quality fermentation algal strain with high productivity and good quality is provided for precision fermentation production of alternative protein.

abstract: [0000]    Royal jelly honey produced by nurse bees, honey and milk has great values in human health and/or beauty. This invention aims to produce royal jelly honey substitute, honey substitute, animal free milk without the need for bees or cows or goats. First, recombinant major royal jelly proteins (MRJPs), defensin-1, and milk proteins are produced by microbes (such as bacteria, yeasts, or fungi) using precision fermentation. The MRJPs, defensin-1 or milk proteins are then formulated with vitamins, water, minerals, fats, salt and/or amino acids to produce a bee-free royal jelly honey substitute, bee-free honey substitute or animal free milk. Plant-based milks can also be supplemented with MRJPs and recombinant milk proteins.

titulo: High-precision fermentation to-be-discharged tank capable of automatically controlling to-be-discharged

titulo: System for co-processing organic waste and preparing microbial protein
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of organic waste treatment, in particular to a system for co-treating organic waste and preparing microbial protein. The system mainly comprises an oxygen supply device, an anaerobic digestion reactor, a microbial protein production unit, an ammonia nitrogen collection unit and a microbial protein collection device. According to the system, methane and hydrogen sulfide in biogas are converted into microbial protein in the microbial protein production unit through MOB and SOB mixed strains, greenhouse gas emission is reduced, and high-added-value products are produced while carbon and sulfur resources are recycled. In addition, the ammonia nitrogen collecting unit effectively recovers nitrogen resources, and meanwhile the environmental emission problem of high-concentration ammonia nitrogen is solved. The stability and efficiency are improved through the synergistic effect of the system components, the resource recovery process is optimized, the economic benefits are increased, and an efficient solution is provided for sustainable waste management and cyclic utilization of carbon, nitrogen and sulfur resources.

titulo: Ancestor laccase and application thereof in detoxification of wheat straw hemicellulose dilute acid hydrolysate
abstract: The invention discloses ancestor laccase and application thereof in detoxification of wheat straw hemicellulose dilute acid hydrolysate, and belongs to the technical field of enzyme engineering. The invention establishes a biological detoxification method based on laccase Anc44 for wheat straw dilute acid hydrolysate containing high-concentration phenolic substances. According to the method, the phenol inhibitor in the hydrolysate can be effectively degraded, so that the growth capability of the candida utilis ATCC22023 and the trichosporon cutaneum ZZ-46 which cannot grow in the high-concentration hydrolysate originally can be recovered. The invention further provides a process for producing the microbial protein by fermenting the detoxified hydrolysate, and the content of bacterial protein produced by fermenting the candida utilis ATCC22023 in the detoxified hydrolysate accounts for 40.282% of that of dry matters. According to the method, a whole-cell catalytic detoxification technology and high-added-value microbial protein production are creatively combined, and the economic benefit and application potential of lignocellulose resource utilization are remarkably improved.

abstract: The present invention is generally concerned with the field of microbial fermentation of dairy or dairy alterative industry waste material and microbial protein production such as single cell protein (SCP). In particular the present invention is directed to microbial fermentation of dairy derived or dairy alternative derived whey for production of single cell proteins (SCP) or microbial biomass. More in particular, the present invention relates to a method of producing a single cell protein or biomass, comprising propagating a microbial culture in a large scale setting under suitable conditions and growth medium comprising dairy-derived whey to produce a single cell protein, where the microbial culture comprises microalgae, yeast and bacterial species (Figure 1). The present invention further provides a product or supplement comprising the composition of the present invention.

titulo: Method for improving yield of microbial protein functional bacteria
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of microbial protein production, and particularly relates to a method for improving the yield of microbial protein functional bacteria. The method comprises the following steps that enriched nitrogen-fixing gas hydrogen-oxidizing bacteria and an ammonium-free culture medium are mixed and then inoculated into a bioreactor, a gas supply strategy is dynamically adjusted in a multi-stage mode according to biomass changes, the biomass is expressed by OD600, and the method specifically comprises the following processes that when OD600 is smaller than a preset value, a first-stage gas supply method is adopted; when OD600 changes to a preset value, the gas supply mode is adjusted from the first stage to the next stage; the proportion of oxygen in the gas supply method in the first stage is lower than that in the gas supply method in the later stage. When the biomass is low, inhibition of oxygen on nitrogenase is relieved by properly reducing the proportion of oxygen, the delay period of the earlier culture period is shortened, oxygen is supplemented in time after the biomass is increased, sufficient electron and energy supply is guaranteed, high-speed growth in the rapid growth period is maintained, and efficient growth of nitrogen-fixing hydrogen oxidizing bacteria is achieved.

titulo: Electrolysis gas lift type microbial electrosynthesis reactor and use method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an electrolytic gas lift type microbial electro-synthesis reactor and a use method thereof, the electrolytic gas lift type microbial electro-synthesis reactor is composed of a tubular electrolytic cell at the bottom, an airlift type bubble tower at the upper end and a cathode outdoor circulation gas circuit, the tubular electrolytic cell arranged at the bottom of the reactor provides micro-nano hydrogen bubbles for the airlift type bubble tower, microorganisms suspended in the airlift bubble tower convert hydrogen and CO2 into corresponding organic matters. And the flow pattern of the catholyte is enhanced and the mixing effect is improved due to the arrangement of the guide cylinder in the airlift bubble tower. The method is suitable for producing organic matters by immobilizing CO2 through microbial electrochemistry, is also suitable for hydrogen-dependent denitrification and microbial protein production, and has the advantages of high electrode current density, short reactor starting time, high production rate, high system stability and the like. Compared with a traditional reactor based on exogenous hydrogen, the in-situ supply of hydrogen bubbles is realized, the micro-nano size and supersaturation production of hydrogen are ensured, and the risk caused by hydrogen storage and transportation is avoided.

titulo: Sewage recovering and microbial protein synthesizing device and method
abstract: The invention discloses a sewage recovering and microbial protein synthesizing device and method, and belongs to the technical fields of water treatment and recycling. A nano-filtration membrane separation unit holds back macromolecular harmful substances in effluent from the anaerobic digestion unit and releases the ammonia nitrogen micromolecular substance. Methane and carbon dioxide generated by the anaerobic digestion unit are introduced into a microbial protein production unit; under the interaction between micro-alga and methane oxidizing bacteria, ammonia nitrogen in the effluent from the nano-filtration membrane separation unit is taken as a nutrient to synthesize microbialprotein, the micro-alga uses carbon dioxide as a carbon source and generates oxygen through photosynthesis; methane oxidizing bacteria take methane as a carbon source and utilize oxygen generated bymicro alga to generate carbon dioxide at the same time; three unit are coupled together; and the nano-filtration membrane separation unit effectively isolates the harmful substances in the effluent from the anaerobic digestion unit to guarantee that the subsequent microbial protein production is not influenced by the pollutants.

titulo: PEPTIDES SÉCRÉTEURS SYNTHÉTIQUES POUR PRODUCTION DE PROTÉINES HÉTÉROLOGUES
abstract: Provided herein are pre-protein signal peptides that direct secretion of expressed payload proteins from Lactobacillus bacteria. The pre-protein signal peptides described herein are designed for increased payload secretion over known signal peptides with minimal or reduced effect on bacterial strain fitness. Also provided herein are methods using the pre-protein signal peptides provided herein.

titulo: PROCÉDÉ D'ÉVALUATION DE LA PRODUCTION DE PROTÉINES DANS DES CELLULES CHO
abstract: The present invention is related to a method of determining suitability of at least one Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) test cell line for optimal heterologous protein production, the method comprising: (a) determining a test methylation profile from genomic material obtained from the CHO test cell line; and (b) comparing the test methylation profile obtained from (a) with a reference methylation profile, wherein the reference methylation profile comprises the methylation status of more than one CpG site from at least one CHO reference cell line that displays at least one phenotype of interest for optimal heterologous protein production, wherein a significant similarity in the test methylation profile of (a) compared to the reference methylation profile, is indicative of the CHO test cell line being suitable for optimal heterologous protein production and wherein the test methylation profile and reference methylation profile are from CpG sites from the CHO cell genome and are determined using DNA methylation- bead-based array.

titulo: CELLULES HÔTES AMÉLIORÉES
abstract: Aspects of the disclosure relate to genetic modifications which increase heterologous protein production in a host cell, such as a methylotrophic yeast host cell, such as Pichia pastoris. Such genetic modifications may comprise, in some embodiments, one or more genetic modifications that result in (a) the expression of a mutant heat shock transcription factor 1 (HSF1); and/or (b) the downregulation of one or more genes SSY1, HSL1, PAS_chr2-l_0053, PAS_chr2-l_0404, PAS_chr4_0550, PAS_chrl-3_0135, and/or PAS_chrl-3_0285.

titulo: KOHLENDIOXIDVERBRAUCHENDES EXPRESSIONSSYSTEM
abstract: The present invention generally relates to the field of heterologous protein production in host cells. In particular, the invention relates to a chemolithoautotrophic bacterium which has been genetically modified to produce one or more heterologous proteins. The invention also relates to a method for heterologous protein expression which makes use of the genetically modified chemolithoautotrophic bacterium of the invention. The invention further relates to the use of the genetically modified chemolithoautotrophic bacterium of the invention for heterologous protein expression. Finally, the invention provides a kit which comprises the genetically modified chemolithoautotrophic bacterium of the invention.

titulo: Application of xpt gene-deleted bacillus licheniformis in heterologous protein production
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of bacterial gene engineering modification and protein high-efficiency expression, and discloses application of xpt gene-deleted bacillus licheniformis in heterologous protein production. According to the invention, a stress protein gene xpt in the bacillus licheniformis WX-02 is knocked out through a genetic engineering method, so that the bacillus licheniformis WX-02 delta xpt of which the gene xpt is deleted is successfully obtained; on the basis, a green fluorescent protein free expression plasmid pHY-GFP, a red fluorescent protein free expression plasmid pHY-RFP, an alkaline protease free expression plasmid pHY-AprE and a keratinase free expression plasmid pHY-Ker are transferred. Compared with a control strain, the engineering strain constructed by the invention has a remarkable effect in the aspect of improving the protein expression quantity, and a new thought is provided for producing the bacillus licheniformis heterologous protein.

titulo: DÉTECTION DE RECOMBINANTS OPTIMAUX À L'AIDE DE FUSIONS DE PROTÉINES FLUORESCENTES
abstract: A detection of optimal genetic recombinants used to prepare target proteins, with assessment of their target-specific "upstream" productivity, genetic stability and means to optimize target protein "downstream" purification using customizable fluorescent tags. A scarless removable protein fusion makes it possible to identify recombinants of Pichia pastoris with optimal performance in heterologous protein production.

titulo: Application of bacillus licheniformis without leucine dehydrogenase gene in heterologous protein production
abstract: The invention, which relates to the field of bacillus licheniformis gene engineering modification and protein efficient expression, discloses application of bacillus licheniformis without a bcd gene in protein production. According to the invention, the leucine dehydrogenase gene bcd in bacillus licheniformis WX-02 is knocked out through a genetic engineering method and thus the bacillus licheniformis WX-02 delta bcd lacking the gene bcd is successfully obtained; and alkaline protease AprE free expression plasmids pHY-AprE, a keratinase free expression vector pHY-Ker and a neutral protease free expression vector pHY-NprE are transferred. Compared with a control strain, the constructed engineering strain has a remarkable effect in the aspect of improving the enzyme activity of the protease,and the enzyme activity is improved by over 23%.

titulo: Application of bacillus licheniformis for enhancing expression of glucose 6-phosphate dehydrogenase in heterologous protein production
abstract: The invention relates to the field of bacillus licheniformis genetic engineering modification and protein efficient expression, and discloses application of bacillus licheniformis for enhancing expression of glucose 6-phosphate dehydrogenase Zwf in heterologous protein production. The glucose 6-phosphate dehydrogenase gene zwf in the bacillus licheniformis WX-02 is enhanced and expressed by a genetic engineering method, the bacillus licheniformis WX-02-zwf enhanced and expressed by the gene zwf is successfully obtained, and on the basis, trypsin SgT free expression plasmid pHY-AprE, a nattokinase expression vector pP43SacCNK and an alkaline protease free expression vector pHY-AprE are transferred. Compared with a control strain, the engineering strain constructed by the invention has a remarkable effect in improving the protease activity, and the enzyme activity is improved by 28% or above.

abstract: [0001]    The present invention provides compositions and methods for regulating expression of nucleotide sequences in fungi. titulo: GENETIC SYSTEM FOR THE PRODUCTION OF LEUPEPTIN AND ITS USE FOR HETEROLOGOUS PROTEIN PRODUCTION.
abstract: The present invention describes the discovery of the genes that direct the biosynthetic pathway of leupeptin, a potent protease inhibitor of the type of small peptide aldehyde (SPA). The prediction of genes that direct the biosynthesis of leupeptin was performed by EvoMining, a bioinformatic pipe for genome data mining of natural products based on evolutionary parameters and was confirmed by molecular biology techniques such as insertional mutagenesis and the comparison of metabolomic profiles between wild strains (producers of leupeptin) and mutants (non producers of leupeptin). Biosynthetic genes of leupeptin were cloned and expressed heterologously in other expression systems of bacterial origin, thus achieving the production of leupeptin. It also describes the design of a cassette for heterologous production of leupeptin and its use for producing leupeptin and variants of it using synthetic biology, and to produce recombinant proteins.

titulo: GENETIC SYSTEM FOR PRODUCING A PROTEASES INHIBITOR OF A SMALL PEPTIDE ALDEHYDE TYPE.
abstract: The present invention describes a new peptide aldehyde produced naturally by Streptomyces lividans 66, which we have called livipeptin. Using genome mining of natural products, we predicted that SLl0883-5 genes encode an unprecedented biosynthetic system, unusually small (4.6 Kbp), which produces an acylated peptide aldehyde. Because of the chemical characteristics of the predicted compound, we postulated its anti-proteolytic activity, which we confirmed by identifying and purifying this compound through metabolic profiles of HPLC and MS of the mutated strain lacking these three genes and the wild strain. To this objective, we identified the conditions wherein these genes are strongly expressed. The livipeptin was purified and its inhibitory activity on the proteolytic activity of selected proteases was demonstrated in vitro. The design of an expression cassette for its heterologous expression is also described plus its use for heterologous protein production.

titulo: OPTIMISATION D'UNE SÉQUENCE DE CODAGE POUR L'EXPRESSION FONCTIONNELLE DE PROTÉINES
abstract: The present invention relates to an approach aimed at the modification of codons in individual polynucleotide sequences encoding a heterologous protein of interest, without altering the amino acid sequence of the polypeptide to enhance the amount of functional expression in a host organism of interest. In its broadest aspect, this approach exploits redundancy in the genetic code by providing a universal set of codons which may be used at certain positions in the polynucleotide sequence in order to achieve improved heterologous protein production in a range of host cells. The present invention also relates to specific codons which may be used to increase protein expression in particular hosts. The present invention also relates to the optimization of the translation efficiency of messenger RNAs on the basis of their secondary structure characteristics, and the provided set of criteria may be used to increase protein expression in particular hosts.

abstract: Provided is a method which comprises developing a high-expression promoter of Pseudozyma antarctica, constructing a heterologous protein production system with the use of the obtained high-expression promoter, and then efficiently producing an enzyme using a strain belonging to the order Ustilaginales including a yeast of the genus Pseudozyma.
